jobs.title: Manager, Field Engineering - Global Telecommunications
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Texas

FEQ227R233
MANAGER, FIELD ENGINEERING

About the Role

As a Manager, Field Engineering, you will lead a team of technical customer advisors who help organizations solve complex data, analytics, and AI challenges. You will work closely with Sales and cross-functional partners to translate customer priorities into effective technical strategies, strong customer outcomes, and durable business impact.

This role is typically aligned to an account district, patch, segment, or comparable portfolio and leads a team of approximately 8–10 Field Engineering professionals. You will stay close to the work while building the coaching, operating, and collaboration practices that enable your team to succeed.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing and inclusive Field Engineering team.
  • Partner with account teams to define technical-win strategy, qualify opportunities, prioritize customer needs, and align team resources.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including Director-, Head of, and VP-level audiences as appropriate to the engagement.
  • Guide discovery, solution strategy, architecture discussions, adoption planning, and value realization for customer engagements.
  • Establish regular operating rhythms to inspect progress, customer health, technical risk, escalations, capacity, and business impact.
  • Coach team members to communicate clearly, navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and connect technical recommendations to business outcomes.
  • Maintain technical credibility across Databricks platform concepts, data and AI technologies, cloud architecture, governance, security, and networking.
  • Represent customer needs internally and partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, Marketing, and Partners to resolve issues and improve outcomes.
  • Create a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, accountability, continuous learning, and recognition.
  • Experiment with AI-enabled tools and repeatable practices that improve team productivity and customer impact.

What We Look For

  • Experience leading technical customer-facing professionals in enterprise software, cloud, data, AI, analytics, technical consulting, or a related environment.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching, motivating, and retaining strong technical talent.
  • Ability to provide timely feedback, hold clear career conversations, recognize contributions, and address performance issues directly and compassionately.
  • Strong customer-advisory skills, including discovery, executive communication, technical storytelling, and value-based solutioning.
  • Practical technical judgment and the ability to coach team members through architecture, deployment, adoption, and risk discussions.
  • Operational discipline: you use data and inspection mechanisms to identify issues, make priorities visible, remove blockers, and drive predictable execution.
  • An AI-first, builder mindset: you learn quickly, test new approaches, incorporate feedback, and use AI to improve customer and team outcomes.
  • Demonstrated alignment with Databricks Culture Principles, including humility, curiosity, transparency, inclusion, and accountability.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience managing or leading a technical customer-facing team.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams through complex, multi-stakeholder customer engagements.
  • Experience in data platforms, analytics, AI, cloud, software, technical consulting, or a related technical domain.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks or comparable data and AI platforms.
  • Experience building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience using data, automation, or AI-enabled tools to improve team effectiveness.
  • Experience supporting customers across multiple use cases, technical environments, or business functions.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition | Remote | Sweden
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sweden (Remote)

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity 

Grafana Labs is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Acquisition based in Sweden who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the Nordics. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals
  • Outbound prospecting into net-new customers
  • Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)
  • Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads
  • Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise
  • Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce
  • Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)
  • Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player
  • Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies
  • You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually
  • Fluent in English and Swedish (both written and spoken)

 Bonus Points For: 

  • Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage
  • Experience using Salesforce
  • Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal
  • Fluency in Danish and/or Norwegian (both written and spoken)

Compensation & Rewards 

In Sweden, the OTE compensation range for this role is SEK 2,016,000 - SEK 2,546,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's Enterprise Solutions team partners with Global grocery and retail chains to power their digital commerce through StorefrontPro, Enterprise API (Fulfillment and Ads), CarrotAds, and adjacent Enterprise Solutions  products. We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the  Customer Success organization — accountable for post-live value realization  across the enterprise software portfolio.

In this highly visible role, you will lead senior managers and Customer Success Managers who serve as the strategic advisor of Instacart to retailer executives. You'll own retailer value realization, measured through adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score coverage, at-risk portfolio management, CSAT, and QBR quality across the portfolio. You'll partner closely with Business Development, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness. You'll also partner with Enterprise Solutions Delivery, Technology leadership, and Product on portfolio strategy, retailer signal, and roadmap adoption.

This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Solutions , and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

About the Job

  • Lead the Customer Success organization for the Enterprise Solutions  portfolio — owning value realization,  outcomes end to end, and partner closely with BD, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness.Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping Customer Success Managers  who engage with retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.
  • Manage senior managers leading segments, setting standards for what good looks like across the CSM’s  — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.
  • Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.
  • Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team ( CS + Technical Account Managers (TAM’s) ) functions as one team to the retailer despite the functional ownership, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.
  • Define and enforce the CSM/TAM boundary based on segmentation — CSM’s lead retailer-executive engagement, value realization, and growth planning, while TAM’s own technical delivery, configuration, and issue resolution, so that CSM capacity stays focused on strategic advisory, not technical execution.
  • Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function.
  • Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.
  • Operationalize the retailer segmented  model in CS — applying high-touch coverage and scaled/digital-first models, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.
  • Build a structured retailer-signal feedback loop into Product — using CS engagements to surface durable patterns (not anecdotes), instrument adoption of roadmap items, and hold CS accountable for adoption outcomes.
  • Apply AI augmentation to scale CS coverage and quality without linear headcount growth — including health monitoring, account-prep automation, QBR/insight generation, and signal triage — partnering with the Technical org on tooling roadmap and adoption.
  • Represent the post-sale narrative for the portfolio to senior leadership — integrating retention, growth, churn risk, executive-account temperature, and pipeline outlook — and serve as the Director-level escalation point for retailer relationships when CSM-led engagement is insufficient.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of enterprise customer success, account management, or post-sale leadership at a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company.
  • Direct, accountable leadership of a customer success organization responsible for adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score, at-risk portfolio, CSAT, QBR quality and support BD with GRR, NRR, and expansion.
  • Track record of managing managers with demonstrated ability to set standards and develop senior leaders without micromanagement.
  • Ownership of a CS book of business or post-sale P&L of meaningful scale (e.g., $1000M+ ARR) with documented outcomes on Adoption, NRR, GRR, or expansion.
  • Proven success operating in a BD- or Sales-led commercial environment — clear instinct for where the CS lane begins and ends, comfort with shared standards rather than rigid RACI/process.
  • Demonstrated executive presence with enterprise customer counterparts (VP / SVP / C-level), including the ability to deliver hard news, navigate escalations, and rebuild trust after issues.
  • Experience designing and operating segmented  CS coverage models (high-touch for strategic accounts, scaled/digital for the long tail), including capacity planning and exception handling.
  • Hands-on experience hiring senior CS  talent — with a clear point of view on profile, comp, and ramp.
  • Strong background  having operated in an  end to end post sales service delivery ecosystem with strong CS interaction with Business Development/Sales, Delivery, Technical and Product teams. Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transforming a CS function from reactive enablement into proactive business advisory, including the talent, comp, operating-model, and tooling changes required (not a renaming exercise).
  • Track record of building or scaling seasoned strategist roles inside a CS org — including hiring profile, ramp, comp design, and integration with the rest of the account team.
  • Experience operating with a separate technical TAM function on shared enterprise accounts — including co-authoring cross-org protocols and managing escalations across an org boundary.
  • Background applying AI to CS workflows — health monitoring, account preparation, QBR generation, signal triage — with measurable impact on coverage, throughput, or quality.
  • Familiarity with the BD/CS interface in commercially complex enterprise sales motions, including renewals, multi-product expansion, and shared-account operating norms.
  • Deep familiarity with enterprise retail, grocery, ecommerce platforms, retail media, or adjacent complex B2B domains — including how large retailers evaluate, adopt, and scale technology solutions.
  • Experience instrumenting retailer signal into structured product feedback (not anecdotal) and partnering with Product leaders on adoption accountability.

#LI-Remote



Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

CAN
$230,000—$242,500 CAD

jobs.title: Product Quality Manager, Home Lending & Auto
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States | Remote

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Upstart’s Secured Lending Quality team is responsible for building and operating the first line of defense quality control program across Upstart’s secured lending products, including Home Lending and Auto Lending. The team ensures loans meet high standards for accuracy, compliance, and salability through a multi-layered quality framework spanning origination, servicing, collections, and non-performing loan monitoring. The team operates independently from production management, providing credible challenges to the business while using AI-powered technology to deliver scalable, examination-ready quality assurance.

As the Secured Lending Quality Manager, you will lead quality control execution across the secured product portfolio, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance monitoring and testing, servicing and collections quality reviews, non-performing loan reviews, and investor defect analysis. You will serve as a key leader in strengthening Upstart’s quality infrastructure, partner closely with Operations, Compliance, Legal, and Risk, and help scale a modern, data-driven quality program in a fast-moving lending environment. This is an opportunity for an experienced quality leader who is energized by building programs from the ground up and improving how quality is measured, monitored, and operationalized across the secured lending lifecycle.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead execution of Upstart’s secured lending quality control program across origination, servicing, and collections, including pre-close and post-close reviews, compliance testing, denied/withdrawn application reviews, investor defect analysis, and non-performing loan reviews
  • Oversee QC sampling methodology and ensure risk-based, statistically sound sample selection aligned with regulatory expectations
  • Serve as product owner for the QC Engine, including rule approval, output validation, threshold calibration, and performance reporting
  • Drive root cause analysis and remediation for defect trends, investor kickouts, repurchase demands, early payment defaults, and other quality issues
  • Develop quality reporting, dashboards, and trend analyses for senior leadership, including defect trends, escape rates, cure rates, sampling coverage, and corrective action status
  • Prepare the Quality function for audits and regulatory exams through strong documentation, evidence management, and examination-ready processes
  • Partner with Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk, and servicing teams to align on quality standards, escalation paths, and remediation timelines
  • Oversee third-party, subservicer, servicing, and collections quality reviews, including compliance with applicable consumer lending requirements
  • Support model risk monitoring through quality reviews tied to credit decisioning, adverse action accuracy, and early default trends

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 7+ years of experience in quality control, compliance testing, or risk management in consumer lending, including secured lending products such as mortgage, home equity, or auto
  • 2+ years of experience leading a QC team or managing quality analysts or auditors
  • Experience conducting pre-close and post-close file reviews, defect identification, root cause analysis, and corrective action management
  • Experience with regulatory exams and responses involving agencies such as the OCC, FDIC, CFPB, or state regulators
  • Experience designing or implementing QC sampling methodologies, including random and risk-based sampling
  • Experience with non-performing loan reviews, early default analysis, repurchase reviews, or servicing quality oversight
  • Working knowledge of key consumer lending regulations applicable to secured products
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AI-powered or automated QC tools
  • Experience with investor delivery requirements, repurchase demands, or loan buybacks
  • Experience with third-party and subservicer oversight frameworks
  • Experience building dashboards, executive reporting, or board-ready quality materials
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical QC procedures and testing frameworks
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills in a fast-paced lending environment

 

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote 

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

 

 

 

#LI-MidSenior 

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.  The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

The Core Pricing Team is responsible for building a best-in-class platform to accurately create loan offers for all of Upstart’s loan products like Personal Loans, Auto loans and Home loans. jobs.title: Sr. Director Revenue Accounting
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US Remote

Senior Director, Revenue Accounting

 

Bitwarden is looking for a Sr. Director of Revenue Accounting to own how we recognize, record, and report revenue across both self-service and sales-assisted channels. This leader is accountable for the full revenue cycle, from contract and invoice through cash and recognized revenue. You will own our revenue stack (Stripe, HubSpot, and Rillet) end to end and partner closely with Sales, Legal, FP&A, and Engineering.

 

What You'll Own:

 

  • Own end-to-end order to cash operations for both self-service (PLG, credit card, via Stripe) and sales-assisted (enterprise, multi-year, custom contract) revenue streams.
  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for self-service and sales-assisted contracts, including performance obligations, standalone selling price, contract modifications, multi-year and ramped deals, usage-based components, and channel or reseller arrangements.
  • Own deferred revenue, revenue schedules, and the monthly revenue close in Rillet, and deliver accurate revenue results to Corporate Accounting for month-end close.
  • Design billing and revenue processes for large, complex transactions: multi-entity contracts, custom pricing, mid-term upgrades and downgrades, true-ups, and co-terming, from HubSpot deal creation through Stripe invoicing to Rillet recognition.
  • Own the data flow and reconciliation across HubSpot, Stripe, and Rillet, including the bookings to billings to revenue reconciliation, the deferred revenue rollforward, and AR subledger to general ledger tie-outs.
  • Own sales tax compliance across all channels, including nexus monitoring, tax calculation and collection in Stripe, exemption certificate management, return filing and remittance, and audit readiness, in partnership with external tax advisors.
  • Write technical accounting memos for non-standard enterprise contracts and review them with external auditors.
  • Own SOX controls for the revenue cycle and serve as the main contact for audit fieldwork on revenue.
  • Define and monitor KPIs: billing accuracy, days sales outstanding, dunning/failed payment recovery rate, invoice cycle time, and dispute rates.
  • Partner with Sales to structure non-standard enterprise deals so they translate cleanly into accurate, compliant billing in Stripe.
  • Own sales commission accounting and administration, including commission calculations and payouts, ASC 340-40 capitalization and amortization of commission costs, and accrual accuracy, and partner with Sales leadership, FP&A, and HR on commission plan design, quota and attainment rules, and the cost and controls impact of plan changes.
  • Drive Stripe configuration and automation (subscription schedules, proration rules, dunning/failed payment recovery, invoicing rules) to reduce manual touch on high-volume self-service billing.
  • Partner with SalesOps to own the HubSpot-to-Stripe-to-Rillet data pipeline — ensuring deal terms, billing events, and revenue entries stay in sync, and closing gaps with native integrations, middleware, or custom tooling as needed.
  • Collaborate with Product/Engineering on Stripe/product OTC enhancements, new pricing models, and packaging changes.
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a billing, collections and commission teams (analysts, specialists, managers) as transaction volume and deal complexity grow.

 

What We're Looking For:

 

  • 10+ years of accounting experience, including 5+ years in SaaS revenue accounting and 3+ years leading teams.
  • CPA or equivalent public accounting experience 
  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606 experience for SaaS, including large and non-standard enterprise transactions: custom terms, multi-year deals, usage-based or hybrid pricing, amendments, and co-terming.
  • Experience accounting for both self-service (high-volume, automated, credit-card-based) and sales-assisted (contract-based, high-value) revenue.
  • Experience with SOX, external audit management, and building controls in a growing company.
  • Experience managing billing, collections, or order-to-cash teams, and commission
  • Track record of building scalable processes and automating manual workflows, including integrations between CRM, billing, and accounting systems.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable in ambiguity and fast-changing environments.

In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team brings together Content Marketing, Brand Marketing, Portfolio Product Marketing, Copywriting, Copy Editing, and Customer Marketing. We create coherent, distinctive stories about the businesses, technologies, and economic forces shaping the internet.

What you’ll do

We are hiring a senior editorial leader to help bring original stories and insights from Stripe–based on our data, expertise, and customer conversations–to a broader audience via media partnerships and other brand marketing channels. This person will be an exceptional editor, writer, and creative partner with strong instincts about what earns attention: an argument worth making, an unexpected angle, an elegant execution, or a piece of work that people genuinely want to share.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the leader of Stripe’s Narrative & Editorial team. The role will spend most of its time shaping major external media partnerships, with the remainder split between helping with original editorial work and advising partner teams on new ideas and their execution.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the editorial and creative direction for Stripe’s most important external media partnerships, including advertising content, research-led collaborations, and original editorial programs developed with respected publishers and creators.
  • Develop work that feels native to the audience and editorial environment in which it appears—not generic brand messaging placed beside someone else’s work.
  • Turn Stripe’s original data analyses, economic insights, customer stories, and more into content pieces that are clear, surprising, useful, and memorable–and that readers and listeners won’t want to skip over.
  • Shape the full editorial process for partnership work: refining briefs, identifying the strongest ideas, directing creative development, and providing decisive feedback on drafts and final deliverables.
  • Direct and manage agencies, external creators, and editorial partners as needed, working within existing partnership structures and commercial agreements.
  • Write, edit, and materially improve high-stakes content across formats, including blog posts, newsletter segments, podcast scripts, ad copy, social posts, and more.
  • Generate original concepts for creative programs, editorial franchises, and nontraditional formats that broaden how Stripe contributes to conversations about the internet economy.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to teams across Stripe, helping them clarify ideas, find the strongest expression of their work, and make better creative decisions.
  • Partner with colleagues in Brand Marketing, Brand Design, Content Marketing, Portfolio PMM, Copywriting, and Customer Marketing to make Stripe’s storytelling more coherent and distinctive.
  • Define and uphold a clear quality bar for editorial and partnership work, making well-reasoned calls about what is ready to represent Stripe and what still needs improvement.

Who you are

We are looking for someone with exceptional editorial judgment and a demonstrated ability to make complicated ideas compelling. You may have developed that experience in a newsroom, independent publication, creative studio, agency, research institution, technology company, or another rigorous creative environment.

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience in editorial, writing, creative development, journalism, publishing, media, brand strategy, or a closely related field. This may include experience writing consistently for a large online followership, even if not professionally.
  • You have an exceptional portfolio of published or public-facing work that demonstrates strong writing and editing, original thinking, and an ability to make ideas resonate with an audience.
  • You are, in the best sense, very online: an active reader of and contributor to the newsletters, social platforms, and niche communities where people debate new ideas about technology, economics, science, business, and culture. You can spot emerging arguments, voices, and formats early—and engage with them authentically, with intellectual honesty and your own point of view.

  • You have experience developing original editorial work, sponsored media, advertising, creative partnerships, or other high-quality audience-facing programs.
  • You understand the difference between work that is merely on-message and work that is genuinely interesting, useful, or worth discussing.
  • You can translate complex subjects—including technology, business, economics, science, or policy—into work that is accessible without becoming simplistic.
  • You have strong creative instincts and a sophisticated design sensibility. You understand how language, ideas, visuals, format, and distribution work together.
  • You are deeply curious about the technology industry and the broader cultural and economic context in which it operates.
  • You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, external partners, writers, designers, marketers, and agencies without relying on formal authority.
  • You can move fluidly between strategy and execution: developing the core idea, shaping the brief, improving the draft, and making the final call on quality.
  • You have high standards, sound judgment, and enough pragmatism to help teams make excellent work within real constraints.

We're looking for a Director of Revenue Enablement to lead and scale our enablement function as Tailscale enters its next phase of growth. You'll own the strategy, team, and systems that help our revenue organization ramp faster, develop deep technical and commercial expertise, and consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

This is an opportunity to build a world-class enablement function at a high-growth, product-led company. You'll partner closely with Sales, Customer Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, skills, and tools to effectively engage technical buyers, communicate the value of Tailscale's platform, and drive meaningful customer outcomes.

We're looking for someone who thinks beyond traditional training programs. As AI transforms how teams learn, engage customers, and work, you'll define the next generation of enablement at Tailscale, building scalable, AI-powered systems that accelerate productivity, deepen technical expertise, and keep pace with our rapidly evolving product and GTM motions.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership, strong commercial instincts, technical aptitude, and a builder's mentality. You've successfully scaled enablement in a high-growth environment, understand what great customer-facing execution looks like across both sales and technical roles, and are energized by rethinking how enablement operates.

Key Responsibilities

Build and Lead Revenue Enablement
  • Define and execute a multi-quarter enablement strategy aligned with Tailscale's revenue priorities and growth objectives.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing enablement team, establishing scalable processes, clear priorities, and accountability.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to revenue leadership, identifying capability gaps and connecting enablement investments to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build scalable enablement systems that support rapid headcount growth, increasing product complexity, and the evolving needs of our customer-facing organization.
Accelerate Onboarding and Continuous Development

  • Build scalable learning paths, competency frameworks, and certifications that accelerate ramp time and drive continuous skill development.
  • Partner with frontline managers to establish coaching frameworks and reinforce learning through everyday workflows.
Drive Sales and Technical Excellence

  • Partner with technical leaders to build enablement programs covering product architecture, technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept execution.
  • Establish role-specific proficiency standards, playbooks, and certifications that improve commercial and technical effectiveness across the customer lifecycle.
Connect Product Innovation to Field Readiness
  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and technical leaders to establish a repeatable product launch readiness framework.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into relevant learning experiences, messaging, and resources tailored to commercial and technical audiences.
  • Maintain scalable content and knowledge systems while establishing feedback loops to continuously improve field readiness.
Reimagine Enablement Through AI and Automation
  • Define and execute an AI-first enablement strategy that transforms how teams learn, practice, access knowledge, and improve performance.
  • Implement AI-powered workflows across onboarding, coaching, technical learning, and knowledge management to personalize development and accelerate productivity.
  • Partner cross-functionally to embed intelligent guidance into everyday workflows and drive adoption of emerging technologies.
Measure Impact and Drive Continuous Improvement
  • Establish metrics connecting enablement programs to ramp time, role proficiency, quota attainment, win rates, and customer-facing productivity.
  • Leverage performance data, conversation intelligence, and qualitative feedback to identify gaps and continuously improve programs.
  • Own the enablement technology strategy and lead readiness initiatives for key revenue events, including Sales Kickoff and technical bootcamps.

  • 10+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, technical enablement, sales leadership, or related GTM functions at B2B technology companies, including experience building and leading teams.

  • Deep expertise in adult learning, instructional design, and competency development, with a track record of driving measurable improvements in performance.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience reinforcing sales methodology, developing customer-facing skills, and improving revenue productivity.
  • An AI-first, systems-oriented mindset, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and scalable processes to improve learning and productivity.
  • A data-driven approach, with demonstrated success measuring enablement effectiveness and connecting programs to business outcomes.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical audiences, advise executives, and drive organizational change.
  • A builder's mentality, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, high ownership, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Bonus Points

  • Background in technical presales, Customer Engineering, or quota-carrying sales roles.

APAC represents an important growth opportunity for Tailscale. We have strong conviction in the region and are looking for a leader who can turn that opportunity into a meaningful, durable business: building pipeline and revenue, developing a strong partner ecosystem, winning strategic customers, and building the team we need to scale.

We are looking for someone who has built a region before and wants to do it again from scratch. You will have significant autonomy to determine what Tailscale needs to win in the region.

You will also be a hands-on commercial leader. You’ll spend time with customers and partners, help shape and close our most important opportunities, and develop a deep understanding of how technology companies need to go to market differently across APAC. You’ll bring those insights back to our global Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams and help Tailscale become a truly global company.

In this role, you will be able to hire the team you need to succeed. We suspect that will include Sales Development, Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, and Partner Marketing, but ultimately we will be open to your recommendation based on expertise. These hires will report directly to you with dotted lines to functional departments in North America and EMEA. You’ll lead that team as a region, while working closely with their functional counterparts elsewhere at Tailscale. This role will report to Tailscale’s President, Kevin Kotecki.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and execute Tailscale’s APAC go-to-market strategy. Determine which markets, customer segments, use cases, and routes to market offer the greatest opportunity for Tailscale.   • Build a high-performing regional GTM organization. Recruit, lead, and develop exceptional sellers and other customer-facing talent in the region. Build a team that operates as one APAC organization while remaining tightly connected to its global functional counterparts. Create the culture, operating rhythms, and accountability required for a small regional team to move quickly and perform at a high level.
  • Lead from the front with customers. Personally engage in Tailscale’s most important opportunities in the region. Build relationships with senior technical and business leaders, help the team navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, and serve as executive sponsor for strategic customers. Stay close enough to the market to know why we are winning, why we are losing, and what needs to change.
  • Build Tailscale’s presence in the region. Establish Tailscale as a credible and increasingly visible technology company in APAC. Represent Tailscale with customers, partners, at industry events, and within the broader technology ecosystem. Develop the relationships and market intelligence that allow us to identify opportunities earlier than we otherwise would.
  • Be the voice of APAC inside Tailscale. Build a strong point of view on regional customers, competitors, partners, buying behavior, and market dynamics. Bring that perspective into company decisions about product, packaging, marketing, partnerships, and future investments. 
  • Build the region for the long term. We expect the shape of our APAC organization to evolve considerably. Identify what capabilities and investments we need next, make thoughtful resource tradeoffs, and build systems that can scale beyond the first phase of the Singapore office.

What We Are Looking For

  • Significant experience in enterprise technology go-to-market, with meaningful experience leading Sales or a broader GTM organization across APAC.
  • You have done this before. You have helped build or materially scale an APAC business rather than only operating within an already mature regional organization.
  • A proven track record of owning and exceeding meaningful pipeline and revenue targets in a B2B technology business.
  • Deep familiarity with the APAC technology market and experience operating successfully across multiple countries and cultures, with particularly strong knowledge of Singapore and Southeast Asia.
  • Established relationships within the regional channel and partner ecosystem, along with a track record of turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.
  • A strong network of exceptional GTM talent in the region. You know what great sellers and SEs look like and have demonstrated that you can attract them to work with you.
  • Experience leading complex enterprise opportunities personally. You are comfortable moving from regional strategy and forecasting into a customer meeting or deal review and materially improving the outcome.
  • Experience selling highly technical products to sophisticated buyers. Experience with infrastructure, networking, security, developer tools, cloud, or adjacent enterprise technology is particularly relevant.
  • Strong commercial judgment and analytical ability. You understand pipeline mathematics, forecasting, unit economics, market prioritization, and where to invest limited resources to produce the greatest return.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills. You can lead a regional team while partnering effectively with global Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations teams that you do not directly manage.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This position is based remotely in Canada.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.  

In this role, you will: 

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4).

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services. 

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation.  In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting. 
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.
  • Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.
  • Experience in project management.
  • Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.

Desired:

  • Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.  
  • Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.
  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.
  • Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.
  • Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.
  • Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting
  • Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.

Location

 This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  •  90,800.00 - CAD 113,500.00  
  • Target Bonus Percentage 15%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Professional Services & Consulting – Public Sector to lead and scale our mission-critical professional services delivery practice across US Federal, State, Local, and Education (SLED) customers. Reporting to Customer Success & Professional Services leadership within Zscaler US Government Solutions, LLC, you will direct a high-performing organization of technical architects, engagement managers, and deployment consultants. In this role, you will champion an AI-native enterprise culture, driving service delivery excellence, accelerated time-to-value, services P&L management, partner enablement, and seamless alignment with federal Zero Trust modernization mandates including OMB M-22-09 and NIST SP 800-207.

  • Oversee complex Zero Trust platform rollouts across federal civilian, defense, intelligence, and SLED agencies, ensuring deployments are executed on time, within scope, and aligned to rigorous mission requirements
  • Manage regional capacity planning, resource utilization, billable margin, and backlog retirement while partnering with FP&A and Operations to forecast revenue and headcount needs accurately
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for public sector customer leadership and strategic Federal System Integrators (FSIs), resolving delivery roadblocks and fostering trusted executive relationships
  • Align delivery methodologies with FedRAMP High, DoD IL5, CJIS, and Zero Trust standards while collaborating with systems integrators to scale ecosystem delivery capacity and quality

  • You act like an owner by taking full accountability for mission outcomes and delivery excellence, moving fluidly between strategic organizational planning and operational deep dives.
  • You are customer-obsessed, bringing deep empathy for government agency missions to ground every engagement decision in solving real-world security challenges and ensuring sustainable customer success.

  • In-depth understanding of the US Public Sector landscape, including federal procurement nuances, prime/subcontractor ecosystems, and compliance standards such as FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53/207, and DoD SRG
  • US Citizenship required with an active US Government Top Secret security clearance (or active within the past 24 months)

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience implementing AI-driven delivery frameworks, predictive analytics, or automation methodologies to optimize professional services operations and public sector outcomes
  • Deep technical familiarity with SASE, SSE, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), secure web gateway (SWG), and cloud workload protection architectures
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, or equivalent enterprise cloud security credentials
  • Demonstrated experience developing and monetizing new service offerings, packaged migration accelerators, and partner-led delivery programs

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Detection Analyst to join our team. This is a Remote (USA Only) role, reporting to the Detection Analyst Manager in the Detection Operations Team. You will utilize our advanced detection platform to analyze EDR telemetry, alerts, and log sources across key detection domains—including Endpoint, Identity, Network, and Cloud—to identify and publish threats for our Managed Detection and Response customers. 

By driving projects that improve our workflow through orchestration and automation, you will ensure our customers receive high-fidelity threat analysis and concise, actionable communication regarding emerging threats at scale.

Shift expectations -10 hours a day 4 days a week Sunday - Wednesday , 3am to 1pm MT. 

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Analyze EDR telemetry, alerts, and log sources across several detection domains including Endpoint, Identity, Network, and Cloud/SaaS
  • Publish threats for customers using concisely written communication to effectively convey key indicators and remediation context
  • Improve the Detection Operations workflow through orchestration and automation to manage high volumes of telemetry

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team and embraces a challenge culture by giving and receiving candid, respectful feedback.
  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy to anchor your decisions in solving real-world problems and championing customer needs from start to finish.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.
  • You operate with urgency and a relentless focus on execution, understanding that delivering high-impact results quickly wins for both the customer and the team.
  • You are data-driven, leveraging analytics to find the truth, measure what matters, and guide informed decisions that consistently drive better outcomes.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Strong experience in Endpoint (EDR) and one or more functional areas including Cloud/SaaS, Identity, Email, or Network detection domains
  • Expertise using query languages and understanding syntax across EDR or other security platforms such as SQL or Lucene

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Practical experience applying AI-driven tools or automated workflows to accelerate threat detection and security engineering
  • Previous professional experience in a Red Team or offensive security capacity
  • Active involvement in the Infosec community through writing blogs, participating in webinars, or presenting at conferences

This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

  • Tap into your creative side to build programs that tell the Glean story and capture the attention of our target audience
  • Innovate and experiment with both in-person and virtual programs
  • Own programs end-to-end in a fast-paced environment with excellent attention to detail and execution
  • Objectively evaluate the ROI on programs and adjust tactics to drive true revenue results for the company
  • Act as the intermediary between the marketing and field sales teams to ensure alignment and understanding of programs, goals, and outcomes
  • Travel required ~30-40% of the time

About you:

  • 4+ years experience in a B2B SaaS field marketing or events role
  • Deadline-driven mindset with ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities on your own
  • High comfort level communicating with various stakeholders across marketing, sales, customer success, product, executive leadership, and our customers
  • Experience in creating and implementing successful field marketing programs that generate high value, and high intent leads
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on relationship-building
  • You might describe yourself as “type A” because you have exceptional project management skills and extreme attention to detail
  • Ability to thoughtfully push pack on various business stakeholders, make data driven decisions, and look for business justification

Location: 

  • This role is remote based in Chicago, Texas, Nashville or a Central US state 
  • This role requires up to 30%-40% travel

The standard base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $145,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team 

The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

About the role

Affirm seeks a practical, proactive, and people-oriented transactional attorney to join our Vendor Legal team. You are pragmatic, solutions-oriented, and comfortable balancing risk with business velocity in a high-growth, technology-driven environment. You will partner closely with Procurement, Financial Partnerships, and other cross‑functional teams to negotiate a range of vendor transactions. In addition to managing a busy deal pipeline, you will help design and improve processes, playbooks, and programs that increase efficiency so the team can scale with company growth. This is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the Vendor Legal team from the ground up.

What you'll do

  • Lead negotiation, drafting, and execution of a wide range of vendor agreements, including marketing tech, technology services, cloud services, SaaS, data platform, contractor, creative, lease, and payment processing engagements. Manage a high volume of deals with speed and sound judgment

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve playbooks, contract templates, negotiation guides, and other projects that enable the team to operate efficiently at scale. Identify friction points and build solutions that reduce cycle time without sacrificing quality

  • Work closely with Procurement, Financial Partnerships, Engineering, Product, Finance, Information Security, Privacy, and other teams to provide clear, practical guidance

  • Serve as a proactive, strategic business partner to stakeholders across the organization

  • Develop and deliver training and resources that empower business partners to self-serve on routine commercial legal matters, increasing team capacity and reducing bottlenecks

  • JD and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar

  • 5+ years of relevant transactional experience in-house at a technology company or in a technology practice group at a top law firm

  • Exceptional drafting skills

  • Experience in marketing tech, adtech, fintech, payments, or financial services

  • Experience supporting global or multi-jurisdictional transactions  (e.g., Canada, US, UK/EU, Australia)

  • Collaborative working style, with experience guiding cross-functional teams toward practical, win-win outcomes

  • Intellectual curiosity and creative problem-solving instincts: you learn new products and business models quickly and enjoy finding solutions to novel challenges

  • Proactive, self-starter mentality with a bias for action

Headquarters: Remote

About the team:

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information. 

About the role:

Rubrik is seeking a Senior Commercial Compliance Analyst to lead Commercial Audit and Certification Management. In this role, you will own Rubrik's portfolio of security certifications and coordinated audits end-to-end, from evidence collection through auditor management to final report delivery, ensuring audit readiness is continuous and audit findings are tracked to closure.

What you'll do:

  • Own the audit and certification calendar across Rubrik's active portfolio: SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, CSA STAR Level 1 and Level 2, TISAX Level 1 and Level 2, HITRUST, HIPAA.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, managing scoping, fieldwork, evidence requests, and remediation of findings through to closure.
  • Maintain the mapping between compliance controls and underlying evidence sources so audit readiness is continuous rather than a point-in-time scramble.
  • Drive coordinated audit strategy, consolidating overlapping evidence requests across frameworks to reduce duplicate work for control owners.
  • Lead evaluation and scoping of emerging and planned certifications to support Rubrik's international and AI governance expansion.
  • Manage the lifecycle of certifications end-to-end, including retirements and transitions
  • Track and report audit status, findings, and remediation progress to leadership, using the team's Jira-based tracking dashboards.
  • Partner with control owners across InfoSec, IT, Legal, and Engineering to gather evidence and close audit findings on schedule.
  • Collaborate with Risk Management to ensure audit findings feed into the broader risk register and remediation lifecycle (RMLC).
  • Support Customer Trust Enablement by ensuring audit and certification outputs are readily usable to answer customer security inquiries.
  • Leverage AI and automation to streamline evidence gathering, control testing, and audit workflows.

Experience you'll need:

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, audit management, or GRC
  • Hands-on experience managing SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 audits, plus at least one additional framework
