jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Team

Pinterest's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the platforms that every engineer at Pinterest uses to build, test, ship and run software. Our CI and deployment platforms handle the journey of every change from commit to production. We're investing heavily in making that journey faster, more efficient and safe by default, especially as AI-assisted development sharply increases how much we ship. We work closely with engineering teams across Pinterest to make sure the platform scales with the business.

What You'll Do

  • Lead cross-team programs that make production changes safe by default, driving adoption of progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis and fast rollback across code, config, data and ML model deployments.
  • Drive the CI platform roadmap to reduce build cost and wait times, improve fleet utilization and migrate CI workloads to our next-generation compute platform.
  • Define and track the delivery and reliability metrics that measure success, such as change failure rate, recovery time, lead time for change and build performance, and build dashboards that surface regressions early.
  • Manage dependencies and migrations across CI, artifact, deployment and compute platforms and the many service teams that depend on them.
  • Influence engineering teams across Pinterest to adopt new standards and paved paths, managing timelines, pushback and risk.
  • Communicate technical tradeoffs among velocity, safety, cost and reliability clearly to audiences from individual engineers to senior leadership.
  • Use GenAI as the default operating model for program execution: produce AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, turn high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (for example, intake triage, status synthesis, action and decision extraction, and risk and dependency tracking), and synthesize signals to surface risks, tradeoffs and escalation paths early.
  • Prototype solutions that improve decisions with data (dashboards, analysis) or simplify processes (workflow helpers, internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding").
  • Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance and safety by design: handle sensitive data appropriately, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions and limits, and make sure AI-assisted workflows meet policy and compliance expectations before broad adoption.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of TPM experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer productivity or SRE.
  • A solid understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure and safe-deployment practices (canaries, progressive delivery, automated rollback), and the tradeoffs between velocity and safety.
  • A track record of driving platform or standards adoption across many engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience defining delivery and reliability metrics (for example, DORA metrics) and using data to drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including giving clear, candid status and risk updates to senior leadership.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a broad mandate, define the plan and measures of success, and drive it to outcomes.
  • Experience with infrastructure efficiency, compute cost or capacity planning is a plus.
  • Workflow design, AI fluency, and a data-and-insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decisions using GenAI (for example, strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts or tools, dashboards, data analysis and using agents where appropriate).
  • Safety-by-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, output validation, auditability) and recognizing where AI use isn't appropriate or needs extra controls.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience.

Join us and help shape the future of Pinterest's infrastructure!

You'll own full-cycle searches across our sales organization, from high-volume roles like Sales Development Representatives to Account Executives and post-sales roles like Relationship Managers and Account Development. jobs.title: Senior Training Specialist
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Training Specialist to join our Operations, Client Support team. This role would be responsible for developing and delivering impactful training programs that drive employee performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across Client and Provider Support. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, adaptable, and passionate about learning and development, and is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Instructional Design and Training
    • Design, develop, and maintain training programs for Client Support and Provider Support, including new-hire onboarding, role-specific training, certifications, process and system training, and ongoing upskilling.
    • Create engaging learning experiences across a variety of formats, including self-paced eLearning, instructor-led materials, job aids, tutorials, demonstrations, assessments, and interactive activities.
    • Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to ensure training is engaging, accessible, and aligned with defined learning and business outcomes.
    • Continuously review and refresh curriculum based on learner feedback, performance data, process changes, and evolving business needs.
    • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, new-hire nesting, demonstrations, guided practice, and other learning experiences for Client Support and Provider Support.
  • Training Administration and Learning Systems
    • Manage training assignments, enrollments, completion tracking, attendance, and learner progress through the LMS and other internal systems.
    • Coordinate training schedules and communicate training requirements and expectations to learners, Supervisors, and other stakeholders.
    • Maintain accurate training documentation and provide completion and learner performance information to relevant stakeholders.
  • Data Analysis & Performance Optimization
    • Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, operational data, and other performance indicators.
    • Use data to identify knowledge and skill gaps, recommend learning interventions, and continuously improve training programs.
    • Maintain department skill assessments and skill matrices to support curriculum development, employee growth, and future training needs.
    • Track and communicate training initiatives, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Strategic Partnership
    • Partner with Client Support and Provider Support leadership to identify learning opportunities and develop strategies that address knowledge and performance needs.
    • Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional partners to translate complex processes, workflows, systems, and business requirements into clear and effective learning experiences.
    • Serve as a trusted training resource during organizational, process, and system changes, helping teams successfully adopt new expectations and workflows.
    • Contribute to training standards, best practices, and broader learning initiatives across the organization.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You 

  • Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Learning & Development, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in instructional design, training, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering training for adult learners, including self-paced eLearning and instructor-led training.
  • Experience with eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Rise, Storyline, Captivate, or similar platforms, as well as Learning Management Systems.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to translate complex processes and information into clear, engaging learning experiences.
  • Data-driven approach to evaluating training effectiveness and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, customer support, contact center, or operations environments preferred.

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $70,000 - $80,000/yr. Within the range, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace, a UHS company, is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer - Public Sector
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, US, Virginia

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Senior Value Engineer 

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the public sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do:

  • Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.
  • Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.
  • Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.
  • Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.
  • Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.
  • AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value, proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.
  • Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 
  • Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English [and native-level local language] communication with commanding executive presence.
  • Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of Financial processes in the public sector domain. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.
  • Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics,  comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor
  • Must possess an active Security Clearance - Secret or Top Secret is preferred 

         Sponsorship is not offered for this role

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our team. This individual will play a key role in designing, building, and scaling the core applications and services that power our platform. The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineer looking to build 0 to 1. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare. As a senior member of the team, you'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions while helping shape technical standards and best practices across the organization.

This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Skills
    • Writes correct and consistent code using both knowledge and expertise (backend, frontend, and devops).
    • Develops and maintains full-stack web applications using React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend.
    • Designs, builds, and integrates APIs and backend services to support product functionality and system integrations.
    • Reviews code efficiently and give feedback on it.
    • Understands industry standards and consistently keeps informed of upcoming trends.
  • Communication and Leadership
    • Communicates and justifies technical decisions via design docs, tech talks and documentation.
    • Mentors Junior Engineers via Pairing, Feedback, PR Review and 1:1's.
    • Communicates effectively cross-functionally to the Product team, his manager, and business if needed.
    • Proactively identifies problems with requirements for and his own projects and the engineers they support and communicates it to stakeholders.
  • Project Management
    • Delivers complex product to QA that is fully developed and bug-free.
    • Takes initiative to fix bugs, open tickets and improve code when needed
    • Persistent in the face of roadblocks, knows when to pull others to solve the problem if needed.
  • Impact
    • End-to-end responsibility for getting production-ready features to the finish line.
    • Identifies problems and potential risks in his code and others.
    • Helps keep consistency and quality in the code base with PR overview and feedback.
    • Helps enforce proper QA for all products that he is involved in.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You 

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering or Math.
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software
  • 5+ years of professional experience working in both react and node.js

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 3%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount! 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $146,000 - $180,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace, a UHS company, is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Experience (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: -REMOTE, USA-

For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smart Assist is Smartsheet's AI agent for work management, used by enterprise customers to analyze, create, and act on their work. AI Experiences builds the orchestration for Smart Assist and the user-facing implementations that expose Smartsheet's Intelligent Work capabilities to any AI surface, so users can reach the right intelligence at the right time through a coherent, reliable experience.

AI Experiences is a pillar within Applied AI, and this is a full-stack team. The work spans these areas: the Smart Assist frontend (UI components, interaction patterns, and rendering for AI experiences across Smartsheet); the Smart Assist backend and orchestrator; UX for Smart Assist tools and agents, from response formatting and onboarding to error states. On the backend, the orchestrator routes each request to the right sub-agent based on user intent, keeps conversation state across multi-turn interactions, handles fallbacks when sub-agents are unavailable, and controls feature-flagged rollout of new capabilities. We partner closely with Agent Engineering on much of this logic.

The role. You will own features and components of Smart Assist from prototype to production, across the front end, the orchestrator and back-end services. You will turn ambiguous product asks into reliable, well-measured behavior customers can trust, and work with product, design, and AI Experience to ship.

You Will:

  • Own a core piece of the Smartsheet AI experience, or a significant part of one (for example conversational analytics, chart-to-dashboard creation, or a new entry point into the assistant) from design through production.
  • Build full-stack: user-facing components, the services behind them, and the contracts between the two, with typed APIs, clear error states, and tests.
  • Design and ship agent tools, skills, MCP tools, and MCP Apps with contracts the model can use reliably, and decide when an action belongs in a tool, a service, or the model.
  • Shape how agent output appears to users: streaming responses, loading and failure states, and handling of long or partial results, working with design and product.
  • Build and evolve the Smart Assist orchestrator: intent-based routing to sub-agents, multi-turn conversation state, fallback and degradation handling, and feature-flag rollout of new capabilities, partnering closely with Agent Engineering. Populate the context the agent receives, such as user locale, timezone, and workspace state.
  • Define how quality is measured for your area: build golden cases and scorers, set regression gates, and use traces and production signals to decide whether a failure needs a prompt, tool, context, or UI fix.
  • Instrument features with tracing, structured logs, and latency, cost, and error dashboards, and act on what they show.
  • Take part in on-call, security, and cost work for Smart Assist, shared with Agent Engineering. Reproduce production failures and review code for your team.
  • Partner with PMs, designers, Agent Engineering, AI Platform, MCP, and data teams. Learn how customers use what you build and flag gaps in requirements and tests.
  • Use AI coding tools to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.

What we're building next:

Our goal for the coming year is to make Smart Assist safe to trust and hard to leave. You will help shape work across four themes:

  • Be everywhere: an assistant that understands what you are looking at, such as the rows you have selected, and meets you in the flow of work, including smoother import and file upload.
  • Build the habit: an assistant that remembers how you like to work, with personal, team, and organization profiles, quick commands, and a growing UI component catalog.
  • Earn the trust: previews before changes apply, linked sources and explanations for results, AI edits visible in history and activity logs, and a view into the agent's reasoning.
  • Work together: a directory of agents, @mentions, and the ability to save and share results as pages.

Further out, the vision is a Smart Assist that finds you before you ask: a proactive, insight-first surface that learns how your workspace works, suggests prompts personalized to you, brings in context from tools like Slack, Zoom, and documents, supports multiplayer conversations, and offers help inside the chat itself. You would help define the trust model for that experience from real customer learnings and feedback.

You Have:

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering shipping production systems.
  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/React, with good habits in testing, code review, and debugging.
  • Experience building and shipping customer-facing features end to end, including APIs, data modeling, and user-facing behavior.
  • 1+ years building LLM-powered features in production: tool or function calling, agent loops, prompt and context design, or multi-step workflows.
  • Working knowledge of how agents fail (bad tool choice, context overflow, hallucinated arguments, runaway cost) and how to design around it.
  • Experience designing eval scorers and golden datasets, and using results to make and defend a decision.
  • Experience with MCP tools and MCP Apps, structured tool calling, or reusable agent skills.
  • Comfort with production observability and with data-heavy environments (Databricks or equivalent).
  • Evidence of using AI coding agents to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.
  • Clear communication of quality, cost, and reliability findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Strong plus:

Experience with conversational or chat UI at scale; LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Phoenix, Braintrust or similar); prompt versioning or CI-integrated evals; dashboard, charting, or data-visualization products; enterprise SaaS permissions and entitlements; prompt-injection mitigation and output validation.

What success looks like:

  • First 90 days: ship a feature or improvement to production with eval coverage, and take your first on-call rotation.
  • First 6 months: own a feature or significant part of a project with measured gains in task success, latency, or user adoption, and contribute at least one reusable component or pattern.

Why this role:

  • You build the Smart Assist experience used by enterprise customers, with real users and a measurable quality bar.
  • You work across the stack, from the interface to the agent tools behind it, so you see your work reach customers end to end.
  • The problems are distinctive: enterprise-grade permissions and security, and one assistant that works across a broad work-management product.
  • You work on the hard parts of production agents, on a team that values engineering rigor and diverse perspectives.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

US Base Salary Pay Range
$125,000—$175,000 USD

 

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. 

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.title: MLRO, Indonesia
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Indonesia (Remote)


Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).
The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.
Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development & Management

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
  • Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
  • Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
  • Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
  • Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
  • Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
  • Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT & MLRO Duties

  • Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
  • Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
  • Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
  • Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
  • Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance & Culture

  • Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
  • Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
  • Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
  • Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
  • Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting & Recordkeeping

  • Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
  • Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
  • Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.
 

What We Look For In You

  • Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
    • Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

    Experience

    • Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
    • Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
    • Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
    • Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
    • Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
    • Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

    Knowledge & Skills

    • Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
    • Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
    • Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
    • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
    • Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
    • High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.
 

Nice to Haves

    • Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
    • Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
    • Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
    • Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
    • In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.
 

Additional Notes

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company event
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Grounded in experience and supported by the integrated research expertise of Wake Forest University School of Medicine, the Advocate Health National Center for Clinical Trials is a first-of-its-kind, fully integrated solution designed to make participation in clinical trials part of the standard of care for patients. Our technology ecosystem supports clinical trials across all stages of planning and execution, from recruitment and retention to management and virtual care, delivering efficient processes and high-quality results. Powered by the expertise of the school of medicine’s research team and Advocate Health clinicians and accelerated by cutting-edge technology, we are uniquely positioned to make an impact.

The NCCT Product Manager plays a pivotal role in advancing the mission of the NCCT by leading the design and evolution of technology-enabled business capabilities that transform how our organization operates. This individual will report to the Vice President and Head of Technology & Transformation, working closely with cross functional leaders operate at the intersection of business strategy, process design and technology execution, helping ensure the organization focuses on the right work and achieves measurable outcomes.


The NCCT Product Manager is responsible for defining, executing, and delivering product strategy and roadmap initiatives that drive business growth and customer value. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, engineering, design, and operations teams to ensure products meet organizational objectives. The NCCT Product Manager leads product lifecycle activities from ideation through launch and ongoing optimization while mentoring junior team members and influencing cross-functional decision-making.

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. jobs.title: Product Engineering Internship
jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is the AI support system for therapists. We believe therapy changes lives, and that AI should empower the clinicians who provide it. More than 70,000 mental health professionals use Blueprint to take the administrative weight off of care, including drafting progress notes, treatment plans, and client letters, running insurance eligibility and billing, and handling scheduling, so clinicians can spend less time on paperwork and more time with the people they serve.

We operate in a space where trust is everything: Blueprint is SOC 2 Type 2 certified (six years running) and HIPAA/PHIPA compliant, with patient data encrypted in transit and at rest.

What you'll do

  • Own a bounded project end to end, from scoping to shipping, with a dedicated mentor
  • Ship AI-powered features across our NestJS backend and React frontend to production, used by tens of thousands of clinicians
  • Contribute to our LLM-powered features: progress-note generation, the clinical Assistant, insurance automation, and the evals that keep them safe and accurate
  • Write tests, go through code review, and take part in standups and planning like any other engineer on the team
  • See up close how a product team evaluates, adopts, or rejects new AI tools and techniques, in both the product and the way we build it

How we work

We are a small, remote-first, high-ownership team.

AI is deeply woven into both Blueprint’s product and the way we work. Under the hood, Blueprint runs LLM calls across the entire clinical workflow: a multi-skill Assistant that helps clinicians prep for their day, reasoning models that generate progress notes, and LLM-powered billing workflows that draft appeals and disputes and helps with the insurance eligibility work that piles up between sessions. Every one of those AI workflows is traced and evaluated in LangSmith, with LLM-as-judge evals gating changes before they ship.

AI is also fully integrated into how we work, not just what we ship. Engineers, PMs, and designers use design and coding agents every day, including to ship code changes, review pull requests, and proactively triage production alerts. We treat AI tooling as a moving target: we actively track what's new in AI coding and dev infrastructure, pull the best of it into how we work, and give everyone room to experiment with the latest tools.

Requirements

  • You can read, write, and reason thoughtfully about code, and you're comfortable getting dropped into an unfamiliar codebase
  • You’re product-minded: you want the 'why' behind the work, not just the spec, you weigh tradeoffs, and you care whether what you shipped helped our clinician and their clients
  • You see AI as a tool for solving real problems, not an end in itself: you reach for it in your own work (or you’re eager to), and you’re thoughtful about where it helps and where it doesn’t
  • You’re curious about AI and LLMs: how to prompt, evaluate, and apply them responsibly where the stakes are real
  • You communicate clearly in writing, which matters on a remote team, and you actively welcome feedback
  • You are highly self-motivated and and are comfortable working independently (with mentorship)
  • You’re based in the US, can work remotely, and can commit at least 20 hours a week
  • Bonus: familiarity with Typescript, React, Node/NestJS, or Postgres; exposure to LLM work (prompting, RAG, agents, evals); experience/interest in the healthcare and mental health space

Benefits

  • $25/hr
  • 100% remote
  • Hardworking, mission-driven, friendly coworkers
  • Flexibility with scheduling - we'd love you full-time. We also know it's winter and you may have school or other commitments. We are willing to work with you to find the right schedule (at least 20+ hours a week)

We welcome applicants from non-traditional backgrounds. Above all, we hire for skills, curiosity, and enthusiasm. Even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements listed above, apply anyway.

Blueprint is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive team. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Certificate Authority Program Steward
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
  • Analytical judgment and program management: Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration: Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is seeking a senior Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Consultant to support its Energy & Infrastructure Consulting practice. Location: Candidate may work fully remote in the United States or Canada. Commuting distance to Denver CO or Framingham, MA desirable.

  • Working knowledge of major power-plant equipment, maintenance and outage planning, equipment reliability, and asset life-cycle considerations.
  • Ability to interpret operational records, budgets, commercial agreements, and technical information to identify practical and financial consequences for an asset.
  • Strong analytical judgment and concise written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical matters to financial and nontechnical audiences.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that aviation accounting requires more than traditional bookkeeping. Flight-related expenses can involve aircraft operators, catering, ground transportation, international payments, and other time-sensitive costs. You should be comfortable working across these moving parts while maintaining a high level of accuracy and confidentiality.

You will also have the opportunity to improve existing processes by building smarter spreadsheets, dashboards, templates, and automation that reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Key Responsibilities

Reconciliation & Financial Accuracy

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot, and accounting accounts.
  • Use Xero to review, categorize, and reconcile business transactions.
  • Maintain consistent chart-of-accounts and expense-coding practices.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and other discrepancies.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is properly maintained and financial records remain complete and accurate.

Aviation Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer balances, payment status, invoices, and supporting documentation.
  • Manage payments to aircraft operators, vendors, and service providers worldwide.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Work with platforms such as Convera to create, track, and reconcile payment orders.
  • Monitor recurring vendors and fixed expenses for changes in spending.
  • Work with internal teams, vendors, and aircraft operators to resolve payment issues and discrepancies.
  • Handle time-sensitive financial issues that may affect active or upcoming flights.

Booking & Financial Operations

  • Keep booking and deal records aligned between HubSpot and Xero.
  • Update HubSpot deal stages as bookings move from quote to confirmed, invoiced, paid, and completed.
  • Maintain booking details including trip dates, routing, aircraft, operator, pricing, and payment status.
  • Match bookings to revenue and reconcile HubSpot deal and payment data against accounting records.
  • Ensure financial information accurately reflects changes to trips and bookings.

Trip Profitability & Financial Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related expenses including aircraft charter costs, catering, ground transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense reports.
  • Maintain consolidated financial reporting for leadership.
  • Build fixed-cost and vendor variance reports to identify changes in spending.
  • Prepare management reports covering expenses, margins, vendor payments, and operational costs.
  • Provide leadership with clear financial data to support pricing, vendor, and spending decisions.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use advanced formulas such as XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, and SUMIFS.
  • Create pivot tables, data validation rules, conditional formatting, and reporting dashboards.
  • Clean and combine data exported from multiple systems.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting processes.
  • Improve workflows to reduce manual work, prevent errors, and make financial information easier to access.
  • Maintain organized accounting records, supporting documents, and shared folders.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Direct professional experience in private aviation, aircraft charter, aviation operations, luxury travel, or a closely related industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including:
    • Bank feeds, bank rules, and reconciliations.
    • Expense coding and chart-of-accounts management.
    • Bills, invoices, payments, and supporting documentation.
    • Tracking categories for trip- or flight-level reporting.
    • Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, Aged Payables, and Aged Receivables reporting.
  • Proven experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Experience with international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong experience tracking expenses, payments, margins, and financial performance.
  • Experience working with CRM or booking systems and keeping operational and financial records aligned.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment when handling confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Convera GlobalPay, including beneficiaries, payment orders, foreign currency payments, approval workflows, and payment confirmations.
  • Experience with HubSpot, including deal stages, booking information, contacts, companies, and data exports.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies and working with USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated financial reports, dashboards, or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Perfect Fit / Culture

  • You have genuine experience working within private aviation or aircraft charter operations and understand the financial complexity behind each flight.
  • You take full ownership of financial accuracy and do not wait to be told when something looks wrong.
  • You notice duplicate charges, missing documentation, unusual transactions, and discrepancies before they become larger problems.
  • You are highly organized and can keep multiple accounts, vendors, payments, and flight-related expenses moving simultaneously.
  • You communicate proactively with leadership, vendors, operators, and internal teams.
  • You look for ways to replace repetitive manual work with better systems, templates, dashboards, and automation.
  • You are comfortable working independently while maintaining a high standard of confidentiality and accountability.

Typical Day

You may begin the day reviewing bank and corporate card activity, checking reconciliations, and following up on outstanding vendor or operator payments. You could then update HubSpot booking records, match payment information against Xero, or investigate a discrepancy between a trip's expected and actual costs.

Throughout the day, you may work on trip-level profitability, prepare management reports, reconcile international payments, coordinate with vendors or aircraft operators, and update financial documentation.

You will also spend time improving spreadsheets, dashboards, and accounting workflows so the team can access accurate information faster and reduce manual work.

Because this is a private aviation operation, urgent payment or vendor issues can occasionally arise outside normal business hours. You must be comfortable providing responsive support when a time-sensitive financial issue could affect a client's flight.

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
  • Analytical judgment and program management: Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration: Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

We are looking for a Solution Architect who combines an architectural perspective with a highly practical approach to system migrations and decommissioning.

This is an opportunity to work across systems, business capabilities and markets, translating target architecture into an actionable rationalisation roadmap and helping the organisation turn that roadmap into real change.

We are not looking for someone whose work ends with a diagram or presentation. What matters is the impact you can have on which systems we evolve, migrate, consolidate and ultimately retire.

Your impact

You will help own and continuously evolve our group-wide business capability model, mapping capabilities to systems across markets and keeping that information up to date in the central architecture repository.

In practice, you will:

  • maintain a clear baseline of systems involved in migration and rationalisation,
  • work with project teams to assess major changes across the technology landscape,
  • translate target architecture into a sequenced rationalisation roadmap,
  • coordinate cross-domain and group-wide migrations from the architecture perspective,
  • stay actively involved in global programme and domain roadmaps to identify risks, dependencies and exceptions to target architecture,
  • influence decisions and roadmaps across domains and markets without having to own delivery directly.

Your impact will extend beyond a single product or application. You will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, application portfolio management, technology transformation and global roadmaps, turning target architecture into concrete migration, rationalisation and decommissioning decisions.

If you enjoy making sense of complex technology landscapes, creating structure and then helping turn that structure into real change, we would like to hear from you.

You could be a great fit if...

You bring 6+ years of commercial experience in business analysis, software engineering, solution architecture or a related field.

Most importantly, you have participated in at least one cross-team system migration or decommissioning initiative on a global scale, end to end. You understand what it takes to move from architecture and planning to navigating dependencies across systems, teams and markets.

You will also feel at home in this role if you:

  • have hands-on experience with business capability modelling and gap analysis at group or multi-system level,
  • can read and discuss architecture diagrams fluently and ask sharp questions,
  • communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders,
  • can influence decisions and roadmaps across domains and markets without directly owning delivery,
  • bring strong analytical precision and attention to detail,

  • communicate in English at C1 level

Nice to have
