jobs.description:
Volontariat Virtuel

Emplacement du partenaire : République démocratique du Congo

Date de début : Décembre 2026

Durée de l’affectation : 3 Mois (au moins 7 heures par semaine ; disponibilité à temps plein bienvenue).

Exigences linguistiques : Français Niveau 4 - Avancé

L'éligibilité : Ouvert aux citoyens canadiens et aux résidents permanents du Canada seulement

Rôle du coopérant-volontaire

Aidez la prochaine génération d'entrepreneurs à transformer leurs compétences techniques en entreprises prospères.

Le Centre Professionnel Don Bosco recherche un(e) spécialiste en entrepreneuriat pour renforcer la préparation des jeunes à la création et à la gestion d'entreprises dans des secteurs porteurs tels que l'énergie solaire, l'architecture intérieure, le froid et la climatisation, l'élevage, la transformation des déchets plastiques et la menuiserie en aluminium.

À titre de bénévole en ligne, vous contribuerez à intégrer l'entrepreneuriat au parcours de formation des apprenants, à développer des outils pratiques et à renforcer les capacités des formateurs afin de mieux accompagner les jeunes vers l'emploi autonome et la création d'entreprises durables.

La personne sélectionnée devra mener les activités suivantes :

  • Analyser les besoins des jeunes et les possibilités d'affaires liées aux différentes filières de formation.
  • Développer ou améliorer un module d'entrepreneuriat adapté aux métiers techniques.
  • Concevoir des outils pratiques tels que des canevas de modèles d'affaires, des budgets prévisionnels et des plans d'affaires simplifiés.
  • Accompagner les formateurs dans l'animation d'activités entrepreneuriales et le mentorat des jeunes.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour soutenir les jeunes dans l'identification d'occasions d'affaires et le développement de leurs projets.
  • Contribuer à la mise en place d'un mécanisme de mentorat et d'accompagnement entrepreneurial.

Compétences académiques essentielles:

  • Diplôme universitaire en entrepreneuriat, administration des affaires, gestion, économie, développement local, développement international ou domaine connexe.

Expérience / Compétences professionnelles essentiels:

  • Expérience dans le développement des compétences entrepreneuriales ou l'accompagnement d'entrepreneurs.
  • Connaissance des enjeux liés au démarrage et à la croissance de petites entreprises.
  • Capacité à vulgariser des concepts entrepreneuriaux auprès de jeunes en formation technique.
  • Expérience en animation, mentorat ou formation d'adultes, un atout important.

Pourquoi vous impliquer?

En partageant votre expertise à distance, vous aiderez des jeunes à acquérir les compétences nécessaires pour créer leur propre emploi, développer des entreprises viables et contribuer au développement économique de leur communauté.

À propos du coopérant-volontaire

Le programme de volontariat virtuel de Cuso International accueille de nouveaux et anciens bénévoles à travailler à distance avec nos partenaires internationaux et bureaux pays. Le volontariat virtuel offre plusieurs des avantages du volontariat international, cependant se démarque pour sa flexibilité; pouvant être géré à partir de chez soi et en accord avec sa disponibilité. Contribuer ses compétences à une communauté, acquérir de nouvelles compétences, et de faire de nouvelles connexions sont les avantages communs du volontariat virtuel, et pour Cuso International c’est aussi une grande opportunité pour engager plus de personnes dans sa mission.

Certains de nos partenaires se trouvent dans des zones reculées avec une connexion Internet peu fiable. Par conséquent, lorsque vous travaillez avec les partenaires, il est raisonnable de supposer que les réponses à vos courriels ne seront pas envoyées immédiatement (structure change in this sentence). De plus, pour certains de nos partenaires, il s'agit de leur première expérience de travail avec des volontaires virtuel, de sorte que la flexibilité et la patience sont une caractéristique précieuse du volontariat virtuel.

À propos de nous

Cuso International (Cuso) est une organisation internationale de coopération et de développement basée au Canada qui œuvre à créer des opportunités sociales et économiques pour les groupes méritant l'équité. Forts de plus de soixante ans d'expérience, nous relevons les défis mondiaux en nous attaquant aux causes profondes des inégalités. En collaboration avec nos partenaires, nous nous concentrons sur les efforts visant à améliorer la résilience économique, à promouvoir l'équité et l'inclusion pour tous et à faire progresser l'action climatique. Nous croyons qu'en partageant nos compétences et habiletés, nous pouvons bâtir un avenir meilleur. Guidée par ses valeurs de courage, d'inclusion, de durabilité et de redevabilité, Cuso combine des stratégies innovantes et des partenariats durables pour créer un changement significatif et durable dans les communautés d'Afrique, d'Amérique latine, des Caraïbes et du Canada.

Projet : SHARE (partage du savoir-faire canadien pour le développement inclusif et l’égalité des genres)

Partenaire : Université Canadienne au Congo

Conditions de sélection

  • Compléter une évaluation linguistique lors de l'entretien téléphonique préliminaire dans la langue requise pour votre affectation.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for release cycles, sprint deadlines, and testing windows)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure software products are reliable, functional, scalable, and production-ready before release. This role combines manual testing, automated testing, defect tracking, and collaboration with engineering and product teams to maintain high software quality standards.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, technically curious, and passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences through structured testing and quality-focused thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys identifying edge cases, improving testing coverage, and helping engineering teams release software with confidence.

Responsibilities

Test Planning & Quality Strategy

  • Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and quality assurance documentation
    • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and developers to understand requirements and user stories
    • Define testing strategies for features, integrations, workflows, and regression coverage
    • Ensure acceptance criteria and edge cases are properly validated before release

Manual Testing & Defect Validation

  • Execute manual testing across functional, regression, UI/UX, cross-browser, and cross-device scenarios
    • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar tools
    • Provide detailed reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and supporting documentation
    • Retest bug fixes and verify impacted areas after updates or deployments

Test Automation

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test suites using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar frameworks
    • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
    • Monitor test execution results and troubleshoot automation failures
    • Improve automation coverage to reduce manual regression effort

Performance & Security Testing

  • Conduct load, stress, and performance testing using tools such as JMeter or Locust
    • Support vulnerability scanning and security-focused testing efforts
    • Validate system stability, responsiveness, and reliability under varying workloads

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for test plans, test cases, bug reports, and testing results
    • Track and report quality metrics such as defect density, pass/fail rates, and regression coverage
    • Prepare clear QA status updates and testing summaries for stakeholders and leadership

Collaboration & Agile Participation

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce, isolate, and resolve issues efficiently
    • Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and release reviews
    • Advocate for quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle
    • Provide usability and testability feedback during feature development

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Detail-oriented and highly analytical with a strong quality mindset
    • Skilled at uncovering edge cases, usability issues, and hidden defects
    • Strong communicator who documents findings clearly and professionally
    • Comfortable balancing testing thoroughness with fast-paced release cycles
    • Proactive, organized, and collaborative within Agile engineering environments

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience
    • Hands-on experience with test management and bug-tracking tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Azure DevOps)
    • Familiarity with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright
    • Strong understanding of Agile workflows and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
    • Experience performing functional, regression, and UI testing

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise software environments
    • Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or RestAssured
    • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
    • Exposure to security testing, compliance-heavy systems, or performance testing workflows
    • Understanding of modern QA best practices and automation strategies

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Quality Assurance Engineer’s day revolves around validating product quality and preventing defects from reaching production. You will:

  • Review user stories and requirements to create or refine test cases
    • Execute manual and automated tests on new features and product updates
    • Log, prioritize, and communicate bugs clearly with engineering teams
    • Participate in sprint meetings and provide testing progress updates
    • Review regression testing results after deployments or new builds
    • Analyze quality trends and improve testing coverage and efficiency
    • Maintain organized QA documentation and testing records

In essence: you are the final quality checkpoint before release, ensuring software is stable, functional, and delivers a reliable user experience.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Defect detection rate before production releases

• Regression test coverage percentage

  • Reduction in escaped production defects
    • Faster resolution time for reported issues
    • % of successful releases without critical or severe bugs
    • Positive stakeholder confidence in product quality and reliability

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Practical Assessment (e.g., design a test plan or execute a sample bug testing scenario)
    • Client Interview with QA / Engineering Leadership

• Offer & Background Verification

We’re here to help people take control of their health. By bringing together behavioural science, technology, and incredible people, our grand mission is to eradicate the global epidemic of chronic lifestyle diseases once and for all.

jobs.title: Senior Field Deployable Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is seeking a Senior Field Deployable Engineer (FDE) to lead integration delivery for government and defense customers worldwide, with deployments across the Middle East, Europe, and the Indo-Pacific. Depending on the engagement, you will lead a team of FDEs, serve as a senior team member, or deploy solo to integrate Orbis products directly in the customer environment. In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and validate data integrations (sensors, C2 systems, and operational feeds) across Orbis data governance and data analysis products, driving assignments from requirement through production deployment in close coordination with your team. A critical part of this role is working directly with customer engineering and operations teams to map their network topology, data sources, and system dependencies before integration work begins; this discovery is not a preliminary step that gets handed off, it is a continuous responsibility that drives every design and deployment decision. When leading a team, you will mentor FDEs, serve as the first escalation point for technical issues, and maintain integration quality across your assigned domain. This role carries direct responsibility for the orchestration and management of both on-premises data platform environments and cloud-connected infrastructure; software-layer issues are escalated to the platform product team. You will also partner with Business Development during capture and proposal phases, delivering technical demonstrations and serving as a technical subject-matter expert. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone ready to shape how integration work gets done, raise the technical bar of the team around them, and ensure the platform infrastructure underpinning that work is properly configured, connected, and maintained.

Travel: This is a remote role with extended travel to the Middle East, including time spent in geopolitical hot zones up to 50% of the time. Please apply if you are willing to meet this requirement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead full-lifecycle integration delivery for assigned data sources, whether leading a team or deployed solo: requirements analysis, connector design, implementation, testing, deployment, and validation in the target environment
  • Deploy to customer sites across the Middle East, Europe, and the Indo-Pacific, either leading a team of FDEs or operating solo as the on-site Orbis technical lead to integrate Orbis products
  • Lead customer technical discovery as a core responsibility: work directly with customer engineering and operations teams to map their network topology, data sources, system dependencies, and operational constraints; this understanding is the foundation that integration design and deployment decisions are built on and cannot be delegated or skipped
  • Drive technical decisions when integrations don't fit established patterns; document decisions and rationale for the team and contribute to shared architectural standards
  • When leading a team, mentor Integration Engineers through code review, pairing, and direct feedback; serve as the team's first point of escalation for technical issues
  • Design and build custom data connectors and integration plugins (producer bridges, operators, consumer bridges) for complex or undocumented source systems across air, land, maritime, air defense, space, and cyber domains
  • Own the orchestration and management of on-premises data platform environments (cluster configuration, service health, data connectivity) and cloud-connected infrastructure (resource provisioning, hybrid connectivity, access controls) across each engagement's deployment surface
  • Deploy and validate integrations across customer environments (cloud-native, on-premises, and tactical edge) using infrastructure orchestration tooling; ensure integrations work in theater, not just in dev
  • Stand up and configure platform nodes and on-premises data platform components using established runbooks; validate cluster health, data platform connectivity, and configuration correctness post-deployment
  • Diagnose and resolve cross-system integration failures under operational pressure; distinguish integration-layer issues from platform-layer issues and drive resolution with the team
  • Triage platform issues: determine whether a problem is in the integration code or in the platform itself, and file high-quality bugs with reproductions when it's the latter; software-layer issues route to the platform product team
  • Contribute reusable integration patterns, runbooks, and onboarding documentation to the Orbis integrator playbook; flag candidates for upstream contribution to the platform product team
  • Provide clear, solution-oriented status updates to the Director of Delivery; frame problems with proposed approaches rather than open questions
  • Support customer technical exchanges within your integration domain; explain integration approaches to customer engineering teams as the primary Orbis technical voice, particularly when deployed solo
  • Partner with Business Development during capture and proposal phases: deliver technical demonstrations of Orbis products, support solution design and technical volume content, and answer customer technical questions

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on system integrations, data pipelines, and distributed data platforms
  • Proficiency in Go (preferred) or Python for integration development
  • Proficiency with headless Linux/Unix based environments
  • Demonstrated ability to drive an integration from requirement through production deployment as a team lead and technical decision-maker
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code and deployment tooling (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) to provision, configure, and validate platform environments
  • Working knowledge of on-premises big data platforms and their operational characteristics (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Presto); ability to configure, validate, and triage at the platform layer
  • Experience deploying and integrating within cloud-native environments (e.g., GCP VPC, BigQuery, Dataflow, GKE); familiarity with cloud resource lifecycle and connectivity patterns
  • Experience connecting on-premises and cloud environments under security constraints (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Private Service Connect, VPN); ability to validate and troubleshoot hybrid data paths
  • Familiarity with access control, identity management, and network security controls in multi-environment deployments (e.g., IAM, VPC Service Controls)
  • Experience debugging complex, cross-system integration failures in production or near-production environments
  • Track record of mentoring junior engineers through code review, pairing, or technical guidance
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in distributed, remote, cross-functional teams
  • Comfort operating as the technical point of contact in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Ability to deploy internationally for extended periods, including solo deployments as the sole on-site Orbis engineer; valid U.S. passport required
  • Ability to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance

Desired Qualifications

  • Proven ability to lead customer technical discovery: mapping network environments, identifying data sources and system dependencies, and translating operational requirements into integration design decisions
  • Familiarity with defense data standards and protocols: ASTERIX, Cursor on Target (CoT), STANAG, radar UDP
  • Track record of designing integration patterns for undocumented or poorly documented source systems
  • Background with military, law enforcement, or intelligence community operations and organizations
  • Background supporting international programs in the Middle East, Europe, or the Indo-Pacific with distributed, cross-cultural teams rotating through operational environments
  • Understanding of service mesh concepts, mTLS, and zero-trust network architectures
  • Familiarity with edge-native deployment patterns and constrained operational environments
  • Background in customer enablement, technical training, or knowledge transfer in field environments
  • Experience supporting business development, capture, or proposal efforts, including live technical demonstrations and technical volume writing
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) as part of daily engineering practice
  • Active U.S. security clearance

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Routine video conference and in-person meetings
  • Extended international travel and deployments to customer sites across the Middle East, Europe, and the Indo-Pacific, including time spent in geopolitical hot zones and austere environments

Sedentary Work: Primarily performs work in a seated position for extended periods; occasionally required to stand, walk, or move within the work area
Fine Motor Skills: Regularly required to use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and standard office equipment
Vision: Must be able to read and view a computer screen for extended periods; close vision and ability to adjust focus required
Communication: Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively in person, via telephone, and through video conferencing platforms; ability to hear and understand spoken information in a professional setting required
Lifting: Occasionally required to lift and/or move items up to 25 pounds (e.g., files, documents, office supplies)
Concentration: Must be able to maintain sustained focus and attention to detail in a professional office or hybrid work environment

Travel: Extended travel to the Middle East, including time spent in geopolitical hot zones up to 50% of the time.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

Job Description:

Job Title: Market Intelligence, Senior Specialist


Purpose:

The Market Intelligence Senior Specialist delivers market, supplier, category, and risk intelligence that enables informed sourcing and business decisions across GS&P. Through market research, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement, the role translates complex external and internal data into actionable insights, strategic recommendations, and executive-ready presentations. The position supports category strategies, supplier negotiations, planning activities, and risk management efforts while leveraging AI-enabled tools and market intelligence platforms to accelerate insight generation and drive business value.


Major Duties/ Responsibilities:

  • Conduct primary and secondary research using market intelligence subscription services, AI-powered research tools, and a range of external data sources, platforms, and internal datasets to enrich market insights.
  • Continuously monitor external market conditions, including regulatory, geopolitical, economic, and industry factors impacting supply markets, leveraging AI-enabled research tools and automated monitoring capabilities where appropriate.
  • Leverage intelligent agents and AI-enabled solutions to automate market monitoring, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and accelerate insight generation.
  • Conduct in-depth market analysis across GS&P categories, including supplier landscapes, cost drivers, pricing trends, commodity indexes, benchmarking insights, and supply/demand dynamics to support sourcing decisions, financial planning, supplier negotiations, and value identification initiatives.
  • Identify risks, early warning indicators, and value creation opportunities related to supplier stability, pricing volatility, supply constraints, and market developments, assessing business impacts and providing scenario analysis and recommendations to support proactive decision-making.
  • Deliver proactive alerts, trend summaries, scenario-based insights, and recommendations by combining external market intelligence with supplier, contract, spend, and business demand data to support risk mitigation, forward planning, and decision-making.
  • Develop structured category intelligence outputs (e.g., market scans, supplier profiles, and intelligence packs) to support sourcing and category strategies.
  • Translate complex market and supplier data into clear, actionable insights and executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and written summaries aligned to business priorities.
  • Develop compelling executive-level narratives and recommendations that translate complex market intelligence into clear business actions and strategic decisions.
  • Partner with Category Managers and sourcing teams to support RFx events, negotiations, supplier selection, and intelligence requirements aligned to specific sourcing initiatives and business questions.
  • Support stakeholder understanding of external market conditions impacting pricing, availability, supplier positioning, and sourcing strategies.
  • Work closely with P&A, and GS&P stakeholders to integrate intelligence into decision-making processes.
  • Contribute to planning cycles by providing market insights into budgeting, forecasting, category strategies, and broader business planning activities.
  • Ensure insights support key outcomes including cost optimization, risk reduction, and value delivery.
  • Ensure research methodologies are structured, repeatable, and aligned to best practices.
  • Build and maintain a centralised market intelligence repository and knowledge base, including templates, frameworks, and reusable outputs to standardize intelligence delivery and ensure insights are accessible, shareable, and consistently maintained across GS&P.

Decision Making:

  • Applies independent judgement in analyzing market data and forming actionable insights.
  • Recommends sourcing, supplier, and strategy decisions based on market intelligence findings.
  • Prioritize intelligence activities based on business value and stakeholder needs.
  • Identifies trade-offs across cost, risk, and market dynamics in support of decision-making.

Span of Control (Direct/Indirect reports)

  • Individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibility.
  • Works across multiple GS&P categories and stakeholder groups.
  • Influences decision-making through insights and expertise rather than formal authority.

Scope of Responsibility (i.e. financial impact):

  • Supports GS&P value delivery through improved sourcing decisions, pricing insights, and risk mitigation.
  • Impacts supplier selection, negotiation outcomes, and category strategy through actionable intelligence.
  • Contributes to cost optimization, supplier performance improvement, and overall procurement effectiveness.

Skills/Knowledge:

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Strong analytical capability with experience in market analysis, supplier research, and data interpretation.
  • Ability to synthesize internal spend, supplier, contract, and business data with external market intelligence to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced ability to transform complex qualitative and quantitative data into compelling narratives, executive-ready presentations, dashboards, and visual insights that drive decision-making.
  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation development skills, with experience creating clear, visually engaging, and persuasive materials for senior leadership audiences.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled research tools, intelligent agents, and market intelligence platforms.
  • Understanding of procurement, sourcing processes, and supply market dynamics.
  • Experience with data analysis tools (Excel, Power BI or similar) and external market research platforms.
  • Familiarity with cost drivers, pricing models, and supplier economics across categories.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with the ability to simplify complex insights and influence business decisions.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and business partnering capability, with confidence presenting recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • High level of curiosity, commercial awareness, and strategic thinking.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality output under time constraints.

Minimum Formal Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, or related discipline preferred (or equivalent experience).

Minimum Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in market intelligence, procurement, sourcing, supplier risk, analytics, strategy, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing complex market, supplier, and business data and translating findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Experience developing executive-ready presentations and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting global stakeholders and working within cross-functional environments.

We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).

The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. jobs.title: Senior Security Research Engineer (SecureChain)
jobs.description:
TuxCare provides security solutions for Linux and open-source software used by enterprise organizations. Our products help companies automate vulnerability patching, reduce downtime, maintain security and compliance, and support critical systems throughout their lifecycle.

Learn more about TuxCare:

We are looking for a Senior / Principal Security Research Engineer to start the Security Research & Automation function of SecureChain.

SecureChain is TuxCare's open-source software supply chain security product. It provides packages rebuilt from verified source code, scanned for malware and supply chain risks.

Learn more:

The Mission

You will be the first engineer of a new function, with a plan to grow it to three or four people. You are a security researcher first, and you build production-quality tools and pipelines to scale your research.

The function has three goals:

  1. Detect malicious code before SecureChain publishes a package.
  2. Build pipelines that find and help fix high and critical vulnerabilities in maintained and end-of-life open-source software.
  3. Publish useful, evidence-backed security research after coordinated disclosure.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning SecureChain's malicious-code detector: alert review and classification, test corpus, quality benchmarks, false-positive and coverage metrics.
  • Extending detection with artifact scanning, static signals, dynamic analysis and external intelligence.
  • Building repeatable pipelines that discover new vulnerabilities in software that SecureChain and ELS support, with priority on high/critical risks and on EOL versions customers still use.
  • Reproducing findings, proving impact and reachability, and storing evidence so another researcher can repeat the result.
  • Developing AI-assisted methods to generate and test candidate fixes, and feeding them into our patch automation.
  • Owning TuxCare CNA work: CVE assignment, record quality and coordinated disclosure with upstream projects.
  • Preparing technical write-ups and research publications together with Marketing.

Your first 90 days:

  • Days 1–30: take over the malicious-code detector, its sample review and CNA responsibilities; inventory services, data, prompts, corpus and open work.
  • Days 31–60: improve the detector and its review workflow, measure alert volume, false positives and cost; start a vulnerability-discovery pilot on 5–10 packages of one ecosystem.
  • Days 61–90: expand discovery across the ecosystem, complete coordinated disclosure where applicable, publish the first research output.

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • Security research background: malware or software supply-chain research, vulnerability discovery and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong Python or another suitable systems language; you build tools and pipelines that run in production.
  • CI pipelines, test automation and operating services.
  • Practical use of static analysis, fuzzing and sandboxing.
  • Heavy, daily use of AI-assisted tools in research and engineering.
  • Experience with more than one package ecosystem (e.g. PyPI, npm, Maven, Go, Linux distributions).
  • Clear research reports and experience with coordinated disclosure.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Published CVEs, advisories or security research.
  • Experience with CNA operations or vulnerability databases (CVE, OSV).

This is not a SOC analyst, compliance, penetration testing or general software development role.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • The opportunity to build a new security research function from the ground up, with technical autonomy and a direct impact on open-source security.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.

  • We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results.

  • We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding

Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈

Your Job

Your mission is to turn AI, tools and data into a scaling lever for every Sparteo department, on top of a coherent architecture that lasts. Our growth should no longer be proportional to our hiring.

You are the AI and tooling partner of every business department (Sales, CSM, Supply and monetization, Marketing, Finance, Support) and the architect of the system that carries them: tools and internal apps, the AI platform and shared skills, knowledge usable by humans and agents, and the data that makes steering possible. You report to the Managing Director, work closely with the CEO, and lead a hands-on team of 4, including our Scale & Optimization team.

The approach, with each department: understand the real need → help formalise the process → design the right answer (tool, app, skill, agent, automation, dashboard) → deploy, with AI as the main lever → measure usage and gains.

Your first projects

From your first weeks, you build: you ship tools, agents and automations that run, not just recommendations.

  • Audit ongoing projects, in particular ticketing: real usage, redundancies, convergence plan.

  • Data stack evolution: recommendations on sources of truth, KPI definitions and business dashboards, with the Data team.

  • Supply team support: make its critical processes reliable and automated, starting with Meetscale onboarding and supply chain checks.

  • AI-native marketing: tooling, skills and agents designed around AI from day one, alongside our new CMO.

  • AI-driven sales: study and pilot a fully AI-driven sales motion for one of our products.

  • Alerting and monitoring: harden blocklist, IVT and revenue-drop alerts.

AI platform & business systems

  • Architect and govern our AI platform: Claude usage, MCPs, context sources, agent patterns, guardrails, with the Shared Services and Security teams.

  • Own the shared skills and agents portfolio: design, testing, versioning, distribution, usage tracking, retirement. Train champions in each team.

  • Design the target architecture of our business tools: one source of truth per piece of data, explicit flows, SaaS rationalisation, less shadow IT.

  • Define and build internal apps when within the team's reach, scope them with Engineering otherwise.

  • Own the knowledge base architecture, so documentation stays usable by humans and agents alike.

Adoption & impact

  • Lead change: sequence deployments, train, run the champions network, measure adoption and correct course.

  • Measure what works: usage KPIs per team, skill and app, and real gains (time saved, volume absorbed, error rate, headcount / activity ratio), reported to the Managing Director and the CEO.

Your profile for this job

  • Must-have

    • Significant experience as VP Operations, COO, Business Systems, Product Ops or transformation lead, ideally in a growing SaaS or tech company.

    • A dual business and technical profile: you understand a CSM's work as well as the architecture of an MCP, and translate one into the other.

    • Advanced, recent hands-on practice of LLMs and agents: prompts, skills, agents, MCP, output evaluation, production deployment. You can show us something you built that runs today.

    • Architectural vision: you have already designed or converged a business tool stack and you document your decisions.

    • Strong technical culture: APIs, data models, SQL, scripting, automation tools, application architecture and security basics.

    • Data culture: KPIs, business data modelling, useful dashboards, alerting.

    • You lead change without line authority, and you have managed a team before.

    • Strong awareness of security and compliance (GDPR).

    • Professional French and English.

  • Nice-to-have

    • Adtech, media or marketplace background.

    • Experience deploying an AI platform at company scale.

    • AI-powered marketing or sales experience.

    • Advanced Notion administration.

Your mind set to share our adventure

  • 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists.

  • 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically.

  • 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you.

  • 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis.

Benefits & Work Environment

  • 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London.

  • 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment.

  • 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones.

  • 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond.

  • 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for.

At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process!

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, schnell wachsen und die Zukunft des E-Commerce mitgestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei NETSHAKE!

Aufgaben

🛍️ Shopify-Umsetzung

  • Du baust Shopify-Shops von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live – Theme-Architektur, Liquid, App-Integrationen und Shopify Functions setzt du eigenständig um.

✍️ Content & Lifecycle

⚙️ AI-Tools & Automation

🤝 Händler & Workshops

  • Du kommunizierst so proaktiv, dass kein Händler und niemand im Team je nachfragen muss, wie ein Projekt läuft.

Qualifikation

🎯 Ownership. Wenn etwas schiefläuft, suchst du nicht nach Schuldigen, sondern nach Lösungen. Du fühlst dich für das Gesamtergebnis verantwortlich, nicht nur für deinen Teil. Und dein Ownership endet nicht an deinen Projekten: Du fühlst dich für den Erfolg des ganzen Teams mitverantwortlich.

⚡ Eigenverantwortung. Du bekommst am Montag ein Ziel und planst selbst, wie du bis Freitag dorthin kommst. Du organisierst deine Sprints, hältst deine Deadlines und sprichst Risiken früh an – nicht erst, wenn es eng wird. Deine Projekte brauchen keinen externen Antreiber. Du bist selbst der Motor.

💡 Über den Tellerrand. Du denkst über die eigentliche Aufgabe hinaus. Du siehst Probleme, bevor sie entstehen, und Lücken im Prozess, bevor sie jemand benennt. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Argentina)
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in training and optimizing multimodal agents with a focus on real-world, interactive deployment. Your work will span the full agent development lifecycle - from data curation, interactive sandbox environments, and training pipeline design to model evaluation and optimization - with the goal of building multimodal agentic models that are both highly capable and practical to deploy locally at scale.

You will work across a wide spectrum of multimodal architectures integrating perception, reasoning, and tool execution across digital environments, applying state-of-the-art research to improve visual grounding, multi-step task completion, and adaptability to unseen interfaces. We expect you to bring a research-driven mindset combined with strong engineering discipline - someone who can identify the right technique for a given problem, implement it rigorously, and measure its impact clearly.

You will work closely with a small, high-caliber team where your contributions will have direct and meaningful impact. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of what multimodal agentic AI can achieve in production environments, this is your opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct end-to-end research and engineering on multimodal agentic models capable of perceiving, reasoning, and acting across real-world digital environments - including desktop operating systems, web browsers, and mobile devices.

  • Design and scale post-training and online reinforcement learning pipelines (SFT, multi-turn GRPO/PPO) across multi-node GPU infrastructure, covering asynchronous rollouts, reward design, deterministic/learned verifiers, and safeguards against reward hacking.

  • Architect high-concurrency interactive sandboxes (VMs, containers, and emulators) with fast snapshotting, deterministic resets, and reproducible evaluation frameworks to measure multi-step task completion and visual grounding.

  • Build and optimize local agentic harnesses that coordinate multi-model orchestration, memory, planning, and cross-device task execution.

  • Research and implement test-time adaptation and continual learning methods to enable rapid generalization to unseen applications and dynamic user interfaces.

  • Develop scalable multimodal agentic datasets, including synthetic trajectory generation, fine-grained UI grounding, and automated trajectory filtering and verification.

  • Drive model efficiency and local deployability on consumer hardware via knowledge distillation, quantization, and runtime optimization without degrading grounding or reasoning accuracy.

  • Translate frontier multimodal agentic research into production improvements, contribute to open-source ecosystems, and publish findings in top-tier AI conferences where applicable.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field (MS/PhD preferred), or equivalent practical research and engineering experience.

  • Strong hands-on experience training or post-training multimodal/vision-language models (SFT, distillation, or online RL such as GRPO/PPO) with measurable gains on agentic, visual grounding, or reasoning benchmarks.

  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and distributed training or high-throughput rollout/inference infrastructure (e.g., FSDP/Megatron, Slurm, verl, vLLM/SGLang).

  • Deep hands-on in one or more of: online agentic RL & verifiers, high-concurrency OS/browser/mobile sandboxing, local agentic harnesses or test-time adaptation.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, revise, and review the Hoisting and Rigging SMP description supporting a DOE DSA and associated TSRs.

  • Identify technical gaps, inconsistencies, and compliance concerns and recommend practical, defensible resolutions.
  • Coordinate with safety basis personnel, hoisting and rigging program owners, lift planners, maintenance organizations, facility representatives, and other SMEs to ensure the SMP description accurately reflects implementation.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated DOE or NNSA nuclear facility experience in hoisting and rigging program management, lift planning, crane operations, rigging inspection, or program assessment.
  • Experience developing, implementing, assessing, or reviewing a Hoisting and Rigging SMP supporting DSAs and TSRs.
  • Working knowledge of 10 CFR 830, DOE-STD-1090, DOE-STD-3009, applicable ASME B30 standards, and OSHA hoisting and rigging requirements.
  • Prior experience preparing, reviewing, or supporting hoisting and rigging sections of DSA, SMP, safety basis, or related nuclear facility documentation.
  • Ability to independently review complex technical material and produce clear, accurate, and defensible DOE-quality documentation.
  • Strong written communication, technical judgment, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to perform work remotely as an independent consultant.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a hoisting and rigging program manager, designated leader, lift planner, crane engineer, qualified inspector, or DOE oversight professional.
  • Experience participating in critical lift reviews, readiness reviews, hoisting and rigging assessments, audits, or regulatory compliance evaluations.
  • Background as a retired or recently separated DOE, NNSA, national laboratory, or management and operating contractor hoisting and rigging professional.

Education and Experience

Candidates must possess sufficient technical education, specialized hoisting and rigging training, qualification history, and directly relevant DOE nuclear facility experience to serve as a credible subject matter expert and independently perform the required document development and review work.

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)

  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

jobs.title: Redakteur Motorsport (m/w/d) | SlickPix GmbH

SLICKPIX ist ein unabhängiges Magazin für Motorsportfotografie. Wir erzählen Motorsport durch außergewöhnliche Bilder, hochwertige Reportagen und authentisches Storytelling – unabhängig und mit einem klaren Fokus auf Racing Culture.

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit/Teilzeit
Arbeitsort: Remote, Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Start: Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Für unsere Redaktion suchen wir einen echten Motorsport-Experten, der in der Szene zu Hause ist, die Zusammenhänge kennt und weiß, welche Geschichten es wert sind, erzählt zu werden. Jemanden, der Motorsport nicht erst recherchieren muss, um ihn zu verstehen, sondern sein Wissen und seine Leidenschaft in starke redaktionelle Inhalte übersetzt.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du planst und koordinierst die redaktionellen Inhalte unserer Printausgabe – von der Themenplanung bis zur fertigen Heftproduktion.

  • Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Themen, Texte, Deadlines und die Zusammenarbeit mit Autor und Fotograf.

  • Du recherchierst und verfasst Texte, Reportagen, Interviews und weitere redaktionelle Beiträge. Auch für unsere Homepage.

  • Du schreibst präzise, informative Bildunterschriften, die Hintergründe vermitteln und Geschichten auf den Punkt bringen.

  • Du entwickelst Themenideen, erkennst spannende Geschichten und bringst dein Fachwissen aktiv in die redaktionelle Planung ein.

  • Du verfolgst das nationale und internationale Renngeschehen und weißt, welche Entwicklungen, Persönlichkeiten und Ereignisse relevant sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Fundiertes Motorsportwissen: Du kennst die Szene, ihre Akteure und ihre Zusammenhänge – über einzelne Rennserien hinaus.

  • Breite Serienkenntnis: Von Formel 1 und WEC über DTM, GT- und Langstreckensport bis hin zu nationalen Meisterschaften und historischen Rennserien bist du fachlich zu Hause.

  • Leidenschaft für den Sport: Du bist nicht nur beruflich interessiert, sondern im besten Sinne ein Motorsportfan. Du verfolgst Rennen, kennst Hintergründe und hast ein Gespür für die Geschichten hinter den Ergebnissen.

  • Redaktionelle Kompetenz: Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich aufbereiten, Texte sicher schreiben und redigieren und Inhalte strukturiert planen.

  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen und engen Produktionsfristen den Überblick.

  • Eigenständigkeit und Verlässlichkeit: Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst mit und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und Deadlines.

  • Ein gutes Gespür für Geschichten: Du weißt, dass Motorsport mehr ist als Startaufstellung, Rennergebnis und schnellste Runde.

Ein journalistischer Hintergrund oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung ist willkommen. Entscheidend sind vor allem deine redaktionellen Fähigkeiten, deine Organisationsstärke und dein fundiertes Wissen über den Motorsport.

WAS DICH BEI SLICKPIX ERWARTET

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle redaktionelle Position in einem unabhängigen Motorsportmagazin.

  • Die Möglichkeit, Themen und Inhalte aktiv mitzugestalten und eigene Ideen einzubringen.

  • Ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld zwischen aktuellem Renngeschehen, Motorsportgeschichte und außergewöhnlichen Geschichten aus der Szene.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, überwiegend remote zu arbeiten.

  • Ein kleines Team, das Motorsport und Fotografie mit Leidenschaft verbindet.

DAS KLINGT NACH DIR?

Dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören. Schick uns eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen bisherigen Werdegang und gern ein paar Arbeitsproben.

SLICKPIX – MOTORSPORT WORTH KEEPING.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Engineer to lead the technical direction of the AI department.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to lead a team of 6 engineers across AI, cybersecurity, and DevOps while staying hands-on in the code. You'll own the technical direction of our LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, designing RAG architectures, building MCP integrations, and keeping GPU-backed inference running reliably and securely.

This is a player-coach position: you'll split your time between building and leading, setting standards, reviewing code and designs, mentoring engineers, and taking LLM-powered features from prototype to production. This is a remote role; Mexico and US candidates can apply to this role.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership (core focus)

  • Lead, mentor, and support a team of 6 AI, cybersecurity, and DevOps engineers, including task planning, code reviews, and technical guidance.
  • Define architecture, coding standards, and best practices for the AI department's systems.
  • Translate product and client requirements into technical plans, estimates, and priorities.
  • Act as the main technical point of contact for AI work with engineering, product, and leadership.

AI / LLM Engineering

  • Design, serve, and operate open-source LLMs with Ollama and llama.cpp in local, on-prem, and air-gapped environments.
  • Architect RAG pipelines and lead MCP integrations that connect LLMs to internal tools and data.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize GPU/CUDA inference environments, including model quantization (GGUF).
  • Build Python backend services for ML inference and AI-driven features, including processing structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office formats).

DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Azure and AWS using Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack, digging into root causes rather than patching symptoms.

Cybersecurity

  • Lead the cybersecurity function with the Senior Cybersecurity Engineer, ensuring security is built into AI systems and infrastructure from design through deployment.
  • Oversee security architecture and least-privilege access across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-prem, and endpoint environments, including project-based access to sensitive client and OEM data.
  • Own AI systems security, including prompt injection, data leakage through RAG and MCP, and model and dependency integrity.
  • Oversee DevSecOps, vulnerability management, and incident response, and support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and client security assessments.

Requirements

    • 6+ years of engineering experience, including 2+ years leading technical teams, ideally spanning AI, cybersecurity, and DevOps.
    • Expert-level production Python.
    • Hands-on experience with LLMs (Ollama and/or llama.cpp), RAG systems, and MCP integrations.
    • GPU/CUDA troubleshooting experience in inference environments.
    • Experience with Azure/AWS, Docker, Linux/Windows administration, and CI/CD automation.
    • Solid cybersecurity knowledge, including cloud security, IAM, DevSecOps, incident response, and securing LLM-based systems.
    • Strong leadership and communication skills, with a root-cause mindset and experience working with remote, distributed teams.
    • Advanced English, spoken and written (B2 or higher).
  • Nice to Have
    • Model quantization, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++).
    • Observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana) and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
    • Security certifications (CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or cloud security certifications).

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - UK Client (Remote Work) - 700
jobs.description:
Position: Business Development Representative

Salary: £ 700 - 1200 GBP (salary would depend based on experience)

Working Hours & Conditions: UK Business Hours

Holidays: TBC

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The client is a pair of sister engineering and technical support businesses serving the UK industrial, energy, and offshore sectors. Led commercially by their Commercial Director and supported by their technical leadership, both companies operate with a relationship-first approach—rejecting high-volume, pushy telesales in favor of consultative partnerships that solve genuine operational, resourcing, and project mobilisation challenges.

While operating as distinct brands with equal commercial priority, they share a unified mission: connecting UK industrial and energy clients with specialized engineering expertise, technical labour, and project support.

  • Brand A (Technical Resourcing): Focuses on technical resourcing, engineering support, and solving skilled labour shortages across industrial and energy projects.
  • Brand B (Engineering & Mobilisation): Delivers specialized engineering, technical scoping, and project mobilisation services—including offshore and broader industrial operations.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

This is a dedicated, full-time outbound B2B (Business-to-Business) relationship-building role reporting directly to the Commercial Director. The representative is responsible for researching prospect lists, engaging key decision-makers across UK (United Kingdom) businesses, and uncovering genuine operational, labour, or project needs across two sister engineering and technical support companies equally—rather than relying on pushy, script-based telesales. Ultimately, the role acts as a strategic gatekeeper who protects leadership's time by qualifying opportunities and handing over well-researched, high-value meetings to the Commercial Director, supported technically by the offshore operations lead and wider engineering team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work through the prospect lists for both businesses and find the person who actually makes or influences the buying decision.
  • Pick up the phone, introduce the clients properly, and have a sensible conversation about the work the company does and any help it may need.
  • Ask good questions about upcoming projects, busy periods, labour shortages, existing suppliers, and who is responsible for buying support.
  • Build relationships over time. Follow up by phone and email without pestering people or using a generic sales script.
  • Keep the client contact records up to date. If a company is relevant to both, flag it and coordinate the approach so we do not contact them twice unnecessarily.
  • Book meetings for the client when there is a real reason for him to speak to the prospect, then send him a clear note before the meeting.

When a meeting is ready for the client:

The client has commitments and is often working offshore, so we need to protect their time. The BDE should not book a meeting just because someone agrees to a chat. Before handing it over, we would expect them to know:

  • Who we are speaking to and what they are responsible for.
  • What the company is working on and which Company A or Company B service might help.
  • Whether there is a genuine need, an upcoming requirement or a sensible reason to stay in touch.
  • What the next conversation with Martin is supposed to achieve.

The handover should be short and useful: company, contact details, project or site, what the prospect has told us, likely services, timing and agreed next steps. The client will take the commercial relationship forward. And the other manager and the relevant technical people will get involved where we need their experience on resourcing, scope, or mobilisation.

Requirements

  • Confident spoken and written English, with a clear and friendly telephone manner that works well with UK businesses.
  • Previous experience making outbound B2B calls and finding the right decision-makers.
  • Engineering, recruitment, or industrial experience would be useful, but is not essential if they can learn quickly.
  • Someone who listens, asks sensible questions and can talk naturally without reading from a script.
  • Organised and persistent, with good follow-up habits and accurate notes in Excel or a CRM.
  • Reliable working from home, with a quiet space, good internet and the ability to work a full-time week during UK business hours.
  • Someone who wants to be part of our businesses and build accounts over time, rather than move from one short-term calling campaign to another.

Benefits

  • Work from Home
  • UK Business Hours
