Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About CookUnity

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

Chef Marketing helps independent chefs grow their businesses on CookUnity. A chef can invest part of their weekly earnings to introduce a dish to new customers, bring past customers back, or give regulars a reason to order again. In the Chef Portal, chefs can manage campaigns and see how their dishes perform. On the customer side, those decisions show up as featured meals, Add & Save discounts, buy-one-get-one offers, and Cashback credits toward a future order.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll own features from the screen a chef uses to configure an offer to the services that decide whether a customer can redeem it. There’s a particular emphasis on backend engineering. A promotion can span multiple delivery weeks, apply only to certain meals or members. Your job is to keep those rules consistent from menu to checkout and make the outcome clear to both the customer and the chef.

Responsibilities

  • Build chef-facing tools in React and TypeScript that make it easy to set up a campaign, understand its results, and decide what to promote next.
  • Develop the APIs and data models behind offer eligibility, schedules, and daily limits. Work with Menu, Pricing, and Checkout engineers so the offer a customer sees matches the one they can redeem.
  • Use automated tests, feature flags, and staged rollouts to check that existing offers keep working during the transition.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Data, and Chef Success to test whether a promotion generates additional sales for a chef and whether customers return to order the dish again.
  • Operate what you ship. Trace slow menu requests, investigate discrepancies in discounts or credits, and add monitoring that helps the team catch problems early.
  • Lead technical design discussions, review code, and mentor other engineers through implementation and launch.
  • Helping to have higher levels of uptime & supporting the on-call rotation that will help the business run 24/7

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of a feature from design through production support.
  • Experience shipping web applications with React and TypeScript and building production backend services with Node.js.
  • Experience designing APIs and relational data models, tuning SQL queries, and keeping data consistent when requests fail or retry.
  • Experience testing user journeys across service boundaries and diagnosing production issues with logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Advanced English and the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, designers, and business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketplace promotions, pricing, loyalty programs, or another domain where an incorrect calculation affects a customer’s bill.
  • Experience migrating business rules from a legacy application or building event-driven workflows across services.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, AWS, or Kubernetes, or experience using product analytics to evaluate an experiment.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

  • Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.
  • We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.
  • We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

Job Description:

Own your opportunity to make a personal impact as a Senior Business Analyst supporting the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS).

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will lead the detailed functional interface design for ClaimsCore integrations with the Healthcare Integrated General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS). Your work will define X12-based interface files and data exchanges that provide functional parity with current Medicare Shared System interfaces and conform to existing HIGLAS interface requirements and specifications.

HOW A SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:
• Lead detailed analysis and functional design for ClaimsCore-to-HIGLAS interfaces, from source transaction identification through X12 file creation, transmission, receipt, validation, processing, reconciliation, and exception resolution.
• Analyze current Medicare Shared System interfaces—including applicable FISS, MCS, and VMS processes—to meet the HIGLAS interfaces, file structures, data content, sequencing, controls, dependencies, and operational behavior.
• Perform current-state-to-target-state gap analysis to ensure the ClaimsCore interface design maintains required functional parity while supporting approved modernization objectives.
• Analyze existing HIGLAS interface requirements, interface control documents, X12 implementation guidance, file specifications, edit rules, control requirements, and operating procedures.
• Develop detailed functional interface specifications and interface control documents (ICDs) that align ClaimsCore outputs and inputs with established HIGLAS requirements.
• Define the applicable X12 transaction structure, including envelopes, transaction sets, loops, segments, elements, qualifiers, code values, delimiters, control numbers, acknowledgments, and balancing information.
• Produce field-level source-to-target mappings between ClaimsCore data and required HIGLAS X12 elements, including data type, length, format, cardinality, valid values, derivations, defaults, conditional logic, and transformation rules.
• Define interface selection criteria, extraction logic, aggregation and splitting rules, sequencing, frequency, cutoff times, dependencies, file naming, transmission triggers, and processing schedules.
• Specify validation rules for X12 syntax, required segments and elements, referential integrity, business-rule compliance, duplicate detection, control totals, and financial balancing.
• Define acknowledgment, rejection, correction, resubmission, suspense, exception handling, restart, recovery, replay, and reconciliation requirements.
• Map existing Shared System interface functions and controls to the proposed ClaimsCore design and maintain a functional-parity matrix identifying retained, modified, replaced, and newly introduced behavior.
• Identify differences between ClaimsCore data structures and HIGLAS specifications; facilitate resolution of mapping gaps, unavailable data, conflicting definitions, and policy decisions.
• Translate detailed interface designs into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical-development inputs, and testable expected outcomes.
• Maintain end-to-end traceability among Shared System behavior, HIGLAS requirements, ClaimsCore requirements, X12 mappings, functional specifications, design decisions, test cases, defects, approvals, and production results.
• Facilitate detailed-design reviews with the Medicare LoB Product Owner, CMS and HIGLAS stakeholders, Shared System SMEs, architects, developers, data engineers, testers, security teams, and operations personnel.
• Support developers during implementation by clarifying X12 mappings, business rules, transformations, validation logic, and exception-processing requirements.
• Validate generated X12 files and data exchanges against approved mappings, HIGLAS specifications, Shared System baseline results, control totals, and expected financial outcomes.
• Analyze defects, rejected transactions, reconciliation breaks, and parity differences; document root causes and coordinate design or implementation corrections.
• Establish version control, review, approval, and change-management practices for interface specifications, mappings, parity matrices, and related design artifacts.
• Support release readiness, cutover, parallel processing, operational procedures, production validation, and post-deployment reconciliation for ClaimsCore–HIGLAS interfaces.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent 8+ years of relevant experience
• 8+ years of business analysis, functional interface design, data analysis, healthcare claims, financial systems, or systems-integration experience.
• Demonstrated experience producing detailed interface specifications, ICDs, file layouts, mapping workbooks, transformation rules, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
• Direct experience with HIGLAS interface requirements, specifications, processing, acknowledgments, reconciliation, or operational support.
• Hands-on experience analyzing and designing X12 file exchanges, including transaction structures, loops, segments, elements, qualifiers, envelopes, control numbers, and acknowledgments.
• Experience performing field-level source-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation analysis, validation design, and reconciliation analysis.
• Experience assessing legacy interfaces and defining target-state designs that preserve required functional parity.
• Knowledge of Medicare claims processing and financial transactions, including payments, adjustments, receivables, reversals, balancing, and exception handling.
• Experience interpreting existing interface requirements and specifications and converting them into implementable functional designs.
• Ability to analyze data extracts and interface results using SQL, spreadsheets, X12 validation tools, or comparable data-analysis methods.
• Experience supporting interface development, system and integration testing, parallel testing, defect triage, release readiness, and production validation.
• Strong facilitation, analytical reasoning, technical writing, problem-solving, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Experience working in an Agile, Scrum, or SAFe delivery environment using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools.
• Ability to obtain a CMS Public Trust clearance and meet the requirement of living in the United States for at least three of the last five years.
• Work visa sponsorship will not be provided.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• Experience with Medicare Shared Systems, including FISS, MCS, or VMS, and their interfaces to HIGLAS or other CMS financial systems.
• Knowledge of healthcare and financial X12 implementation guides, companion guides, validation rules, and acknowledgment transactions.
• Experience with ClaimsCore, HealthEdge, or another COTS healthcare claims-processing platform.
• Knowledge of CMS accounting, funds control, Treasury interfaces, payment reporting, financial reconciliation, and audit requirements.
• Familiarity with AWS-based file processing, secure file exchange, APIs, event messaging, ETL/data pipelines, relational databases, and monitoring solutions.
• Business analysis, X12/EDI, Product Owner, SAFe, Scrum, data-management, or project-management certification.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description:
UX/UI Designer – Figma, Product Design & User Experience

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for sprint reviews and design handoffs

About the Role

We’re hiring a UX/UI Designer to create intuitive, visually polished, and user-friendly digital experiences across web and mobile products.

You’ll work across the full design lifecycle — from understanding user needs and mapping journeys to creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, high-fidelity interfaces, and scalable design systems.

You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to turn business requirements and user insights into digital experiences that are easy to use, accessible, and built for engagement.

This role is a strong fit if you combine UX problem-solving with strong UI design skills and enjoy taking products from early concepts through developer handoff and iteration.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & User Experience

  • Conduct user interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral analysis
  • Identify user pain points, friction, and opportunities for improvement
  • Translate research into user personas, journeys, flows, and actionable design recommendations
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Hotjar, FullStory, and Google Analytics
  • Design experiences that balance user needs with product and business objectives

Wireframing & Prototyping

  • Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes
  • Develop low-fidelity concepts through high-fidelity product designs
  • Work primarily in Figma, with experience in Adobe XD or Sketch also valuable
  • Rapidly iterate based on user testing, stakeholder feedback, and product requirements
  • Clearly present and explain design decisions to stakeholders

UI & Product Design

  • Design clean, modern interfaces for web and mobile products
  • Create responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Apply strong principles of:
    • Typography
    • Layout and spacing
    • Color
    • Visual hierarchy
    • Interaction design
  • Design intuitive onboarding, navigation, dashboards, workflows, and conversion paths

Design Systems

  • Build and maintain reusable components and scalable design systems
  • Establish consistent patterns for layouts, components, spacing, and interactions
  • Maintain style guides and design documentation
  • Ensure visual and functional consistency across products and features

Accessibility & Usability

  • Apply WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility best practices
  • Design with contrast, keyboard navigation, screen readers, and responsive behavior in mind
  • Identify usability issues before they reach development
  • Continuously improve experiences based on testing and product feedback

Developer Handoff & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers throughout the development lifecycle
  • Prepare developer-ready specifications, assets, and documentation
  • Use tools such as Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or InVision
  • Review implemented features for design accuracy and consistency
  • Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, critiques, and Agile ceremonies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think about the user experience, not just how a screen looks
  • You have a strong eye for polished, modern UI
  • You can explain the reasoning behind your design decisions
  • You enjoy solving complex user and product problems
  • You’re comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly
  • You collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams
  • You care about consistency, usability, accessibility, and detail

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional UX/UI, Product Design, or Digital Product Design experience
  • Strong proficiency in Figma
  • Experience designing responsive web and/or mobile products
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • User flows
    • Interaction design
    • Usability
    • Responsive design
  • Experience creating:
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • High-fidelity interfaces
    • Design systems
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and UI execution
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, developers, and stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to work remotely during U.S. client business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing SaaS products, mobile apps, or e-commerce platforms
  • Familiarity with HTML/CSS and frontend development concepts
  • Experience with user analytics and behavior tools such as Hotjar or FullStory
  • Experience conducting usability tests or user research
  • Knowledge of A/B testing and conversion optimization
  • Experience maintaining large or scalable design systems
  • Familiarity with Agile product development environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing user feedback or analytics to identify UX improvements, then create wireframes or prototypes for an upcoming feature.

Throughout the day, you’ll collaborate with product managers and engineers, refine high-fidelity designs, update reusable components, review implemented features, and prepare designs for developer handoff.

You’ll continuously use feedback, testing, and product data to improve usability and create better experiences.

In short: you turn user needs and product requirements into intuitive, accessible, and visually engaging digital experiences.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Improved usability and user satisfaction
  • Reduced friction and user errors
  • Increased task completion and engagement
  • On-time delivery of design assets for development
  • Consistency between designs and implemented products
  • Strong adoption and scalability of design systems
  • Positive stakeholder and user feedback

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Intro Video via Spark Hire
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Design Task
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video.

It’s a short, self-recorded video completed on your own time and is the final step needed to complete your application.

Instead of repeating your background across multiple screening calls, you get to introduce yourself once and show hiring teams how you communicate before the first interview. If there’s a strong fit, your first live conversation can focus on the role rather than starting from scratch.

Don’t overthink it. You can record your responses multiple times, and discarded takes are not shared.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you:

  • Love solving user problems through design
  • Have a strong Figma and UX/UI portfolio
  • Enjoy creating polished web and mobile experiences
  • Understand both user experience and visual design
  • Thrive in collaborative product environments

We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Trilingual Technical Writer (FR, UK, DE)
jobs.description:
Our Customer Success team is looking for a Technical Writer to join us remotely.

In this role, you’ll help increase 360Learning’s user adoption by keeping our knowledge base and external product documentation in step with every product release.

You’ll be closely connected to our Product and Support teams, who will be your day-to-day partners, and you’ll enjoy the autonomy to organize your work in a flexible, async-friendly environment. You’ll move easily between English, French, and German while helping shape documentation that lives alongside the code in GitHub.

Everything we write is public: Knowledge Base, API documentation, notifications documentation.

For a closer look at how we work, read this post by a member of the team.

Within one month, you will:

Within three months, you will:

  • Convert existing internal material into external how-to articles and long-form guides

Within six months, you will:

  • Manage the end-to-end documentation process for new feature launches (around 20 / month)

Within twelve months, you will:

  • Own and lead tech writing initiatives

  • 1–3 years of experience writing technical documentation from scratch.
  • C2 proficiency in German and English, and C1 or above in French.
  • Bonus: experience working collaboratively on multilingual content and publishing workflows.
  • Comfortable using GitHub and testing documentation across web and mobile platforms.
  • Able to work independently and asynchronously with teammates across time zones.
  • A genuine love of language. Would rather cut than rewrite, rewrite than write, and write than talk. Sticks to the facts, chooses adjectives and adverbs with care, and respects the reader’s time. Notices curly apostrophes, non-breaking spaces and list punctuation.
  • Familiar with Diátaxis, the GOV.UK writing standards and accessibility best practices.
  • Puts users first, always.
  • Shares enthusiasm for our culture, explained here:

What we offer:

  • Compensation: Package includes base salary and a variable component 📈
  • Benefits: Work From Home allowance, social security, health insurance, unemployment insurance, common contingency, salary guarantee fund, lunch vouchers. Leave requests are subject to local policies.
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in Spain 🏠. Working remotely from outside Spain is also possible, subject to some conditions (tenure, performance, destination, length, etc.) and the approval of our Remote Committee 🌍

Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process:

  • Phone screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Head of Support
  • Writing test to do at home and debrief with Tech Writers
  • Culture Fit Meeting with our Chief People Officer
  • Offer!

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

jobs.title: Senior Data Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For more than 30 years, we have helped organizations build the data foundations that power intelligent systems. Today, we go further by designing and operationalizing intelligence that delivers measurable business value.

Building AI capabilities is only part of the challenge. Real transformation happens when those capabilities work within existing business systems, data environments, workflows, and processes.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

Role details

What you'll architect

As a Senior Data Strategy Consultant, you'll connect business priorities with data and analytics capabilities, ensuring that strategic initiatives deliver measurable business value.

You'll partner with business stakeholders, Data Product Management, and Data Architecture teams to identify opportunities, design solutions, and translate strategic objectives into actionable data initiatives that drive growth, operational efficiency, and customer insights.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and guide data strategy initiatives to ensure alignment between business needs, technical capabilities, and strategic outcomes.

    • Define and track KPIs, evaluate business impact, adoption, and ROI, and communicate progress, risks, recommendations, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership.

Who you are

You are a strategic, proactive, and solution-oriented data professional who combines strong business acumen with technical fluency and a consulting mindset. You excel at understanding business challenges, identifying opportunities, and translating complex needs into actionable data solutions. You communicate confidently with different audiences, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and demonstrate leadership, initiative, and ownership of strategic outcomes.

What you bring

Experience

  • 4–7 years of experience in Data Strategy, Analytics, or Solution Delivery.

Consulting and communication skills

    • Proactive problem-solving, initiative, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience managing a small team or mentoring data strategy professionals.
    • Experience supporting enterprise data strategy and annual planning.
    • Experience evaluating build-versus-buy decisions for data solutions.
    • Previous experience in the Insurance or Healthcare industries.

What makes you successful

    • You act as a trusted advisor, building strong relationships and ensuring effective collaboration between business and technical teams.
    • You translate complex business challenges into clear solution blueprints, actionable roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
    • You demonstrate strong leadership and ownership, developing team capabilities and continuously improving data strategy practices.

What we offer at Keyrus

• 100% remote work

  • International and multicultural projects
    • Opportunities to work with leading technologies in the Digital Commerce ecosystem
    • Access to training programs and continuous professional development
    • Professional growth opportunities and internal mobility
    • A culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution.

As Architects of Intelligence, we design the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, embedding intelligence into business processes so that it creates sustainable, measurable value.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we architect reliable:

• Intelligence Foundations

• Performance Steering

With over 30 years of expertise and 3,000 experts across 30 countries, we build adaptive, resilient intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capability and performance compounds over time.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

The role also supports reporting governance, Workday releases, production troubleshooting, and delivery of HR data and metrics to Human Resources and senior leadership.

Responsibilities 


  • Gather and analyze requirements and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical report designs and validation criteria.
  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize Workday HCM reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and related reporting solutions using Workday Report Writer and other applicable reporting tools. Create reports using Workday and other data sources, including consolidated outputs that support business, operational, regulatory, and leadership reporting needs.

Assists with the support of all aspects of Human Resources as it relates to data requests, including but not limited to EEO-1, Affirmative Action Plan, and benefits census.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Associate Director - FP&A & Investor Reporting
jobs.description:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike traditional platforms that stop at insights, Lucidya closes the loop. Our proprietary AI is built in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, enabling teams across marketing, support, and CX to deliver experiences that actually move the needle.

We’re scaling fast, and that growth brings complexity. That’s where this role comes in.

Role Overview

Lead the Financial Planning & Analysis function and serve as a strategic finance partner to the CFO and executive leadership team. Own financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, commercial finance and investor reporting. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights, drive financial accountability and support fundraising, M&A, financial due diligence and long-term IPO readiness.

Key responsibilities

Financial planning, budgeting & forecasting

  • Own annual business planning and budgeting across the organization.
  • Develop and maintain the integrated long-term financial and strategic business plan.
  • Lead rolling forecasts incorporating business dynamics and operational performance.
  • Build integrated revenue, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow and capital requirement models.
  • Conduct scenario planning, sensitivity analysis and stress testing.
  • Establish budgetary controls, resource allocation and expenditure management frameworks.
  • Drive financial accountability through defined financial and operational KPIs.

Management reporting & business performance

  • Own timely monthly and quarterly MIS for executive leadership and the Board.
  • Analyze actual performance against budget, forecast and prior periods; highlight drivers, risks and opportunities.
  • Establish early warning indicators and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop executive dashboards and lead periodic functional performance reviews.
  • Reconcile management reporting with statutory financial information and operational data.

SaaS metrics & unit economics

  • Own reporting, analysis and governance of ARR, MRR, bookings, expansion, contraction, churn, NRR, GRR, CAC, CAC payback, LTV, LTV/CAC, sales efficiency, Magic Number, Rule of 40, Burn Multiple, ARPA, revenue concentration and customer cohorts.
  • Analyze product, customer and segment profitability and benchmark against global SaaS and AI industry standards.
  • Develop Agentic AI unit economics, including consumption-based pricing, inference and infrastructure costs, and contribution margins.
  • Standardize metric definitions across internal, Board and investor reporting.

Finance business partnering & commercial finance

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Professional Services and other functions.
  • Support deal economics, pricing, discount evaluation and contract profitability assessments.
  • Evaluate pipeline conversion, sales productivity, quota capacity and revenue predictability.
  • Drive cost optimization and operating leverage across cloud infrastructure, AI compute, third-party tools and headcount.
  • Evaluate ROI of new products, market expansion and strategic initiatives.
  • Drive margin improvement and productivity initiatives; establish investment appraisal and capital allocation frameworks.

Investor reporting & investor relations support

  • Own end-to-end preparation and timely delivery of investor reporting packs, including financial statements, SaaS metrics, performance updates and forward-looking information.
  • Prepare Board presentations, shareholder updates and materials for existing and prospective investors.
  • Translate financial and operational performance into clear, credible investor-facing narratives.
  • Manage institutional investor and shareholder information requests in coordination with the CFO.
  • Ensure compliance with investor information rights and periodic reporting obligations under applicable shareholder and financing agreements.
  • Maintain an investor reporting calendar and track reporting commitments.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency and traceability of information across reporting periods and fundraising rounds.
  • Own financial and operational sections of the Virtual Data Room (VDR), maintaining accurate and current information for authorized stakeholders.
  • Support the CFO in investor meetings, presentations, fundraising discussions and responses to investor queries.
  • Establish institutional-grade investor reporting processes aligned with global best practices.

Strategic finance, fundraising & M&A

  • Support equity and debt fundraising through financial modelling, valuation and investor and lender materials.
  • Evaluate financing structures, capital requirements, shareholder dilution and returns.
  • Support financial and commercial due diligence and coordinate responses to investors, lenders and advisors.
  • Evaluate M&A opportunities through valuation, synergy and investment return analysis.
  • Develop post-acquisition financial models and monitor synergy realization.
  • Support capital structure optimization, capital allocation and the Finance IPO readiness roadmap.

Cash flow & working capital management

  • Maintain short- and long-term cash flow forecasts with Treasury and Accounting.
  • Monitor cash burn, liquidity runway and funding requirements.
  • Analyze working capital, receivables, collections and billing cycles.
  • Support evaluation of working capital financing and other funding alternatives.
  • Monitor financial covenants, assess projected compliance and recommend liquidity risk mitigation.

Finance transformation, systems & team development

  • Build a scalable, data-driven FP&A function and automate planning, reporting and analytics.
  • Establish a single source of truth through integration of ERP, CRM and business intelligence platforms.
  • Institutionalize FP&A policies, processes, reporting standards and governance frameworks.
  • Build, mentor and develop a high-performing FP&A team and foster financial discipline, ownership and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline; CA, CPA, CMA, CIMA, CFA or MBA in Finance strongly preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience, including relevant leadership experience. The person has to be hands on and ready to roll up the sleeves when the occasion called for it.
  • Prior experience in high-growth B2B SaaS, technology or AI-driven businesses strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated investor and Board reporting experience and engagement with institutional investors.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics, integrated financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and scenario analysis.
  • Exposure to fundraising, debt financing, M&A and due diligence highly desirable.
  • Working knowledge of IFRS; advanced Excel, modelling and presentation skills; experience with ERP, CRM, BI and planning platforms.
  • Experience in VC-backed, PE-backed or pre-IPO organizations advantageous; GCC exposure desirable.


Key competencies

  • Strategic thinking, commercial acumen and exceptional analytical and modelling capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights and compelling financial narratives.
  • Executive communication and confidence engaging senior leadership, Board members and institutional investors.
  • Ownership, accountability, attention to detail and ability to constructively challenge assumptions.
  • Leadership, stakeholder management and effectiveness in a fast-paced growth environment.
  • Integrity, confidentiality and sound professional judgment.

Paralegals are expected to be available for clients during business hours as agreed upon with each client, but around-the-clock availability is not expected. Job Overview

Paralegals within Zirtual’s Paralegal Division are custom matched based upon the client’s specific needs, practice areas and state. The outlined tasks below will vary based on each client and practice area. When reviewing, please consider those tasks applicable to your specialty.

In general, paralegals are expected to have a minimum of 3 years of experience handling the below outlined duties.

When offered a client, you will be provided with a Statement of Work that outlines the pay rate for the specific client as well as any area specific additions. While paralegals may be asked to handle legal assistant tasks, the rate will be outlined in the provided Statement of Work.

Experienced Probate & Estate Administration Paralegal

Position: Fractional, Remote Paralegal
Location: Remote – U.S.-Based
Practice Area: Probate, Intestate Administration & Estate Planning

Hours per month: 10
Jurisdictions: New York and New Jersey

About the Opportunity

A growing legal practice focused on probate, intestate administration, and estate planning is seeking an experienced paralegal to provide ongoing, fractional support.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience handling probate and intestate administration matters and be comfortable managing legal tasks independently with minimal supervision. This opportunity is best suited for someone who can step into an established practice, quickly learn existing procedures, and provide reliable support without requiring foundational training.

The attorney is looking for a dependable, detail-oriented professional who understands probate workflows, communicates proactively, and can take ownership of assigned matters from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with probate and intestate administration matters from initiation through completion.
  • Draft, prepare, and assist with filing probate petitions and related court documents.
  • Prepare estate inventories and assist with probate accounting and court accounting documentation, as applicable to experience and assigned responsibilities.
  • Assist with estate administration and related legal documentation.
  • Conduct client follow-up and maintain communication regarding active probate matters.
  • Track deadlines, monitor outstanding documentation, and proactively communicate upcoming deadlines or items requiring attention.
  • Maintain organized client files and supporting documentation.
  • Work within the attorney's established systems and procedures while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency when appropriate.
  • Provide occasional support with estate planning matters as assigned.

Requirements

    • Minimum of 3 years of relevant legal experience, with substantial hands-on experience in probate and/or intestate administration.
    • Prior experience working as a paralegal or experienced legal assistant in a law firm.
    • Demonstrated experience drafting and preparing probate petitions and related court filings.
    • Working knowledge of probate administration processes, estate inventories, and probate accounting.
    • Familiarity with New York and New Jersey probate procedures and court requirements.
    • Ability to manage assigned matters independently without requiring foundational training.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
    • Dependable, responsive, and consistent follow-through.
    • Ability to manage deadlines and prioritize multiple active matters.
    • Comfortable working independently within an established workflow.
    • Understanding of attorney-client privilege and the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality.
  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Experience handling both New York and New Jersey probate and intestate administration matters.
    • Experience preparing estate inventories and probate or fiduciary accountings.
    • Experience with estate planning and trust administration.
    • Experience supporting a solo practitioner or small law firm.
    • Familiarity with WealthDocs or similar estate administration software.
    • Ability to work with minimal supervision and quickly adapt to existing processes.
  • Technology
    • WealthDocs (familiarity preferred; not required at launch)
    • Electronic document management and file organization systems
    • Probate court filing portals and related court systems

Benefits

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • You will be compensated as a 1099 independent contractor.
  • When matched out of our preferred network, and depending on your practice area, you can expect to earn a minimum of $28 per hour for paralegal work.
  • You can expect to earn $20 per hour for legal assistant work.
  • Pay is dependent on client plan size, area of practice and need.

NOTE:

  • Zirtual does not guarantee hours or clients. Please note that this application is to join the Zirtual contractor network. If offered to join, you will be considered for client opportunities that best match your skills and interests.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
  • No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment.
  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address.
  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Internship - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.

Learn more:

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You'll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.

As a Sales Operations Intern, you'll become an integral part of our team, working on impactful projects that enhance OpenSesame's sales processes and drive growth. You'll gain hands-on experience in sales analytics, process optimization, and system management while collaborating across departments and engaging with our leadership team.

AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You'll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we'll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You'll explore how AI and data can improve sales processes, data quality, and customer outcomes, and see how process design and AI innovation combine to make a sales team more effective.

Intern AI Hackathon

As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You'll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.

About the Sales Operations Team

At OpenSesame, our Sales Operations Team is the engine that powers our sales success! We're experts at streamlining processes, diving into data, and crafting innovative strategies that elevate sales performance and efficiency.

With a focus on problem-solving, data-driven insights, and seamless cross-functional collaboration, we ensure every move aligns with our ambitious business goals. Guided by data and AI-driven insights, we keep improving how we work. Join our dynamic team to lead innovation, drive continuous improvement, and play a pivotal role in shaping the growth and success of OpenSesame!

Performance Objectives

By 2 Weeks

  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of OpenSesame's sales operations processes and tools.
  • Get set up with our internal AI tools and learn how the team uses them day to day.
  • Assist with things like creating and documenting scalable and repeatable sales processes.
  • Start improving data quality and integrity across systems used by sales and customer success teams.

By 30 Days

  • Support teams like Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Managers with process documentation and error resolution.
  • Assist with things like order management verification and system migrations to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude, to analyze data, identify trends, and suggest areas for improvement in sales operations.
  • Join the intern hackathon team and build a working prototype (see above).
  • Learn more about our organization-wide training program, OpenSesame Qualified.

By 60 Days

  • Establish yourself as a reliable resource for teams like Sales Leadership, Order Fulfillment, Partners, Business Intelligence, and Finance.
  • Lead a small project to develop tools, including AI-powered ones, that support self-reflection and development for the sales team.
  • Conduct training sessions on topics like leveraging data insights and AI tools, refining sales processes, and using tools effectively.

Not selected for this role? You’re still in the running. We’ll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

Application and Creative Project

Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide. It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.

To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.

We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.

You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:

  • How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
  • What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
  • Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
    • Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
    • Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.

We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.

Additional Program Details

Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027

Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Compensation: $20 an hour

Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.

Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame's internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You'll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.

Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they're being considered for.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

CPRA (California candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive (USA)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Huble!

Huble is a Go-To-Market (GTM) Consultancy that helps large mid-market and small multinational companies transform their marketing, sales, and service operations using HubSpot as the core platform. Huble is a global HubSpot Elite Solutions Partner. Huble was named HubSpot's Global Partner of the Year in 2025 (based on 2024 performance). We have placed in the top 10 globally every year the accolade has existed. We are one of around 49 Elite-tier partners out of more than 6,000 globally. We have been a HubSpot partner since 2012, making us one of the longest-standing partners in the ecosystem.

Who we are looking for:

Huble is looking for an experienced Senior Account Executive to grow new business across NAM.

This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for an experienced sales operator who is comfortable owning complex B2B sales cycles from first conversation through to close. You’ll be responsible for developing new opportunities across enterprise and mid-market accounts, working across inbound, outbound, partner-led and self-generated pipeline, and building long-term relationships with senior decision makers.

The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in enterprise sales and consultative solutions selling, ideally within CRM, MarTech, digital transformation, technology or professional services. You’ll be comfortable selling complex solutions rather than predefined products, understanding business challenges, shaping propositions, coordinating internal specialists and translating customer requirements into compelling commercial outcomes.

Experience with CRM or Marketing Automation platforms such as Hubspot either through selling the platform, implementing it, working within the HubSpot ecosystem or using it commercially. You should understand the broader CRM and GTM landscape and be able to have credible conversations with Marketing, Sales, Service, IT and C-level stakeholders.

You’ll take ownership of the complete sales process: qualification and discovery, stakeholder mapping, solution development, proposals and RFPs, presentations, commercial negotiations and contract close. You’ll be technically minded enough to lead discovery and solution conversations without relying on a sales engineer for every engagement, while bringing in Huble’s wider consulting, technical and delivery teams when required.

A key part of the role will also be building a strong go-to-market relationship with HubSpot’s sales organisation. We want someone who can become a trusted partner to HubSpot AEs, BDRs and Customer Success teams, creating joint opportunities and helping Huble become a natural extension of their sales motion.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants genuine freedom to operate entrepreneurially within an established international consultancy. You’ll need to be commercially driven, curious, credible with senior stakeholders and comfortable creating a pipeline rather than waiting for leads to arrive.

🚀 Key Performance Areas:Management of Prospects and Customers in the Sales Process to Reach Set Target

  • Taking a prospect or customer from expressed interest though the Huble sales process, following all the identified steps and adapting where necessary to close the deal including:
    • Conducting Discovery Meetings
    • Coordinating a consultative approach and participating in proposition, commercial and proposal development
    • Building presentations and presenting solutions and commercials to prospective customers
    • Responding to RFP’s and Tenders
    • Negotiating commercial and contractual terms
  • Conducting demonstrations of the HubSpot platform.
  • Developing a plan to reach and exceed sales targets set.

Reporting on Sales Process

  • Recording and keeping all data related to your sales activities in Huble systems such as HubSpot and spreadsheets.
  • Submitting accurate forecast reports.
  • Report on levels of activity and plan to reach sales targets.

Sourcing of Leads

  • Working closely with the Huble marketing team to ensure inbound leads are being generated in your territory.
  • Responsible for generating a large share of your own pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting.
  • Responsible for identifying prospects (matching our ICP) from alternative sources that result in qualified opportunities.
  • Manage outreach programs to decision makers and influencers from prospects identified from above exercise, on successful connect built relationships.
  • Through relationships with target accounts, identify opportunities that can move into the sales process outlined in areas of responsibility #1.
  • Build relationships with the HubSpot Sales Team, Channel Team and Customer Success Teams so that they come to you and Huble for assistance in closing new customers together and retaining and growing existing customers together.
  • Use your personal network and existing customers to gain referrals to new potential customers.

🏗️ To excel in this role, you should have the following:

  • Proven experience and success in a B2B sales role in a digital consultancy or agency or CRM software company or a team leader of a marketing/digital/CRM consultancy who wants to focus their career on solution design instead of delivery.
  • Technically minded with ability to conduct discovery meetings without the need for a sales engineer.
  • Tech-savvy strategist experienced in leading the pre-sales process and accurately scoping technical deliverables for high-complexity projects.
  • Ability to conduct software demonstrations.
  • Experience in negotiating with C-level executives from mid-market to large companies.
  • Confident in using the telephone.
  • Ability to build commercial solutions and proposals using a consultative approach (not only a set product list).
  • Ability to present your work and articulate succinctly.
  • Ability to drive and manage multiple internal stakeholders during sales engagements.

⚡️ These personal qualities are key to your success:

  • Always questioning and naturally curious
  • Coachability
  • Prior Success in Sales
  • Intelligence and high emotional intelligence
  • High Work Ethic
  • Domain Expertise - digital and CRM
  • Rapport Building
  • Objection Handling and Negotiation Skills
  • Ability to prioritise and work autonomously
  • Able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Excellent time and self-management skills
  • Excellent communication, influential and interpersonal skills with people at all levels, internally and externally

💥Huble Values:

  • We are Human
  • We embrace Change
  • We are Innovative
  • We solve for the Customer
  • We are Team Players

🤝 Ready to make a move?

If you are ready to take on this exciting opportunity and join our team, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and let's Huble together!

🛣️ Interview Process

  • Video/Screening Call (15 min)
  • 1st Interview (30 min)
  • Take Home Assessment
  • Presentation Interview (60 min)
  • Final Interview (30 min)

NB - Please note that candidates must have the legal right to work and current residency in USA.

Please note that we have not enlisted the help of external recruiters for this role. If contacted by someone outside of Huble who does not have the @hubledigital.com email domain, please inform us immediately. Thank you!

Benefits

🎁 As part of the remuneration package, you will receive the following

The salary range is between USD 84,000 - USD 88,000 per annum, depending on skills and experience + commission, with the following benefits:

  • 🌍 Work from anywhere - Enjoy the freedom of remote work within the country of employment.
  • 🏦 Pension scheme - Enjoy a discretionary 401K Match.
  • 🏥 Healthcare benefits- Join our company healthcare scheme after just one full calendar month of service.
  • 🪑 Create your ideal workspace - Receive a budget to set up your home office with your preferred desk and chair.
  • 💻 Choice of devices - Choose between a MacBook or Windows Laptop, complete with a monitor and mouse.
  • 🌴 Generous leave policy - Enjoy 19 annual leave days, in addition to Public and Banking Holidays, and receive 1 bonus day for special occasions like your Birthday.
  • 🧘 Flexible working hours - Benefit from flexible working hours to accommodate your personal needs, whether it's for leisure or family commitments.
  • 👕 Show your company pride - Get your hands on Huble Swag.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword — it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


About the Role

The Senior Technical Architect, specializing in our Voice-centric product solutions, is a recognized expert in the deep technical infrastructure, integration, and security of Voice and Contact Center solutions for enterprise customer engagements. This role significantly shapes the successful technical architecture, engineering standards, and deployment of complex cloud telephony projects, while driving technical excellence and engineering best practices within the CSG Professional Services team.


This senior-level position sits within CSG Professional Services, in the Emerging Specialized Delivery team. You will serve as the premier technical authority and Salesforce platform expert to the company's largest, most complex enterprise customers, guiding their engineering and IT teams through transformational initiatives utilizing Agentforce Contact Center (AFCC), Partner Contact Center (formerly SCV), Voice AI, and core Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) ecosystems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect Technical Infrastructure: Serve as the primary technical authority, providing architectural leadership on the design, build, and deployment of highly scalable voice infrastructure, CTI integrations, and real-time media/data architectures across the Agentforce and Partner Contact Center product suites.
  • Lead System Integration: Design and oversee the deep technical integration of enterprise CCaaS platforms (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, Five9) with the Salesforce platform, managing complex nuances such as SIP trunking, WebRTC, carrier connectivity, firewall configurations, and network latency optimization.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Define and enforce technical standards, CI/CD deployment pipelines, environment management strategies, and code quality (Apex, LWC) for telephony-integrated CRM solutions.
  • Manage Technical Risk: Identify and proactively manage architectural and security risk areas on high-profile engagements, and commit to seeing complex system integration and network routing issues through to complete resolution.
  • Technical Problem Solving: Troubleshoot complex, multi-system integration failures and negotiate technical solutions with third-party voice vendors, network engineers, and client IT teams.
  • Artifact & Quality Control: Review and correct technical artifacts (e.g., system context diagrams, data models, integration sequence diagrams, security architectures) to ensure high performance, security, and scalability.
  • Practice Development: Contribute to internal technical initiatives; build reusable code assets, reference architectures, and automation scripts to accelerate voice deployments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 7+ years of software engineering, system architecture, or technical consulting experience, with at least 5 years of dedicated, hands-on technical experience in Contact Center, CCaaS, or Voice infrastructure technologies.
  • Deep technical implementation expertise in Partner Contact Center and at least one leading telephony platform (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, Five9), including API-level integration capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience designing enterprise CRM workflows on Salesforce Service Cloud—ideally including Omni-Channel routing and Case Management—with a proven track record of unifying voice and digital channels into a cohesive agent workspace.
  • Extensive foundational knowledge of network and telephony protocols, including SIP, WebRTC, RTP, TCP/UDP, PBX, ACD, and softphone architectures.
  • Advanced application design and development skills with deep knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP/GraphQL APIs, OAuth, JWT, event-driven architectures like Platform Events or Kafka) for connecting voice systems with CRM data.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines specific to Salesforce (e.g., Salesforce DX, Copado) and cloud infrastructure.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and architect new technical concepts in the Voice AI, Natural Language Understanding (NLU), and machine learning integration space.
  • Strong technical communication skills, capable of aligning engineering teams, infosec departments, and enterprise architecture boards on complex telephony designs.
  • Travel to client sites (average of 10%), but maybe higher or lower based on the client engagement.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.


Preferred Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (or its foreign degree equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent demonstrable work experience in lieu of a degree will be considered.
  • Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g., Integration Architecture, Identity and Access Management Architect, System Architect) and specific vendor engineering certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect/DevOps, Genesys Cloud Certified Professional).
  • Deep understanding of contact center compliance, security standards (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC2), encryption, and data residency considerations related to voice recording and transcription.
  • Experience implementing Amazon Connect infrastructure as code (IaC) and Contact Center Technology across various industries.
  • Hands-on experience coding and integrating Conversational AI and voice bots (e.g., Amazon Lex, Google Dialogflow) via APIs.
  • Experience leading technical engineering teams or workstreams, with a passion for code reviews, architectural reviews, and mentoring technical talent.
  • Ability to build and maintain key relationships with technical leaders (CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Lead Network Engineers).

Required Qualities

  • PASSION: Passionate about building robust, scalable technical solutions.
  • BEGINNER'S MIND: Always learning; approaches each technical challenge with an open mind; highly hands-on and curious.
  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at leading engineering workstreams.
  • COMMUNICATOR: Speaks and writes technical specs with clarity, brevity, and purpose; influences and engages Enterprise Architects and CTOs with authority and confidence.
  • STORYTELLER: Confidently defends architectural decisions; facilitates technical design sessions effectively.
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with cross-functional development teams.
  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast, troubleshoot rapidly, and drive technical results.
  • TRUST: Trusts the company’s core values; shows integrity, transparency, and reliability in handling secure data.
  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of technical uncertainty and changing requirements.
  • COMMUNITY CHAMPION: Leads internal engineering initiatives; actively contributes technical assets to the Community’s knowledge base.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

Success looks like a team comprised of competent, well-supported licensed clinicians and non-clinicians, oversight and facilitation of clinical quality and safety processes that hold up to client and audit review, and adherence outcomes that clients can see.

Core Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Clinical Solutions function day to day through the Clinical Navigators and Adherence Coordinators: set priorities, assign work, manage scheduling and coverage, and make sure patients and caregivers receive timely, compassionate clinical support.
  • Hire, coach, develop, and manage performance of licensed non-exempt Clinical Navigators, and clinical and non-clinical Adherence Coordinators. Maintain a clear distinction between each clinical role following program-defined business rules and Medical Affairs-approved content from each client. The differentiated roles represent navigators, as a role that uses independent clinical judgment, while coordinators, follow specific program-defined guidelines and materials.
  • Implement clinical protocols and escalation pathways, including patient safety escalations, and ensure adverse events are identified and reported according to each program's procedures and client requirements.
  • Verify and monitor licensure, credentials and competency across a mixed-discipline team; govern standards and escalation rather than supervising each discipline's scope of practice, in line with state requirements.
  • Run clinical quality assurance and audits; track QA scores, escalation turnaround and adverse-event reporting timeliness; and drive corrective action and continuous improvement.
  • Apply Medical Affairs-approved clinical content in all clinical services work and own product specific clinical education and training. Review the clinical accuracy of policy, prior authorization and appeal materials in partnership with the Director, Payor Strategy & Policy.
  • Own the clinical handoffs: receive patients from Case Management, Pharmacy and Reimbursement Operations, and pass clinical findings, adherence barriers and risk back to those teams so nothing is lost between stages of the patient journey.
  • Scope and manage clinical operations for stand-alone service line for the organization.
  • Serve as the operational clinical contact for client program teams; participate in business reviews, escalations and program design discussions, and bring clinical considerations into new programs and launches.
  • Define, track and report clinical and adherence measures to leadership and clients on a regular cadence, including navigator retention and competency, and adherence outcomes.
  • Manage within the approved budget and staffing plan; escalate risk, scope and budget changes early and propose growth plans as program volume changes.
  • Model PRO-spectus's culture and behaviors: act with purpose, own the challenge, and keep the patient first in every clinical decision.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills & Requirements:

  • Clinical credibility: able to lead licensed clinicians and earn their trust, with sound judgment on patient safety, escalation and adverse-event reporting.
  • Leads people effectively: hires, coaches, holds people accountable and builds a team culture of ownership and compassion, including in a remote, hourly, mixed-license setting.
  • Strong understanding of patient adherence, patient and caregiver education, and clinical support models in specialty, orphan or rare disease therapies.
  • Quality mindset: designs and runs QA reviews and audits, reads the data, and turns findings into practical improvements.
  • Collaborates across Patient Services, Pharmacy, Reimbursement Operations and Policy; manages handoffs clearly and follows through.
  • Communicates clearly and calmly with clients, patients, caregivers and executives, including in escalations and high-stakes situations.
  • Decision quality under ambiguity: makes timely, well-reasoned calls, escalates appropriately and owns the result.
  • Business insight: balances clinical quality with capacity, budget and client commitments; connects navigator work to client outcomes.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and case management systems such as Salesforce; comfortable using metrics dashboards.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • Required: Active, unrestricted clinical license able to credibly lead licensed clinicians (for example RN, NP, PA or PharmD).
  • Required: Bachelor's degree in nursing, pharmacy or another healthcare field.
  • Required: 8+ years of relevant clinical or patient services experience.
  • Required: 4+ years leading people, including direct leadership of licensed clinicians.
  • Preferred: Advanced degree (for example MSN, DNP, MHA, MBA or PharmD).
  • Preferred: Experience in patient support, hub, specialty pharmacy or adherence programs, and with adverse-event reporting and clinical quality or audit programs.
  • Preferred: Experience with orphan or rare disease, or cell and gene therapy.

Physical Requirements:

  • As a remote-forward organization, this position operates in a virtual professional office environment and teleworking from the employee’s home address listed in their employment file.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Keyboarding
  • Speaking
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times
  • Flexibility of working hours to support activities across EST to PST zones
  • Minimal travel possible

Our PRO-spectus Culture Philosophy

At PRO-spectus we have created a culture that is supportive, dedicated, and teamwork driven. We celebrate each other’s joys in personal life and professional accomplishments, promoting meaningful relationships and friendships.

Our employees bring strength of mind and spirit to make the extraordinary happen every day. With humility and compassion at our core, PRO-spectus is proud of our relentless focus towards the higher purpose of improving the lives of patients we support.

We recognize it takes a lot of people working together with a common goal to make spectacular happen, and we never forget that at the heart of our company are the people who make it work.

PRO-spectus is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status or other protected status under federal, state or local laws.1

At PRO-spectus, we are deeply committed to pay transparency and equity. The annual range for this position is $150,000 - $160,000, based on experience and qualifications, with the final offer reflecting skills and other job-related factors. Beyond competitive pay, we offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance.

Our benefits include robust medical, dental, and vision plans; life insurance and disability coverage; and tax-advantaged savings accounts. We also provide an Employee Assistance Program, home office benefits, and unique perks like an Employee Ownership Program. With paid time off, holidays, bereavement leave, and a 401(k)-retirement plan with employer matching, PRO-spectus prioritizes your financial and personal security. Plus, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus opportunity.

Join PRO-spectus, where your career growth, well-being, and contributions truly matter!
