ABOUT THE COMPANY

Next Churchill Business, Inc., doing business as My Cash Finders (“My Cash Finders”), provides recovery services that help U.S. customers identify and pursue potential financial recovery opportunities, including unclaimed property. Its work involves research, claimant and ownership information verification, customer communication, and the collection and organization of supporting documentation.

CONTRACTING COMPANY: Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC, doing business as Enterprise Workforce Solutions

RECEIVING COMPANY(S): Next Churchill Business, Inc. DBA My Cash Finders

POSITION TITLE: Claims Processor

ALTERNATE TITLE(S): Claims Processing Specialist; Claims Support Specialist

DIVISION: Operations

DEPARTMENT: Corporate and Professional Services Staffing

ACCOUNTABLE TO: Operations Manager - Next Churchill Business Inc. dba My Cash Finders

ACCOUNTABLE FOR: Reviewing, organizing, and tracking claimant information and supporting documentation; verifying claim-related details; maintaining accurate records; coordinating customer follow-ups; and supporting the complete and timely handling of recovery claims.

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt – Independent Contractor (Non-U.S., W-8BEN)

AVAILABLE WORK SCHEDULES (U.S. Eastern Time)

Position 1: Monday 7 AM–3 PM, Tuesday 7 AM–3 PM, Wednesday 7 AM–3 PM, Thursday OFF, Friday OFF, Saturday 7 AM–3 PM, Sunday 11 AM–7 PM.

Position 2: Monday 11 AM–7 PM, Tuesday 11 AM–7 PM, Wednesday OFF, Thursday 7 AM–3 PM, Friday 7 AM–3 PM, Saturday 11 AM–7 PM, Sunday OFF.

Position 3: Monday OFF, Tuesday 9 AM–5 PM, Wednesday 11 AM–7 PM, Thursday 11 AM–7 PM, Friday 11 AM–7 PM, Saturday OFF, Sunday 7 AM–3 PM.

Schedule Availability:Three (3) positions are available, each with a designated weekly schedule. Applicants may indicate their preferred schedule, subject to availability. Once a schedule has been assigned, it will no longer be available to other applicants.

COMPENSATION: $5.00 USD per hour; approximately $200 USD per week for 40 approved service hours. Fixed hourly rate; no commissions, sales bonuses, or financial incentives.

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: N/A

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The Claims Processor supports My Cash Finders’ recovery operations by reviewing and organizing claimant information and supporting records, verifying relevant details, maintaining accurate claim documentation, and coordinating with customers and internal teams to support the processing of potential financial recovery claims. The role requires strong research and documentation skills, careful handling of confidential customer information, and professional communication with U.S.-based customers.

The position may involve researching unclaimed property and public records, identifying and verifying claimant and ownership information, assisting customers with documentation requirements, and coordinating with Research, Operations, and other Claims Processing personnel. The contractor is also expected to maintain complete and accurate records in company-approved systems.

SCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review, organize, and maintain claimant files and supporting documentation related to potential financial recovery claims.
  • Research unclaimed property records, public records, and other available sources to support the identification and verification of potential claims.
  • Identify and verify claimant information, ownership details, and supporting records for accuracy and completeness.
  • Review submitted customer information and documents, identify missing or inconsistent items, and coordinate appropriate follow-up to obtain or clarify required information.
  • Prepare, update, and maintain accurate claim notes, research findings, reports, and documentation in company-approved systems.
  • Track claim-related documentation, follow-up needs, and file status to support timely and organized processing.
  • Communicate professionally with customers by telephone and other approved channels to explain documentation requirements, respond to inquiries, and clarify next steps.
  • Handle inbound customer calls, including calls transferred by the AI-powered outbound calling system, and provide clear and accurate assistance within the assigned scope.
  • Conduct occasional outbound follow-ups for information verification, missing documentation, or customer requests; return missed calls as needed.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Research, and Claims Processing personnel to address file questions, documentation gaps, and customer follow-up needs.
  • Maintain accurate CRM notes and customer communication records.
  • Protect customer information and follow applicable confidentiality, privacy, and information-security requirements when accessing, handling, or communicating records.
  • Meet assigned deadlines and service expectations while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and complete documentation.

UNSCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist with related research, administrative, or customer-support tasks reasonably connected to recovery claim processing.
  • Support follow-up on pending customer requests or incomplete documentation as operational needs arise.
  • Assist with resolving documentation or information discrepancies by coordinating with the appropriate internal personnel.
  • Participate in operational updates, quality reviews, or process discussions related to claim handling.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer; frequent telephone and headset use; and sustained attention to digital records, research materials, and customer documentation.

WORK CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote work-from-home arrangement.
  • Fast-paced, deadline-driven environment supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Assigned work hours follow U.S. Eastern Time and may include overnight hours in the Philippines and weekend coverage.
  • Requires a quiet, private workspace and reliable computer, internet, headset, and electricity.

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS

  • Strong spoken and written English proficiency, including clear pronunciation, grammar, vocabulary, and comprehension of American English.
  • Professional telephone communication, active listening, and customer-service skills.
  • Strong research, analytical, problem-solving, and information-verification abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when reviewing claimant information and supporting documents.
  • Ability to organize files, maintain complete records, and prepare clear written summaries and CRM notes.
  • Proficiency with CRM software, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online databases.
  • Ability to explain information and documentation requirements clearly and accurately.
  • Ability to work independently, manage assigned tasks, and meet deadlines.
  • Commitment to customer confidentiality and information security.

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS

Education

High school diploma or equivalent required; college education preferred.

Experience

  • At least one (1) year of experience in call center operations, customer service, research, financial services, or administrative support.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in BPO operations, financial services, unclaimed property research, or claims processing is an advantage.

Technical Requirements

Proficiency with CRM software, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online research databases.

Remote Work Requirements

  • A reliable computer or laptop and stable, high-speed internet connection.
  • A professional headset with a clear microphone.
  • A quiet, private workspace suitable for confidential telephone and computer-based work.
  • Reliable access to electricity and connectivity throughout assigned working hours.
  • Availability for the complete assigned U.S. Eastern Time schedule, including weekends where scheduled.
  • Ability to maintain customer confidentiality and information security.

Candidate Selection Process

Initial Screening - Assessment - Final Interview

Shortlisted applicants will complete:

  1. Live English Assessment: Spoken fluency, clarity, listening comprehension, and professional communication.
  2. Customer Service Simulation: A simulated U.S. customer telephone inquiry.
  3. Research Assessment: Online investigative research and information verification.
  4. Written English Assessment: Professional documentation and written communication.

About GCG

For more than 20 years, Gabriele Consulting Group Inc. (GCG) has provided mid-size and large organizations, including companies in the Fortune 100, with strategic guidance and hands-on support in solving their most complex challenges where technology intersects with transformational business objectives. With deep expertise in mergers, acquisitions and divestitures, data governance, legal sourcing and eDiscovery services, GCG is uniquely positioned to bridge the gap between tech teams and business unit leaders to improve performance, mitigate risk, and realize significant cost savings. Our goal is to provide clients with sustainable strategies, technical solutions and optimized processes, which drive profitability and competitiveness.

GCG is guided by our mission, vision, and values which unite us through a common goal, and exist to multiply the impact our clients have in the world by removing the obstacles that stand in the way of achieving their greatest potential.

Mission: Through a hands-on consulting approach, we solve complex problems and build sustainable capabilities for our clients.

Vision: We are a deeply integrated, trusted partner for a select few of the world’s most impactful companies.

Core Values:
  • Hands-on- We differentiate from others in the consulting industry by rolling up our sleeves to get the work done, not just making recommendations without follow-through.
  • Human-Centric - We understand the competing priorities within organizations and across departments and we customize our solutions, taking into account the unique needs of all of the people involved.
  • Integrated- We don’t just operate as an outside consultant; our model of internal consulting allows us to embed our team members in our client organizations, improving our ability to deeply understand the needs, develop customized solutions and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Accuracy - We take pride in tending to the details because we know our clients need to focus on the big picture, and we know accuracy is key to building trust.
  • Sustainable Growth - We help our clients build sustainable capabilities by teaching them how to maintain the solutions we develop, thus reducing their dependence on us, and we sustain our own growth by identifying new ways to add value.

Learn more about us: GCGstrategy.com

Position Summary:

We are seeking a skilled program manager with IT program and project management experience to serve as the critical link between business managers and technical teams. This role does not require deep technical expertise (such as coding), but it does require the ability to understand the intersection between interrelated tech applications and business goals, exceptional organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to keep projects on track in a complex environment with multiple stakeholders.

The successful candidate will be adept at translating business requirements into actionable project plans, ensuring all parties are aligned on goals, timelines, and deliverables, and proactively addressing roadblocks to maintain project momentum.

As examples of the types of projects this position could work on, here are several projects we have been or are currently involved in with our current client:

  • Project management of very large unstructured data governance initiative, including managing unstructured data separation strategy and execution for a large-scale spinoff
  • Project management of a large-scale migration from prior versions of SAP and JDE ERPs to SAP S/4 HANA.
  • Program management of the ingestion of data into the company’s Common Data Layer (CDL), which is a massive data repository, housing data from hundreds of apps and tens of thousands of tables.

Why Join Us

At GCG, you’ll have the opportunity to experience the best of both worlds—the agility and camaraderie of a small, collaborative team combined with the resources, scale, and challenges of working with a Fortune 100 company. You’ll be trusted with the autonomy to move projects forward and make an impact.

We offer flexible hours and remote work to support a healthy work–life balance, while giving you the chance to sharpen your project management and stakeholder communication skillsin a fast-paced, high-visibility environment. Every day brings fresh variety, meaningful challenges, and the satisfaction of seeing your work influence high-profile IT initiatives that matter.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure clear, shared understanding of goals, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and progress reports.
  • Coordinate meetings, document action items, and track follow-up to ensure commitments are met.
  • Manage dependencies, risks, and issues, escalating when needed to keep work on track.
  • Facilitate effective communication across business and technical teams, ensuring information flows accurately and on time.
  • Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and adjust plans as needed.
  • Ensure all stakeholders are informed of status, upcoming milestones, and potential impacts to timelines or scope.
  • Support change management processes to ensure smooth implementation of new systems or processes.

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, project management, information systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience); a Masters degree is a plus
  • 10+ years of post-graduate experience in consulting and/or project management, preferably in IT or enterprise environments
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing projects involving multiple stakeholders
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello, Asana) and collaboration platforms (e.g., MS Teams, SharePoint)
  • PMP, CSM, or similar certification a plus, but not required

Skills and Character Traits:

  • Highest personal and professional integrity and work ethics; ability to handle highly confidential information discreetly and responsibly
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences
  • Skilled at fostering collaboration and building consensus without direct authority
  • Comfortable navigating large corporate structures while representing a nimble consulting team
  • Tech savvy; someone who enjoys figuring out new technology and utilizing technology for process efficiency and data visualization
  • Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Ability to get to the heart of the problem, develop a game plan, and engage diverse stakeholders in a solution
  • Natural inclination toward viewing challenging situations as puzzles to solve

Overview

Build the Future

Our focus is on creating seamless, impactful products that truly benefit our users while supporting growth and collaboration across teams. We foster a culture that values innovation, teamwork, and a balance between career growth and personal well-being.

How can you make an impact?

The Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – Technology is responsible for setting and leading sourcing strategies across a portfolio of technology categories that are enterprise-critical to business operations, security, and scalability. This role serves as the senior sourcing partner to Technology, Security, Finance, and Legal leaders, leading large cross-functional teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into multi-year sourcing strategies and contract outcomes that balance value, risk, performance, and speed to deliver.

Category scope includes enterprise software (SaaS and on-prem), cloud infrastructure and platforms (IaaS/PaaS), AI platforms and tools, data-related services, and network and connectivity services, with direct accountability for the largest, most complex, and highest-risk technology agreements in the portfolio. The Senior Manager leads strategic sourcing events and negotiations, directs relationship management for strategic technology suppliers, leads and develops a team of sourcing professionals, and ensures sourcing activities comply with governance, security, and risk standards.

Success is demonstrated through material, measurable value delivery at the portfolio level, disciplined commercial outcomes on enterprise agreements, reduced technology and supplier risk, executive stakeholder confidence, and consistent contract execution that enables reliable technology adoption at scale.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

What You’ll Do:

Category Strategy & Market Insight

  • Set multi-year technology portfolio strategies aligned to enterprise business and technology roadmaps; incorporate market dynamics, supplier innovation, and total cost of ownership considerations, and review and approve category and sub-category strategies developed by team members.
  • Direct multi-event sourcing roadmaps across software, cloud, AI, and network services, including requirements definition, supplier landscape assessment, evaluation criteria, and implementation plans; identify consolidation and platform rationalization opportunities across the enterprise.

Commercial & Negotiation Capability

  • Lead the most complex, high-value technology sourcing events and contract negotiations (e.g., enterprise SaaS, cloud commitments, AI platforms, network services), structuring commercial terms and service commitments to balance value, scalability, and risk in partnership with Legal and Security.
  • Set negotiation strategy for strategic technology agreements, oversee the evaluation of supplier proposals and pricing models (including subscription and usage-based constructs), and resolve trade-offs such as term, flexibility, audit rights, and exit provisions.
  • Ensure contracts include clear performance requirements (e.g., service levels, support, escalation, and remedies) aligned to business-critical needs, and establish executive-level governance with strategic suppliers.

Stakeholder & Influence Skills

  • Serve as the senior sourcing partner to Technology and business leaders, including executives; challenge demand constructively, drive alignment on requirements, and facilitate decisions on trade-offs across competing priorities.
  • Lead large cross-functional teams through technology sourcing initiatives; set direction, coordinate workstreams, and resolve conflicts to keep decisions on schedule.
  • Direct cross-functional reviews (Security, Privacy, Architecture, Finance, Legal) to ensure sourcing decisions meet governance and risk expectations while maintaining delivery timelines; present options, risks, and recommendations in senior leadership forums.

Analytical & Financial Acumen

  • Direct the financial analyses that drive decisions; review and approve business cases, TCO models, and value tracking for technology deals.
  • Own the credibility and measurability of savings and value reporting for the technology portfolio, including cost avoidance, consumption management opportunities, and contract compliance levers, partnering with Finance to align results to budgets and forecasts.

Risk, Governance & Compliance

  • Identify and mitigate portfolio-level technology commercial and operational risks (e.g., data security obligations, regulatory exposure, vendor lock-in and concentration, continuity/resilience considerations) and escalate material risks to senior leadership with recommended mitigations.
  • Ensure sourcing activities across the portfolio comply with procurement governance, contract standards, and required documentation for audit readiness; contribute to the development and refinement of those policies and standards.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop sourcing team members, which may include Managers and Analysts; set clear expectations, manage performance, and hold the team accountable for execution quality and stakeholder outcomes.
  • Drive capability building across the sourcing organization by improving templates, playbooks, and standard work for technology sourcing and contracting; serve as a subject matter expert for technology sourcing.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or professional certification preferred.
  • 10+ years of applicable experience in strategic sourcing, technology procurement, or related commercial roles, including experience leading people and/or large cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced negotiation and commercial judgment; ability to lead complex, high-value technology sourcing events end-to-end with strategic suppliers.
  • Extensive experience sourcing and negotiating enterprise technology agreements (software, cloud, AI, or network services) involving complex pricing models, significant spend, and material risk considerations, in partnership with Legal.
  • Ability to translate technical and business needs into structured requirements, evaluation criteria, and contract terms, and to guide team members in doing the same.
  • In-depth knowledge of technology contracting concepts such as licensing metrics, subscription and consumption models, service levels, data/security obligations, and exit/transition considerations.
  • Strong analytical capability; ability to interpret and challenge financial models and defend assumptions in senior leadership forums.
  • Proven ability to lead large cross-functional teams and influence senior and executive stakeholders in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, and team development.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience negotiating cloud commercial constructs (e.g., committed spend/discount programs) and enterprise software licensing agreements with major technology suppliers.
  • Familiarity with vendor performance management (SLAs/KPIs), technology risk reviews, and contract lifecycle processes.
  • Professional certification (e.g., CPSM, CIPS) or equivalent.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The National Strategic Account Executive (NAE) role will contribute directly to our “best in class” Market Access team and will have leadership responsibilities for developing and implementing key Commercial Payor strategies for our organization’s first product launch. The NAE is the primary face to our access customers, and as such is responsible for promoting a positive corporate image on behalf of the organization. The NAE is responsible for establishing, maintaining, and enhancing broad patient coverage, access and reimbursement across Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid and Government Payers. Key functions of this role include providing education and information to assist in the development, maintenance, and enhancement of coverage and coding healthcare policy. In addition, the NAE must have a thorough understanding of the clinical and pharmacoeconomic data, coverage, payment influencers, distribution process, Medical Benefit (Buy & Bill model).   • Drive favorable access across assigned National Payors ensuring medical coverage policies are consistent with FDA approved prescribing information.
  • Initiate, lead and manage relationships with National Payors to appropriately influence the formulary review process, including the coordination of resources from Medical Affairs, Health Economics, and other cross-functional SMEs.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute pre-launch, and post-launch business and account plans across National Payor segments (Commercial/Medicare/Medicaid) including IDN’s in geographical region.

Develop relationships away from transactional to valued business partnerships.
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert and primary point of contact for all National Account related issues, trends, market insights, risks, and opportunities; ensure relevant and timely payor coverage information is communicated to appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with Medical, Marketing, Patient Services and Distribution to develop support programs that will enhance our value proposition, removing barriers to access and assisting HCPs with understanding the National coverage environment providing appropriate patients a path to product and mitigating any access barriers.
  • Partner with Marketing, Patient Support Services, Medical and Sales to develop and communicate clear and effective customer pull through strategies and initiatives that support formulary placement and coverage.
  • Collaborate with field teams (Field Sales, FRM’s, Medical Affairs) to monitor the payer access environment to identify key trends, access barriers and partner with colleagues to mitigate.
  • Partner with HEOR to develop and execute our therapeutic value proposition messages that resonate with our National Payers

  • Bachelor's Degree required, MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 10+ years in Managed Markets/Market Access
  • Minimum of 8+ years of demonstrated success in National Account roles across commercial and government payors.
  • Previous market access account responsibility for Biotech/Pharmaceutical launch required.
  • Strong launch experience with pre-PDUFA market preparation & planning Demonstrated knowledge Medicare B and Buy & Bill payment models.
  • Extensive National Account relationships with a strong understanding of market access, reimbursement, and pricing landscape for pharmaceutical products. Including a strong knowledge and working relationships with Commercial/Medicare/Medicaid and other government and specialty segments.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the current and evolving payor landscape for complex therapies from both a Medical and Pharmacy benefit perspective.
  • Established customer relationships with Pharmacy Directors, Medical Directors, and other key personnel at National Payors.
  • Strong negotiation skills and a proven track record of engaging National Accounts at all relevant levels of the organization leading to successful attainment of desired formulary position.
  • Deep understanding of customer-specific review, approval, and reimbursement processes
  • Strong analytic acumen, displaying the ability to assess and identify business opportunities and challenges.
  • Experience developing and executing payer pull-through strategies in collaboration with field sales, sales leadership, medical, marketing, patient services, trade and distribution.

jobs.description:
This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region of the Americas.

What your day will look like:

  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you:

  • Bachelor’s level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise software or technology sales
  • Experience with open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Experience developing and managing complex customer relationships, including technical, executive and procurement stakeholders
  • Understanding of public sector customers, government procurement processes and the unique challenges of selling technology solutions to government or education organizations
  • Ability to develop and execute account strategies, build new pipeline and manage complex sales cycles within an assigned territory
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest:

  • 3+ years of experience selling enterprise software or technology solutions to U.S. Public Sector customers, including federal civilian, defense, intelligence, state and local government, or education organizations
  • Previous sales experience with an enterprise software, open source software, cloud or infrastructure technology company
  • Previous employment or experience working with U.S. government agencies, the military, Intelligence Community, government contractors or systems integrators
  • Familiarity with government acquisition and contracting processes, public sector procurement vehicles and channel partner ecosystems
  • Established customer relationships within federal agencies, the Intelligence Community, state and local government, or education markets
  • Current or previous U.S. government security clearance, particularly for roles supporting defense, intelligence or other federal government customers
  • Experience with cloud computing, Linux, virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, AI or cybersecurity solutions
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

jobs.title: Project / Program Manager – Agile Delivery
jobs.description:
Overview

Build the Future
At McGraw Hill, we are dedicated to delivering digital learning experiences that transform education for learners and educators. Our focus is on creating seamless, impactful products that truly benefit our users while supporting growth and collaboration across teams. We foster a culture that values innovation, teamwork, and a balance between career growth and personal well-being.

How can you make an impact?

The Program Operator plays a pivotal role in supporting the successful execution of agile programs, overseeing the coordination and operational aspects of multiple projects or product initiatives within an agile environment. The Program Operator ensures that all teams adhere to agile principles and methodologies, facilitates communication across teams, manages dependencies, and removes operational obstacles to ensure program success. This role requires strong organizational and problem-solving skills to oversee the day-to-day execution of the program, while maintaining alignment with business goals and customer needs.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

What You’ll Do:

  1. Agile Program Management:
    • Participate in the planning, execution, and delivery of large, complex agile programs by ensuring that teams follow agile processes and methodologies.
    • Ensuring that scope is documented and kept up to date.
    • Coordinate cross-functional team efforts to ensure timely delivery of program objectives.
    • Support the Program Manager or Scrum Master in monitoring program progress and identifying any blockers or risks.
    • Ensure alignment between multiple product teams working within the program.
  2. Facilitate Agile Ceremonies and Practices:
    • Organize and facilitate agile ceremonies such as Progression, Refinement, Alignment and Retrospectives for the program teams.
    • Support teams in adhering to their milestones, are sprint ready and work to resolve operational roadblocks.
    • Ensure consistency and effective communication of agile practices across teams, maintaining high standards for agile execution.
  3. Dependency and Risk Management:
    • Assist in the identification, tracking, and management of dependencies between teams, projects, and external stakeholders.
    • Proactively address and manage potential risks to program delivery, escalating issues when necessary to appropriate stakeholders.
    • Coordinate mitigation strategies and ensure risks are appropriately managed and communicated.
  4. Operational Support:
    • Provide day-to-day operational support to agile teams, helping them adhere to timelines and deliverables.
    • Ensure that the tools and resources required by the teams are available and functioning.
    • Act as a liaison between technical teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure operational needs are met.
  5. Stakeholder Communication and Reporting:
    • Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders, ensuring they are informed of program status, risks, and any changes to scope or delivery timelines.
    • Prepare and present regular status reports, key metrics, and updates on program progress and performance.
    • Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed effectively and that any changes or issues are communicated in a timely manner.
  6. Continuous Improvement:
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas for process optimization and efficiency gains.
    • Support change management with agile teams in adopting new tools, techniques, or processes that improve team performance and overall program delivery.
    • Facilitate knowledge-sharing between teams and encourage a culture of innovation.
  7. Program Documentation and Metrics:
    • Responsible for maintaining program-related documentation - including roadmaps, timelines, release plans, and issue logs.
    • Track and analyze program performance metrics, including velocity, burn-down charts, and release progress, to inform decision-making.
    • Use data-driven insights to identify trends, optimize workflows, and guide strategic decision-making.
  8. Support Product and Technical Leadership:
    • Work closely with product managers, program managers, scrum masters, and technical leads to ensure product goals and program objectives align with business priorities.
    • Help bridge the gap between business strategy and execution by translating high-level objectives into actionable plans for the teams.

What you bring:

  • Experience:
    • 3+ years of project/program management experience with at least 1 year of Agile experience
    • Edtech/Education/Publishing background is preferred.
    • Hands-on ownership of project plans, roadmaps, and budgets preferredFamiliarity with managing cross-functional programs involving multiple agile teams.
    • Experience with agile tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, or similar).
  • Skills:
    • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
    • Ability to project manage and track multiple initiatives, manage dependencies, and ensure deadlines are met.
    • Knowledge of agile frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) and program management best practices.
    • Solid understanding of risk management and issue resolution techniques.
    • Comfortable working with stakeholders at all levels, including product, technical, and business leaders.
  • Education:
    • A degree in Business, Project Management, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience in program or project management within an agile framework.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities.
    • High attention to detail and a focus on results.
    • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to foster collaboration among diverse teams.
    • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Project Management Certification (PMP, Prince2, CAPM or similar)
  • Agile certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, Certified Scrum Product Owner, or similar).
  • Experience with large-scale agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS).
  • Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience in coordinating global or distributed teams.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $55,000 - $95,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings.

Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email.

Hiring Entity: FlexEnergi, a Subsidiary of Accurant

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 3,700,000 - 5,500,000 INR

Job Title: Engineering Lead - Grid & Devices (IoT / Energy Systems)

We are hiring an Engineering Lead to own FlexEnergi’s Grid & Devices area end to end: how our DERMS platform connects to devices, which grid standards we speak, and how we dispatch flexible energy resources in real time. It’s the most technically demanding part of our platform and the one our utility customers look at first.

This is a lead role first and a management role second. Expect roughly 70% hands-on technical ownership (architecture, building, code review, and running production systems) and 30% leading a small team of 2–4 engineers. It’s ideal for a senior engineer who wants to be accountable for a critical area, not step away from the code.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction for Grid & Devices and write the technical plan the team builds from
  • Own the real-time dispatch engine running in production: its design, reliability, and extension to new device types, portfolio-level dispatch, and grid-aware constraints

jobs.title: Dentist – Virtual Care & Consultation
jobs.description:
Company: GoTo TelemedLocation: Fully Remote – United States (Multi-State Licensure Preferred)Employment Type: Full-Time, Part-Time, or 1099 Independent ContractorCompensation: $95.00 – $140.00 per hour (or competitive per-encounter consultation rate)Department: Dental & Oral Health Services

Role Overview

GoTo Telemed is seeking licensed Dentists (DDS or DMD) to join our nationwide virtual healthcare network. In this fully remote position, you will deliver comprehensive routine, preventive, and basic dental support to patients across the country. Working through our integrated EHR and telecommunications platform, you will provide clinical consultations and care management without the overhead of physical practice administration. Our digital health model connects oral healthcare with primary medicine, pediatrics, and behavioral health, supporting comprehensive whole-person wellness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Synchronous Teledentistry: Conduct real-time, HIPAA-compliant video and audio consultations (CDT D9995) to assess oral health concerns, dental discomfort, and acute emergencies.
  • Asynchronous Evaluations: Perform diagnostic reviews of patient-submitted clinical data, high-resolution intraoral photographs, and forwarded radiographic records (CDT D9996) within our cloud EHR system.
  • Diagnostic & Acute Care: Deliver problem-focused clinical evaluations (CDT D0140), diagnose non-emergent conditions, and manage acute oral infections, trauma, and temporomandibular joint pain.
  • Preventive Management: Provide preventive oral health guidance, individualized home-care plans, and post-procedural recovery reviews (CDT D0171).
  • Teleprescribing: Prescribe non-controlled therapeutic agents (antibiotics, topical antimicrobials, non-opioid analgesics) in accordance with state dental practice acts and teleprescribing laws.
  • Care Coordination: Identify conditions requiring hands-on clinical intervention or surgical management and coordinate referrals to local dental specialists.
  • Collaborative Supervision: Serve as a collaborative, supervising dentist for platform Registered Dental Hygienists (RDHs) providing preventive oral health education.
  • Clinical Documentation: Maintain accurate, timely clinical records adhering to institutional standards within 24 hours of encounter completion.

Minimum Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Doctoral degree (DDS or DMD) from an institution accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA).
  • Licensure: Active, unencumbered license to practice dentistry in at least one U.S. state (candidates holding multi-state licenses are strongly prioritized).
  • Credentials: Active federal DEA registration and state controlled-substance credentials (where required), plus current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
  • Experience: Minimum of two years of clinical dentistry experience in general, public health, or urgent dental practice. Experience with digital health platforms preferred.
  • Workspace: Dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant home workspace with high-speed internet, a high-definition webcam, and a noise-canceling headset.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Customizable consultation blocks across daytime, evening, and weekend hours.
  • Zero Overhead: 100% remote work opportunity with no travel or physical office expenses.
  • Risk Management: Comprehensive professional malpractice insurance coverage provided for all platform encounters.
  • Administrative Support: Dedicated internal teams for billing, coding, clearinghouse submissions, and revenue cycle management.

Platform Application Screening Questions (For Indeed/LinkedIn Setup)

  1. Do you hold an active, unencumbered DDS or DMD license in one or more U.S. states? (Yes/No - Knockout)
  2. Did you graduate from a CODA-accredited dental program? (Yes/No - Knockout)
  3. Please list the states where you currently hold an active dental license. (Short Answer)

Remote Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH) – Virtual Patient Support & Preventive Care Coordinator

Company: GoTo TelemedLocation: Fully Remote – United States (Multi-State Licensure Advantageous)Employment Type: Full-Time, Part-Time, or PRNCompensation: $38.00 – $52.00 per hourDepartment: Preventive Oral Health & Clinical Triage

Role Overview

GoTo Telemed is seeking Registered Dental Hygienists (RDH) to join our nationwide virtual healthcare team. In this fully remote position, you will deliver preventive oral care education, patient triage, nutritional counseling, and oral hygiene instruction to individuals and families. Working collaboratively with licensed GoTo Telemed dentists under collaborative practice agreements, you will serve as a frontline care coordinator. This role is dedicated to routine, non-invasive oral health support delivered entirely through our secure digital platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventive Guidance: Provide live, one-on-one virtual patient education on home preventive care, biofilm control, and oral hygiene techniques.
  • Risk Assessment: Administer structured caries risk assessments (CAMBRA) and periodontal screening questionnaires via digital intake forms and live video.
  • Wellness Counseling: Deliver individualized counseling focusing on dietary factors, dry mouth management, and tobacco cessation (CDT D9993).
  • Clinical Triage: Monitor incoming patient messages and photo uploads; identify acute symptoms and escalate complex pathology to the supervising dentist.
  • Post-Operative Support: Conduct structured follow-up check-ins after routine dental treatments to review comfort, healing, and home-care compliance.
  • Patient Navigation: Guide patients through systematic intraoral photo capture and visual self-inspections to support early detection.
  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work with medical and behavioral health providers on systemic-oral health connections, including diabetic and prenatal oral wellness.
  • Documentation: Record all assessments and patient interactions in the cloud EHR in strict compliance with HIPAA and state recordkeeping laws.

Minimum Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Degree in Dental Hygiene from an educational institution accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation (CODA).
  • Licensure: Active, unencumbered Dental Hygiene license issued by a U.S. state dental board (multi-state licensure or residence in a collaborative practice state preferred).
  • Experience: Minimum of two to three years of clinical practice experience as an RDH. Background in public health, community clinics, or virtual care platforms is a plus.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Clear understanding of dental hygiene scope boundaries, collaborative practice agreements, and supervisory requirements.
  • Technical & Soft Skills: Strong verbal communication skills, empathetic bedside manner, and comfort using EHR software and video communication suites.
  • Workspace: Private, quiet home office environment meeting HIPAA privacy and information security standards.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Transparent Pay: Competitive hourly compensation with transparent payroll processing.
  • Work-Life Balance: 100% remote flexibility with customizable scheduling options.
  • Professional Development: Comprehensive onboarding and training covering digital health workflows and clinical triage protocols.
  • Tools Provided: Free access to cloud-based EHR tools, scheduling software, and virtual communication platforms.

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Terraform
  • AWS CloudFormation
  • Pulumi
  • GitHub Actions
  • Jenkins
  • GitLab CI/CD
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Elasticsearch
  • Python
  • Bash
  • PowerShell

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Passionate about automation and cloud-native technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Comfortable working in production environments.
  • Proactive and ownership-driven.
  • Collaborative team player who works well with software engineers.
  • Continuously looks for opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Monitor cloud infrastructure and resolve operational issues.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes workloads.
  • Optimize infrastructure performance and scalability.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Collaborate with development teams on deployment strategies.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and system reliability.

In short: You build and maintain secure, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure that enables engineering teams to deliver software quickly and reliably.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • High infrastructure uptime and reliability.
  • Faster and more reliable deployment pipelines.
  • Reduced manual operational workload through automation.
  • Scalable and secure cloud infrastructure.
  • Improved deployment frequency and recovery times.
  • Strong monitoring coverage and rapid incident resolution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work with modern cloud-native technologies.
  • High ownership and technical impact.
  • Opportunity to solve large-scale infrastructure challenges.
  • Continuous exposure to automation and platform engineering.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Final Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

jobs.title: Manager, Client Experience - Health & Wellness
jobs.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
  • Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others do the same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
  • Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
  • Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
  • Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Client Experience Manager with a career built in healthcare, health-tech or wellness to lead delivery for Boldr’s Health & Wellness clients. Our clients span preventive and functional health, digital health, diagnostics and lab testing, practitioner platforms and wellness brands. Their customers are patients and members, not just shoppers, so privacy, clinical sensitivity and getting it right first time matter on every contact.

You will own delivery for a portfolio of Health & Wellness accounts and lead the Team Captains who run them. You will act as a business owner, accountable for SLA performance, quality and compliance, and you will be the operations voice in the room with client leaders, including founders, medical directors and clinical operations teams.

You will help foster a healthy working environment for our team members, represent Boldr to our clients, and act as our internal client across departments. You will need to be laser-focused on operational performance and comfortable leading global teams day to day.

You will be responsible for client communication, performance reporting, training and escalation management, including clinical and privacy escalations. Having an eye for detail will be important, as you will keep our client success tools and procedures accurate and up to date.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

Health & Wellness is one of Boldr’s core verticals, and our clients trust us with their patients’ and members’ experience. We need someone who already speaks their language: someone who understands care journeys, health data privacy and clinical escalation, and who can turn that knowledge into tight, measurable operations. If you are impact-driven, bring your best to everything you do and champion our values, we would love to hear from you.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Processes

  • Develop and maintain an authentic relationship with all the Client and internal stakeholders.
  • Build a deep understanding of each health and wellness client’s business model (e.g., preventive and functional health, digital health, practitioner platforms, wellness products), their regulatory context, and the outcomes that matter most to them (e.g., member retention, care journey completion, appointment and test adherence).
  • Work confidently with clinical and medical stakeholders (e.g., medical directors, clinical operations teams) and ensure care-related issues follow clear escalation paths.
  • Own the clinical and safety escalation path for your accounts: make sure agents know what they can and cannot answer, and that urgent or care-related issues reach the right clinical team fast.
  • Run daily and weekly performance reviews with client stakeholders and Boldr leadership, tracking health-specific measures alongside SLAs (e.g., care journey completion, appointment and test adherence, member retention, escalation turnaround).
  • Ability to work seamlessly with different departments namely: Implementation, Client Solutions, Finance, IT, People Experience and Office Operations.
  • Communicating and resolving basic to complex inquiries and concerns in an accurate, valid, complete, and timely manner.
  • Create and manage Client contracts such as MSAs and SLAs.
  • Manage a team of Team Captains and monitor compliance against SLAs and achievement of Client KPIs.
  • Root cause analysis, planning and execution to ensure KPIs are met
  • Ensure your teams meet health data privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR), including access controls, handling of protected health information (PHI), audit readiness and privacy incident response.
  • Partner with Team Captains to ensure documentation is constantly updated and identification of process improvements are sourced with the TC and their team.
  • Lead the operations story in Client Business Reviews (MBRs and QBRs) in partnership with your SBU Head: what the numbers mean for the client’s patients or members, and what we will do next.
  • Develop relationships within each Health & Wellness client to spot growth opportunities, such as new lines of business, sister brands or additional services, and bring them to the commercial team.
  • Use AI and automation in your own work and your teams’ workflows (e.g., reporting, QA, knowledge management, planning) in ways that keep protected health information safe.
  • Update Hubspot deal cards and ensure all necessary items are appropriately invoiced.
  • Follow up with clients on invoicing, pricing discrepancies, and other billing-related issues.

People Management

  • Supervise and develop Team Captains through guidance, observation, and performance management activities.
  • Coach Team Captains and their teams to handle sensitive patient and member conversations with empathy, accuracy and the right escalation.
  • As needed, joins the Team Captain on calls with the Client, team huddles or coaching sessions to stay up to date with all Client and team developments.
    • This also provides an opportunity to observe the Team Captain’s presentation, Client communication and coaching skills.
  • Taking steps to ensure learning and growth through development plans and, when necessary, progressive counseling.
  • Promote and foster a culture of continuous improvement by providing positive and constructive feedback to team members.
  • Establish, promote, and maintain the Boldr culture within the organization.
  • Understand employee career growth aspirations to enable matching Boldr’s needs with employee abilities.
  • Act as the escalation point for the Team Captains and Senior Team Captains.
  • Responsible for upholding our organization’s values throughout the workplace
  • Monitor achievement of internal and external KPI’s and ensure Operational Excellence
  • Identify performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and work with operations to improve performance on KPIs through motivating, guiding, and holding local operations managers accountable for following SLA.

Tools, Administration, and Reporting

  • Familiarity with Google Suite of Services is a must for this role
    • Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Docs are used heavily in Boldr
  • Experience with Hubspot is a plus.
  • Experience with health and wellness CX and care tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Health Cloud, EHR/EMR or practice-management platforms, telehealth or lab-ordering systems is a plus.
  • Confident using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to work faster and smarter.
  • Maintain Client schedule (Weekly Updates, MBRs, QBRs, Implementations) and collect feedback and drive necessary actions to completion

Training

  • Coordinate necessary training and best practices related to Tools and Processes
  • Onboard new hires so they are ready to succeed, including privacy and PHI training before they handle client data.
  • Build health and wellness knowledge (e.g., care journeys, privacy requirements, clinical escalation protocols) into team training and QA.
  • Lean six sigma knowledge and/or certification is a plus

Ongoing support and knowledge sharing

  • Obtain feedback from Clients and team members on processes and tools to ensure continuous improvement
  • Provides input and communication to drive Client Success improvement, for all Clients, enterprise-wide.

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Rooted in health and wellness: you understand how patients and members experience care, and you care about getting it right for them
  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
  • Proactive and passionate about the client, patient and member experience
  • Strongly interested in learning new ideas, processes, and unique requirements. On top of that, you’re willing to share your skills and talents with the team.
  • Calm and credible with senior client leaders and clinical stakeholders, with the executive presence to hold the room

YOU HAVE…

  • 3+ years in a client-facing operations management role
  • 5+ years of customer experience or operations experience in healthcare, health-tech or wellness (e.g., digital health, telehealth, diagnostics or lab testing, preventive or functional health, health insurance, wellness or supplement brands), with clear career progression within the sector. BPO, staffing or other business services experience is a plus.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, ideally including team leads or supervisors across locations
  • Hands-on experience with health and wellness support workflows: patient or member onboarding, scheduling, lab and test journeys, billing and insurance queries, and clinical escalation.
  • Experience working directly with clinical or medical stakeholders, such as medical directors, nurses or clinical operations teams.
  • Working knowledge of health data privacy and compliance (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) and how it shapes support workflows, QA and escalation.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for the reporting you will own
  • A track record of presenting performance and insight to senior client leaders and turning data into clear recommendations.
  • Create dashboards and provide visibility to stakeholders
  • Identify root causes, design and execute action plans
  • Focus on listening and understanding what other people are saying, ask questions as appropriate, and not interrupt at inappropriate times.
  • Maintain an open dialogue with the organization's external and internal Client partners in both positive and negative situations.
  • Read, research, and draft letters, emails, and documents.
  • Identify complex problems and review related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
  • Speaking in a public setting and delivering presentations to individuals and groups.
  • Cope effectively with losses or rejections by moving on to other challenges and learning from past experiences.

jobs.description:
AI-Native Talent Partner

Location: United States (Remote flexibility, subject to confirmation)
Language Proficiencies: Mandarin and English (Fluency in both languages required)

About Our Client

Our client is a global AI foundation-model company developing proprietary technologies across large language models, multimodal AI, video generation, speech, and intelligent agents. As AI transforms how organizations operate, our client is rethinking how exceptional talent can be discovered, engaged, and developed in an increasingly AI-native world.

The Opportunity

Our client believes that one of the greatest competitive advantages in the AI era is the ability to identify and attract extraordinary people. They are seeking an AI-Native Talent Partner who combines strategic talent intelligence with strong technical curiosity, systems thinking, and hands-on AI workflow capabilities. Rather than simply using AI tools to support conventional recruitment processes, you will help rethink how recruitment operates by designing, integrating, and orchestrating AI-powered workflows that enhance productivity, improve talent identification, and enable more effective decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of talent acquisition, AI technology, and organizational innovation.

Key Responsibilities

- Design & Orchestrate AI Workflows
- Design and implement AI-powered workflows across candidate sourcing, research, enrichment, qualification, and recruitment operations.
- Integrate existing AI tools, LLMs, agents, automation platforms, and data sources into coordinated workflows.
- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities while maintaining human oversight for critical decisions.
- Explore custom AI agents or more advanced orchestration approaches where they provide meaningful value.

- Develop Global AI Talent Intelligence
- Map exceptional AI researchers, ML engineers, and infrastructure specialists across Silicon Valley, Seattle, and other leading technology ecosystems.
- Identify overlooked talent through technical contributions, research impact, open-source projects, and unconventional signals.
- Develop scalable methodologies for evaluating scarce technical talent beyond conventional qualifications.
- Rethink Talent Acquisition in the AI Era
- Challenge traditional recruitment processes and explore how AI can fundamentally improve productivity.
- Experiment with emerging AI models, automation tools, and agentic workflows.
- Continuously evaluate and optimize recruitment systems based on effectiveness, accuracy, and candidate quality.
- Partner with Technical Leadership
- Work closely with AI research and engineering stakeholders to understand complex technical hiring requirements.
- Translate technical challenges into effective talent identification and engagement strategies.
- Combine AI-enabled intelligence with human judgment to identify exceptional individuals.

Candidate Profile

- Experience in technical recruitment, talent intelligence, HR technology, software engineering, data science, or related fields.
- Demonstrable experience designing, implementing, or orchestrating AI workflows, whether through existing platforms, automation tools, AI agents, or custom solutions.
- Strong understanding of AI tools, LLMs, workflow automation, and technology integrations.
- Ability to think systematically about improving processes rather than simply automating individual tasks.
- Strong technical curiosity and the ability to understand sophisticated AI and engineering talent.
- Analytical thinking, creativity, resourcefulness, and a willingness to experiment.
- Professional proficiency in Mandarin and English is mandatory.
- Experience with agent orchestration frameworks, API integrations, Python, n8n, Make, or comparable technologies is advantageous.
