jobs.title: Call for consultancy external evaluation of the governance reform
jobs.description:
Terms of reference

External evaluation of the governance reform

General information

Project title

External evaluation of the governance reform

Mandate

Resolution of the 2026 Ordinary General Assembly (14 and 15 October 2026)

Commissioned by

International Board, SOS Children’s Villages International

Prepared by

Executive Board, SOS Children’s Villages International

Date

November 2026

1. Context and background

In 2024, the General Assembly adopted a governance reform to strengthen transparency and accountability and to establish more democratic and representative governance structures across the Federation. A new Executive Board is in place, and the bodies and committees established through the reform have been constituted. The experience of implementing the framework has also provided important lessons, and elements of it may need to be adjusted as the Federation continues to evolve.

At its 2026 Ordinary General Assembly, the General Assembly therefore resolved that the International Board shall commission an independent external evaluation of the governance reform and of its implementation to date. Given the short time since its implementation, the evaluation seeks to assess whether the Federation is on the right track and to advise on corrective measures, should that be necessary. On behalf of the whole Federation, the International Board is seeking an independent evaluator for this review.

2. Purpose

The purpose of the evaluation is to:

  • Assess the effectiveness of the implementation of the governance reform adopted in 2024 and identify first signals regarding its responsiveness to the intended objectives.
  • Identify strengths, challenges, risks and unintended consequences arising from the current governance structure.
  • Assess the extent to which governance arrangements support accountability, transparency, strategic oversight, safeguarding, compliance and organisational effectiveness.
  • Provide recommendations for further strengthening the Federation’s governance framework.
  • Distinguish between challenges arising from the design of the governance framework and those resulting from its implementation following the transformation of the Secretariat.

The evaluation will give all parts of the Federation a common factual basis for the next stage of its governance development. It is part of the Federation’s commitment to continuous improvement, not a reconsideration of the principles of the reform.

3. Objectives and key questions

  • Governance effectiveness. Assess the transparency, accountability, functionality and effectiveness of the governance bodies established or reshaped by the reform, including their interaction in practice and alignment with the Federation’s Statutes and By-Laws. Key questions may include:
  • Are the roles, responsibilities and authorities of governance bodies sufficiently clear?
  • Are decision-making processes effective, transparent and appropriately documented?
  • How effectively do the General Assembly, the International Board, their respective Chairs, the GA committees, the Executive Board and Member Associations interact?
  • To what extent are governance arrangements supporting strategic oversight and accountability?
  • Do governing bodies and committees have adequate access to information, expertise, support and resources to fulfil their responsibilities effectively?
    • Governance risks. Assess governance risks arising from the current structure and its implementation, paying particular attention to child safeguarding oversight; legal and regulatory compliance requirements across Federation jurisdictions; financial stewardship and fiduciary oversight; risk management and internal control arrangements; and stakeholder confidence, including that of Member Associations, donors, institutional funders and the public.
    • Federation-wide experience. Assess stakeholder perspectives regarding inclusiveness and representation; information flows and transparency; the extent to which the governance framework balances Member Association autonomy and participation in the Federation’s governing bodies; confidence in governance arrangements; and areas requiring adjustment or clarification.
    • Future governance development. Identify opportunities for improvement and propose recommendations regarding governance structures; governance processes and practices; board and committee functioning; accountability mechanisms; capacity building and support; and future governance review and evaluation mechanisms.

    4. Approach

    The approach will be defined by and with the evaluator, but we expect it to include interviews with the stakeholders listed in section 5; focus groups or consultations with Member Associations; desk research on the relevant documents, including the Statutes and By-Laws, with analysis against recognised non-profit governance principles and standards; and confidential submissions: the evaluator will give Member Associations and Federation staff the opportunity to make submissions in confidence. In addition to the groups directly involved in governance, the evaluator will carry out a Federation-wide data collection, for example a short online survey, to gather a broad picture of how Member Associations, their staff and other stakeholders across the Federation perceive and value the current governance structure. The evaluator will have unrestricted access to the relevant documents and to the members of the governing bodies.

    5. Stakeholders

    The evaluator decides on the selection of stakeholders based on three principles: at least one stakeholder from each sub-category, a fair representation of all opinions, and no bias, meaning the International Board Chair cannot influence the selection and the General Assembly cannot bias it. The sub-categories are the legal bodies, the General Assembly, and the Federation. Beyond these groups, the Federation-wide data collection described in section 4 will give everyone in the Federation the opportunity to contribute. The evaluator will be selected in consultation with the Member Associations.

    After the evaluation, a working group of two International Board, one Executive Board and six Member Association representatives (one per region, nominated by the Member Associations) will review the report, prepare resolutions for the 2027 Ordinary General Assembly, including on regular external evaluations after 2027 and their costs, and circulate its proposals to all Member Associations four weeks before the General Assembly.

    6. Deliverables

    The deliverables below are indicative:

    Deliverable

    Content

    Timing

    Inception report

    Approach, methodology, work plan, stakeholder engagement plan and evaluation framework including the design of the Federation-wide data collection.

    January 2027

    Interim debrief

    Emerging observations, for the steering group designated by the International Board

    During the evaluation

    Summary report: draft

    Executive summary; findings by evaluation criterion; results of the Federation-wide data collection; strengths and weaknesses; risk assessment; comparative observations and benchmarking; recommendations

    April 2027

    Summary report: final

    Revised findings after factual review; prioritised recommendations, each with a timeline plan: short term (within 12 months), medium term (1 to 3 years) or long term (more than 3 years)

    Early May 2027

    Presentation

    To the Working Group that reviews the outcomes and prepares recommendations for the General Assembly

    June, 2027

    Final report and debrief

    Incorporating outcomes of the General Assembly to be held end of June 2027

    August 2027

    7. Evaluator profile

    • Demonstrated expertise in the governance of international non-profit federations.
    • Substantial experience conducting governance reviews or board effectiveness evaluations.
    • Independence: no advisory or service mandate with the Federation or its governing bodies since 31 December 2023, and disclosure of any actual, potential or perceived conflicts of interest.
    • Ability to engage with stakeholders across the Federation’s regions and to report concisely.

    8. Reporting and oversight

    The evaluator reports to the International Board through the designated International Board representatives in the Working Group. The Working Group and the Secretariat support access to documentation and stakeholders but do not interfere with the evaluator’s independent assessment or conclusions.

    9. Timeline

    When

    Milestone

    November 2026

    Publication of the terms of reference

    December 2026

    Interviews with candidate evaluators

    January 2027

    Selection, contracting and kick-off; inception report

    February to April 2027

    Evaluation; summary report: draft in April

    April to May 2027

    Validation of the summary report and of the timeline plan for the recommendations; summary report: draft final in May

    Last week of June 2027

    2027 Ordinary General Assembly, with the findings and recommendations as an agenda item

    August 2027

    Final report and debrief

    10. Procurement and application

    Interested evaluators are invited to send a short proposal (approach, methodology and workplan), the CV of the proposed evaluator or team with relevant references, a declaration of independence and a financial offer, including the daily rate and total fees, to by December 22, 2026. Proposals will be assessed on expertise, independence, the quality of the proposed approach and cost.

jobs.title: Mainland China Tax, Accounting & Auditing Specialist (SME) - AI Evaluator
jobs.description:
Remote | Project-Based Independent Contractor
Compensation: $15 to $45 Location-Based Hourly Rates (USD), based on qualifications, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Finance, Tax & Accounting

What if your expertise in Mainland China taxation, accounting standards, financial reporting, and auditing could help artificial intelligence better understand financial regulations, tax requirements, accounting treatments, reconciliation processes, and audit methodologies?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced finance, tax, accounting, and audit professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Tax Specialists, Certified Accountants, Auditors, Tax Advisors, Financial Reporting Professionals, and Finance Compliance Experts who can apply their professional expertise, analytical judgment, and regulatory knowledge to evaluate AI-generated financial content.

This isn't a traditional tax advisory, accounting, financial reporting, or audit position. You won't be preparing tax returns, issuing audit opinions, or managing financial reporting processes. Instead, you'll assess complex financial content, validate calculations, evaluate accounting and audit documentation, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your finance and accounting expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It is important to understand the nature of freelance work. Tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent. Candidates must currently reside and perform all project-related work outside Mainland China.

The Opportunity

As a Mainland China Tax, Accounting & Auditing Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated financial, tax, accounting, and auditing content.

You'll analyze taxation scenarios, accounting treatments, financial reporting requirements, reconciliation models, audit documentation, internal controls, and compliance assessments while identifying errors, unsupported conclusions, calculation discrepancies, and regulatory inconsistencies.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex taxation, accounting, auditing, and financial reporting challenges within Mainland China's regulatory environment.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or both of the following specialties:

1. Mainland China Tax Specialist

Professionals with CICPA qualifications and/or recognized Mainland China Certified Tax Agent (CTA) or Tax Advisor credentials who possess hands-on experience applying Mainland China's domestic taxation regulations and calculating tax liabilities.

Relevant expertise may include:

  • Mainland China domestic taxation
  • Value-Added Tax (VAT)
  • Enterprise Income Tax (EIT)
  • Corporate Tax Compliance & Reporting
  • Tax Research & Regulatory Interpretation
  • Historical Tax Policy Verification
  • Tax Calculations & Financial Reconciliation
  • Tax Compliance Reviews
  • Tax Reporting Requirements
  • Financial Schedule Validation

2. Mainland China Accounting & Audit Specialist

CICPA-qualified accountants and auditors with specialized knowledge of PRC GAAP, Chinese Accounting Standards (CAS), financial reporting, and auditing practices.

Relevant expertise may include:

  • PRC GAAP
  • Chinese Accounting Standards (CAS)
  • Financial Reporting & Disclosure
  • Financial Statements
  • General Ledger Reviews
  • Journal Entries & Reconciliations
  • Accounting Records & Supporting Documentation
  • Auditing & Internal Controls
  • Audit Documentation Reviews
  • Financial Risk Assessments
  • Audit Evidence Evaluation

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated financial content: Assess taxation, accounting, auditing, financial reporting, and compliance-related content for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory alignment.
  • Review financial and regulatory information: Examine content involving tax laws, accounting standards, financial reporting requirements, audit procedures, and compliance frameworks.
  • Analyze financial reasoning: Assess tax interpretations, accounting treatments, financial conclusions, audit findings, and calculation methodologies for accuracy and professional validity.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate statements, outdated regulations, calculation errors, unsupported assumptions, and compliance concerns.
  • Validate information: Research and verify content using official PRC government publications, tax regulations, accounting standards, auditing standards, and regulatory guidance.
  • Review tax calculations and reconciliation models: Assess tax liabilities, tax rates, preferential tax treatment, calculations, reconciliations, and financial schedules.
  • Evaluate accounting records and financial documentation: Review financial statements, general ledgers, accounting workbooks, journal entries, supporting schedules, and disclosures.
  • Assess audit documentation and evidence: Identify missing audit items, insufficient supporting documentation, procedural gaps, and unsupported conclusions.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings and recommend accurate corrections supported by professional standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring rubrics, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Expertise in a New Way

Use your specialized knowledge of taxation, accounting, auditing, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance to contribute to emerging AI technologies.

Earn Supplemental Income

This freelance opportunity allows qualified professionals to earn additional income while applying their expertise to flexible, project-based assignments.

Leverage Your Mainland China Expertise Internationally

Apply the education, qualifications, and professional experience you've developed in Mainland China while working remotely from your current country of residence.

Help Improve Financial Accuracy

Your evaluations will improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated tax calculations, accounting assessments, financial reporting guidance, and audit-related content.

Explore Emerging Technology

Gain exposure to AI content evaluation initiatives while leveraging your existing professional expertise.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for professionals who can identify financial inaccuracies, assess technical reasoning, and communicate expert findings clearly.

Compensation

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on specialty, experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements.

Locations and Pay Rate (USD/Hour)

Singapore, UK, US: $35–$45

Taiwan, Europe: $25–$35

Malaysia, Hong Kong: $15–$25

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, professional qualifications, and assignment complexity.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Geographic Requirement: Must reside and perform all project work outside Mainland China
  • Regional Expertise Requirement: Relevant education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional work experience in Mainland China
  • Domain: Finance, Taxation, Accounting & Auditing (Mainland China)
  • Specialties: Mainland China Tax Specialist; Mainland China Accounting & Audit Specialist
  • Certification Requirements: CICPA and/or Mainland China CTA/Tax Advisor qualifications for Tax Specialists; CICPA qualification for Accounting & Audit Specialists
  • Languages: English plus the ability to independently interpret original Chinese-language materials
  • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
  • Project Type: AI Content Evaluation Pilot
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be asked to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises before project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced taxation, accounting, and auditing professionals who bring more than familiarity with financial regulations and reporting requirements. You should be comfortable reviewing complex financial information, evaluating calculations, exercising independent professional judgment, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

General Qualifications

  • Relevant education obtained in Mainland China and/or professional work experience in Mainland China within taxation, accounting, auditing, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Must currently reside and perform all project work outside Mainland China.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in taxation, accounting, financial reporting, auditing, or related specialties.
  • Academic qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Auditing, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of Mainland China's taxation, accounting, auditing, and regulatory environment.
  • Ability to interpret tax regulations, accounting standards, auditing requirements, and official guidance.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong written Chinese reading comprehension skills and professional written English communication skills.
  • Comfort using spreadsheets, financial workbooks, research platforms, databases, and digital collaboration tools.
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed project guidelines.

Mainland China Tax Specialist Requirements

  • CICPA and/or recognized Mainland China Certified Tax Agent (CTA) or Tax Advisor qualification.
  • Hands-on experience applying Mainland China's domestic taxation regulations.
  • Expertise in VAT, Enterprise Income Tax, preferential tax treatment, and tax surcharge calculations.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, validating, or reconciling tax calculations and supporting financial records.
  • Ability to independently verify historical tax regulations using official PRC sources.

Mainland China Accounting & Audit Specialist Requirements

  • CICPA professional qualification.
  • Professional experience involving accounting, auditing, financial reporting, or financial statement review.
  • Strong working knowledge of PRC GAAP and Chinese Accounting Standards (CAS).
  • Experience reviewing general ledgers, trial balances, financial statements, accounting records, and supporting documentation.
  • Understanding of Mainland China auditing standards, audit procedures, and documentation requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Tax Manager
  • Tax Advisor
  • Certified Tax Agent (CTA)
  • Certified Public Accountant (CICPA)
  • Financial Accountant
  • Financial Reporting Specialist
  • Audit Manager
  • Internal Auditor
  • External Auditor
  • Finance Manager
  • Corporate Controller
  • Financial Compliance Specialist

Additional preferred qualifications include:

  • Experience with Big Four accounting firms or established tax, audit, or advisory organizations.
  • ACCA, CPA, CIA, or other international financial certifications.
  • Experience supporting Mainland China entities in cross-border environments.
  • Experience preparing tax returns, tax calculations, financial statements, reconciliations, or audit workpapers.
  • Experience researching historical tax regulations and regulatory amendments.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel, financial modeling, and reconciliation experience.
  • Experience using ERP systems, accounting software, tax reporting platforms, or audit management solutions.
  • Previous exposure to AI-assisted financial research, fintech, regulatory technology, or AI content evaluation.

Experience with AI model evaluation, data annotation, research projects, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

Bring Your Finance Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced tax, accounting, or audit professional who enjoys analyzing complex financial information, validating calculations, applying professional judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of financial AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Mainland China Tax, Accounting & Auditing Specialist (SME) – AI Evaluator opportunities.

Compensation & Structure

Why Gorin Systems?

jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Scientific Editor will oversee the editorial and strategic development of assigned academic journals, ensuring high-quality publishing standards and advancing journal impact. This role requires expertise in manuscript evaluation, team work, stakeholder engagement, and operational management. The successful candidate will contribute to journal growth and uphold diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) principles in publishing practices.

Primary Responsibilities

  1. Manuscript Evaluation and Decision Making

  • Participate in the daily running of assigned journals.

  • Understand and assess submitted papers on a broad range of topics within the aims and scopes of assigned journals.

  • Evaluate and make final accept decisions on manuscripts at a level of deep understanding of the subject matter so that you can interrogate peer reviewers’ comments and author’s responses.

  • Stay up-to-date with latest relevant research and publishing practices to be: confident in making final decisions; provide expert input when required.

  1. Journal Strategy and Development

    • Provide expert input in the following areas:

      • Lead Editorial Board recruitment and maintain a functioning editorial board

      • Research and suggest possible Special Collection topics, Guest Editors and article titles for the Commissioning team to enact

      • Marketing initiatives to target specific researchers

      • Improvements in journal processes and workflows that ensure maintenance of quality and ability to meet Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  2. Team Leadership and Development

    • Ability to coach other/new editorial team members, as required, fostering professional growth.

    • Work within an inclusive and collaborative environment, promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) for team members and academic contributors.

  3. Stakeholder Engagement

    • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure journal quality and reputation.

    • In particular, work with Senior Scientific Editor and Journal Manager, as required, to ensure portfolio success

    • Advocate and implement DEI principles in manuscript evaluation and academic partnerships.

  4. Operational Management

    • Manage around 1200 submissions annually, ensuring journal performance metrics and KPIs are achieved, and that high-quality publishing is maintained.

    • Stay informed on organizational strategies and initiatives, incorporating them into editorial work.

Qualifications

  • Education:

  • A PhD in a relevant scientific discipline and/or an advanced medical degree is preferred.

  • An MSc qualification in the subject area may be suitable but only if the person has appropriate editorial experience within scholarly publishing.

  • Experience:

  • In-depth postgraduate research in a relevant scientific discipline is desired.

  • Previous editorial experience in assessing research manuscripts and handling manuscripts through peer review is an asset but not essential.

  • Expertise in a broad range of topics within the subject area(s) of assigned journal(s) is the aim; however, candidates with in-depth knowledge of some of the areas and has the ability to learn on the job, will be considered.

  • Skills:

    • Strong analytical and decision-making abilities, and a keen eye for detail to ensure consistent quality of work.

    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Key Competencies

  • Ability to efficiently manage and prioritize a high volume of manuscript submissions through to final decision.

  • A proactive, growth-focused mindset, good commercial awareness and a strong understanding of the Open Access journals publishing business and processes.

  • Commitment to advancing DEI initiatives in academic publishing.

Shipium builds technical infrastructure for complex supply chain.

Modern operators turn to Shipium when they want to turn their supply chain into a strategic value driver. Shipium's platform provides cloud infrastructure and leading AI capabilities that optimize costs and scale automation.

We’re building tech that connects previously fragmented systems and automates complex supply chain decisions to deliver speed and value across operations.

Founded in 2019 by supply chain technology experts from Amazon and Zulily, the company is on a mission to help every eCommerce company provide its customers a great delivery experience while simultaneously reducing their costs to fulfill orders.

About the role

Shipium Corp is seeking an autonomous, hands-on Director of Solutions Engineering to act as a player-coach—leading technical pre-sales, architecting enterprise solutions, managing a direct report, and scaling the Solutions Engineering organization.

In this high-impact role, you will blend strategic leadership with deep individual-contributor execution. You will partner closely with Sales on early deal scoping, build proofs of concept (POCs), conduct detailed API reviews with enterprise prospects, and serve as the technical bridge between Go-To-Market (GTM), Product, and Engineering.   • Scope deals accurately: Partner with Sales and Professional Services on early scoping to deliver reliable cost and timeline estimates for custom configurations.
  • Shape architecture decisions: Work with Product and Engineering on complex technical and architectural trade-offs.

  • 2+ years of experience directly managing, coaching, and scaling technical individual contributors.
  • Deep, hands-on experience across B2B SaaS, parcel, and supply chain technologies.
  • Proven track record in a customer-facing technical role within the supply chain, parcel logistics, or e-commerce technology space.
  • Deep command of complex SaaS architectures and hands-on proficiency configuring and demonstrating RESTful APIs.
  • Demonstrated daily proficiency using paid AI tools (specifically Claude) for code/POC generation, data parsing, and workflow automation, paired with rigorous quality governance to catch hallucinations or errors.
  • Working knowledge of CRM platforms, JIRA, Confluence, and modern sales/project management tools.

Strong analytical judgment to solve non-standardized customer problems under tight deal timelines.

jobs.title: Retention Specialist
jobs.description:
At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for a Retention Specialist to help our learners find the right solution when they consider leaving, while protecting revenue and keeping customer satisfaction high. If you're a natural communicator, enjoy turning difficult conversations into positive outcomes, and like hitting clear targets, we'd love to meet you.

This is a full-time, remote role with a working schedule of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, customer relationships don't end after enrollment—they're just beginning. As a Retention Specialist, you'll handle refund requests and overdue payments day to day, offering the right alternatives, resolving billing questions, and keeping learners on track to finish what they started. Reporting to our Retention Lead and working alongside Sales, Customer Success, and Billing, you'll have a direct, measurable impact on revenue and on how our learners feel about ELVTR.

You'll Love This Role If You:

  • Enjoy turning challenging customer conversations into positive outcomes
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, KPI-driven environment with clear daily targets
  • Are a persuasive communicator who can find win-win solutions
  • Stay calm, empathetic, and professional under pressure
  • Are highly organized and keep accurate records of every interaction
  • Like learning from feedback and sharpening your skills over time
  • Enjoy working as part of a team and helping colleagues succeed
  • Believe outstanding customer experiences drive long-term business success

What You'll Do

  • Handle incoming refund and cancellation requests by phone, email, and chat, aiming to retain revenue while delivering a positive customer experience
  • Understand each learner's reasons for leaving and offer suitable alternatives, including account credits, payment plans, partial refunds, course transfers, and deferrals
  • Follow up on overdue installment payments, reminding customers, resolving billing questions, and agreeing on realistic repayment arrangements
  • Work with the Billing team to resolve failed payments and help prevent chargebacks
  • Log every interaction, outcome, and agreement accurately in the CRM
  • Follow retention scripts, workflows, and policies, and suggest improvements based on what you hear from customers
  • Flag recurring refund reasons and customer pain points to your Lead so they can be shared with Sales, Product, and Operations
  • Escalate complex or sensitive cases to the Retention Lead with clear context and a recommended solution
  • Meet individual targets for retention rate, retained revenue, and installment recovery
  • Coordinate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to make sure each customer's issue is fully resolved

Requirements

  • 1–2+ years of experience in Customer Retention, Sales Retention, Customer Success, Collections, or a related customer-facing role
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience supporting customers in the US market
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills, with a track record of saving customers or recovering payments
  • Comfort handling refund requests, billing questions, and payment follow-ups
  • Ability to navigate difficult conversations with empathy while protecting company interests
  • A results-oriented mindset and comfort working toward daily and monthly targets
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in CRM record-keeping
  • Openness to coaching and feedback, with a drive to keep improving

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the online education or EdTech industry
  • Experience in high-ticket B2C sales or retention environments
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
  • Experience working with subscription or installment payment models
  • Basic knowledge of billing operations, chargebacks, and payment recovery
  • Familiarity with AI-powered customer support or sales tools, including conversation intelligence platforms
  • Interest in growing into a senior or lead retention role

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path to senior and lead roles as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow: Free access to ELVTR courses, ongoing training and coaching, and career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, in a flexible and supportive environment with a collaborative international team
  • Health & Wellbeing: Gym membership reimbursement, mental health support, and a generous paid vacation allowance

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact: Every learner you help stay on track gets closer to building new skills, advancing their career, and unlocking opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career: We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team: Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another customer service role—if you want to build meaningful customer relationships, solve real challenges, and see the measurable impact of your work every day—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

ELVTR is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all.

jobs.title: Manager, Client Experience - Health & Wellness
jobs.description:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

  • Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world.
  • We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact.

LET’S START WITH OUR VALUES

  • Excellent. Being excellent at what we do sets us apart. It happens when we care about our work and how it lands, set clear standards, and hold each other accountable. We don't stop at meeting the standard; we keep raising the bar.
  • Authentic. Real connection happens when we show up as our best, truest selves, help others do the same, and stand by each other through the harder times.
  • Curious. Curiosity keeps us innovative. Better understanding comes from asking helpful questions, seeking to understand before we act, and building on each other's thinking.
  • Dynamic. Growth is central to our purpose, and it only happens in dynamic environments where we stay flexible, adaptable and open.
  • Empathetic. Great partnerships happen when we take the time to understand the people we work with, our teams, our clients and our communities, for better outcomes for each.

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Client Experience Manager with a career built in healthcare, health-tech or wellness to lead delivery for Boldr’s Health & Wellness clients. Our clients span preventive and functional health, digital health, diagnostics and lab testing, practitioner platforms and wellness brands. Their customers are patients and members, not just shoppers, so privacy, clinical sensitivity and getting it right first time matter on every contact.

You will own delivery for a portfolio of Health & Wellness accounts and lead the Team Captains who run them. You will act as a business owner, accountable for SLA performance, quality and compliance, and you will be the operations voice in the room with client leaders, including founders, medical directors and clinical operations teams.

You will help foster a healthy working environment for our team members, represent Boldr to our clients, and act as our internal client across departments. You will need to be laser-focused on operational performance and comfortable leading global teams day to day.

You will be responsible for client communication, performance reporting, training and escalation management, including clinical and privacy escalations. Having an eye for detail will be important, as you will keep our client success tools and procedures accurate and up to date.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

Health & Wellness is one of Boldr’s core verticals, and our clients trust us with their patients’ and members’ experience. We need someone who already speaks their language: someone who understands care journeys, health data privacy and clinical escalation, and who can turn that knowledge into tight, measurable operations. If you are impact-driven, bring your best to everything you do and champion our values, we would love to hear from you.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Processes

  • Develop and maintain an authentic relationship with all the Client and internal stakeholders.
  • Build a deep understanding of each health and wellness client’s business model (e.g., preventive and functional health, digital health, practitioner platforms, wellness products), their regulatory context, and the outcomes that matter most to them (e.g., member retention, care journey completion, appointment and test adherence).
  • Work confidently with clinical and medical stakeholders (e.g., medical directors, clinical operations teams) and ensure care-related issues follow clear escalation paths.
  • Own the clinical and safety escalation path for your accounts: make sure agents know what they can and cannot answer, and that urgent or care-related issues reach the right clinical team fast.
  • Run daily and weekly performance reviews with client stakeholders and Boldr leadership, tracking health-specific measures alongside SLAs (e.g., care journey completion, appointment and test adherence, member retention, escalation turnaround).
  • Ability to work seamlessly with different departments namely: Implementation, Client Solutions, Finance, IT, People Experience and Office Operations.
  • Communicating and resolving basic to complex inquiries and concerns in an accurate, valid, complete, and timely manner.
  • Create and manage Client contracts such as MSAs and SLAs.
  • Manage a team of Team Captains and monitor compliance against SLAs and achievement of Client KPIs.
  • Root cause analysis, planning and execution to ensure KPIs are met
  • Ensure your teams meet health data privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR), including access controls, handling of protected health information (PHI), audit readiness and privacy incident response.
  • Partner with Team Captains to ensure documentation is constantly updated and identification of process improvements are sourced with the TC and their team.
  • Lead the operations story in Client Business Reviews (MBRs and QBRs) in partnership with your SBU Head: what the numbers mean for the client’s patients or members, and what we will do next.
  • Develop relationships within each Health & Wellness client to spot growth opportunities, such as new lines of business, sister brands or additional services, and bring them to the commercial team.
  • Use AI and automation in your own work and your teams’ workflows (e.g., reporting, QA, knowledge management, planning) in ways that keep protected health information safe.
  • Update Hubspot deal cards and ensure all necessary items are appropriately invoiced.
  • Follow up with clients on invoicing, pricing discrepancies, and other billing-related issues.

People Management

  • Supervise and develop Team Captains through guidance, observation, and performance management activities.
  • Coach Team Captains and their teams to handle sensitive patient and member conversations with empathy, accuracy and the right escalation.
  • As needed, joins the Team Captain on calls with the Client, team huddles or coaching sessions to stay up to date with all Client and team developments.
    • This also provides an opportunity to observe the Team Captain’s presentation, Client communication and coaching skills.
  • Taking steps to ensure learning and growth through development plans and, when necessary, progressive counseling.
  • Promote and foster a culture of continuous improvement by providing positive and constructive feedback to team members.
  • Establish, promote, and maintain the Boldr culture within the organization.
  • Understand employee career growth aspirations to enable matching Boldr’s needs with employee abilities.
  • Act as the escalation point for the Team Captains and Senior Team Captains.
  • Responsible for upholding our organization’s values throughout the workplace
  • Monitor achievement of internal and external KPI’s and ensure Operational Excellence
  • Identify performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and work with operations to improve performance on KPIs through motivating, guiding, and holding local operations managers accountable for following SLA.

Tools, Administration, and Reporting

  • Familiarity with Google Suite of Services is a must for this role
    • Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Slides, and Docs are used heavily in Boldr
  • Experience with Hubspot is a plus.
  • Experience with health and wellness CX and care tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Health Cloud, EHR/EMR or practice-management platforms, telehealth or lab-ordering systems is a plus.
  • Confident using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to work faster and smarter.
  • Maintain Client schedule (Weekly Updates, MBRs, QBRs, Implementations) and collect feedback and drive necessary actions to completion

Training

  • Coordinate necessary training and best practices related to Tools and Processes
  • Onboard new hires so they are ready to succeed, including privacy and PHI training before they handle client data.
  • Build health and wellness knowledge (e.g., care journeys, privacy requirements, clinical escalation protocols) into team training and QA.
  • Lean six sigma knowledge and/or certification is a plus

Ongoing support and knowledge sharing

  • Obtain feedback from Clients and team members on processes and tools to ensure continuous improvement
  • Provides input and communication to drive Client Success improvement, for all Clients, enterprise-wide.

Requirements

WHAT WE’LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE…

  • Rooted in health and wellness: you understand how patients and members experience care, and you care about getting it right for them
  • Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
  • An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
  • Proactive and passionate about the client, patient and member experience
  • Strongly interested in learning new ideas, processes, and unique requirements. On top of that, you’re willing to share your skills and talents with the team.
  • Calm and credible with senior client leaders and clinical stakeholders, with the executive presence to hold the room

jobs.title: Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Our InfoSec team is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead how we defend Paddle in a rapidly changing threat landscape. AI is changing both sides of security. Attackers are using it to scale social engineering, find weaknesses faster and automate intrusion, while our own adoption of AI tools and agents creates new risks to manage. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for an experienced security generalist who wants to build our defences against these threats, and to use automation and AI to make our detection and response faster and more effective. You’ll be a senior technical leader across InfoSec and IT, working across both our Enterprise IT and Product environments, and helping our global team of Paddlers operate securely without slowing them down.

What you’ll do

  • Lead our incident response capability, from playbooks and readiness exercises to acting as senior technical lead during security incidents.

  • Improve our security operations, strengthening detection coverage, alert quality and triage, and turning manual operational work into engineered, repeatable processes.

  • Build and evolve our defences against AI-enabled threats, including AI-driven phishing, impersonation and deepfakes, and accelerated vulnerability exploitation.

  • Help Paddle grow our adoption of AI securely by designing guardrails, access models and monitoring for AI tools and agents, including the non-human identities and integrations they rely on.

  • Use automation and AI to speed up detection, investigation and response, so the team can handle a growing threat volume without growing headcount at the same rate.

  • Contribute to the secure configuration, posture management and monitoring of our AWS cloud infrastructure, working with the Platform team so security initiatives are delivered in a scalable and reliable manner.

  • Strengthen identity and access security as capabilities evolve, including our approach to MFA, device trust and conditional access.

  • Support GRC initiatives on technical control implementation and audit evidence automation, in line with SOC 2, PCI DSS and CIS Benchmarks.

  • Partner with InfoSec, IT and Engineering leadership to set technical direction and deliver the department’s key security programmes, making design decisions and driving work across multiple business functions.

  • Mentor and support other engineers across InfoSec, IT and the wider Engineering function, building a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

Skills & Experience

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Have extensive experience as a security engineer or in a similar role, with breadth across incident response, security operations, security engineering and cloud security, and a strong track record of hands-on delivery.

  • Have led or played a senior role in responding to real security incidents, from investigation and containment through to recovery and lessons learned.

  • Bring strong cloud security expertise, including identity, resource configuration, logging and monitoring. Hands-on experience securing AWS, including containerised workloads and cloud-native deployments, is highly desirable.

  • Have experience with detection and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR and cloud security posture management platforms, and know how to make them effective rather than noisy.

  • Understand how AI is changing the threat landscape, and are excited about using automation and AI to improve how security teams detect, investigate and respond.

  • Are familiar with modern identity, device management and endpoint security solutions (e.g. Okta, Iru, Island, SentinelOne), as well as collaboration and networking tools (e.g. Google Workspace, Slack, Cloudflare Zero Trust).

  • Can script or program to automate workflows and integrate systems. Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred) is desirable.

  • Have experience implementing technical controls against frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI DSS or CIS Benchmarks (nice to have).

  • Are comfortable operating autonomously on high-impact, wide-reaching work, and working collaboratively across multiple business functions.

  • Can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing at all levels of the business, including during high-pressure incidents.

  • Are passionate about security and want to make a real impact at scale.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Development, APJ
jobs.description:

Join Temporal and take on a leadership role where your expertise and enthusiasm will shape the future of our business development efforts. If you are ready to lead, innovate, and collaborate in a hybrid work environment, we invite you to be part of our journey!

jobs.title: Presales Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Presales Engineer, South EMEA.

About the job

This position is needed to enable our customers to build the future of communications. The Presales Engineer is a critical part of the sales team focused on our both New Business and Strategic segments.

Twilio’s Presales Engineers are responsible for delivering the Technical Win and best Product Fit to our customers. They lead the technical pre-sales relationship, drive technical discovery, propose technical architectures, demonstrate the product, anticipate concerns and offer creative solutions. They build customer trust in Twilio’s solutions.

Presales Engineers should be comfortable engaging a CEO or sketching out an API flow on a whiteboard with customer software engineers.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with Account Executives to execute pre-sales activities including opportunity qualification, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concept, RFP, design documentation, technical presentations and enablement sessions.
  • Help customers achieve success by leading the technical and product sale, recommending best-practice solutions, and guiding them on how to use Twilio’s APIs.
  • Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to our customers, by taking the lead on understanding customer technical pains through discovery in order to design, demonstrate, and present innovative solutions that solve business challenges.
  • Build and present highly interactive, complex and engaging customer product demonstrations to help showcase the capabilities of Twilio’s Communications Products, while effectively forming strong customer relationships with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders
  • Be Hands-on, high-energy, passionate, and a creative problem solver, equipped with the knowledge of how to get things done and ability to lead others to success.
  • Take the initiative to identify and solve problems - both for the customer and within the organization as we grow
  • Contribute to the broader Twilio Presales Engineering community through knowledge sharing, constructing demonstration materials, and creating reusable presentations
  • Mentor less experienced Presales Engineers

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years pre-sales experience selling complex, technical products or 10+ years of professional experience supporting technical products coupled with customer facing experience, particularly in delivery or consulting
  • Excellent communicator and presenter able to gain audience confidence
  • An engaging storyteller - you can gain audience confidence and communicate complex topics to multiple levels of audience.
  • Ability to build a deep understanding of a customer’s communications needs and guide them to a technical solution
  • Previous software development experience or working knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
    • Backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP)
    • Web development (JavaScript, HTML/CSS, frontend frameworks - React, Vue.js, Angular)
    • Experience building with REST APIs
  • Previous experience in Telecom, SIP, Contact Center, or Security .
  • Experience with sales methodologies
  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in a technical discipline (Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience

Desired:

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) and cloud application architecture.
  • Experience working with customers in the South region
  • Proficient French, Spanish or Italian speaker

Location

This role will be remote and based in the UK, Ireland or Spain

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 35% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The Role:

We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before.

As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings.

This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle.

What you'll do:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us.

  • Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts.

  • Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.).

  • Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

  • Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand.

  • Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance.

  • Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets.

  • Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day.

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone.

  • Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results.

  • Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different.

  • Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets.

  • See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value.

  • Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity.

  • Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity.

  • Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft.

  • Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social.

  • Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

jobs.title: WordPress Advanced Support Guide

jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Global Tax Director to lead the organization's global tax function, overseeing tax compliance, tax accounting, governance, transfer pricing, and tax risk management across multiple jurisdictions.

The role will provide strategic and operational leadership across UK, European, US, and other international tax matters. The successful candidate will lead tax teams in the Philippines and the UK while maintaining hands-on involvement in complex technical tax matters, compliance activities, and remediation initiatives.

This is a senior leadership position that requires a combination of deep technical tax expertise, strong people management capabilities, and the ability to strengthen global tax processes, controls, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

Global Tax Leadership & Compliance

  • Lead global tax compliance, reporting, governance, and tax accounting activities across all relevant jurisdictions.
  • Oversee UK, European, and US corporate tax compliance, including US Federal, State and Local Taxes (SALT), and sales and use tax obligations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate tax filings and compliance with applicable local and international regulations.
  • Manage tax audits, regulatory inquiries, and relationships with tax authorities and external tax advisers.
  • Lead the resolution of historical tax filing deficiencies, due diligence findings, and weaknesses in existing tax controls.
  • Maintain oversight of tax obligations across the organization's global legal entity structure.

Transfer Pricing & International Tax

  • Own and manage the global transfer pricing framework and intercompany arrangements.
  • Ensure compliance with OECD transfer pricing documentation requirements.
  • Oversee international tax matters, including permanent establishment, withholding tax, and tax residency considerations.
  • Monitor developments in international taxation, including Pillar Two requirements, and assess their potential business implications.
  • Provide technical guidance on complex cross-border tax matters.

Tax Governance, Risk & Controls

  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the Group Tax Control Framework.
  • Own the global tax compliance calendar and tax risk register.
  • Strengthen tax governance, internal controls, and risk management processes.
  • Identify and address tax compliance gaps and control weaknesses.
  • Improve tax risk reporting and provide clear updates to executive leadership and relevant governance committees.

Tax Accounting & Reporting

  • Oversee tax accounting, deferred tax, effective tax rate (ETR) reporting, and statutory tax disclosures under IFRS.
  • Ensure accurate and consistent tax reporting across relevant jurisdictions.
  • Provide technical oversight on complex tax computations and accounting matters.

Business Partnership & Advisory

  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Commercial, and M&A teams on transactions, business restructurings, and expansion activities.
  • Provide practical tax advice to support commercial and strategic business decisions.
  • Assess tax implications and risks associated with business initiatives and cross-border transactions.
  • Work closely with external advisers and internal stakeholders to address complex tax matters.

People Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Lead, manage, and develop tax teams based in the Philippines and the UK.
  • Build a high-performing global tax function with clear accountability, effective processes, and strong technical capabilities.
  • Provide guidance and oversight while remaining directly involved in complex tax compliance, computations, and remediation matters when required.
  • Drive process standardization, automation, and operational efficiency across the tax function.
  • Improve the use of tax technology, reporting systems, workflow management, and data analytics.

Technical Scope

Candidates should have strong technical knowledge and experience across several of the following areas:

  • UK Corporation Tax, VAT, and Employment Taxes.
  • European direct and indirect taxation.
  • US Federal Tax.
  • US State and Local Taxes (SALT).
  • US Sales and Use Taxes.
  • International Transfer Pricing and OECD compliance.
  • Pillar Two and international tax developments.
  • Permanent Establishment and tax residency matters.
  • Withholding tax.
  • Tax accounting and reporting under IFRS.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Significant experience in multinational tax leadership, preferably within a complex international organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing global tax compliance obligations across the UK, Europe, and the United States.
  • Strong technical expertise in international taxation, transfer pricing, and cross-border tax matters.
  • Proven experience leading tax compliance remediation and tax governance improvement initiatives.
  • Experience overseeing tax accounting, reporting, and compliance processes across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage tax audits, regulatory inquiries, and relationships with tax authorities and external advisers.
  • Experience leading and developing geographically distributed tax teams.
  • Ability to combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in complex technical and operational tax matters.

Professional Qualifications

  • ACA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional accounting or tax qualification.

Tax Technology & Systems

jobs.title: Bilingual (Spanish) Care Guide
jobs.description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

  • Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.
  • Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.
  • Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:

We are seeking a remote Bilingual (Spanish) Care Guide to serve as the vital first point of contact for new members joining Nadia Care. As the entry point to our care team, you set the tone for a member’s entire journey. Responsibilities include welcoming families, conducting their critical first visit, educating them on our services, and completing initial intake. Once you have successfully enrolled, scheduled, and completed the first visit with the member, you will seamlessly pass them to their designated Maternity Navigator for ongoing care and support. This role will report directly to the Senior Manager of Care Delivery.

Work Schedule:

This role is expected to work the following schedule (paid hourly):

  • Monday, Wednesday, Friday: 8:30am-5:30pm ET
  • Tuesday, Thursday: 11:00am-8:00pm ET

Please note this schedule is subject to change.

Key Responsibilities

  • First Visit & Onboarding: Serve as the first face of Nadia Care by conducting up to 7 comprehensive, virtual Welcome Visits per day. Assess members' baseline needs, educate them on our services, identify and escalate any urgent medical or social needs to the clinical team as they arise,and establish a warm, trusting relationship.
  • Care Team Warm Handoff: Coordinate directly with Maternity Navigators and clinical specialists to ensure smooth care transitions and pass critical intake notes to the core team.
  • System Documentation: Maintain rigorous data accuracy across platforms by logging interactions, scheduling visits, and tracking onboarding progress in systems like Athena

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3-5+ years in patient onboarding, member engagement, customer service, community health, or healthcare navigation (experience with Medicaid populations is a strong plus).
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fully fluent in English and Spanish (verbal and written) with strong conversational fluency and comfortable using non-technical terminology with members.
  • Communication Skills: High emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and the ability to build immediate rapport while guiding members through structured talk tracks.
  • Technical Savvy: Comfortable navigating CRM platforms, virtual communication tools, and scheduling software (e.g., Acuity, Spruce, EHRs, MacOS).
  • Adaptability & Drive: Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while hitting daily outreach quality and engagement targets.
  • Education & Basics: High school diploma or GED equivalent; reliable home internet access and a quiet space for taking calls.

This is a full-time hourly position with a pay range between $19-$22/hr. Exact compensation will depend on years of direct relevant experience.

At Nadia Care, we value transparency and want you to feel prepared at every stage of your candidate journey. Below is our standard interview process for this role:

  1. Recruiter Screen | 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview | 30 minutes
  3. Team Interview | 30 minutes

Please note that this process is subject to change, but we will always keep you informed along the way.

For full-time employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both professionally and personally:

Time Off That Works for You

  • Recharge with annual paid holidays off.
  • Full-Time Salaried Employees (Exempt): Enjoy unlimited time off after the 90-day introductory period.
  • Full-Time Hourly Employees (Non-Exempt): Receive three weeks of paid time off after the 90-day introductory period.

Comprehensive Health & Wellness Coverage

  • Medical Insurance: Access top-tier healthcare, covering hospital, surgical, and prescription drug benefits. Coverage begins the first of the following month.
  • Dental Insurance: Coverage for preventive care, as well as basic and major procedures.
  • Vision Insurance: Coverage for routine eye exams and eyeglasses.

Security & Future Planning Options

  • Stock Option Grant: We believe in shared success.
  • Life Insurance: Financial protection for your beneficiaries.
  • Disability Insurance: Short-term and long-term coverage in case of illness or injury.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Opportunity to save for the future.

We’re building something great and want you to be part of it. If you're looking for a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your contributions make an impact, apply today!

Remote positions are open to candidates in the contiguous US only. Due to operational and compliance requirements, we are unable to hire candidates residing in ND, AL, HI, PR or outside the contiguous US.

Please note that our recruitment team will only contact candidates via an official company email address ending in @nadiacare.com. Be cautious of scams; Nadia Care will never ask for financial information or payments at any stage of the hiring process.

About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

Coalition is a leader in cyber insurance, combining insurance protection with cybersecurity technology to help organizations prevent and recover from digital risk. That makes actuarial pricing here distinctive: the work connects insurance data with evolving cyber threats, security signals, and advanced analytics.

As an Actuarial Pricing Co-op, you will collaborate with actuaries and colleagues in data science, engineering, and security. You will gain exposure to AI and predictive models that inform cyber-risk assessment and pricing—and learn how model signals are evaluated alongside actuarial judgment. Depending on team priorities, you may contribute to risk segmentation, pricing new and existing products, portfolio monitoring, or process automation. With guidance from experienced teammates, you will turn analysis into clear recommendations that can help inform Coalition’s pricing decisions and product improvements.

If you are curious, enjoy solving complex problems, like working across teams, and want your work to matter from day one, we would love to meet you.

  • Build tools and dashboards to track pricing rates and business performance.
  • Testing new risk signals and 3rd party data and assessing their added value.
  • Automate and improve actuarial processes to make pricing more efficient.
  • Respond to ad hoc requests and prepare analyses and recommendations for business partners and leadership, with guidance from senior team members.

  • Upper-year undergraduate or graduate student in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, economics, or a related quantitative field

Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

OrderMesh is the operating system for modern print-on-demand fulfillment.

We build intelligent order orchestration software that sits at the center of a complex global supply chain — connecting brands, marketplaces, and producers through a single platform. We replace the fragmented legacy systems that the industry has outgrown, with modern, API-first software built for today's scale and speed.

OrderMesh is part of Taylor Corporation, a multi-billion-dollar global leader in print, manufacturing, and technology-enabled services — operating one of the largest production footprints in the world, serving enterprise customers across retail, ecommerce, and beyond.

The best of both worlds — and we mean it.

Most companies say "startup energy with enterprise backing." Few actually deliver it. At OrderMesh, the combination is real:

  • Startup ownership: Small, high-trust teams. Real autonomy over architecture. A direct line between what you build and how it performs in production.

We're at an inflection point. The platform already runs real, live production volume — and we're expanding its capabilities, building out new infrastructure, and actively shaping how an entire industry operates. The decisions you make here — technical, architectural, product-driven — will have lasting impact.

This isn't a role where you maintain someone else's roadmap. You'll be building serious software, solving meaningful real-world problems, and doing it with the backing of a world-class organization.
