jobs.title: SAP Entwickler / Solution Architect SAP HCM

Dies umfasst die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Wartung kundenspezifischer Lösungen in klassischen SAP HCM-Modulen (z. B. PA, OM, PY, PT) sowie die Gestaltung komponentenübergreifender Lösungsarchitekturen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren HCM-Beratern und Kunden stellt der Stelleninhaber sicher, dass die technische Architektur, die Systemlandschaft und die Geschäftsprozesse optimal aufeinander abgestimmt sind. Ziel ist es, nachhaltige, wartbare, performante und zukunftsfähige Lösungen zu gestalten, die sowohl den individuellen Kundenanforderungen als auch den strategischen Zielbildern (z. B. S/4HANA, SuccessFactors sowie Hybrid-Modelle) gerecht werden.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

1. Entwicklung und Systemanpassung:

  • Entwicklung von Reports, Formularen (z. B. SAPscript, SmartForms, Adobe), User-Exits, BAdIs und kundeneigenen Programmen im SAP HCM
  • Technische Realisierung von Anforderungen in den Modulen PA, OM, PY, PT
  • Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Anpassung von Schnittstellen (z. B. für Payroll Service Provider, Zeitwirtschaftssysteme etc.)
  • Verantwortung für das Solution Design in SAP HCM On-Premise, S/4HANA HCM und SAP Private Cloud Edition
  • Konzeption, Modellierung und Dokumentation der Systemarchitektur (PA, PY, PT, OM, PKP, ESS/MSS, Workflow, Fiori sowie Integrationen externer Systeme)
  • Definition von Integrationsarchitekturen zwischen SAP HCM, SuccessFactors und Drittsystemen (z. B. Zeitwirtschaft, Payroll Provider, SAP BTP, Atoss, PKP).
  • Definition und Einhaltung von Best Practices, Namenskonventionen, Systemstandards

2. Beratung und Anforderungsanalyse:

  • Enge Abstimmung mit den HCM-Beratern zur gemeinsamen Konzeption technischer Lösungen
  • Analyse und Bewertung technischer Machbarkeit von Anforderungen der Kunden
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung technischer Spezifikationen und Aufwandschätzungen
  • Technische und fachliche Leitung von Workshops zu Architektur, Schnittstellen und Datenflüssen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, Teamleitung und Entwicklern bei der Umsetzung

3. Transformationsmanagement & Analyse

  • Steuerung und Begleitung von Brownfield- und Greenfield-Transformationen
  • Durchführung von Systembewertungen, Readiness-Analysen und Erarbeitung von Transformationsstrategien
  • Technische Begleitung von SAP HCM Projekten (z. B. Migrationen, Releasewechsel, Digitalisierungsprojekte)
  • Unterstützung bei Rollout-Projekten und systemübergreifenden Entwicklungen

4. Support und Optimierung:

  • Wartung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender HCM-spezifischer Eigenentwicklungen
  • Performanceanalysen und Optimierung von kritischen Anwendungen
  • Technischer 2nd-/3rd-Level Support im SAP HCM Umfeld

5. Prozessentwicklung & Standardisierung

  • Entwicklung eines internen Solution Frameworks und dazugehörige Templates (z. B. Migrationsvorgehen, Mapping-Kataloge, Fit/Gap-Struktur)
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der ABAP/ABAP OO Entwicklung, speziell im SAP HCM Umfeld
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in den Modulen PA, OM, PY und PT aus technischer Perspektive
  • Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von SAP FIORI Applikationen von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung mit Formulartechnologien (SmartForms, Adobe Interactive Forms), Schnittstellen (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, ODATA)
  • Kenntnisse im SAP Lohnabrechnungsumfeld (Schemen, Regeln, Infotypen) von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Das erwartet DICH bei uns:

  • Ein dynamisches Unternehmen mit außergewöhnlich viel Freiheit, Gestaltungsraum und Eigenverantwortung
  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns sehr wichtig, deshalb darfst du, Im Rahmen der Kundenanforderungen, große Flexibilität und viel Vertrauen bezüglich der Gestaltung deiner Arbeitszeit und deines Arbeitsortes (100% remote) genießen
  • Individuelle Entwicklungsperspektiven und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten:
    Sie erhalten Zugriff auf die neuesten Lerninhalte der SAP und die Möglichkeit der Zertifizierung durch die SAP AG
  • Ein spannender Mix nationaler und internationaler Projekte bietet Ihnen stets die Chance, Ihr Können unter Beweis zu stellen und an neuen Herausforderungen zu wachsen
  • Einen langfristig gesicherten Arbeitsplatz durch einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, der den Einstieg in eine dynamische Firma mit außergewöhnlich vielen Freiheiten bietet
  • Teamevents (Auslandsreisen, Gemeinsame Events in Deutschland, usw.) werden bei uns großgeschrieben und der Spaß ist bereits vorprogrammiert
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, wie z.B:
    • 30 Tage Urlaub (unabhängig von Ihrem Wohnort, gilt der Feiertagskalender unseres Hauptsitzes in München/Bayern)
    • Leistungsgerechtes Vergütungssystem und betriebliche Altersvorsorge
    • Zuschüsse zu Fitnessstudio, Homeoffice Ausstattung (bis 500€), Internetrechnung, etc.

Seit nun mehr als 20 Jahren ist TeamWork ein erfolgreiches Systemhaus und SAP-Beratungsunternehmen mit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeitern an 27 Standorten – weltweit.

Voller Begeisterung für den Kunden und der Liebe zur Herausforderung fokussieren wir uns als TeamWork Germany seit 2011 auf personalwirtschaftliche SAP-Projekte. Dabei stehen unsere Kunden im Mittelpunkt und wir definieren gemeinsam die besten Lösungen mit der optimalen Technologie, führen diese ein und betreuen unsere Kunden im Betrieb. Ob OnPremise, Cloud oder hybride Landschaften – immer individuell auf die Bedürfnisse der Kunden abgestimmt.

TeamWork ist bei seinen Kunden dafür bekannt, dass es ihre operative Leistung steigert, sie bei ihrer digitalen Transformation unterstützt und neue Hebel für Wachstum und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit schafft.

This role may be a fit for you if:

  • You know insurance compliance inside and out: You've investigated and answered DOI complaints, worked carrier audits, and know how expectations shift from state to state.

  • You're a tinkerer: When you see a broken process, you can't leave it alone. You take it apart, figure out why it breaks, and rebuild it better.

  • You reach for AI first: You already use AI tools in your daily work, and you're excited to build agents and automations that do the research and first drafts so your team can focus on judgment.

  • You write with precision: Regulators, carriers and customers read your work, and you take pride in getting it right the first time.

What you'll actually do:

  • Own Regulatory & Complaint Response: Lead the investigation and response for every DOI, Attorney General, BBB and carrier-escalated complaint, and hand Legal a clean, complete packet for final review.

  • Build Complaint Intelligence: Create the taxonomy, logging and trend reporting that show us root causes and size our exposure.

  • Automate the Heavy Lifting: Partner with our Ops automation team to build and keep improving AI agents that classify complaints, research accounts across our CRM and carrier portals, and draft responses for human review.

  • Build AI-Native Compliance Monitoring: Design and run AI-powered monitoring of calls, chats, messages and our app and web signup flows to catch compliance issues before they turn into complaints.

  • Run a QA Program: Set the quality bar for complaint handling and coach the team to it.

  • Turn Findings into Fixes: Bring together the teams involved to find the root cause of each issue, drive the fix through training, process or product changes, and confirm the same issue doesn't come back.

  • Carrier Compliance Partnership: Serve as the operational point of contact for carrier audits, information requests and complaint investigations.

  • Coach our Complaint Specialist: Manage and coach the specialist on our team, setting the quality bar for complaint handling.

  • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license, or the ability to obtain one quickly.

  • 3+ years of experience in insurance compliance, complaints, regulatory affairs or claims. Experience leading or coaching others is a plus; formal management experience isn't required.

  • Hands-on experience owning DOI complaint responses, whether you wrote them or reviewed and finalized them, plus supporting carrier audits. P&C experience strongly preferred.

  • Regular use of AI tools in your own work, and examples of processes you've improved with technology, from spreadsheet automation to no-code tools to AI. Experience building automations or AI agents is a big plus.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort turning messy data into clear trends and decisions.

  • Exceptional written communication with an eye for legal and compliance detail.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Build It Your Way: Design a modern, AI-powered compliance program from the ground up, partnering with our Ops automation team.

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Erfahrung im Bereich KI-gestützte Content-Erstellung: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren.

Eine offene, wertschätzende Kommunikation ist für dich selbstverständlich und du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven konstruktiv zusammenzubringen.

Benefits

We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth.

Help Shape the Future of AI in Human Resources & Payroll Compliance

What if your expertise in Mainland China labor law, payroll administration, statutory benefits, and employment compliance could help artificial intelligence better understand employment regulations, payroll requirements, HR communications, and workforce compliance obligations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment law professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Human Resources professionals, Payroll Specialists, Labor Compliance Experts, Employment Law specialists, Compensation & Benefits professionals, and HR Operations practitioners who can apply their professional expertise, regulatory knowledge, and analytical judgment to evaluate AI-generated employment and payroll content.

This isn't a traditional HR, payroll administration, or labor relations position. You won't be managing employees, processing payroll, or administering benefits programs. Instead, you'll assess employment-related content, validate payroll calculations, review HR communications, identify regulatory inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your HR and payroll expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It is important to understand the nature of freelance work. Tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent. Candidates must currently reside and perform all project-related work outside Mainland China.

The Opportunity

As a Mainland China Labor & Payroll Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated HR, payroll, and employment compliance content.

You'll analyze labor law scenarios, payroll calculations, compensation structures, employee communications, statutory benefit requirements, and employment compliance matters while identifying errors, unsupported conclusions, regulatory inconsistencies, and procedural gaps.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex HR, payroll, labor compliance, and employment-related challenges within Mainland China's regulatory environment.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of the following areas:

1. Mainland China Labor Law & Employment Compliance

Professionals experienced in interpreting and applying PRC labor laws, employment regulations, labor contracts, employee rights, terminations, severance requirements, leave entitlements, disciplinary procedures, and workplace compliance obligations.

2. Payroll Administration, Compensation & Wage Compliance

Professionals experienced in payroll processing, compensation administration, wage calculations, overtime requirements, tax withholding, severance calculations, payroll reconciliation, and statutory payroll compliance.

3. Social Insurance, Statutory Benefits & Housing Provident Fund

Experts in social insurance administration, Housing Provident Fund requirements, statutory contribution calculations, employer obligations, employee enrollments, and regional contribution requirements.

4. HR Communications, Policies & Employment Documentation

Professionals experienced in drafting, reviewing, and implementing employment contracts, HR policies, employee communications, handbooks, compensation notices, disciplinary communications, and employment-related documentation.

5. Labor & Payroll Regulatory Research

Professionals experienced in researching labor regulations, employment laws, payroll requirements, government announcements, regulatory guidance, and historical regulatory changes.

6. Payroll Auditing & Technical Validation

Professionals who review payroll calculations, compensation models, payroll workbooks, reconciliations, calculation methodologies, and supporting documentation for accuracy and compliance.

7. Compensation & Benefits Administration

HR professionals responsible for employee compensation planning, statutory benefits administration, payroll compliance, and employee rewards programs.

8. Employment Compliance & HR Operations

Professionals responsible for employment compliance reviews, labor policy implementation, workforce administration, and HR operational governance.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated HR and payroll content: Assess employment, payroll, labor law, and compliance-related content for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and regulatory alignment.
  • Review employment and payroll information: Examine content involving labor laws, payroll administration, compensation, statutory benefits, HR policies, and workplace compliance.
  • Analyze regulatory reasoning: Assess employment interpretations, payroll methodologies, and compliance conclusions for accuracy and alignment with applicable regulations.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate statements, payroll errors, unsupported interpretations, missing obligations, and compliance risks.
  • Validate information: Research and verify content using official PRC labor, employment, taxation, and social insurance resources.
  • Review HR communications: Evaluate employee notices, workplace policies, compensation communications, and employment documentation.
  • Review payroll calculations: Assess salary calculations, overtime, tax withholding, statutory contributions, leave pay, and severance calculations.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings and recommend accurate corrections supported by regulatory references and professional practice.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation rubrics, quality standards, and review criteria.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established timelines.

Apply Your Expertise in a New Way

Use your specialized knowledge of labor law, payroll administration, HR compliance, and employment practices to contribute to emerging AI initiatives.

This freelance opportunity allows qualified professionals to earn additional income while applying their professional expertise to flexible, task-based assignments.

Your evaluations will improve the quality and reliability of AI-generated employment, payroll, benefits, and compliance information.

jobs.description:
Vego Garden is making gardening as accessible and sustainable as possible, while encouraging gardening to be an avenue for personal and community development!

Since its successful launch in 2020, Vego Garden has quickly become the leading brand in raised garden beds and one of the fastest-growing consumer brands in the country. In just five years, our rapid growth has led to the establishment of a 200,000-square-foot headquarters and distribution center, along with a beautiful 5-acre farm.

Today, Vego Garden proudly employs over 100 dedicated team members across the U.S. and internationally. Our high-quality raised garden beds are recognized for their durability, eco-friendly materials, and safety for both children and pets. We are proud to be partnering with Costco, ACE Hardware, Home Depot, Menards, Lowe’s, Wayfair, and Amazon.

We owe our success to our loyal customers and passionate team. Through our Vego Garden Kids and Giving Back Program, we have donated more than 3,500 garden beds to schools, underserved communities, and other philanthropic initiatives - helping to grow gardens and give back across the nation by making gardening easier anytime, anywhere! We're proud to be a certified Great Place to Work company!

Vego Garden Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, or marital status.

Job Purpose:

Vego Garden is looking for a Senior Retention Marketing Manager, DTC & E-Commerce with deep expertise in retention strategy and a proven track record of growing existing customer revenue for DTC consumer product brands.

You will own the retention strategy across the entire customer lifecycle, from converting first-time buyers into repeat customers to increasing purchase frequency, expanding category adoption, and reactivating lapsed customers. This goes beyond managing email campaigns or building basic automated flows. You will leverage advanced lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, behavioral insights, and rigorous experimentation to develop sophisticated retention strategies that meaningfully increase repeat purchases, customer lifetime value, and profitable growth.

This role requires a true retention expert who can connect high-level strategy with hands-on execution, using a deep understanding of DTC consumer purchasing behavior to turn customer relationships into a sustainable competitive advantage.

Essential Responsibilities:

Retention Strategy & Existing Customer Growth

  • Build and execute a retention roadmap that increases repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, cross-category adoption, and customer lifetime value.
  • Identify the highest-impact opportunities across onboarding, second-purchase conversion, cross-sell, loyalty, and win-back.
  • Develop customer journeys that reflect gardening seasonality, product ownership, and customers’ evolving needs.
  • Partner with the Growth Director to set retention goals, prioritize investments, and forecast existing customer revenue.

Lifecycle Marketing & Customer Experience

  • Own the strategy and execution of email, SMS, and other relevant lifecycle channels, including automated journeys and promotional campaigns.
  • Build segmented, personalized experiences based on purchase history, engagement, customer value, and lifecycle stage.
  • Strengthen post-purchase journeys through product education, timely recommendations, and content that helps customers succeed in their gardens.
  • Manage the retention calendar, balancing education, product discovery, seasonal demand, and promotional activity.
  • Establish strong standards for deliverability, audience health, consent, and communication frequency.

Customer Insights, Measurement & Experimentation

  • Analyze customer cohorts to understand repeat purchase patterns, time to second purchase, category progression, and lapse risk.
  • Build reporting that connects retention activity to customer behavior, revenue, and profitability.
  • Run structured experiments across messaging, offers, timing, segmentation, and customer journeys.
  • Use holdouts and incrementality testing where appropriate to distinguish additional revenue from purchases that would have happened anyway.
  • Turn customer feedback and performance insights into clear recommendations for marketing, merchandising, and customer experience.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with acquisition teams to improve customer quality and connect first-purchase campaigns with long-term value.
  • Work with Creative, Content, Merchandising, E-commerce, and Customer Experience to deliver cohesive customer journeys.
  • Shape loyalty and referral initiatives based on customer needs and business economics.
  • Manage relevant agency, platform, and contractor relationships to support execution.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of specialized experience in retention and lifecycle marketing, with demonstrated ownership of retention strategy and programs for a DTC or e-commerce business.
  • Direct experience with a DTC consumer product brand, ideally involving physical products and repeat-purchase or cross-category growth. Must understand the retention challenges unique to DTC consumer products.
  • Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing retention and lifecycle marketing team members, providing strategic direction, setting priorities, and raising the team's overall level of expertise and performance.
  • A proven track record of developing and executing retention strategies that measurably improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, existing customer revenue, or customer lifetime value.
  • Deep expertise in lifecycle marketing strategy, including customer segmentation, behavioral triggers, cohort-based strategies, customer journeys, and advanced lifecycle automation beyond basic email flows.
  • Hands-on expertise with email and SMS platforms such as Klaviyo or comparable tools, including automation, segmentation, testing, and performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using cohort analysis and customer data to identify retention opportunities and guide strategic decisions.
  • A clear understanding of contribution margin, promotional economics, and the trade-offs between short-term revenue and long-term customer value.
  • The ability to translate customer insights into compelling messaging, relevant offers, and personalized lifecycle experiences that drive measurable results.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and project management skills.
  • Comfort moving between strategic planning, hands-on execution, and performance analysis in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in gardening, home, outdoor living, or other categories with seasonal demand and longer purchase cycles.
  • Experience with Shopify, loyalty platforms, customer data tools, or subscription programs.
  • Experience designing incrementality tests or working with business intelligence (BI) tools and SQL.
  • A personal interest in gardening and helping customers build confidence as they grow.

Physical Demands:

This position primarily involves working at a desk and operating a computer for prolonged periods with moderate walking and standing.

Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Security Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Team

At DoorDash, including international brands Deliveroo and Wolt, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and Dashers. Global Cyber Defense is a highly talented and globally distributed team that covers response, intelligence, insider risk, threat hunting, automation, and detection engineering. We exist to keep our brands safe for the Dashers, merchants, and consumers who depend on us. Our mission is to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats with speed and precision, while continuously hardening our defenses through automation, AI, and cross-regional collaboration.

About the Role

Security at DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt runs on telemetry, and our data pipelines team owns all of it. You will own multi-terabyte-per-day ingest across AWS and GCP, including reliability, cost, and schema, so that every detection engineer, threat hunter, and responder across three brands can find what they need. Most of your week goes to code, pipelines, and query performance rather than alert triage. The team spans the US and UK, so you will be in the room (or the thread) with IT, legal, privacy, incident response, insider risk, threat intelligence, and detection engineering on a regular basis. Very little of this work happens in isolation, and that is the fun of it. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Cyber Defense in the United States. The role includes participation in an on-call rotation for pipeline health.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own multi-terabyte-per-day log pipelines across AWS and GCP: ingest, routing, enrichment, schema management, and onboarding new sources as the business adds them
  • Control ingest cost and volume, cutting noise at the edge without dropping the audit logs investigators depend on
  • Model security data and tune query performance in Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift, including the tables detection engineering builds on
  • Ship production services and integrations that other teams depend on: custom SIEM connectors, API clients, and automation
  • Set and defend SLOs for log availability and freshness, and build the dashboards and alerting that prove them
  • Own infrastructure as code and CI/CD for all of the above, including the deployment path that detections-as-code rides on
  • Build AI agents and automated runbooks that speed up triage and time to fix across cloud infrastructure
  • Enforce IAM and service account governance for the pipeline's cloud workloads
  • Lead cross-functional projects spanning infrastructure, platform engineering, and incident response
  • Create and maintain the standards and documentation that keep the service consistent, and mentor engineers across Cyber Defense

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years building and operating high-volume data pipelines in production at multi-terabyte-per-day scale, with tools like Kafka, Cribl, Dataflow, Kinesis, or CloudWatch
  • 4+ years writing production software in Python, Go, Rust, or Java: services and tooling that other engineers run, beyond one-off scripts
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS and GCP, including infrastructure as code and ownership of CI/CD pipelines on GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
  • Strong SQL and data modeling in a columnar warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift, covering partitioning, cost control, and query tuning
  • A track record owning reliability for a platform other engineers depend on, including on-call
  • Experience building executive dashboards and engineering metrics that people actually act on
  • Proven leadership and technical project management across infrastructure, platform engineering, and incident response
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, a collaborative instinct, and a habit of continuous learning
  • Familiarity with an enterprise SIEM as an operator or a consumer (Google SecOps/Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic, CrowdStrike LogScale) is a plus, as is time with Kubernetes, Docker, and runtime security controls
  • Any hands-on time with security telemetry sources, detections-as-code (YARA-L, Sigma, SPL), LLM-assisted workflows, penetration testing, red teaming, or triaging bug bounty reports is a bonus

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Colombia)
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.title: Growth Copywriter
jobs.description:
Why should you join Jerry?

  • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).

  • Work closely with brilliant leaders and teammates from companies like McKinsey, BCG, Nvidia, Better, NerdWallet, SoFi, etc.

  • Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.

  • Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.

  • Own Jerry’s acquisition messaging end to end across a growing product lineup, from car insurance to home, renters, motorcycle, and RV & boat insurance, plus property tax appeals.

About the Role

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners’ needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we’re just getting started. Now we’re expanding beyond the car to help people protect and save on their broader physical assets, with motorcycle, home, renters, and RV & boat insurance, and property tax appeals.

We’re looking for a Conversion Copywriter with direct-response instincts and a testing mindset. You’re someone who knows that one headline can move CPA more than a budget change. You’ll own the words across our acquisition funnel (search ads, paid social copy, and landing pages), and define how each new product shows up for customers from day one. You’ll write, test, and iterate on them at high speed, using AI to multiply your output without lowering the bar. You’ll report to our Creative Lead and work day to day with our SEM, paid social, and growth teams

Why you will (or won’t) like working here:

  • Your work is measured. Every line you write is tested against CTR, CVR, and CPA. If you love seeing the impact of your words in the data, you’ll thrive. If you’d rather write one perfect manifesto, this isn’t the role.

  • Build from zero: We’re launching several new products, and each one needs its story written for the first time. You’ll create the foundational value props: positioning, proof points, and the first messages tested in market. You’ll be building those, not just tweaking copy that already works.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’ll build the messaging foundation (angles, proof points, an approved-claims library) that the all marketing channels, website, app store all draw from. You’ll also write the RSAs yourself.

  • Insurance is not “sexy,” and it’s regulated: People think about insurance when a renewal bill arrives, and nobody wakes up excited about a property tax appeal. Can you make savings feel real and trustworthy, and stay compliant while doing it?

What You’ll Do

  • Write and iterate acquisition copy across channels: Google RSAs, Meta and TikTok primary text and headlines, YouTube and CTV supers, and landing pages.

  • Build foundational value propositions for new products: For each new product (motorcycle, home, renters, RV & boat insurance, property tax appeal), research the customer, the competitors, and what makes Jerry different. Then define the core UVP, the messaging hierarchy, and the proof points, and validate them quickly through paid tests.

  • Own the testing roadmap for copy: form hypotheses, structure tests so they produce clear learnings, read the results, and ship the next round quickly.

  • Develop angles, hooks, and messaging frameworks grounded in customer insight. You’ll dig through app reviews, support tickets, call transcripts, and Reddit for the language customers actually use.

  • Make landing pages convert: keep the message consistent from ad to page, structure the page as an argument, handle objections, and add trust signals. You’ll partner with marketers and growth PMs on CRO.

  • Build and maintain Jerry’s messaging and claims library: pre-approved value propositions, proof points, and compliant claims, created with Legal and used across all marketing channels, website, and app store for every product line.

  • Partner with media and analytics: turn search terms, auction data, and performance signals into better copy.

  • Use AI tools to generate variants at scale, build prompt libraries and voice guides others can run, and stay the editor and strategist rather than the typist.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of performance or direct-response copywriting: ideally in-house at a growth-stage app, fintech, insurtech, or lead-gen company, and/or at a performance marketing agency.

  • Proven track record, with numbers: a portfolio that shows lifts in CTR, CVR, or CPA, not just polished work.

  • Channel fluency: you know RSA mechanics (pinning, character limits, how Google combines assets), Quality Score, platform-native social copy, and landing page best practices.

  • Testing and data literacy: you can pull your own reports, read results critically, and know the difference between a winner and noise.

  • Positioning chops: you’ve defined value props or messaging for a new product or category launch, not just optimized existing copy.

  • Range: you can write rational, intent-driven search copy and emotional, scroll-stopping social hooks.

  • AI fluency: you actively use generative tools in your writing workflow and can show us how.

  • Collaborative, low-ego, fast: you’re happy to kill your own darlings when the data says so.

  • (Plus) Experience in a regulated category: comfortable writing within compliance (insurance, financial services, health) and working efficiently with Legal.

  • (Plus) lifecycle/CRM or UX writing experience; experience at an insurance or financial comparison marketplace; or experience across multiple insurance lines (home, renters, specialty vehicles) or in property or real estate.

Why This Role Matters

Copy touches every dollar we spend on acquisition, yet today it’s written on the side by channel owners. As Jerry expands from car insurance into motorcycle, home, renters, and RV & boat insurance and property tax appeals, every new product needs a sharp, differentiated story from day one. We need a dedicated owner of our messaging: someone who defines those value props, increases how fast we test, and keeps every claim compliant and consistent across products.

You’ll be the connective tissue between customer insight and conversion, building a scalable messaging system that blends craft, data, AI, and media strategy.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

Compensation Range: $100K - $145K

Всичко е благодарение на нашия екип, който е съставен от смели, отдадени и сърцати хора. Ние не искаме просто да следваме отъпкания път - искаме да се превърнем в модерна и дигитална система от продукти, която обслужва всички финансови нужди на клиентите и партньорите ни. Това не са корпоративни приказки, това са думите на нашите колеги.

Искаш ли да станеш част от нашата уникална история?

Каним те да се присъединиш към екипа на позицията:
Агент Събиране на просрочени вземания

  • Добра компютърна грамотност - МS Office и работа с интернет

  • Отговорност, организираност, внимание към детайлите, aналитичност

  • Стартово обучение в рамките от 3 - 5 дни присъствено в централното управление в гр. София

Requirements

tbi e твоето място, ако искаш:

  • да се възползваш от възможността да развиеш кариерата си

  • да се включиш във вълнуваща и иновативна работа

  • да получаваш признание за работата и отношението си

  • да придобиваш нови умения и интерактивни обучения

  • да станеш част от голям, приятелски настроен и подкрепящ се екип

  • да получаваш преференциални цени за нашите банкови продукти

Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

  • ASAP - on est prêt(e)s à t'accueillir dès maintenant

  • Un préavis est possible, mais plus il est court, mieux c'est

🏡 Type de contrat

  • Freelance

  • Temps partiel - 1 jour par semaine

  • Séniorité : confirmé(e)

🌍 Localisation

  • 100% Remote (Europe)

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio qui conçoit, lance et scale plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement. Notre croissance repose aujourd'hui en grande partie sur l'acquisition payante : le canal organique existe sur tous nos produits, mais il reste largement sous-exploité. C'est là que tu entres en jeu.

Nous cherchons un(e) Expert(e) SEO freelance confirmé(e) pour intervenir 1 jour par semaine sur nos 4 produits principaux. Ta mission : poser les bases d'un référencement naturel solide (y compris face aux nouveaux moteurs IA comme ChatGPT ou Claude), développer le trafic organique et soigner l'image de marque de nos produits sur le web.

C'est une mission stratégique avec une vraie liberté d'action : tu audites, tu recommandes, tu pilotes tes priorités et tu rapportes directement au CGO.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoins l'équipe Acquisition (3 personnes), tou(te)s expert(e)s et orienté(e)s performance. Ton manager direct sera Bastien BRICOUT, notre Chief Growth Officer, qui assurera une supervision régulière tout en te laissant l'autonomie nécessaire pour cadrer ta mission.

Tu travailles en full remote, avec une communication claire et un reporting structuré comme socle de collaboration. Ponctuellement, tu échanges avec l'équipe Tech pour faire déployer tes recommandations.

📂 Tes responsabilités

SEO on-site

  • Réaliser un audit SEO technique et sémantique de chaque produit, avec des recommandations priorisées

  • Piloter les optimisations sur nos sites et landing pages : balises, mots-clés, descriptions d'images, FAQ, structure des contenus…

  • Rendre nos produits lisibles et citables par les moteurs IA (ChatGPT, Claude…) autant que par Google

  • Faire vivre la stratégie de contenu, à commencer par notre blog (articles rédigés en français puis déclinés dans toutes nos langues grâce à l'IA)

SEO off-site & e-réputation

  • Développer le netlinking : backlinks, mentions de marque, articles sur des sites et médias d'autorité

  • Piloter l'e-réputation de nos produits : contrebalancer les avis négatifs (Reddit, blogs, forums) par des contenus positifs sur des sources de confiance, en cohérence avec nos objectifs Trustpilot

Pilotage & reporting

  • Suivre les performances via Ahrefs et Google Search Console

  • Produire un reporting régulier auprès du CGO

  • Prioriser intelligemment ton jour par semaine pour maximiser l'impact sur l'ensemble du portefeuille

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans minimum d'expérience en SEO

  • Parcours en agence ou en freelance, avec un portfolio diversifié

  • Expérience obligatoire en e-réputation et en netlinking

Compétences techniques

  • SEO on-site : audit technique, optimisation des pages et des contenus

  • SEO off-site : netlinking, obtention de backlinks et d'articles sur des sites d'autorité

  • E-réputation : gestion de l'image de marque dans les résultats de recherche

  • Maîtrise de Ahrefs et Google Search Console

  • Connaissance fine des algorithmes Google et des enjeux de visibilité sur les moteurs IA

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Autonomie et ownership

  • Organisation rigoureuse et capacité à prioriser

  • Proactivité et force de proposition

  • Reporting clair et structuré

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais professionnel courant - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

🚀 Les avantages du poste

  • Full remote depuis l'Europe

  • Mission flexible - 1 jour par semaine

  • Un canal organique à fort potentiel, où ton impact se verra vite

  • Un portefeuille multi-produits SaaS varié et stimulant

  • Collaboration directe avec le CGO : décisions rapides, vision claire

⚡ Les défis du poste

  • 1 jour par semaine : la priorisation est la clé pour couvrir 4 produits aux contextes et objectifs différents

  • Un SEO à structurer : hormis notre blog, la plupart des produits partent de zéro côté organique

  • Des résultats mesurables attendus - les métriques Ahrefs et Search Console parlent d'elles-mêmes

  • Une collaboration 100% à distance : communication et reporting clairs indispensables

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien de découverte avec Noémie, notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  2. Étude de cas avec Bastien, notre Chief Growth Officer

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante

Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence

Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ?

Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH"Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

jobs.description:
We are looking for an accomplished senior operational leader to join us as Head of Service – Payments, Pharmacy and Performers List.

Job title:

Head of Service (Payment, Pharmacy & Performers List)

Job Description:

We are looking for an accomplished senior operational leader to join us as Head of Service – Payments, Pharmacy and Performers List.


This is a high-profile leadership position with accountability for the safe, compliant and effective delivery of complex, high-volume services. You will lead service performance, customer outcomes, financial delivery, operational controls, transformation and the development of large, multidisciplinary teams.


What you’ll be doing


Reporting to the Head of Service Delivery for Health, you will:


  • Provide end-to-end leadership for our Payments, Pharmacy and Performers List services, ensuring contractual and business commitments are achieved.
  • Translate PCSE strategy, client priorities and contractual obligations into clear operating, workforce and delivery plans.
  • Own service performance across SLAs, KPIs, quality, customer outcomes, productivity, backlogs and operational risk.
  • Take accountability for service P&L, budgets, forecasts, cost control and agreed business-plan benefits.
  • Build trusted senior relationships with NHS England, primary care stakeholders and internal Capita partners.
  • Lead client governance and performance reviews, providing clear assurance, transparent reporting and credible recovery plans.
  • Establish strong quality, risk and control frameworks covering payment accuracy, case handling, data quality, access and records.
  • Sponsor service improvement, automation, innovation and technology-enabled change.
  • Lead operational readiness for future service models and contractual transitions, ensuring people, processes, technology, data and controls are prepared.
  • Provide visible, inclusive leadership, strengthening capability, accountability, engagement, retention and succession across the service.

About You


You will be an established senior leader who can combine strategic thinking and commercial judgement with strong operational control. You’ll be comfortable leading at pace, making evidence-based decisions and providing constructive challenge to senior stakeholders.


You’ll bring:

  • Substantial senior leadership experience within complex, high-volume transactional processing, case management or operational service delivery.
  • A strong record of delivering SLAs, KPIs, customer outcomes, quality standards and effective operational risk management.
  • Demonstrable ownership of a significant P&L, budget and forecast.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary teams through management structures.
  • Evidence of improving operational performance and customer experience through data, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement.
  • Experience sponsoring or leading complex transformation and service transition, including readiness, cutover, stabilisation and benefits realisation.
  • Strong client and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to influence and negotiate at senior and executive levels.
  • A sound understanding of governance, assurance, business continuity and regulatory or contractual compliance.
  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn performance and financial insight into clear decisions and actions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, supported by resilience, sound judgement and a collaborative leadership style.

Desirable Experience


It would be particularly beneficial if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:


  • NHS, primary care, healthcare administration or another complex public service environment.
  • Payments, pharmacy administration, regulated lists, registration services or similarly controlled operational processes.
  • Introducing digital, automation, data or workflow solutions into live services.
  • A recognised qualification in continuous improvement, operational excellence, project management, change or leadership.

About PCSE


Primary Care Support England (PCSE) is delivered by Capita on behalf of NHS England and NHS Improvement (NHSEI), to deliver digital, logistical and support services to every GP, Dentist, Optician and Pharmacist providing NHS services in England.

Our focus is on improving these services by standardising all processes nationally, to make each service more efficient. To date we have already transformed a number of services for Primary Care Support, including ordering medical supplies, tracking medical records, maintaining the Performers Lists for England and processing Ophthalmic GOS payments. These services are now all hosted on PCSE’s online platform, PCSE Online.ine.


What’s in it for you?

  • A competitive basic salary
  • 23 days’ holiday (rising to 27) with the opportunity to buy extra leave
  • The opportunity to take a paid day out of the office, volunteering for our charity partners or a cause of your choice
  • Auto-enrolment to our company pension, life assurance, a cycle2work scheme, 15 weeks’ fully paid maternity, adoption and shared parental leave, paternity pay of two weeks…and plenty more
  • Voluntary benefits designed to suit your lifestyle – from discounts on retail and socialising, to health & wellbeing, travel and technology
  • Access to our Employee Network Groups, which represent every strand of diversity and allow colleagues to connect and learn from each other on an open, inclusive platform

Unlock Your Potential with Capita

At Capita, your career can take you wherever your ambition leads. You'll become part of a diverse network of talented, forward-thinking professionals working across a wide range of disciplines and sectors. We’re committed to your growth — offering endless opportunities to expand your skills, explore new paths, and advance your career.

Join us and discover a career with purpose. #CareersWithPurpose

🤝 Customer first, always​🧑‍💻 Fearless innovation​✅ Achieve together​💙 Everyone is valued


What we hope you’ll do next:

Choose ‘Apply now’ to fill out our short application, so that we can find out more about you.


Equal Opportunities


At Capita, we’re committed to providing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and working environment for everyone. We want everyone to have the best chance of succeeding as they move through their application and start their career with us. We are an equal opportunity and Disability Confident employer; we want to hear from you if you’d like to discuss any adjustments you might need during your recruitment process. Please email or call 07784 237318 and we’ll get back to you to discuss.

For more information about equal opportunities and the types of adjustments we can offer, please visit the Capita Careers website.

If you have a question that does not relate to adjustments during your recruitment process, please email our Talent Acquisition team -


AI & Fair Recruitment at Capita
At Capita, we use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to help us manage applications consistently and fairly. These tools support our recruitment teams, they do not make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a trained member of our Talent Acquisition team, and all decisions are made by people. If you need any adjustments during the process, we’re here to support you.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process
To help us deliver a fair, consistent and efficient recruitment experience, Capita uses AI-assisted technology at some stages of the process. These tools simply help us organise and assess information, they do not replace human judgement. All decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers. If you have any questions or need adjustments, please let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.

jobs.description:
Wir sind ekipa.

Als Corporate Venturing Partner helfen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen die besten Innovationen mit den besten Partnern und einer erprobten & etablierten Methodik zu realisieren. Dafür befähigen und begleiten wir entlang des ganzen Innovationsprozesses.

Mit diesem Ansatz adressieren wir die großen Herausforderungen unserer Gegenwart und Zukunft. Vor diesem Hintergrund arbeiten wir auch mit politischen Institutionen zusammen.

Mit unseren inspirierenden Innovationsprojekten in den Bereichen Nachhaltigkeit, Digitalisierung, Health Tech und weiteren Themenfeldern haben wir bereits zahlreiche Kunden befähigt, neue Lösungen, Geschäftsmodelle und Innovationen zu entwickeln. Und für die Zukunft planen wir noch Größeres.

Damit wir uns auf diesen Wachstumskurs konzentrieren können, brauchen wir ein verlässliches Fundament. Dafür suchen wir eine strukturierte, verantwortungsbewusste Person, die unsere Finanz- und Verwaltungsprozesse mit Sorgfalt und Überblick am Laufen hält.

Aufgaben

Da wir ein Startup sind, kannst du bei uns ab Tag 1 Verantwortung übernehmen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

  • Du unterstützt bei der Lohn- und Personalabrechnung: von Lohnmeldungen über DATEV bis zur Prüfung von Probe- und Endabrechnungen

  • Du koordinierst das SV-Meldewesen, bearbeitest Rückfragen von Krankenkassen und Arbeitsagentur und bist Schnittstelle zu unserem Steuerbüro

  • Du verantwortest die Benefits-Verwaltung inklusive Bestellung und Rechnungskontrolle

  • Du übernimmst die Rechnungsstellung über verschiedene Systeme und Kundenportale und behältst dabei stets den Überblick über offene und fällige Posten

  • Du kümmerst dich um unser Forderungsmanagement, gleichst Zahlungen ab und stimmst dich bei Rückfragen mit unseren Account Executives und Kund:innen ab

  • Du unterstützt bei Buchhaltung und Belegwesen, sammelst fehlende Belege im Team ein und bereitest den Jahresabschluss mit vor

  • Du behältst Fristen für Fördermittel und Spesenrichtlinien im Blick und sorgst für eine saubere Dokumentation

Qualifikation

Um diese Aufgaben erfolgreich zu meistern, sind folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften sehr hilfreich:

  • Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig, auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben mit festen Fristen

  • Du hast ein gutes Zahlenverständnis und idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Buchhaltungs- oder Abrechnungssoftware (z. B. DATEV, LexOffice) – notwendig ist das aber nicht, wichtiger ist deine Lernbereitschaft

  • Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen und Fristen den Überblick und sprichst proaktiv an, wenn Informationen fehlen

  • Du gehst vertraulich und sorgfältig mit sensiblen Daten um

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich, auch wenn du intern nachfassen oder extern mit Kund:innen und Dienstleister:innen abstimmen musst

  • Du bist lernbereit und offen für ein sich wandelndes, dynamisches Umfeld

  • Du verfügst über fließende Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Damit du dich stets entwickeln und wachsen kannst, schaffen wir passende Rahmenbedingungen und eine Teamkultur, die dein Wachstum kontinuierlich fördert:

  • Du kannst flexibel arbeiten, wann und wo du willst – Hauptsache, das Ergebnis stimmt

  • Du arbeitest im Hintergrund eines Teams, das an Trendthemen in den Bereichen Digitalisierung und Nachhaltigkeit arbeitet, und trägst mit deiner Arbeit zur Stabilität dieses Wachstums bei

  • Als ein junges 25-köpfiges Team fördern wir die Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe mit Kollegialität anstatt Konkurrenz

  • Wir unterstützen dich mit kontinuierlichen Coaching- und Weiterbildungsprogrammen

  • Wir haben einen Office-Space mitten in der Frankfurter Innenstadt

  • Da wir als Startup die 4-Tage-Woche eingeführt haben, hast auch du immer Freitags frei

Gemeinsam können wir elementarer Bestandteil einer innovativen und nachhaltigen Zukunft werden. Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir damit Menschen, Gesellschaften und unsere Welt positiv verändern können.

Wenn auch du diese Verantwortung mitgestalten möchtest, dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und steige unkompliziert in unseren Bewerbungsprozess ein!

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

jobs.title: Technical Product Support
jobs.description:
Team: Customer Success & Solutions.

Location: Remote (based in Rio or Sao Paulo)

Type: Full-time role

Role overview

Every query you answer helps an organisation keep talking to the people who rely on it: a mother getting a vaccine reminder, a refugee finding services, a health worker getting a test result. Many of the people who write to us work in small teams, under pressure, and aren't technical. They need someone kind, clear and quick.

At Turn.io, AI does the first pass on much of support. Plain drafts replies, finds similar past threads and flags gaps in our knowledge base. Through MCP servers, our AI tools can look into a customer's Turn setup, our Linear issues and HubSpot. That doesn't make the human less important. It means you spend less time searching, and more time understanding the problem, solving it properly and making sure the customer feels looked after.

The role blends frontline support with the first layer of support engineering. You'll solve more technical SaaS issues yourself than support teams used to, and escalate only with a clear diagnosis. You'll be based in Brazil and look after customers worldwide, with a focus on Latin America.

What you'll do

Look after our customers

  • Be the friendly first response in Plain, Slack and email, within our SLAs, in plain language.
  • Own each query until it's resolved, and keep the customer updated even while it's with engineering.
  • Notice when a customer is stressed or stuck, and go the extra step: a call, a walkthrough, a check-in after a fix.

Solve problems with AI and MCP tools

  • Use Claude with the Plain, Linear and Turn MCP servers to investigate: read thread history, check account setup, find related bugs and draft replies.
  • Review every AI-drafted reply before it goes out. Check the facts, the tone, and that it actually answers the question. You're accountable for what we send.
  • Handle technical questions that used to go to Support Engineering: journeys and automations that misbehave, webhook and API errors, rejected WhatsApp templates, and Meta account or number issues.
  • Escalate to Product engineering with a clear write-up: what happened, how to reproduce it, what you've ruled out, and the impact on the customer.

Make support better every week

  • Turn repeated questions into knowledge base articles written so both customers and Plain's AI can use them.
  • Work through Plain's knowledge gap reports.
  • Tag themes and flag at-risk accounts for the Customer Success Lead's weekly health review.
  • Test new features before launch and give QA feedback.

What we're looking for

  • Kind, patient and warm. You enjoy helping people, and it shows in your writing.
  • Driven by impact. It matters to you that our customers serve vulnerable people.
  • Some customer support or customer-facing experience, ideally with a SaaS or technical product. This can also be your first job if you have a technical background, such as a degree, course or your own projects, and you love working with people.
  • Daily use of AI tools, with the judgment to check what they produce.
  • Technical curiosity: happy to read an API error, look at a webhook payload or follow a log. Some experience with APIs, JSON or basic SQL is a plus.
  • Professional working English and Portuguese, written and spoken. Spanish or French is a plus.
  • Calm and organised under pressure.

KPIs and success metrics

Primary KPIs

  • First response and resolution times within SLA.
  • Customer satisfaction score.
  • Share of queries resolved without escalation.

Monitoring KPIs

  • Quality of escalations: engineering rarely needs to ask follow-up questions.
  • Knowledge base articles added or updated.
  • Reopened tickets.

Sounds like you? Apply with your resume and cover letter.
