jobs.title: Customs & Trade Compliance Subject Matter Expert (Mexico)
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking experienced customs and trade compliance professionals to support a project focused on Mexican import/export regulations, tariff classification, and customs compliance.

This project involves reviewing realistic customs scenarios, documenting how experienced professionals approach complex regulatory decisions, developing expert reference solutions, and validating technical analyses. The resulting expert materials will support the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems for professional workflows.

This is flexible, project-based consulting work intended for professionals who are actively practicing or have recent hands-on experience in Mexican customs and trade compliance.

Project Details:-

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor / Project-Based (Flexible, Part-Time)

Location: Remote (Mexico)

Compensation: $12/hr

Scope of work: 10 hrs-12 hrs Weekly

What You’ll Do

  • Review realistic import and export scenarios involving Mexican customs regulations.

    • Develop expert reference solutions for customs classification and trade compliance tasks.

    • Document the reasoning behind customs decisions and regulatory interpretations.

    • Review and validate alternative solutions for technical accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.

    • Identify missing information, incorrect assumptions, or inappropriate decision sequences.

    • Reference applicable regulations where appropriate (e.g., Ley Aduanera, LIGIE, TIGIE, NOMs, RRNA, T-MEC).

    • Collaborate with our project team to ensure expert knowledge is accurately represented.

    Required Qualifications

    • 3+ years of recent, hands-on experience in customs brokerage, tariff classification, trade compliance, import/export operations, or a related field.

    • Current or recent (within the past two years) practical experience with Mexican customs regulations and procedures.

    • One or more of the following professional backgrounds:

    • Licensed Agente Aduanal

    • Clasificador Arancelario

    • Trade Compliance Specialist

    • Customs Compliance Specialist

    • Import/Export Compliance Professional

    • Customs or Trade Consultant

    • Professional fluency in Spanish.

    • Ability to clearly explain and document the reasoning behind regulatory and classification decisions.

    Preferred Experience

    Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

    • Tariff classification (Clasificación Arancelaria)

    • LIGIE / TIGIE

    • T-MEC / USMCA

    • NOMs and RRNA

    • Customs valuation

    • Rules of origin

    • Pedimentos

    • VUCEM

    • Customs audits or trade compliance reviews

    Experience using official Mexican customs resources (e.g., ANAM, SAT, SNICE, VUCEM) is preferred. Experience with commercial customs software is welcome but not required.

    Working proficiency in English sufficient to understand project instructions and communicate with the project team.

    Knowledge of U.S. customs regulations, HTS classification, or cross-border Mexico-U.S. trade operations is a plus.

    Why This Project Matters?

    Your expertise will help document how experienced customs professionals solve complex regulatory problems in practice. By capturing expert workflows and decision-making, you will contribute to the development of high-quality reference materials that support advanced AI systems for professional customs and trade compliance.

    Compensation

    Additional Information

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning (Consumer Revenue)
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking to hire a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on our Consumer Revenue ML team. This team applies Machine Learning across Discord's core revenue surfaces — Shop, Nitro, Server Subscriptions, and Gifting — building the ranking, targeting, and recommendation systems that connect users to the right products, subscriptions, and content. If this excites you and you’ve led org-wide initiatives in the past, keep reading!

What You'll Be Doing

  • 8+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning, inclusive Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Strong expertise in applied deep learning and mainstream RecSys model architecture (e.g. two-tower, transformer-based models, multi-task learning).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
  • A track record of building ML systems from 0→1 in ambiguous, early-stage environments, and taking them to production at scale.
  • Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to translate experiment results into roadmap decisions.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills — able to lead cross-functional technical initiatives across multiple verticals and keep stakeholders educated and aligned.
  • The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by open-ended, technically challenging problems.

What you should have

  • Built internal ML platform/tooling (shared data standards, targeting endpoints, recommender libraries) adopted by multiple product teams.
  • Familiarity with personalized marketing systems — lifecycle targeting, audience segmentation and lookalikes, campaign optimization.
  • Deep expertise in distributed training (e.g. PyTorch on GPU, Ray, Anyscale) and large-scale data processing pipelines (e.g. Chronon, Spark, Flink).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management (Instore Selling)
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As Director, Product Management, you will define strategy and drive execution across Lightspeed’s Instore Selling product portfolio, shaping key differentiators across services, AI-driven insights, and the broader customer experience. You will translate customer and market insights into a compelling, multi-year vision, align senior stakeholders and cross functional teams around strategic priorities, and build capabilities and operating models needed to deliver measurable merchant and business impacts.

Beyond leading individual product teams, you will connect strategy across multiple product areas, identify portfolio-wide opportunities and challenges, and make strategic trade-offs that maximize customer and business value.

You will bring demonstrated experience setting strategy at a scale materially larger than a single product or team, having shaped direction across a broad portfolio, platform, business unit, or company-level domain.

As a passionate advocate for our retailers, you will elevate product thinking across the organization, develop exceptional product leaders and teams, and foster a culture of strategic clarity, collaboration, and accountability to deliver meaningful outcomes at pace.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Set product strategy and vision

    • Define and communicate a multi-year product strategy across a substantial portfolio or business area, aligned with broader company priorities.

    • Guide investment and prioritization decisions using customer insights, data, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and business outcomes.

    • Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify opportunities for growth, revenue, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

  • Lead portfolio execution and outcomes

    • Own strategy, execution, and measurable outcomes across multiple product areas, platforms, or a substantial portfolio.

    • Translate strategy into clear objectives, investment priorities, and operating practices that empower teams to discover, test, and deliver impactful solutions.

    • Address systemic challenges across teams and hold the organization accountable for customer and business outcomes.

  • Build and lead a high-performing product organization

    • Hire, develop, and retain exceptional product leaders and managers, strengthening strategic thinking, product judgment, and outcome ownership.

    • Elevate product management practices, organizational capabilities, and operating models across the business.

    • Foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that empowers teams to make effective decisions and take shared accountability.

  • Influence and communicate

    • Build executive and cross-functional alignment around product strategy, priorities, and trade-offs.

    • Communicate complex customer, market, and business challenges clearly to drive decisions and action.

    • Strengthen customer and retailer empathy across the organization while balancing speed, quality, and long-term value.

What you need to bring:

  • Significant product management experience within software or technology companies, with a proven track record of delivering measurable business and customer impact across multiple product areas.

  • Demonstrated experience setting and executing strategy at a portfolio, platform, business unit, or organizational level, beyond the scope of a single product or team.

  • Strong strategic and portfolio management capabilities, with the ability to prioritize investments, navigate trade-offs, and make high-impact decisions across multiple planning horizons.

  • Experience leading through product leaders and managers, including hiring, developing, coaching, and building high-performing teams and leadership capabilities.

  • Deep understanding of modern product management practices, including product discovery, delivery, experimentation, and outcome-based planning.

  • Ability to translate customer insights, market trends, competitive intelligence, and business objectives into clear product strategies and measurable outcomes.

  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from individual contributors to executive leadership, across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and other functions.

  • Exceptional strategic thinking and judgment, with the ability to connect customer needs, market opportunities, product investments, and organizational priorities.

  • Strong customer advocacy and empathy for the needs and challenges of retailers and other local businesses.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to articulate strategy, build alignment, and adapt messaging to diverse audiences.

  • A collaborative, low-ego leadership style that builds trust, navigates ambiguity, and drives alignment without relying solely on formal authority.

  • Resilience, curiosity, and a bias toward action, continuous learning, and measurable impact.

  • A university degree or equivalent practical experience.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skill set, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the total compensation for this position to be in the range of $220,000 to $250,000 CAD. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, RRSP plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this compensation information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within Ontario and reflects the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting. This role represents an existing vacancy at Lightspeed. Lightspeed uses artificial intelligence–enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by our recruiting and hiring teams.

#LI-DS1

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
Member of Technical Staff

Location - San Francisco Bay Area (required)

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Start in minutes with a fully managed, scalable Postgres database and a suite of tools that eliminate the complexity of backend development. Use one or use all—Supabase gives teams the flexibility of open source with the speed and simplicity of a modern platform, so they can move fast without sacrificing control.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Member of Technical Staff to work with leading AI labs in San Francisco. We’re looking for someone with a background as a Strategic Solutions Architect or Engineer. You’re a technical subject-matter expert who can build relationships with Product and Engineering stakeholders and navigate a large AI lab.

You’ll lead relationships with top AI labs and serve as Supabase’s quarterback, driving the following engagement model:

  1. Account Mapping and Relationship Building - Identify the key relationships Supabase needs to build across Product, Engineering, and Developer Relations teams at AI labs.

  2. Lunch and Learns/Tech Talks/Technical Enablement - Lead onsite tech talks, lunch and learns, and technical enablement sessions to educate AI labs about Supabase and its roadmap.

  3. Co-build (product integration): Build integrations and joint solutions in collaboration with Supabase’s Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) organization.

  4. Developer Relations (DevRel): Work with AI labs to create content—including blogs, docs, videos, and live streams—and run in-person community events and hackathons.

  5. Quarterly Technical Reviews: Lead quarterly reviews with each lab to discuss highlights, adoption metrics, what’s working and what isn’t, key product initiatives, and alignment with technical resources.

As the Quarterback for the AI labs end-to-end — you’ll work from technical scoping and launch through post-launch growth — working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Data to ensure Supabase drives real business outcomes with top AI labs

This is a high-visibility senior IC role with direct impact on product adoption and ecosystem expansion.

  • This is a build and scale member of technical staff role.

  • You’ll be expected to operate with a lot of ownership and little process at the start.

  • If you enjoy writing the playbook and running it in-market, this role will be a good fit.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in technical roles as a Strategic Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer or Product Management

  • Strong understanding of developer ecosystems and modern data / infra stacks

  • Demonstrated experience shipping integrations and growing them post-launch

  • Experience using AI and vibe coding tools in conjunction with Supabase

  • Clear, concise communicator who can align Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams

  • Highly organized operator who can build programs from scratch and iterate quickly

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity in a fast-moving, open-source-first environment

  • Data-driven and outcome-oriented

  • Startup experience is a plus

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media

QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands. We run these virtual- and private-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.

Our industry leading segmentation and AI-driven matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster. They allow brands to target and reach in-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment-by-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.

Our campaign-results-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.

We believe in:

  • The direct measurability of digital media.
  • Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
  • The advantages of technology.

We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.

Job Category

We are seeking an autonomous, driven, and data-fluent Account Manager to join our performance marketing team, specializing in the health and Medicare insurance category. In this role, you will own client relationships with health/Medicare carriers, brokers, agencies, and aggregators. You will act as a proactive strategic partner—optimizing revenue, managing media performance, and driving client portfolio growth.

Because this is a fully remote position, we are looking for a natural self-starter who thrives in an autonomous environment, takes complete ownership of their accounts, and proactively uncovers new revenue opportunities.

Responsibilities

  • Client Portfolio Management & Strategy: Own end-to-end relationships with a portfolio of health and Medicare insurance clients, serving as their primary strategic advisor.
  • Proactive Revenue Growth: Proactively identify opportunities to scale client accounts, optimize performance, and expand the client profile to drive category revenue.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor and analyze key performance indicators—including revenue, Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and media buying metrics—to hit or exceed client targets and KPIs.
  • Performance Marketing Execution: Manage lead generation, calls, and clicks performance campaigns specifically tailored to the insurance sector.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Leverage advanced tools to evaluate campaign performance, build insightful reports, and communicate actionable insights clearly to internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal media buying, affiliate, and data/analyst teams to align campaign strategies, streamline execution, and maximize client portfolio performance.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Industry Experience: Direct performance marketing experience within the health and Medicare insurance category (or closely related insurance/financial verticals).
  • Technical & Analytical Proficiency:
    • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data manipulation).
    • Strong proficiency in Tableau for data visualization and client reporting.
  • Performance Marketing Expertise: Deep understanding of revenue models, ROAS, media buying strategies, and lead/call/click generation.
  • Exceptional Communication & Interpersonal Skills: High charisma, top-tier relationship-building capabilities, and proactive communication.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Proven track record as a self-starter who excels in a remote, independent environment without requiring heavy managerial oversight.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Understanding: Strong working knowledge of CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) marketing guidelines and compliance frameworks essential for Medicare and health insurance performance marketing.
  • Organization: Impeccable organizational skills to manage multiple high-stakes client accounts simultaneously.

Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Skills)

  • Familiarity with AI-driven tools and workflows that enhance client management, data processing, or campaign optimization.
  • Prior experience in direct portfolio management with established industry clients.

The expected salary range for this position is $70,000 USD to $100,000 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the Company’s compensation practices. The salary may be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location. The position is also eligible to receive performance bonus or commission and equity in the form of restricted stock units. This position is eligible to participate in the Company’s standard employee benefits programs, which currently include health care benefits; (2) retirement benefits; (3) the amount of paid days off (paid sick leave, parental leave, paid time off, or vacation benefits); (4) any other tax-reportable benefits.

QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Account Manager (South Canterbury)
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

We’re looking for a driven, high-performing Account Manager to join the momentum and help shape the future of farming in the Canterbury region. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change, working with some of the highest-performing dairy farms in New Zealand. Serving as the primary point-of-contact for Halter customers, you will be passionate about driving farmer success for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies that will transform how they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be backed by a team of exceptional people on the ground in the South Island and at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have.

Location - This role is to be based anywhere in the South Canterbury region. Frequent travel is required as part of the position.

What your day could look like

  • Revenue Retention & Expansion: You will own the retention, renewals and expansion targets of Halter’s existing revenue in the region.

  • Ensure farmers are extracting full value from Halter to achieve their goals and ultimately understand the impact it’s having on their farming business.

  • Account Management: Responsible for renewing customer agreements and expanding the revenue of existing Halter customers, by adding value in every interaction to drive on-farm goals and performance.

  • Deployment: Supporting the onboarding, training and implementation of the Halter system on customers' farms, ensuring all relevant farm owners, managers, and workers are able to successfully use the system.

  • Relationship Building: Proactively cultivate genuine and trustworthy relationships with farmers, their teams, and families, fostering strong connections and understanding.

  • Farmer Success: Strategically partnering with customers to establish clear business goals, timelines, priorities and metrics of success.

  • Problem-Solving: Provide prompt and effective communication and support to farmers and team members, addressing technical or operational challenges with expertise and efficiency.

  • Community & Networking: Represent the Halter brand with pride, lead local discussion groups, and proactively build strong networks within the community for increased brand visibility and connections.

  • Customer Advocate: Acting as the voice of the customer and bridging the gap with our product teams to provide important context about what is happening on the ground with our farmers and their animals.

  • Technical Expertise: Working closely with our product teams to provide technical and practical advice from a farmer’s perspective on everything reproduction, pasture and agronomy.

  • Contribute to a positive team environment, supporting others to succeed and role modelling Halter’s Operating Principles.

We’re backing potential over polish. These are the traits that matter most:

  • A great human first

  • You bring integrity, humility, and care. You do what you say you’ll do. You show up for your farmers and your teammates.

  • Lifelong learner mindset

  • You’re genuinely curious. You ask questions, seek feedback, and are excited to keep leveling up alongside a world‑class team.

  • Hunger and grit

  • You love chasing ambitious goals, solving hard problems, and sticking with it when things get tough.

  • Positive energy and team spirit

  • You lift the people around you, not drain them. You enjoy collaborating, sharing ideas, and celebrating others’ wins as much as your own.

  • Comfort in a fast‑moving environment

  • You’re at your best when things are dynamic. You can work autonomously, manage your time well, and stay focused on what matters most.


Experience that helps you hit the ground running

  • A background in relationship management, account management, sales, or working closely with customers.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: Value-based sales experience, with a strong history of creating opportunities, closing deals, and building lasting customer relationships. You understand post-sales value building and have experience upselling to grow partnerships.

Yadimen is looking for an OT Compliance Engineer to support an OT inventory and compliance programme across pharmaceutical manufacturing sites. jobs.title: Commercial Counsel - US
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our US commercial team. In this role, you will support complex commercial transactions across North America, including SaaS, licensing, and strategic partnerships, while helping the company navigate diverse legal and regulatory frameworks in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. You will work closely with global colleagues to provide practical, business-oriented advice that enables growth while managing risk across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, with a primary focus on GTM/Sales transactions in North America, including enterprise customer contracts

  • Partner with sales, business development, and operations teams to design and implement strategies that support high-growth go-to-market initiatives.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving legal and regulatory developments, including data protection, technology, and AI-related frameworks, and apply this knowledge to contract drafting and risk assessment.

  • Develop, maintain, and localize contract templates, playbooks, and policies to reflect regional requirements and industry best practices.

  • Provide clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused legal advice to cross-functional teams, tailoring advice to enable responsible growth and innovation.

  • Contribute to scaling the Legal Team’s commercial function, fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, have a strong sense of ownership with enthusiasm for applying your legal expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • Experienced in navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments, with the ability to manage ambiguity and make informed, timely decisions.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global colleagues.

  • Proactive, business-minded, and committed to delivering practical solutions that support both compliance and commercial success.

What you bring

  • J.D. and active membership in at least one U.S. State Bar (NY or CA preferred)

  • 6+ years of relevant post-qualification legal experience (in-house experience in technology or SaaS strongly preferred).

  • Proven track record drafting and negotiating complex commercial and technology agreements.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise software licensing, SaaS, data protection, and intellectual property.

  • Experience advising on privacy, cybersecurity, and cross-border data transfer issues.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and tight deadlines

  • Prior experience with heavily regulated industries is a plus

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States, with a preference for New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About Bio-Works

At Bio-Works, we strive to create new possibilities for better therapies. We believe that the best solutions emerge when you have meaningful alternatives, enabling you to challenge established approaches and make informed choices.

We are a Swedish chromatography specialist with an international customer base, combining deep scientific expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset. We develop and manufacture differentiated chromatography resins for purification applications, from early development to commercial production. We take pride in our ability to listen, adapt and respond to your needs.

Role purpose

The Marketing Director will develop and execute Bio-Works' marketing strategy, with a primary focus on building market awareness, generating demand and driving commercial growth. The role will be instrumental in shaping the company's identity, market positioning and communications.

Combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution, the Marketing Director will establish a modern, scalable and data-driven marketing function, building internal capabilities, systems and processes while leveraging digital technologies and AI to enhance marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency.

The role also provides leadership and strategic direction to Product Management, ensuring alignment between product strategy, market needs and commercial priorities. The Marketing Director will initially have one direct report, a Product Manager, report directly to the CEO and be a member of the Leadership Team.

Key responsibilities

Marketing strategy and commercial impact

  • Develop and execute a marketing strategy aligned with business objectives, product portfolio strategy and commercial priorities.

  • Translate market intelligence, customer insights and competitive intelligence into actionable priorities and growth opportunities.

  • Develop differentiated market positioning, value propositions and customer-centric messaging.

  • Establish marketing KPIs, manage the marketing budget and prioritize resources to maximize measurable commercial impact.

Awareness, demand generation and communications

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns to increase market awareness, generate qualified leads and support pipeline development.

  • Drive digital marketing, including marketing automation, social media, email marketing, SEO and paid media.

  • Shape and strengthen Bio-Works' brand identity and ensure consistent, scientifically credible communications across all channels.

  • Develop marketing content and sales enablement materials, including hands-on copywriting and content production.

  • Establish effective lead generation, qualification and nurturing processes in close collaboration with Sales.

Digital infrastructure and AI

  • Own and develop Bio-Works' website, CRM and marketing systems, ensuring alignment with business needs and appropriate governance and quality standards.

  • Establish data management, analytics and reporting processes to drive performance optimization.

  • Develop and implement AI-enabled solutions, including agentic AI workflows, to enhance marketing effectiveness, productivity and scalability.

Leadership and capability building

  • Build and develop Bio-Works' internal marketing capabilities, establishing scalable processes and ways of working, supported by a network of specialized external service providers.

  • Lead, coach and develop direct reports, providing strategic direction and fostering cross-functional collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.

Experience and qualifications

  • Extensive Life Sciences marketing experience, preferably within bioprocessing, downstream purification or chromatography.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute data-driven marketing strategies, demand generation initiatives and integrated campaigns with measurable commercial results.

  • Hands-on experience in building marketing capabilities and implementing digital systems, including CRM, marketing automation, website management and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Strong understanding of Product Management, including portfolio strategy, lifecycle management and go-to-market strategies.

  • Excellent copywriting and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex science into compelling customer-centric messaging.

  • Strong leadership, analytical and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Education

  • University degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • Additional qualifications in Marketing, Business Administration or Management are advantageous.

Personal attributes

For this role, mindset, motivation and approach to work are as important as professional experience. The successful candidate is:

  • Results-oriented: Intrinsically motivated to make a difference and deliver tangible business outcomes.

  • Strategic and hands-on: Equally comfortable setting direction and executing operational activities.

  • Entrepreneurial: Resourceful, pragmatic and energized by building capabilities from the ground.

  • Data-driven: Uses facts, insights and measurable outcomes to guide decisions and continuously improve performance.

  • Curious and forward-thinking: Actively explores new technologies and translates innovation into practical business value.

  • Collaborative and independent: A strong team player who takes ownership, demonstrates initiative and drives activities independently.

  • A mature leader: Demonstrates sound judgment, integrity, humility and the ability to navigate change and ambiguity.

Good to know

  • Location: Europe (remote), with travels to our headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, approximately once a month.

  • Employment: Permanent, full-time employment through our employer of record (EOR) partner, in line with local employment law in your country of residence. You must have the right to work in your country of residence

  • Start date:1 April 2027, or by agreement.

Application

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the closing date. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible, but no later than 15 December.

We do not accept applications by email.

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

Juniper Square’s Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone of our go-to-market motion. As our Senior Revenue Operations Manager, Fund Administration, you’ll serve as the dedicated Revenue Operations partner for our Fund Administration business. You'll own the systems, processes, and reporting that keep Fund Administration, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance aligned and moving fast, from CRM health and renewal/forecasting workflows to pipeline reviews and cross-functional reporting cadences. You’ll report to the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, and partner closely with Fund Administration, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance leadership.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as the primary Revenue Operations partner for the Fund Administration business, ensuring alignment on priorities, strategies, and execution plans, and acting as the operational glue between Fund Administration and other departments.

  • Own the health and integrity of our Salesforce (CRM) instance — data quality, workflow configuration, and process governance across Fund Administration and the broader RevOps funnel.

  • Own and optimize the end-to-end renewal workflow process, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and scalability, and maintaining clear documentation of timelines, responsibilities, and required actions.

  • Manage the forecasting process for Fund Administration and broader RevOps, including pipeline reviews, forecast roll-ups, and reporting cadences, integrating key metrics such as renewals, upsells, and churn.

  • Design, document, and continuously improve revenue processes (e.g., lead routing, opportunity management, territory and quota administration, and a standardized expansion deal process) to remove friction.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that give a clear, accurate view of pipeline, conversion, renewals, and revenue performance.

  • Establish and enforce clear rules of engagement for Fund Administration's interactions with other departments, serving as a point of escalation for cross-functional disputes and ensuring smooth handoffs and alignment.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Fund Administration, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to align on shared metrics, definitions, and operating rhythms (QBRs, pipeline reviews, forecast calls).

  • Use AI tools (e.g., Claude) to orchestrate multi-step workflows that reduce manual work across recurring RevOps tasks.

  • Identify and prioritize opportunities for process automation and tooling improvements across the revenue tech stack, and support change management and enablement for new tools and processes.

  • Support pricing and packaging, sales compensation, territory design, and quota-setting processes in partnership with Fund Administration and Sales leadership and Finance.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related GTM/Business Operations role.

  • Experience in fintech, SaaS, or a complex B2B enterprise sales motion.

  • Experience supporting Fund Administration, private markets, or another complex, services-driven revenue motion.

  • Hands-on Salesforce administration experience: you understand how data structure and process design impact downstream reporting and forecasting accuracy.

  • Experience owning end-to-end renewal and/or expansion workflows, including documentation, performance reporting, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment.

  • Experience managing forecasting, pipeline reporting, and recurring GTM operating cadences (QBRs, pipeline reviews, forecast calls).

  • Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in data and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce reporting, Tableau, Looker, or advanced Google Sheets/Excel).

  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear processes, systems, and recommendations.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfort partnering with and influencing across teams, including establishing and enforcing rules of engagement.

  • AI fluency: you use AI tools like Claude to orchestrate multi-step workflows across two or more tools (e.g., CRM, spreadsheets, reporting/BI tools) producing reusable, structured outputs. You can describe at least one recurring revenue process you’ve redesigned around AI-assisted execution and speak to its team-level impact (e.g., reduced reporting turnaround, improved forecast accuracy, faster pipeline prep).

Nice to have:

  • Experience with GTM tooling such as Gong, Outreach, Apollo, or Clay.

  • Experience building lightweight automations or integrations (e.g., Zapier, no-code tools, or basic scripting).

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field.

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications.

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $116,000 - $145,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Partner
jobs.description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with

is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call.

How the Draw Works

We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 — as long as you’re generating results.

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

  • The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.

This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.

A typical approach might look like this:

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with . Who handles your social media?"

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you.

Who Thrives as a Territory Partner

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

  • People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

  • Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours

  • Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required)

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

What You’ll Need

  • UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

  • Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

  • Smartphone with internet access

  • Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

  • The drive to build your own business

No degree required. No prior sales experience required. If you can hold a conversation and you’re willing to put in the work, we’ll provide the resources to help you succeed.

The Career Path

Omada Sales Territory Partners aren’t capped. Top performers progress through a clear leadership pathway with increasing commission rates, territory ownership, and team-building opportunities:

  • Territory Partner — You’re in the field, closing deals, building your reputation.

  • City Captain — Exclusive city territory, higher commissions, and the opportunity to mentor new partners.

  • State Director — Leading a regional team with override commissions on your team’s closes.

  • Regional Director — Multi-region leadership with premium compensation.

  • Country Manager — Running Omada’s field operation for an entire market.

About

We’re an AI-powered marketing platform built specifically for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so business owners can stop worrying about marketing and focus on what they do best.

We’re backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing across the UK, and building a network of Territory Partners who want to win.

Ready to start? Apply now

Self-employed contractor opportunity. Equal opportunity partner programme.

jobs.title: Manager, Renewals
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in EST.

At Tines, our Customer Experience organization is recognized by customers for the quality of our work, responsiveness to their needs, and commitment to helping them realize meaningful value from our platform.

Within Customer Experience, the Renewals team plays a critical role in protecting and growing our customer relationships by creating a predictable, consistent, and customer-centered renewal experience. Renewal Managers partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, Legal, and Deal Desk to manage the commercial renewal process, navigate complex negotiations, identify risk early, and ensure customers can continue their partnership with Tines with clarity and confidence.

As Manager, Renewals, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of Renewal Managers responsible for executing renewals across our customer base. You will be accountable for renewal performance, forecasting accuracy, commercial execution, team development, and the processes that allow the function to scale.

You will also play a key role in strengthening the broader customer lifecycle at Tines, helping establish clear ownership and operating rhythms between Customer Success, Renewals, and Sales while ensuring that customer value, risk, and commercial strategy come together effectively at renewal.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead and develop a team of Renewal Managers, providing coaching, commercial guidance, and clear direction to drive strong customer and business outcomes.
  • Own renewal performance across the portfolio, with accountability for Gross Revenue Retention, renewal rate, churn and contraction outcomes, and on-time renewal execution.
  • Establish and maintain a consistent renewal forecast, providing leadership with clear visibility into renewal timing, risk, expected outcomes, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Guide Renewal Managers through complex customer negotiations involving pricing, contract terms, multi-year agreements, competitive pressure, procurement, and other commercial challenges.
  • Ensure renewal engagement begins early and that Renewal Managers have the customer context, risk signals, value realization, and relationship insights required to execute effectively.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure clear ownership between customer outcomes and commercial renewal execution, with CSMs focused on value, adoption, relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewals leads the commercial renewal process.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to identify and coordinate expansion opportunities associated with renewal cycles while maintaining clear ownership across teams.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to improve renewal forecasting, CRM workflows, dashboards, automation, reporting, and operational discipline.
  • Develop scalable renewal motions across customer segments, including high-touch, mid-touch, and digital or automated approaches where appropriate.
  • Establish clear renewal playbooks, timelines, escalation paths, handoffs, and operating cadences that create consistency for customers and internal teams.
  • Establish and manage metrics and KPIs that measure renewal effectiveness, including GRR, logo retention, forecast accuracy, renewal timing, cycle time, multi-year adoption, team productivity, and portfolio health.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain strong commercial talent as the Renewals function and company continue to scale.

What will you bring with you?

  • 7+ years of experience in SaaS, enterprise software, Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, Sales, or a similar commercial customer-facing environment.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated track record of coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing or commercial teams.
  • Experience owning or managing a meaningful recurring revenue portfolio and delivering against retention or renewal targets.
  • A strong understanding of SaaS business metrics including ARR, Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, churn, contraction, renewal rate, and expansion.
  • Experience building and managing renewal forecasts with a high degree of operational rigor and predictability.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience navigating pricing, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and customer objections.
  • The ability to coach teams through complex commercial situations while balancing customer relationships, revenue protection, and long-term business value.
  • Experience working closely with Customer Success and Sales teams to coordinate customer strategy and commercial outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify trends, diagnose performance, and determine where intervention is required.
  • A track record of improving workflows, standardization, automation, or systems to increase organizational efficiency and capacity.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and demonstrated ability to influence Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and executive stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to navigate both detailed commercial discussions and senior executive conversations.

What success looks like

In this role, you will build a Renewals organization that creates greater predictability for the business and a simpler, more consistent experience for customers.

Your team will engage customers earlier, identify and address risk before renewals become reactive, execute commercial conversations with confidence, and provide accurate visibility into renewal outcomes. Customer Success teams will be able to remain focused on driving value, adoption, strategic relationships, and risk mitigation while Renewal Managers bring dedicated commercial expertise to the renewal process.

At the same time, you will help Tines develop a renewal motion that can scale with the business combining strong talent, clear ownership, operational discipline, automation, and data to improve retention and strengthen long-term customer relationships.

Target Annual Compensation: $150-170K OTE (70/30 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-SW1

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced U.S. based Privacy Counsel to join our Legal Team. In this role, you will help shape and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program as the company continues to expand internationally. You will advise on privacy, data protection, and AI governance issues across our products and operations, while supporting commercial transactions involving data processing and technology services. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and GTM teams to provide practical, business-oriented guidance that enables innovation while ensuring compliance with evolving privacy and AI regulatory frameworks across multiple jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

  • Advise on global privacy and data protection laws, including CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, and other U.S. and international regulatory frameworks.

  • Advise on privacy and regulatory risks relating to AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, and other sensitive data types.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to implement privacy-by-design principles and support responsible development of AI products.

  • Conduct and oversee privacy risk assessments, including Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)and related documentation.

  • Support commercial transactions by advising on data protection terms, including Data Processing Addendums (DPAs), Business Associate Agreements (BAAs), cross-border data transfers, and privacy provisions in customer agreements.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving legal and regulatory developments relating to privacy, AI governance, and data use, and translate them into practical guidance for the business.

  • Help develop and maintain ElevenLabs’ privacy policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.

  • Support responses to privacy-related regulatory inquiries, audits, and incidents, working closely with Security and Safety teams.

Who you are

  • Curious about the future of AI and emerging technologies, with a strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for applying privacy law to cutting-edge products.

  • Comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving regulatory landscapes.

  • Able to translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical guidance for product and business teams.

  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented, with a strong commitment to enabling innovation responsibly.

What you bring

  • JD with active membership in at least one U.S. state bar (New York preferred).

  • 6+ years of relevant legal experience, with a focus on privacy compliance and data governance.

  • Experience advising AI, technology or SaaS companies on global privacy compliance and data governance.

  • Experience advising on US biometric privacy laws and regulatory requirements, including laws governing biometric identifiers and information.

  • Experience advising on HIPAA, healthcare privacy, PHI, and BAAs, particularly in connection with technology or SaaS products.

  • Experience advising on AI, data use, or emerging technology regulatory frameworks is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is seeking an experienced Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for its FINTRAC-registered Money Services Business entity. Under the Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act and its Regulations, this role is the legally-appointed compliance officer responsible for implementing RBCC's AML/ATF compliance program and for reporting suspicious transactions to FINTRAC. This is a standalone, high-accountability compliance leadership role: you will own Ramp Canada’s AML program end to end, act as the primary point of contact for FINTRAC and Ramp’s financial partners in the region, and serve as the gatekeeper protecting Ramp's Canadian entity from financial crime.
