jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build and operate the distributed systems and services that Human Interest's data platform runs on, at a pivotal moment in Human Interest's growth. This role exists to own the infrastructure and compute layer that moves data reliably at scale. You will drive the evolution of our data platform toward an architecture that scales for AI consumption and for Human Interest's next growth stage.

This is a software engineering role in the data domain. You will spend your time designing services, reasoning about failure modes, and tuning distributed compute rather than authoring analytics models. We are looking for engineers who have built production systems and moved into the data world, and who want to keep building systems there. This is a high-ownership role where your architectural decisions will have a direct and visible impact on Human Interest's capabilities.

About the team

The Data Platform team at Human Interest owns the data stack from ingestion and orchestration through transformation, governance, and delivery to BI tools. Our stack currently includes Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Meltano, and AWS. We're a small, highly collaborative team embedded within the HI Tech organization, working closely with Analysts, Finance, Product, and engineering teams to ensure that the data people rely on is trustworthy and accessible.

You'll shape how we evolve our architecture towards AI-consumption and to set the standard for how production data systems are built, deployed, and operated at Human Interest. The team actively uses AI tools as part of our development workflow, and we expect this role to help drive and expand that practice across the team.

What you get to do every day

  • Design, build, and operate the distributed services and compute infrastructure behind our data platform, including containerized workloads on AWS ECS, autoscaling and resource sizing, and the orchestration layer that coordinates them.
  • Own end-to-end design and development of scalable data pipelines and data-moving services, from ingestion and orchestration through transformation and delivery.
  • Improve how event-sourced data moves from our production systems into our data infrastructure and back out to other systems.
  • Participate in on-call for the data platform, and own production issues in distributed data systems end to end.
  • Ensure participant and employer data is handled securely as it moves through the platform, including PII classification and masking, role-based access controls and least-privilege patterns, encryption and key management, lineage, and the audit trails our SOC 2 and regulatory obligations depend on.
  • Lead the technical direction and evolution of our data platform as we move toward an AI-first data infrastructure. You will design for AI consumption, unstructured data access, and integration with AI tooling from the ground up, including the pipelines and infrastructure that support model and AI workloads running in production.
  • Build the interfaces that data engineers, analysts, and AI systems use, and the systems that move curated data back out of the warehouse into production services and downstream tools.
  • Mentor engineers and analysts and raise the technical bar across the team, setting the standard for testing, code review, and operational readiness on the data stack.

What you bring to the role

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production software systems, with significant time spent on data-intensive systems such as data pipelines, data streaming platforms, and data infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems and services, with the ability to reason clearly about software concepts like concurrency, backpressure, idempotency, partial failure, and the tradeoffs between them.
  • Hands-on experience running containerized workloads in production on AWS including scaling, resource sizing, and performance and cost tuning under real load.
  • The ability to independently own and improve complex production systems, alongside the software engineering practices that go with them: automated testing, code review, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration at scale, including Airflow or equivalent tools.
  • A strong desire to leverage AI tools and workflow automation as the primary way work gets done, not just to augment work.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with event-sourced or append-only log systems, or with change data capture and streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka or Kinesis).
  • Working knowledge of cloud data warehouse technologies, including Snowflake or equivalent, covering access control, performance tuning, and cost management.
  • Experience getting machine learning models into production and keeping them healthy there. We are interested in the engineering side of ML in production rather than model development itself (e.g. serving infrastructure and monitoring).
  • Experience with data lakehouse architectures and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake.
  • Experience building data infrastructure to support AI-driven data access, such as exposing data assets via MCP, implementing governance frameworks for AI data access, and curating, monitoring, and evaluating the quality of AI-generated query responses.

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
Why We Exist

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We’ve reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and scaled revenue 70X. We’re now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

Why We’re Hiring

Jerry is expanding into several new markets at the same time. Capital allocation is now one of the most consequential decisions we make: each dollar committed to a new product line, a marketing channel, or a headcount is a dollar not available elsewhere.

We are hiring a Strategic Finance Manager, reporting to our VP of Finance, to build the analysis those decisions rest on. You will own the operating model and the planning cycle, partner with functional leaders across the company, and work closely with the CFO and the founders.

What You’ll Own

The operating core is the model, the planning cadence, and the spend discipline the company runs on. Alongside it, you are the analytical partner on new opportunities — the products, verticals, channels and partnerships we are deciding whether to back. And over your first year or two, as our newer products scale and the audience for our numbers widens beyond the people who already know the business, the reporting itself has to reach a standard that holds up to outside diligence.

Own the operating model and forecast cycle:

  • Own Jerry’s driver-based operating model for the base business and expand it as we launch new insurance products and business lines.

  • Run the annual budget and long-range planning process end to end — cadence, assumptions, stakeholder inputs, and the consolidated plan the executive team commits to.

  • Own the monthly and quarterly forecast cycle and variance analysis: Once Accounting closes the books, explain what moved against plan and prior period, why it moved, and what it means for the forecast.

  • Write the executive narrative: Translate the financial results into clear business insights for the CFO, the founders, the board, and our investors, at a standard that survives external diligence.

  • Lead monthly business reviews: Work with functional leaders and turn what the numbers show into the business decisions that need to be made.

  • Support the team in evaluating and implementing a planning system: Assess the options, make the recommendation, and own the rollout.

Build the financial case for new opportunities

  • Build the financial model for new product, vertical, channel or partnership: Size the market, model the economics, evaluate capital commitment and return profile.

  • Read results back against the case: Once something is live, compare the actual economics to what we underwrote and carry the lesson into the next decision. Monitor product and channel economics including CAC and payback, policy retention and lifetime value, contribution margin etc.

  • Support corporate development: Capital markets and investor workstreams through diligence, modeling, and transaction analysis as the need arises.

  • Frame build, buy or partner decisions: help refine the frameworks we use to compare the options and the return profile of each.

Underwrite vendor spend:

  • Build the business case before a commitment is made, support negotiation on terms, and give budget owners the visibility to manage their own numbers.

Who You Are

  • Accurate under deadline: Your numbers are right the first time, and they stay right when the deadline compresses. You check your own work before anyone else has to.

  • Picks the right question: No one hands you the workstream. You decide which analysis will actually change a decision, and leave the rest alone.

  • Direct communicator: You form a view, communicate it directly, and revise it when the evidence changes.

  • Executive-ready output: What you produce can go in front of the founders or the board without a rewrite — clear, precise, and honest about what the numbers do and do not show.

  • Owner: You take ownership of outcomes and are comfortable building process where none exists yet.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally combining 2+ years at a reputable investment bank, corporate development group, or private equity firm with 2+ years in strategic finance or FP&A at a high-growth company.

  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a similarly quantitative field.

  • Strong financial modeling skills: driver-based operating models, three-statement mechanics, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and a working command of accounting concepts and GAAP.

  • Experience with unit economics in a consumer or marketplace business, including CAC, LTV, payback, cohort retention, and contribution margin.

  • A track record of translating complex analysis into a clear narrative for an executive or investor audience.

  • Startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred, including building financial processes from scratch.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for analysis, research, and workflow automation.

Nice to have:

  • Insurance, insurtech, fintech, or marketplace experience;

  • CFA certification;

  • vendor negotiation or procurement exposure;

  • finance tech stack experience (NetSuite, Ramp, planning tools).

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Scale
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. As a Scaled Customer Success Manager on the Commercial team, you will manage a high volume of accounts once onboarding is complete. You will support requests but also proactively identify growth opportunities and risk throughout the customer lifecycle in order to prioritize outreach.

This is a highly impactful role as you execute and improve scaled programs to not only impact one customer at a time but hundreds to thousands. You’ll be transforming the way customers uncover value with Samsara both by using AI and one-to-many programs to drive success.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely at school, or whether power is restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities our customers face provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You’re technical and curious: You’re comfortable getting hands-on with integrations, APIs, and complex product configurations — and you enjoy diagnosing technical challenges to find the right solution for a customer.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: whether with our customers or cross-functional teams at Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You want to build, not just operate: This team is still shaping its future. You’ll have the autonomy to help build the next chapter of Mid-Market CS at Samsara, leveraging AI to do the best work of your career.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our AI-powered IoT platform.
  • Manage a high volume portfolio of accounts, monitoring customer health, growth, and risk signals at scale to prioritize and improve retention.
  • Help build the next chapter of scalable CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how the team operates.
  • Conduct workshops, webinars, office hours, and other scalable motions with customers to support the growth and adoption in their journey.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities — including its more technical and integration-related features — to explain technical solutions to a non-technical audience.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2 – 4+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong prioritization and high emotional intelligence.
  • Possesses a strong bias for action with a customer-centric approach.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, being inquisitive and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience supporting a high-volume book of business, working towards retention and growth goals.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience supporting or working with technical products and comfort with APIs and integrations.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager - 6 Month Fixed Term Contract

Location: Remote (UK), with occasional travel to clients in the EU and USA and to huumun UK HQ in Bracknell
Job type: Full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract initially

About huumun

huumun is a digital experience partner to the global life sciences sector. We put people at the heart of everything we do, to build genuine and valuable relationships, whether we are engaging with patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals or consumers. We provide a digital edge, with a human touch.

Why this role exists

As Senior Project Manager, you will lead the successful delivery of complex, integrated projects and workstreams within huumun's pod model, making sure delivery is cohesive, commercially controlled and focused on agreed client outcomes.
Working closely with the Programme Director and cross-functional leads, you will turn strategy and scope into achievable delivery approaches and plans, shape how work is executed across disciplines and channels, and keep clear oversight of progress, dependencies, risks and priorities. You will also play an active role in opportunity shaping, scoping and project setup, bringing the delivery insight that makes proposed solutions feasible and set up for success.

What you'll do

Delivery leadership and execution

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, high-value or integrated projects within scope, budget and quality expectations
  • Translate strategy, scope and intended outcomes into clear delivery approaches, plans, governance and ways of working
  • Shape how work is phased, resourced and coordinated across disciplines and channels, challenging assumptions where feasibility, dependencies or risk require it
  • Keep strong commercial oversight of scope, budget, resource use and forecasts, taking early action where delivery or margin is at risk
  • Support change control by clearly explaining the delivery implications of changes in scope, timing, quality or resourcing
  • Make sure work connects across content, creative, scientific, platform, data and experience, with well-managed dependencies and handovers
  • Take accountability for project-level delivery quality

Client and stakeholder management

  • Act as the primary day-to-day lead for client stakeholders, building trust-based relationships and confidence in delivery
  • Manage expectations proactively on scope, priorities, timelines and risks
  • Lead delivery-focused client communications, including status updates, issue resolution and key decisions
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments across client teams and partner organisations

Team guidance

  • Provide practical guidance, mentoring and delivery oversight to Project Managers and Project Support colleagues
  • Help colleagues work through complex delivery, stakeholder and commercial situations while they keep ownership
  • Review delivery plans, project health and risk where senior input is needed, and share effective practice across the team

Pod collaboration and new business

  • Work as part of an integrated pod alongside the Programme Director, Global Client Partner and cross-functional teams
  • Lead and contribute to pod rhythms such as planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives
  • Play an active role in presales, scoping and project shaping, developing feasible estimates, plans and governance
  • Identify opportunities within and beyond project scope that contribute to client growth
  • Lead the coordination of external partners and suppliers that form part of an integrated delivery plan

Innovation and intelligent delivery

  • Apply new tools, approaches and AI-enabled ways of working to improve delivery efficiency and quality
  • Support the practical adoption of innovation within projects, in line with governance and client requirements

What success looks like

  • Projects delivered on time, within scope and budget, with improved predictability
  • Stronger quality outcomes, with less rework and smoother execution across disciplines
  • Improved commercial performance through effective scope management and consistent margin control
  • Earlier identification of risks, fewer escalations and clear mitigation in place
  • Positive client relationships and strong stakeholder confidence
  • Better delivery standards across the team through mentoring and support

About you

  • Typically 5 to 8 years' experience in project management or a related delivery discipline, including leading complex projects across multidisciplinary teams and guiding the work of others
  • Demonstrable knowledge of project management methodologies, processes and challenges
  • A working knowledge of software development and creative design processes
  • A strong track record of delivery in high-pressure environments
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to key stakeholders
  • Strong digital and omnichannel understanding, with the ability to plan and lead delivery across content, creative, technology, data and channel-based work
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

Nice to have

  • Previous pharmaceutical experience and an understanding of the ABPI Code and other country guidelines
  • A project management certification such as PMI, Agile, PRINCE2 or APMP
  • A degree in Marketing or a related discipline
  • Experience of managing, mentoring and developing team members
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Project

Our commitment to diversity

We embrace workforce diversity and believe it enriches us all. We give full and fair consideration to all applicants regardless of difference, and we do not discriminate on age, ability, gender identity or reassignment, race or ethnicity, religion or beliefs, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy or parental responsibility. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Earn $70 Recording Videos at Home for AI
jobs.description:
Record a set of short videos at home with your iPhone and TV, and get $70.

One-time task. $70 for one approved task, done once. About 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time on Wi-Fi.

Help train AI for smart TVs. You'll film a short video of your face, then a series of short videos in your living room while a set clip plays on your TV. Step-by-step instructions on YouTube show you exactly what to do, and you upload everything through the Mindrift app.

Mindrift connects people with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We're looking for participants based in Canada to record a short set of videos at home for a smart TV AI project. There is no prior experience required: you follow the video instructions and record with your own iPhone. On this project, participants will:

  • Record a short video of their face;
  • Record a series of short videos in their living room while a set clip plays on the TV, following the step-by-step YouTube instructions (sitting on the couch, moving in front of the TV, using a few everyday items);
  • Set up the phone on a tripod or phone holder and keep the whole setup within about 3 m (10 ft) of the TV;
  • Upload all recordings through the Mindrift app over Wi-Fi.

It's a one-time task: once your recordings are approved, you're done and you get paid.

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for anyone in Canada with a recent iPhone Pro and a living room with a TV who is looking for a quick, paid, one-time task. You will need:

  • To be 18+, living in Canada, and speak English;
  • An iPhone 15 Pro or newer Pro / Pro Max model with 256 GB or more and at least 70 GB free. iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max and other phones can't record this task;
  • A living room with a TV, a couch with 3+ seats facing it, and about 3 m (10 ft) of open space. You need to be alone in the room while recording;
  • A tripod or phone holder, a chair, glasses with clear lenses, a baseball cap and a blanket;
  • A Wi-Fi connection for the upload.

This opportunity is not open to residents of Quebec.

Technical skills

  • iPhone 15 Pro, 16 Pro, 17 Pro or newer, or the Pro Max version of any of these (iPhone 14 Pro / Pro Max and older models are not supported)
  • 256 GB storage or more (128 GB won't work), with at least 70 GB free space
  • Ability to install and use the Mindrift app on the phone
  • Wi-Fi connection for uploading large video files

Additional requirements

  • A living room with a TV and a couch with 3+ seats facing it
  • About 3 m (10 ft) of open space in front of the TV
  • Alone in the room while recording
  • A tripod or phone holder, a chair, glasses with clear lenses, a baseball cap and a blanket
  • Comfortable appearing on camera: the recordings include your face and are used as project deliverables (consent is collected during onboarding)

Language and Availability

  • Language: English
  • Location: Canada, excluding Quebec
  • Availability: a one-time task of about 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time; you choose when to record

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Record and upload the videos → Get paid

How to apply

Please confirm in your application which iPhone model you have (Pro / Pro Max, 15 or newer), its storage size, and the country and province you live in.

Earnings

$70 for one approved task, paid once. The task is done once; repeat participation is only possible if approved by the project coordinator.

Project time expectations

This is a one-time task. Recording takes about 1 to 1.5 hours, plus upload time on Wi-Fi. You choose when to record. Recordings need to follow the instructions and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Why this opportunity might be a great fit for you

  • Quick, paid, one-time task you can do from home at a time that suits you;
  • No experience needed: step-by-step video instructions show you exactly what to record;
  • Take part in a real AI project for a leading tech company.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Platform Migration
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of acquired screening and adjacent HR tech businesses into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. Your job is the data: understanding what each acquired platform holds, getting it into Veremark correctly, and showing it's right. You'll also make each integration quicker than the last, by building reusable mappings, queries and checks.

What you'll do

Profile and map

  • Profile each acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, client usage, active vs dormant accounts, data quality and the edge cases the documentation misses.

  • Build and maintain field-level mappings between the two data models, covering check types, client configurations, candidate records and history.

  • Raise gaps between what the source holds and what Veremark needs, with evidence, so the product team can decide.

Migrate and prove

  • Validate and reconcile each client cohort before and after migration: counts, key values, statuses and outcomes.

  • Log every difference and trace it to a cause: the source data, the mapping or the expectation.

  • Prepare the evidence pack that lets a cohort be signed off, and support UAT with the people who check it.

Integrations and commercial data

  • Keep an inventory of each client's ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and their migration status.

  • Map products, price books and contract terms, and help Finance reconcile billing between each acquired platform and Veremark.

Report

  • Own the migration dashboards for every integration in progress and contribute to the Programme Director's weekly update.

  • Give Customer Success and Sales the client data they need to plan each move.

  • Use AI to work faster: query data with prompts, draft and review SQL, generate first-pass mappings and documentation, and automate routine checks, always verifying results against the source.

Make each integration faster

  • Build a reusable library of profiling and reconciliation SQL, mapping templates and sign-off checklists.

  • Feed what you learn back into the integration playbook after each deal.

  • Where needed, review a target company's data before a deal closes, so we know what we're taking on.

Must have

    • 3+ years as a data analyst, with hands-on work on at least one data migration, platform consolidation or system implementation. Tell us what you moved, how much, and what went wrong.

    • Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions and aggregation, used to profile unfamiliar data and reconcile a source against a target.

    • Confident with AI and new tools: you already use AI in your daily work, for example querying data with prompts, drafting and reviewing SQL with an LLM, or using AI features in your BI tool. You know where it saves time, and you check what it produces against the data.

    • Data mapping and validation: you've written field-level mappings, tested migrated data against them and investigated the differences.

    • Reporting: dashboards in Looker, Metabase or similar that non-technical people use.

    • Enough BA craft to work with the product team: documenting current and future state, writing clear requirements, and supporting UAT.

    • Clear communication: you can explain a data problem to a client success manager and a finance lead.

    • Comfortable working to a playbook: you follow an agreed process and flag what doesn't fit, rather than reinventing it, and help improve it after each deal.

Nice to have

    • Python for data cleansing and profiling

    • Experience with billing, pricing or contract data, or with systems like NetSuite or a CRM

    • Background in HR tech, background screening, fintech or another regulated industry

    • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms such as Workday, Greenhouse or Bullhorn, and with APIs and webhooks

    • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit evidence

    • Previous post-acquisition or post-merger integration work

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

What We Offer:

  • A supportive, team-driven culture focused on collaboration and excellence.
  • Structured onboarding, tools, and resources to help you succeed.
  • Opportunities for career growth within the Candidate Support function.
  • Remote work
  • A chance to directly impact the candidate journey in a meaningful way

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

jobs.description:
About the company

Nuitée is the API infrastructure powering travel, inside banks, AI assistants, airlines, loyalty programs and hotel brands. Nuitée Connect gives businesses one API for 2.9M properties, 600+ airlines and 200K+ experiences, built for apps and AI agents alike. Nuitée Cloud lets hotels reach new demand and control pricing, payments and operations in one platform.

Founded in 2017, Nuitée has 300 colleagues across 25 countries and a mission to make travel distribution simpler, faster and fairer for everyone in travel. We raised a $48M Series A led by Accel and work with companies such as Revolut, Grab, and Sabre.

About the job
Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.

Set the technical direction for the front end of Nuitée's fastest-growing product.Our white-label platform is the live interface that our clients' customers use every day. Banks, travel brands, and global influencers each launch their own version, and it is growing into the main attraction on Nuitée Connect.
You'll be the technical authority on the front end. You'll define the architecture, the design system, and the standards for performance, security, and scalability, and you'll stay hands-on in the code every day.
A small team has moved fast to get the platform to market; now it needs someone to own its long-term direction and give it structure.

What makes it interesting for you

  • You set the direction. There is no front-end architecture owner today, so the framework, the layers, and the conventions are yours to define.
  • You build for many kinds of clients. Each tenant brings its own branding and requirements, so multi-tenant design is a daily problem.
  • You work close to decisions. The team is small, so a good technical idea can reach production quickly.
  • You help other engineers grow. Your experience shapes how a senior and two juniors approach the product.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre.

The kind of problems you'll work on

  • How should a front end be structured so that new clients can launch with their own look and behaviour without forking the code?
  • What does a design system look like when it has to serve many tenants and still stay maintainable?
  • Where does performance suffer as the platform grows, and what is the cleanest way to fix it?
  • Which security and scalability decisions should be made now, before the product is much bigger?

This role fits you if you

  • 7+ years of front-end experience, including 2+ years in a Lead or Staff role where you owned architecture decisions.
  • Are strongly focused on the front end, with Vue or React in production. The architecture, layers, tooling and conventions on our Vue stack are yours to define.
  • Work closely with Product and Design, and set standards for code quality, testing, monitoring and reliability.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools daily, and can spot where AI can improve both our workflow and the product.
  • Understand design systems and the UX/UI workflow, and know how to turn designs into reusable, feasible components.
  • Weigh performance, security, and scalability when you make technical decisions.
  • Have built scalable multi-tenant, white-label or platform-based front ends.
  • Nice to have: Travel/OTA experience, superapp integrations or AI-powered product development.

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You'll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your architecture actually delivers.
If this sounds like your kind of front-end role, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV.

Why Nuitée?

Nuitée is building the infrastructure to power travel.

  • Real scale: Nuitée Connect gives businesses one API for 2.9M properties, 600+ airlines and 200K+ experiences, and processes 1bn searches a day.
  • Strong backing: We raised a $48M Series A led by Accel.
  • Startup agility: We combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global impact: Our infrastructure supports customers such as Revolut, Grab, and Sabre, alongside banks, airlines, loyalty programs and hotel brands.
  • Built for AI: Nuitée Connect is built for apps and AI agents alike, so teams can launch intelligent travel experiences quickly.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team building a category-defining platform. You’ll work at global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries and grow with us, Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager (SEO, GEO & Social) for a DTC brand (US-Based/Remote)
jobs.description:
We are a high-growth e-commerce company, with deep experience building and scaling successful DTC brands. Our team operates in a high-performance environment, with approximately $1M per month in ad spend. We’re looking for an exceptional marketing operator who wants to work closely with experienced e-commerce entrepreneurs and have a meaningful impact on the growth of the business.

This is not a role for someone looking to simply manage a marketing calendar. We’re looking for a hands-on workhorse who is highly ambitious, moves quickly, takes ownership, and knows how to execute.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager – SEO, GEO & Social to own and coordinate key areas of our organic marketing and content strategy.

You’ll work closely with the leadership team and manage/coordinate the SEO team, GEO initiatives, copywriting, social media, and testing initiatives. You’ll also work directly with the team to identify opportunities, launch experiments, and improve marketing performance.

The ideal candidate has a strong DTC/e-commerce background, understands performance marketing, and has experience working with brands at meaningful scale.

Key Responsibilities

SEO & GEO

  • Manage and coordinate the SEO team and ensure SEO initiatives are executed effectively.
  • Own SEO priorities, strategy, content opportunities, and performance tracking.
  • Work closely with the team on GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and increasing brand visibility across AI-powered search experiences.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic, search rankings, brand visibility, and revenue.
  • Stay ahead of changes in Google search, AI search, and evolving consumer discovery behavior.
  • Coordinate technical SEO, on-page optimization, content, internal linking, and authority-building initiatives.

Copywriting & Content

  • Work closely with copywriters to develop high-performing marketing content.
  • Help establish content briefs, messaging, angles, and priorities based on SEO, GEO, and business objectives.
  • Review and improve copy to ensure it aligns with brand positioning and conversion goals.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose content across SEO, social, email, and other channels.

Testing & Optimization

  • Work directly with leadership and the marketing team to set up and execute split tests/A-B tests.
  • Help develop testing hypotheses based on customer behavior, performance data, and marketing opportunities.
  • Coordinate test execution, track results, and help determine next steps.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve conversion, engagement, and customer acquisition.

Social Media

  • Own and coordinate the organic social media strategy.
  • Manage the social media team and ensure content is planned, produced, and published consistently.
  • Develop content ideas based on trends, brand positioning, customer interests, and performance.
  • Monitor social performance and identify opportunities to increase reach, engagement, and brand awareness.
  • Coordinate content across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other relevant channels.

Marketing Operations & Leadership

  • Manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously while maintaining clear priorities and deadlines.
  • Coordinate internal team members and ensure projects are moving forward.
  • Work closely with leadership to identify growth opportunities and turn ideas into execution.
  • Use data and performance insights to make marketing decisions.
  • Take ownership of projects from strategy - execution - measurement - optimization.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on marketing experience
  • Proven experience working with large or fast-growing e-commerce brands.
  • Strong understanding of SEO and organic growth.
  • Experience managing or coordinating SEO teams.
  • Understanding of GEO / AI search optimization.
  • Strong copywriting and content strategy understanding.
  • Experience managing social media teams or social media execution.
  • Experience setting up and analyzing A/B tests or split tests.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to move quickly and manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English.
  • Strong ownership mentality, You see something that needs to be done and take care of it.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

The Type of Person We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an absolute workhorse.

Someone who is:

  • Highly motivated and hungry to grow.
  • Comfortable operating at a fast pace.
  • Extremely proactive and resourceful.
  • Willing to get into the details rather than only delegate.
  • Comfortable working with experienced e-commerce operators.
  • Obsessed with finding opportunities to improve performance.
  • Data-driven but also creative.
  • Able to take an idea and turn it into execution quickly.
  • Comfortable being held accountable for results.
  • Someone who has done the work, not just managed people who did it.

Benefits

    • 💰 Competitive salary in USD
    • 🕒 Flexible working schedule
    • 🌎 100% remote, long-term career opportunity

jobs.title: Fingerprint Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Fingerprint Coordinator manages the full fingerprinting and background screening lifecycle for candidates and employees. This hybrid role combines candidate contact, calendar and scheduling coordination, and technical biometric enrollment. The goal is a smooth, welcoming experience while maintaining strict compliance with state and federal security regulations.

This is a remote position. The ideal person is a candidate-first communicator who is highly detail-oriented, comfortable handling confidential personal information, able to learn new software and biometric hardware quickly, and able to work independently while contributing to a team in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary contact for applicants going through the background check process
  • Give clear, friendly instructions on fingerprinting requirements, acceptable ID, and venue logistics
  • Coordinate and manage appointment availability for in-person fingerprinting sessions
  • Resolve scheduling conflicts proactively and manage high-volume candidate bookings
  • Administer digital (Live Scan) and traditional ink fingerprint captures in line with legal and organizational compliance requirements
  • Monitor submission portals (e.g., state repositories, FBI databases) for background check results
  • Track candidate progress and promptly flag delayed files or fingerprint rejections for re-scheduling
  • Enter and maintain sensitive applicant information in the identity management system or ATS
  • Protect data privacy and keep data accurate and clean

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in HR support, recruiting coordination, credentialing, or a high-volume administrative role
  • Fingerprinting experience (preferred)
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with a candidate-first mindset to ease anxiety during screening
  • Strong organizational skills with a proven track record managing complex calendars or scheduling software
  • Extreme attention to detail and ability to handle confidential PII
  • Comfort learning biometric hardware and software
  • Live Scan Operator certification (preferred), or willingness to obtain it upon hire
  • Regular and punctual attendance
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to change
  • Able to learn new software quickly and use systems accurately
  • Natural problem solver focused on solutions
  • Works well independently and as part of a team

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Hazina (ERP) Implementation  - WWF International
jobs.description:
CONTRACT TERM: 2 YEARS FIXED TERM

WWF International global recruitment team are exclusively managing this vacancy. We kindly ask that you do not contact the local office on this position.

As Senior Project Manager – Hazina Implementation, you hold day-to-day delivery accountability for Project Hazina, a strategic initiative to implement a unified, cloud-based Global Finance & Accounting System (GFAS) on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. The goal of the project is to replace an ageing, fragmented finance systems landscape across more than 30 entities, including the Secretariat and its managed Country Offices. The project will be delivered over approximately two years.

You are accountable for delivering the project within the scope, schedule, budget and quality set by the project governance.

MISSION OF THE DEPARTMENT

To align and harmonise technology, digital and data capabilities across the WWF Network to enable conservation impact at scale while safeguarding the organisation and the people we work with, through fit for purpose solutions that are device and hardware agnostic, mobile functional, built on integrated, secure and scalable cloud enabled technology platforms and are consistently delivered and supported anytime anywhere.

MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Own end-to-end delivery of the Hazina implementation: build and maintain the master plan covering scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, dependencies and stage gates from contract signature through discovery, design, build, test, rollout, stabilisation and decommissioning of legacy systems.

Manage the implementation partner and the wider vendor estate: hold the implementation partner to contracted scope, deliverables, quality and commercials; run change control; and escalate commercial or performance issues through Procurement, Legal and the Executive Sponsor.

Own the project risk profile: identify, quantify and actively mitigate delivery risk — data migration, integration, scope creep, resource availability, adoption and legacy-platform continuity — and give governance bodies an honest view of confidence against milestones.

Steward the investment: manage the approved budget, track spend and forecast against variance, protect the contingency, and report cost position and benefit realisation to the Business Owner, SPOC, the other relevant governance bodies.

Lead business change and adoption: direct the change, communications, training and readiness effort across the Secretariat and Country Offices so that standardised finance processes are understood, accepted and used from go-live, and so that benefits are realised rather than assumed.

Safeguard quality and operational readiness: define acceptance criteria, own the testing and UAT regime, and confirm with Finance, GTDS and Cybersecurity that each release meets architecture, security, control and supportability standards before it is recommended for go-live.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project planning and delivery management

Develop, own and maintain the integrated Hazina delivery plan — scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies, assumptions and stage gates — covering discovery, design, build, configuration, data migration, integration, testing, training, rollout, stabilisation and legacy decommissioning.

Establish the programme team and operating rhythm: define roles, responsibilities and the delivery RACI across WWF and the implementation partner so that accountability for the plan, the budget and the go-live recommendation is unambiguous and the "who owns this" gaps do not arise.

Track progress against milestones and critical path, maintain the RAG position for the Systems Projects Oversight Committee reporting cycle, and proactively drive recovery actions as soon as slippage appears rather than reporting it after the fact.

Operate formal change control over scope, schedule and cost, ensuring every material change is assessed for benefit, risk and funding impact and approved at the right level of governance.

Stakeholder management and governance

Working with the Executive Sponsor and the Business Owner to ensure project governance is appropriately designed, implemented and fully functioning throughout the project lifecycle.

Prepare and present delivery reporting, decision papers and stage-gate submissions for the Systems Projects Oversight Committee, the Executive Team, and other relevant governance bodies for oversight of implementation.

Work with the Executive Sponsor, the Business Owner for Finance, and the GTDS leadership to align competing priorities, resolve escalations, and secure the decisions required to keep the project on track.

Build and hold the confidence of Country Directors, Finance Directors and Country Office focal points where adoption is influenced rather than instructed, and where local finance practice, capacity and connectivity vary widely.

Manage expectations candidly: set out trade-offs between scope, time, cost and quality with the evidence behind them, and hold a defensible position under challenge from senior stakeholders and committee members.

Budget and investment management

Manage the approved Hazina budget end to end: maintain the cost baseline, phase spend across FY27 to FY29, forecast to completion, explain variance and flag overrun risk before it compounds.

Identify and agree with GTDS Platforms and Finance the recurring costs after go-live — licences, environments, hosting, vendor support and integration services — so that they are budgeted and owned before the project closes.

Control the contingency deliberately, with a documented basis for every drawdown, and identify value-engineering and cost-avoidance opportunities with the implementation partner and Microsoft.

Own the benefits realisation plan: baseline the measures behind the assessed non-financial benefits, track them through and beyond go-live, and report realisation honestly to SPOC, the Executive Team and the other governance bodies.

Risk, issue and dependency management

Own the project risk and issue registers, with named owners, mitigations, triggers and target dates; actively manage the exposures that decide project outcomes — data migration and data quality, integration dependencies, scope creep, resource availability, partner performance, user adoption and business continuity.

Maintain the continuity position for the legacy finance systems through decommissioning, so that the organisation is never exposed to an unsupported platform and a partially delivered replacement at the same time, and agree with Finance, Internal Audit and GTDS how historical finance data is archived, retained and kept accessible for audit and reporting after each legacy system is switched off.

Escalate material architecture, data, cybersecurity, data protection, finance policy or compliance matters to the accountable authority — the GTDS Enterprise Solutions and Solution Architecture lead, the Director, Data, AI and Platforms, the Global CISO, the Director of Technology and Digital Services, or Finance leadership — rather than absorbing them within the project.

Ensure the project’s control environment, audit trail and documentation are sufficient for internal and external audit scrutiny at any point in delivery.

Resource, team and vendor management

Resource and mobilise the WWF side of the project: secure workstream leads, business process owners, subject matter experts and Country Office participation, and keep them available against competing operational demands.

Lead a multi-disciplinary, multi-location team without line authority — setting direction, resolving conflict, coaching, and sustaining pace and morale across a two-year delivery in multiple time zones, languages and operating contexts.

Manage the implementation partner day to day: agree and monitor the statement of work, deliverable acceptance, resource profile and rate card; challenge estimates and designs; and hold the partner to schedule, quality and knowledge-transfer commitments.

Work with Procurement and Legal on contract variations, service credits and commercial negotiation, and provide the evidence base for any escalation with the vendor.

Solution quality, data and operational readiness

Work within GTDS technical design authority: solution architecture, integration design and GTDS technology standards are set and approved by the GTDS Enterprise Solutions and Solution Architecture lead. The Senior Project Manager plans and runs delivery against them and escalates any conflict between schedule, cost and standards.

Drive the design and configuration agenda towards a standardised global core in line with the design principles: challenge customisation requests, protect the out-of-the-box position that the business case rests on, and ensure exceptions are justified, costed and approved.

Own the data migration plan with Finance and the Data, AI and Platforms team — scope, cleansing, mapping, reconciliation, dress rehearsals and sign-off criteria — and treat data readiness as a gating condition for go-live, not a parallel activity.

Ensure master data definitions, record identifiers and the system of record for each shared data area — including grants and awards, projects, offices and implementing entities, and budgets and expenditures — are agreed with GTDS data architecture and the Finance data owners, so that Hazina stays consistent with connected systems such as PI360, the grants management system.

Plan the transition of finance reporting and analytics with the GTDS Data, AI and Platforms team: inventory legacy reports and data feeds, agree what moves to Dynamics 365, Power BI or the enterprise data platform, and confirm that core finance, donor and management reporting works before each go-live.

Define acceptance criteria and oversee the full test regime, including integration testing across the connected systems, user acceptance testing with finance users, and the security testing gates required by enterprise standards.

Plan and execute cutover and transition to operations and support with GTDS platform and support teams: support model, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, hypercare and post-go-live stabilisation, confirming that operational-readiness criteria are met before each entity goes live.

Change management and adoption

Own the change management plan, working with Finance leadership and GTDS learning and adoption: impact assessment by role and entity, stakeholder engagement, communications, training design and delivery, super-user networks and readiness assessment for each wave of the rollout.

Work with Finance leadership and People & Culture on the process and ways-of-working changes that the platform requires, including the process standardisation that underpins future shared-service options.

Measure adoption after each go-live and act on what it shows, so that the efficiency, data quality and control benefits in the business case are actually delivered.

Capture and apply lessons learned across rollout waves, and hand over to the Finance business owner and the GTDS Enterprise Solutions lead, as the business and technology owners of the platform after the project closes, the documentation, capability and governance needed to run and evolve it.

PROFILE

Required Qualifications and Experience.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field; a postgraduate qualification or professional finance qualification is an advantage.

Minimum of 10 years' progressive experience in the delivery of enterprise business systems, including at least 7 years in project or programme management roles, of which at least 5 years managing enterprise finance or ERP implementations.

Demonstrated accountability for at least one full-lifecycle ERP or enterprise finance implementation — selection or mobilisation through design, build, migration, testing, go-live and stabilisation — delivered in a multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country environment.

Experience managing programmes of comparable financial scale and duration, with personal accountability for a multi-million budget, a formal stage-gate governance regime and reporting to executive or board-level committees.

Proven experience directing a major implementation partner, systems integrator or consultancy as client-side lead, including deliverable acceptance, change control and commercial challenge.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, or of a comparable enterprise ERP platform, sufficient to challenge design, configuration and estimates credibly; familiarity with the wider Microsoft ecosystem and integration patterns is an advantage.

Sound understanding of core finance processes — general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, fixed assets, budgeting, project and grant accounting, consolidation, treasury and month-end close — and of the control and audit requirements around them.

Recognised project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent) required; an ERP implementation credential and a change-management certification such as Prosci are strongly preferred.

Experience of the non-profit, international development or multilateral sector, including donor and grant-funded environments, is an advantage; experience of federated or membership-based organisations is highly valued.

Required Skills and Competencies

Authoritative delivery leadership: able to hold a large, multi-party project to plan, make decisions with incomplete information, and recover a situation that is drifting.

Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with the confidence to challenge a major consultancy on estimates, scope and quality while keeping the working relationship productive.

Excellent executive communication: concise written papers and clear verbal briefing for board-level committees, alongside plain, practical communication with finance teams in Country Offices.

Analytical and financial rigour: comfortable with cost models, benefit cases, variance analysis and the evidence behind a forecast.

Sound judgement on risk: knows what to resolve, what to escalate, and when a milestone should not be signed off however much pressure sits behind it.

Influence without authority across a federated organization, and the cultural sensitivity to work effectively with colleagues in very different operating contexts.

Resilience and composure over a sustained, high-visibility delivery, with the personal credibility to be trusted by both the Executive Team and the people doing the work.

Full professional proficiency in English; French or Spanish is an advantage.

WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Internal

Hazina Executive Sponsor and the Finance Business Owner; Global Technology and Digital Solutions (GTDS) leadership and technical teams; the Global Chief Information Security Officer; Finance leadership at the Secretariat and in Country Offices; Procurement, Legal, Internal Audit and People & Culture; the Systems Projects Oversight Committee, the Executive Team, and the Finance & Investment and Audit, Risk and Compliance Committees; Country Directors, Finance Directors and Country Office focal points.

External

Hazina implementation partner and its delivery teams; Microsoft and other platform vendors; third-party consultants and contractors engaged on the project; and providers of integrated services including banking, treasury and payroll.

Along the way, you’ll be part of a supportive, relationship-driven culture where people are invested in your growth and success.

The Impact You'll Make


We're looking for a Data Engineer II to design, build and run scalable cloud data solutions. These solutions feed analytics, real-time applications, AI/ML and our enterprise data products. You'll build reliable pipelines, reusable frameworks and low-latency operational data stores, and you'll use AI-assisted tools to deliver faster without lowering quality. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to understand needs, align priorities and deliver business value.

Our tech stack

Our platform is built primarily on Azure Databricks. We use Delta Lake, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Auto Loader, Databricks SQL and Declarative Automation Bundles. Experience with other modern data platforms, such as Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift, is a plus.

How you'll contribute

  • Design, develop, test and document data pipelines, data solutions and supporting applications.
  • Build and support batch and streaming pipelines that integrate and transform data from multiple sources and technologies into consistent, trusted datasets. Sources include databases, cloud storage, SaaS applications, APIs, files and event streams.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of data architectures under senior engineering guidance.
  • Build reusable frameworks driven by metadata and configuration for ingestion, transformation and reconciliation. Use CDC, incremental processing, SCD patterns and idempotent backfills.
  • Tune distributed processing, SQL, storage and compute for performance and cost.
  • Build and support low-latency operational data solutions on managed PostgreSQL platforms such as Lakebase, serving curated data to applications, APIs and AI agents.
  • Model data for analytics and AI, including semantic layers, feature pipelines and data preparation for RAG.
  • Ensure data is accurate and secure through testing, validation, data quality monitoring, access control, lineage and PII protection.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data issues. Drive process improvements that automate manual work, optimize data delivery and improve scalability and reliability.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines and deployments as code, and use AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery while validating all generated output.
  • Monitor production pipelines and data products using observability, alerting and operational dashboards to ensure reliability and SLA adherence.
  • Share knowledge with teammates, participate in code reviews and contribute to Agile delivery.

What you'll bring

Required

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 3–5 years of data engineering experience on modern cloud data platforms.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on Databricks experience, including Delta Lake (MERGE and upserts, schema evolution, time travel, Change Data Feed and table optimization), notebooks, jobs and Databricks SQL.
  • Advanced SQL and strong Python/PySpark skills, with experience tuning performance.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse design.
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouses that integrate structured, semi-structured and unstructured data sources, including CDC, SCD and incremental processing patterns.
  • Experience designing and supporting operational data stores such as PostgreSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Lakebase, Aurora PostgreSQL or similar platforms.
  • Hands-on relational database and OLTP experience, including schema design, indexing, transactions and query tuning.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and Agile delivery.
  • Azure cloud experience.


Preferred

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools. Our team uses GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and Databricks Genie Code, and experience with any of them is a plus.
  • Experience with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Auto Loader, Declarative Automation Bundles and Unity Catalog governance features such as row filters, column masks and lineage.
  • Hands-on Lakebase experience, including synced tables, branching, autoscaling, point-in-time restore and integration with Databricks Apps or online feature serving.
  • Experience with Delta Sharing, Lakehouse Federation, event streaming, infrastructure-as-code or production observability platforms.
  • Experience with other modern data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
  • T-SQL experience, including migration of legacy SQL Server workloads to modern cloud data platforms.
