jobs.title: Cloud Security Architect
jobs.description:
About TTS-US: Founded in 2011, Toyota Tsusho Systems US, Inc. (TTS-US) is a Toyota group company that develops IT solutions wherever global businesses operate. Transforming into a technology and mobility company, TTS-US and its global affiliates are helping establish a secure and resilient Toyota global value chain.

Who We’re Looking For

Our team is looking for a highly motivated, hands-on leader to fill the role of Security Architect. This role will be the security authority for the cloud environments with a focus on Microsoft Azure.

The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure that security tools are architected and integrated to protect the environment appropriately, that security governance is performed consistently, and that firewall and network access rules are reviewed and approved under strict separation of duties. You will lead the security assessment and drive the security roadmap from discovery through sustainment.

What you’ll be doing

Security Tool Architecture & Integration

  • Architect TFS enterprise security tooling in Azure, including Orca CSPM, CrowdStrike EDR, Okta / Entra ID identity integration, ColorTokens micro-segmentation and SIEM log forwarding (direct or via Cribl / Event Hub)
  • Decide where TFS enterprise tooling is required versus where Azure-native controls (Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps, Azure Policy, Microsoft Sentinel) are sufficient, eliminating duplicate capability and documenting the rationale
  • Design secure patterns for ephemeral, IaC-built workloads, such as building EDR agents into image pipelines and automatically removing destroyed hosts from security consoles

Network Security & Firewall Governance

  • Own the review and approval of firewall rule changes for ingress, egress and east-west traffic (Azure Firewall, Front Door / WAF), keeping approval separate from implementation
  • Lead recurring firewall allow-list and egress reviews, endpoints and run-level egress IP ranges, and ensure every rule has a business justification and owner
  • Define the long-term hub-and-spoke network security architecture, segmentation between low, high and production run levels, and the model for central TFS Network Security governance
  • Ensure no storage, API or management endpoint is publicly exposed without WAF or authentication protection

Identity & Privileged Access

  • Set the target IAM standard for the tenant, including Entra ID / Okta integration, PIM and just-in-time access, Conditional Access, break-glass accounts and compensating controls where geo-location is unreliable
  • Assist IAM in monitoring the lifecycle of member, guest, third-party (e.g., TTEC), test and service accounts, including permanent assignments, legacy accounts, service principals and secrets, with recurring access reviews

Logging, Detection & Response

  • Architect security telemetry flows from Entra ID, Azure Activity, Firewall, WAF, Defender, Dynamics and Azure DevOps to the TFS SIEM / SOC, and define SOC use cases, alerting baselines and tuning ownership

Governance, Risk & Assessment

  • Lead structured security assessments across identity, logging, posture, network, data, SaaS integrations, endpoint and governance domains, scoring maturity (0–4) and producing executive heat maps, a redline register and a prioritized remediation roadmap
  • Identify and escalate cyber redlines (e.g., privileged everyday accounts, admin access without MFA, unprotected public exposure)
  • Run the security review gate for new SaaS and application integrations (e.g., Alfa, RapidCX, banking partners), maintaining an authoritative integration register and controlling scope creep
  • Oversee validation before go-live, including WAF and application penetration testing, control validation, detection testing, DR testing and access reviews, and give the formal security sign-off with residual risks accepted by named owners

Requirements

jobs.description:

Job Overview

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (SrCRA) has local responsibility for the delivery of the studies at allocated sites and is an active participant in the local study team(s). The SrCRA works in close collaboration with other CRAs and the Local Study Team/ Study Manager to ensure that study commitments are achieved in a timely and efficient manner. The SrCRA acts as the main contact with the study site and has the responsibility for monitoring the study conduct to ensure proper delivery of the study.

The SrCRA is responsible for the preparation, initiation, monitoring and closure of assigned sites in clinical studies, in compliance with Sponsor's Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP, and relevant local regulations and that the sites deliver according to their respective commitment in the individual studies.


Job Responsibilities

  • Contributes to the selection of potential investigators.
  • In some countries, as required, Sr. CRAs are accountable for study start-up and regulatory maintenance. Tasks may include Site Qualification Visits, collection, preparation, review, and tracking of documents for the application process; submission of appropriate application packages to Ethics Committees/Institutional Review Boards (ECs/IRBs) and Regulatory Authorities for study start-up and throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Trains, supports, and advises investigators and site staff on study-related matters, including Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) principles.
  • Confirms that site staff have completed and documented all required training appropriately, including ICH-GCP training, prior to and throughout study conduct. Ensures sites remain inspection-ready at all times.
  • Actively participates in Local Study Team (LST) meetings.
  • Contributes to Investigator Meetings, as applicable.
  • Initiates, monitors, and closes study sites in compliance with applicable study procedures and SOPs.
  • Shares information regarding patient recruitment and site performance with the Local Study Team.

  • Updates CTMS and other study systems with site data within required timelines.
  • Manages study supplies (ISF, etc.), investigational product supplies, and investigational product accountability at study sites. Prepares investigational product for destruction, when applicable.
  • Performs monitoring visits (remote and onsite) and remote data review activities according to the study-specific Monitoring Plan. If required, determines and discusses with the Study Manager the appropriate timing and type of monitoring visits.
  • Performs Source Data Review (SDR), Case Report Form (CRF) review, and Source Data Verification (SDV) in accordance with the Monitoring Plan.
  • Conducts regular Site Quality Risk Assessments and adjusts monitoring intensity accordingly throughout the study.
  • Ensures timely resolution of data queries.
  • Collaborates with Data Management to ensure the quality and integrity of study data.
  • Ensures accurate and timely reporting of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) and associated follow-up information.
  • Prepares and finalizes monitoring visit reports in CTMS and provides timely feedback to the Principal Investigator, including follow-up correspondence, within required timelines and in accordance with applicable SOPs.
  • Follows up on outstanding actions with study sites to ensure timely resolution.
  • Escalates systematic or significant quality issues, data privacy concerns, protocol deviations, or ICH-GCP compliance issues through appropriate quality management processes.
  • Assists sites in maintaining inspection-ready Investigator Site Files (ISF).
  • Prepares for and supports activities associated with audits and regulatory inspections in collaboration with the Study Manager and quality representatives, as applicable.

  • Provides feedback regarding sites, investigators, competing studies, and market intelligence that may support study execution.
  • Ensures compliance with company Code of Conduct and Ethics, as well as policies and procedures related to people, finance, technology, security, and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
  • Ensures compliance with applicable local, national, and regional regulations.
  • Collaborates with relevant cross-functional stakeholders as directed by the Study Manager or line manager.

Education, Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in a related discipline, preferably Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare field, or equivalent qualification (*).
  • 5 years of monitoring experience
  • Excellent knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines and basic knowledge of GMP/GDP principles.
  • Good knowledge of applicable local regulations.
  • Good medical and scientific knowledge, with the ability to learn assigned therapeutic areas.
  • Basic understanding of the drug development process.
  • Strong understanding of Clinical Study Management, including site monitoring, investigational product management, and data management.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Effective negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as required.
  • Valid driver's license (*) where applicable.

Desirable

  • Experience working within a remote or geographically dispersed team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to change and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to identify and implement more efficient methods and processes for delivering high-quality clinical trials.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with risk-based monitoring methodologies, including remote monitoring approaches.
  • Strong cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across diverse regions and teams.
  • Proficiency with clinical systems and technologies used in an e-enabled clinical research environment.

What’s in it for you!

  • Professional growth through exposure to architecture, design, engineering, and manufacturing leaders nationwide.

What You’ll Do

  • Identifies relevant projects, key players, and decision-makers with the goal of increasing the frequency of product specifications by architects and designers during the design phase of projects.

  • Communicates and establishes a good working relationship with Project Management and Product Technical Teams to address client concerns and project needs.

  • Develops and executes strategic plans by leveraging technological and financial opportunities, while maximizing and enhancing available assets and resources.

  • Plans, manages, and attends trade shows and conferences where company presence is necessary; plans and assists representatives with their shows. Follows up with them on their shows to assess the value to and impact on the company.

What will make you successful

  • Ability to develop proficiency on all products and stay current on trends to help contribute to the Product Development Team.

Why should you join Arktura LLC, a subsidiary of Armstrong World Industries?

About Arktura LLC

Armstrong World Industries (AWI) is a leader in the design and manufacture of innovative commercial and residential ceiling, wall and suspension system solutions in the Americas. With approximately $1.3B in revenue, AWI has about 3,600 employees and a manufacturing network of twenty-one facilities in North America.

jobs.title: People Services Partner, Operations & Compliance
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for a People Services Partner, Operations & Compliance focused on compliance and employment infrastructure to help Tailscale scale responsibly as our workforce and global footprint continue to grow.

This role will own the operational side of People compliance, partnering closely with Legal, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and other stakeholders to ensure our employment practices, policies, documentation and processes remain compliant and scalable across the locations where we operate.

You'll help translate employment requirements into practical People processes, building the infrastructure, documentation and controls that allow the company to grow without creating unnecessary complexity for employees or managers.

Key Responsibilities

Employment Compliance & Governance

  • Monitor relevant employment requirements across the locations where Tailscale operates and partner with Legal to assess required changes
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical People policies, processes and documentation
  • Coordinate updates to employee handbooks, employment agreements, required notices and related employment documentation
  • Support worker classification, employment status and other compliance reviews
  • Maintain a clear calendar and framework for recurring People compliance requirements

Global Employment Infrastructure

  • Support People Operations requirements as Tailscale expands into new jurisdictions
  • Research operational employment requirements and coordinate with Legal and local advisors as needed
  • Help establish compliant processes, documentation and controls for new locations
  • Maintain country- and jurisdiction-specific People documentation and guidance

Audits, Controls & Reporting

  • Conduct regular audits of People processes and employee records
  • Coordinate required compliance reporting and documentation
  • Identify gaps or risks in existing People processes and recommend solutions
  • Build repeatable controls and checklists to ensure compliance requirements are consistently followed

Policies & Process Design

  • Own the operational maintenance and implementation of People policies
  • Partner with People team members to ensure new programs and processes account for relevant compliance requirements
  • Create clear SOPs, decision guides and documentation for managers and the People team
  • Identify opportunities to simplify compliance processes through systems, automation and better documentation

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Legal on employment-related matters and changing requirements
  • Work with Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, Finance and People Business Partners to operationalize compliance requirements
  • Provide guidance to the People team on routine compliance questions and escalate higher-risk matters appropriately

What We're Looking For

  • 4 - 6 years of experience in People Operations, HR compliance, employment operations or a related area
  • Experience working with employment counsel or external advisors and translating employment requirements into operational processes
  • Familiarity with employment practices across multiple jurisdictions; U.S., Canada, UK, and EMEA experience is a plus
  • Strong project management, research and documentation skills
  • Strong judgment and ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring legal guidance
  • High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive information
  • Ability to build processes and infrastructure in a rapidly growing environment
  • Clear, practical communication and a collaborative approach to solving complex problems

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$108,000—$154,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Location: Remote — Latin America

Schedule: US business hours
​

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded GTM Manager / Trigger Data Researcher based in Latin America to determine who our SDRs call, when they call them, and why.

Every Ignitvio client account is built around trigger data — signals that indicate when a company may be more likely to need our client’s services. These can include permits, zoning approvals, building sales, leadership changes, new projects, and service agreements approaching renewal.

Your job is to find these signals, identify and verify the right decision-makers, and turn large amounts of market data into focused, actionable prospect lists for our SDRs.

You’ll also help own the go-to-market strategy for new client accounts, including the target vertical, geography, trigger strategy, list-building process, channel mix, and initial performance targets.

This is not simply a list-building role. We’re looking for someone who can combine research, data quality, and commercial judgment to identify which companies are worth contacting and why now is the right time.

What You’ll Do
  • Research permits, zoning approvals, planning-board records, property and building sales, leadership changes, renewal windows, and other relevant buying signals
  • Build and maintain trigger-based prospect lists for client accounts, prioritizing companies based on the strength and timing of each signal
  • Identify and verify the correct decision-makers, direct phone numbers, and email addresses
  • Own the initial go-to-market plan for new client accounts, including target markets, trigger strategy, list building, channel mix, and first-30-day targets
  • Brief SDRs and the copywriter on each target segment: who the buyer is, what changed, and why the timing matters
  • Track which triggers and segments generate qualified meetings and use performance data to improve targeting
  • Continuously improve list quality and remove inaccurate, outdated, or irrelevant data
  • Document research and data processes so new client accounts can be set up efficiently within their first two to three weeks
  • Monitor list health, trigger volume, data quality, and meeting results
  • Report findings, trends, and performance insights to the founder
  • Manage research and targeting across multiple client markets simultaneously

Requirements

What We’re Looking For
  • Experience in GTM research, sales operations, revenue operations, lead generation, market research, or building targeted B2B prospect lists
  • Experience researching US companies and markets strongly preferred
  • Comfortable working with public records and fragmented data sources, including permit portals, planning-board agendas, property records, business filings, and company websites
  • Strong spreadsheet and data-management skills
  • Experience with prospecting and enrichment tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Clay, or similar platforms is a plus
  • SQL, Python, or another scripting language is a plus, but not required
  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of verifying information before it reaches the sales team
  • Commercial judgment — you should be able to understand why a company may be worth contacting now, not simply find contact information
  • Ability to analyze results and identify which triggers, markets, and segments are producing qualified meetings
  • Clear written English and fluent spoken English
  • Self-directed and comfortable managing multiple projects and client markets
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Available during US business hours
  • Reliable high-speed internet
  • Reliable backup power/internet solution


Benefits

What You Get
  • $2,500–$3,500 USD/month base salary
  • Direct training from the founder - a 7x President’s Club performer in enterprise software sales and former Oracle Sales Manager
  • Ownership of the targeting and trigger-data system behind client accounts
  • Direct visibility into how your research translates into qualified meetings and client results
  • Opportunity to influence which markets, verticals, and targeting strategies Ignitvio pursues as the company grows
  • Opportunity to grow with the company as the GTM and research function expands
  • Fully remote work

jobs.title: Founder & CEO (Vico Lead) mit SAP-Fokus
jobs.description:
As Founder & CEO build your own €10M+ SAP services company, at zero financial risk, and join us in disrupting the industry

(Offices: Berlin, Frankfurt, Barcelona, Seville)

Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies - “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e.g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Why we are looking for founders & CEOs of new Vicos with SAP focus

The founders & CEOs of Vicos we call Vico Leads. They are the key players, growing their Vicos. An important focus of our growth lies in SAP services which offer much growth potential for disruption. Therefore, we look for proven leaders in SAP services to become successful Vico Leads with our backing and support. Thereby, you grow your Vico beyond 10M+ € in revenue and 6-7-digit personal income.

Some great leaders in SAP consulting have the ambition to become entrepreneurs. Few, however, act on it because the classic way to start a business is expensive and risky. Vícoland gives you the opportunity to (a) avoid the expenses and risk and (b) offer clients the unique benefits of services delivered by Vicos.

Your opportunity: cross the €10 million € revenue line within two years

We are looking for founders who want to take their Vico to €10 million in revenue and more, within about two years. Vicos can grow to multi-million € revenue already within 12 months.

  • Your business: Your clients, your offer, your positioning. You decide what you build and how fast you grow.
  • Your team: You build your team from freelancers and SMEs and can bind key people to your Vico by contract.
  • Your profit & asset: Your Vico's profit is yours. You or a personal company of yours is general contractor of the Vico. Which means you can also sell the business you build as your Vico.

What Vicoland offers

We provide extensive support and backing to enable and accelerate your business building:

  • Infrastructure: Our certified platform covers marketing, finance, legal and organization, so you can run your Vico end-to-end without overhead.
  • Market access: You can use Vicoland GmbH’s listing with major corporations to make business with them immediately.
  • Sales support: We provide leads from our enterprise pipeline and support in acquisition.
  • Sourcing: You get access to thousands of experts, with a strong focus on SAP, and support in finding the right people for your team anywhere in the world.
  • Financial services: We provide insurance and factoring.
  • Mentoring: You get guidance from experienced Vicoland professionals.
  • Transition: If you are moving from employment, we give you financial security for the transition.

What you do

You run your Vico as its founder & CEO, that is Vico Lead. You:

  • Win clients from your own network and build your own pipeline. Leads from Vicoland add to it, they do not replace it.
  • Pitch, close deals and grow your client relationships.
  • Define your focus, for example S/4HANA, BTP, FI/CO, MM, SD, SuccessFactors or AI.
  • Recruit your team from your own network and from Vicoland's network of experts.
  • Lead delivery and answer to your clients for its quality.
  • Set the standards and playbooks your Vico scales with.
  • Build your visibility through content, events and your community.

Who you are

  • You have won clients: you have pitched, closed deals and kept clients.
  • You have led and grew something: a team, a unit, a practice or a business line, ideally with revenue responsibility.
  • You know enterprise technology and bring a network of clients and experts. SAP is the natural fit, because our expert network is strongest there. Strong experience in other enterprise technologies works as well.
  • You want to build a company, not try out self-employment.
  • You have not taken the step yet, but you are ready for it.
  • You speak German and English fluently.

You do not need to be a finished entrepreneur yet. You do need the ambition to become one.

Ready to build your own company?

Then let's talk. We start with a conversation, not a formal application. Apply with the button on this page. Or get in touch via LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Protection Products & Merchandising
jobs.description:
About Caribou

At Caribou, we care about giving people financial freedom so they can focus on what’s most important to them. Today, less than two percent of Americans refinance their auto loans despite drastic increases in the cost of new and used cars. We see huge potential to help folks reduce their monthly auto payments and increase the predictability of those expenses over time. We do this by building technology to pair customers with credit unions, banks, and finance companies and by simplifying every step of the process. On average, our drivers save $162/month on their car loans while protecting their investment long term.

Caribou is led by leaders from the technology, automotive, and finance industries. We’re proud to be backed by a great team of investors, including QED Investors, Goldman Sachs, Moderne Ventures, Accomplice, Link Ventures, Motley Fool Ventures and others.

About the Role

Caribou is seeking a Senior Product Manager to be the product lead for our Value & Protection team, owning how customers choose protection for their vehicle as part of their refinance. Protection products like Guaranteed Asset Protection (GAP) and vehicle service contracts (VSCs) help customers protect the value of their vehicle and prepare for the unexpected. Our north star is a digital sale where customers understand the value of each product and confidently choose the protection that’s right for them.

You'll own the platform for pricing and packaging, including the systems and tools that enable experimentation and optimized fulfillment of each product across Caribou's marketplace of vendors. You'll also own the customer experience that drives digital attach, helping customers find the products that fit their needs. This is a highly analytical role with a meaningful customer experience component. The ideal candidate has built checkout, pricing, or bundling experiences in a regulated industry, and is just as strong shaping the experience as the business logic that powers it.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the digital sale of protection products, from discovery to launch to iteration.
  • Drive digital attachment by improving how protection products are priced, packaged, and presented, using data to weigh tradeoffs across revenue, cost, and conversion metrics.
  • Manage the roadmap across the selling experience and the systems behind it, growing the business by driving conversion and revenue across digital and sales-assisted flows and helping customers choose protection that fits their needs.
  • Own the system that determines which products and packages are available on each loan.
  • Work with business stakeholders and Engineering to improve how we fulfill each product across our marketplace of vendors, and bring new vendors and products online.
  • Build and evolve our pricing testing framework, running experiments that personalize the experience and inform what we scale.
  • Collaborate with Design and Legal & Compliance to deliver a clear, compliant experience that builds trust and helps customers make a confident decision.
  • Use AI tools like Claude to move faster across analysis, specs, and prototyping, while verifying the output and owning the conclusions.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years in product management, with significant time owning consumer-facing (B2C) digital products that drive a purchase decision.
  • Merchandising, Pricing & Selling: Has shipped merchandising, checkout, pricing, packaging, and/or bundling experiences; understands tradeoffs across revenue, cost, and conversion.
  • Regulated Industries: Has built products in a highly regulated industry (e.g., fintech, insurance, healthcare) and partnered closely with Legal & Compliance.
  • Systems Thinking: Comfortable designing business rules with many constraints, partners, and edge cases.
  • Analytical Rigor: Highly analytical; confident setting test metrics, reading results, and using data to size opportunities and guide pricing decisions.
  • Product Taste: Customer-centric; can articulate why an experience works for both customers and the business.
  • Technical Awareness: Comfortable going deep with engineering on complex business logic, performance, and third-party API integrations.
  • Communication: Skilled at writing clear specs; adept at driving alignment through both verbal and written communication.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with marketplaces, supply chain products, or multi-vendor fulfillment.
  • Background in auto lending or auto refinance.
  • Experience building digital upsell or optional add-on purchase experiences.
  • Experience taking a digital sales experience from zero to one.

How we will take care of you

Everyone at Caribou is a valued team member. Our compensation and benefits package includes:

  • Competitive compensation: $151k - $188k
  • Eligible for annual performance-based incentive
  • Equity options
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Generous paid time off including Flexible Time Off (FTO) for all employees and 100% paid parental leave for all parents
  • Exceptional benefits including highly subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, and fully company-paid mental health, disability, and basic life insurance
  • Optional benefits to suit your individual circumstances such as HSAs (with Caribou HSA contributions), FSAs, supplemental life and health, legal, and pet insurance
  • Up to $1,000 per year for eligible professional development expenses
  • Employee referral program

Our Core Values

We come from all walks of life and are joined together by our shared values, which guide our work and how we work together.

  • Give a damn. What we’re doing matters. We show up determined to deliver results, and we love it.
  • Velocity. We’re intentional about where we’re going and we race towards it.
  • Make the assist. We have diverse strengths. We offer and ask for help so we all win.

The essential functions of this position require consistent attendance, availability, and active engagement throughout your full scheduled shift.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, marital status, military or protected veteran status, genetics, or any other characteristic protected by law. Product and engineering (the other half)

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The DevOps Engineer helps build, operate, and improve the automation and delivery systems that enable engineering teams to provision, build, test, deploy, monitor, and support applications and infrastructure. The role applies established DevOps practices to improve delivery consistency, reduce manual effort, and strengthen reliability and security.

This is a career-growth individual-contributor role. The engineer owns well-scoped changes and project components affecting the team or department, resolves routine to moderately complex deployment and infrastructure issues, and contributes to improvements in CI/CD, configuration, monitoring, and release processes. Work is performed with general direction and appropriate review, with risks and blockers raised proactively.


What You’ll Do:

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipeline components, deployment configurations, build steps, and release automation using established patterns.
  • Automate routine operational and delivery tasks using Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages.
  • Use infrastructure-as-code and configuration-management tools to make reviewed, repeatable changes to cloud and infrastructure environments.
  • Support reusable deployment patterns for cloud and containerized workloads, including Docker and Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Help maintain infrastructure modules, environment configuration, access patterns, secrets integrations, and policy checks.
  • Contribute to secure delivery practices such as secret detection, protected branches, merge-request controls, artifact management, and automated validation.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, dashboards, alerts, and basic service-health signals using established team standards.
  • Investigate pipeline failures, deployment issues, configuration drift, monitoring gaps, and routine infrastructure problems using logs, metrics, traces, and documented procedures.
  • Resolve root causes of assigned problems when possible and escalate issues when they exceed documented procedures or create material operational risk.
  • Participate in change planning, testing, peer review, rollout validation, and rollback activities.
  • Document reusable procedures, troubleshooting steps, configuration changes, and operational learnings.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, cloud, security, and application teams to gather requirements and communicate status clearly.
  • Participate in retrospectives, incident follow-up, and continuous-improvement work.
  • Contribute to reusable delivery and infrastructure capabilities while following established platform patterns, standards, and change-management practices.
  • Use supported self-service workflows and document deviations from standard patterns for review.
  • Escalate complex infrastructure, security, reliability, and architecture decisions to the appropriate senior engineer, platform owner, DevOps lead, or service owner.
  • Respect service ownership: delivery teams remain accountable for their applications and service-level operations; this role supports the tooling and infrastructure that enable them.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 2–3 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, software engineering, SRE, or a related discipline; experience is a guideline, not a barrier to entry.
  • Working knowledge of source control, software delivery concepts, CI/CD pipelines, and system administration.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Bash, or a comparable scripting language.
  • Experience using infrastructure-as-code or configuration-management tools such as Terraform or Ansible under review.
  • Understanding of containers, cloud platforms, deployment workflows, monitoring, and reliability practices.
  • Ability to follow runbooks and established procedures while recognizing when a situation requires clarification or escalation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot moderate problems, identify contributing factors, and communicate status, risks, and blockers proactively.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem solving.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or a similar delivery platform.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, Azure, or another public or hybrid cloud platform.
  • Exposure to Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty, or similar tools.
  • Exposure to GitOps, DevSecOps, software supply-chain security, or secrets management.
  • Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, or DevOps certifications.

jobs.description:
Nicht jede Heldentat ist laut. 22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill, oft ohne es zu merken. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Remote-first, technisch anspruchsvoll, mit viel Ownership. Wenn du Systeme bauen willst, die echte Arbeit erleichtern:

Willkommen bei easybill.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und genug Raum, um Dinge wirklich sauber zu lösen. Keine Meeting-Karaoke. Keine Konzern-Polonaise. Kein „Wir brauchen dafür noch sieben Freigaben“. Dafür: Fokus, Verantwortung, gute Tools und Menschen, die Probleme lieber lösen als verwalten.

Das ideale Profil? Du bringst tiefe PHP-/Symfony-Erfahrung mit, bist in TypeScript sattelfest und hast Lust, wie ein Founding Engineer Verantwortung zu übernehmen: pragmatisch, sauber, mit Blick fürs Ganze. Wenn dein Profil nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllt, du aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast.

Aufgaben

Wir sind ein sehr motiviertes Engineering-Team mit viel Ownership und kurzen Wegen. Als Teil davon baust du neue Features, löst Skalierungsprobleme und übernimmst Verantwortung für komplette Projekte – von der Idee bis zum sauberen Betrieb.

Wir suchen Menschen, die nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Systeme verstehen, verbessern und die E-Rechnungslandschaft aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Unsere Hauptanwendung ist in PHP und TypeScript geschrieben. Im Bereich E-Rechnung betreiben wir zusätzlich Microservices auf der JVM mit Java und Kotlin. Dazu kommen MySQL bzw. Percona XtraDB Cluster, TiDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, MinIO, Docker und weitere Tools, die man braucht, wenn 22.000+ Unternehmen sich täglich auf stabile Prozesse verlassen. Sicherer Umgang mit mehreren Programmiersprachen ist für diese Rolle wichtig.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, motiviert und selbstorganisiert. Wir investieren gern in gute Kolleginnen und Kollegen – und haben gleichzeitig hohe Erwartungen
  • Du entwickelst Backend-Features mit PHP 8.x und Symfony: Domänenlogik, APIs und Schnittstellen in einer über 18 Jahre gewachsenen, datenlastigen Codebasis
  • Du arbeitest im Frontend mit TypeScript, React und TanStack an modernen Oberflächen und produktnahen Workflows
  • Du entwickelst Node.js-Services für ausgewählte Bereiche unserer Plattform mit TypeScript und Next.js
  • Du arbeitest an JVM-Microservices mit Java und Kotlin im Bereich E-Rechnung.
  • Du migrierst Daten, refactorst bestehende Module und modernisierst gewachsene PHP-Bereiche Schritt für Schritt sauber weiter
  • Du gehst tief in Fehleranalyse und Debugging, wenn Systeme nicht so laufen, wie sie sollen
  • Du nutzt KI als echten Produktivitätshebel. Claude Code ist bei uns kein Spielzeug, sondern Teil des Engineering-Alltags – und wir erwarten, dass du intensiv damit arbeitest
  • Je nach Thema arbeitest du auch an Infrastruktur und lokalen dockerisierten Entwicklungsumgebungen mit

Qualifikation

Grundsätzlich musst du nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist: Du kannst zeigen, dass du in deinem aktuellen Technologie-Stack richtig tief drin bist, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich schnell in neue Systeme einarbeitest.

Unser Stack ist anspruchsvoll, aber du bekommst klare Prioritäten, gute Tools und ein Team, das Wissen teilt – wir erwarten dafür Eigenverantwortung, Lernstärke und den Anspruch, Dinge sauber zu lösen.

  • Du hast tiefe, eigenverantwortliche Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung mit PHP und Symfony auf Senior-Level – mit sauberem Domain-Design, Testing und Performance in einer großen, langlebigen Codebasis. Je nach Schwerpunkt bringst du zusätzlich TypeScript/React mit
  • Du gehst sicher mit relationalen Datenbanken wie MySQL um, inklusive Query-Optimierung und Datenmodellierung bei großen Datenmengen
  • Bonus: Du hast Erfahrung mit Node.js, Datenstrukturen & Algorithmen, verteilten Systemen sowie datenlastigen Anwendungen
  • Bonus: Du hast Erfahrung mit JVM-Sprachen wie Java oder Kotlin. Generell freuen wir uns über außergewöhnlich starke Engineers, auch aus anderen Stacks
  • Bonus: Du hast Open-Source-Contributions oder öffentliche Experimente auf GitHub
  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

  • Deutschlandweit Remote-First Team – keine Bindung an einen Standort
  • Workation auf Mallorca - Unsere Mitarbeiter* haben die Möglichkeit, die
    angemietete Villa auf Mallorca für eine inspirierende Kombination aus
    Arbeit und Erholung zu nutzen
  • Hoher Impact
  • Eine inspirierende und flexible Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung basiert.
  • Wir sind ein offenes, motiviertes und nettes Team mit flacher Hierarchie
  • Keine Sprints und künstlich erzeugter Druck
  • Faire Vergütungspakete und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub und einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
  • Arbeitszeiten sind flexibel und werden mit dem Team abgestimmt
  • Freiwillige Mitarbeiter-Events
  • Aktuelle MacBook Pros
  • Schulungen/Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten im Wert von bis zu 1.500 Euro pro Jahr

Wir haben vielfältige Herausforderungen und suchen einen motivierten Teamplayer! Wenn du dich hierin wiedererkennst und eine neue Herausforderung suchst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: Senior Support Engineer
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.

You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.

Some examples of our projects:

  • A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
  • A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
  • A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
  • A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do

  • Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.
  • Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.
  • Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.
  • Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.
  • Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.
  • Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.
  • Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.
  • Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.
  • Fluent Korean language skills (required)

About the team

We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack. We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our Support Team page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.description:
Every mind is unique. Yet much of the world is still built for what’s considered "normal," leaving too many people behind. At Everway, we change that by creating technology that helps everyone understand and be understood. By understanding and addressing the unique needs of each individual, we're creating a world where differences are recognized and valued.

Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.

Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to be curious, have courage, and commit fully.

Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator (Service Cloud) to join our Information Systems team, responsible for the technical ownership, administration, and optimisation of our Salesforce based Service capability.

This role will play a critical part in ensuring our customer support systems (Service Cloud, Zendesk, Gainsight) are reliable, well-integrated, and enabling scalable revenue operations.

You will work within our Salesforce team, liaising closely with the data team, and business stakeholders across Renewals and Customer Success to ensure systems and integrations support end-to-end revenue processes and help optimise the tech stack to deliver tech efficiencies to the company.

Responsibilities:

  • CSM System Ownership
    • Act as the technical SME for the customer support ecosystem, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and aligned to business needs.
    • Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimisation of Service tools (Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Gainsight).
  • Integration & Data
    • Monitor and support integrations between Salesforce, CSM tools and other key business systems.
    • Investigate data-flow issues and work with internal engineering teams or external partners to resolve them.
    • Gather requirements and contribute Salesforce expertise to integration design.
  • Process Enablement
    • Support key processes with the CS teams to translate business requirements into system solutions.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Data & Reporting
    • Ensure accurate and timely data flows between systems to support reporting and analytics.

jobs.title: Engineering Applications, Virtual Probability, and Statistics Tutor
jobs.description:
Thrive Education Partners is seeking an experienced probability and statistics tutor to support a student enrolled in CE 6300: Probabilistic Methods in Engineering Design at Vanderbilt University. This is a virtual role with a flexible evening schedule, beginning immediately.

This is not a general engineering tutoring role. Although the course sits in an engineering department, it is fundamentally graduate-level applied probability and statistics: random variables and distributions, parameter estimation, regression, Monte Carlo simulation, and component and system reliability, moving into first- and second-order reliability methods and reliability-based design. The right tutor has already studied or taught this material at the graduate level and can open the course text to any chapter with confidence.

The student arranged this engagement himself and is motivated and proactive about it. He wants to stay ahead of the course rather than react to assignments as they come due, which shapes who this role is for: we are prioritizing someone who knows this material cold over someone willing to learn it alongside him. The semester is already underway, so we need someone who can begin quickly and step into the content at full speed.

What You'll Do

  • Meet virtually with the student twice per week on a consistent evening schedule.
  • Preview upcoming course material so the student arrives at each lecture already familiar with the concepts.
  • Break down mathematically complex material into clear, sequential steps without losing the underlying rigor.
  • Work through representative problems and course assignments, building problem-solving fluency rather than walking through solutions.
  • Connect probability and statistics principles to their engineering applications across civil, mechanical, chemical, biomedical, and electrical contexts.
  • Identify gaps in prerequisite mathematics or statistics and strengthen them efficiently, without derailing the pace of the course.
  • Support preparation for homework, midterms, and the cumulative final exam.
  • Coordinate directly with the student on scheduling, priorities, and where sessions should focus next.
  • Adjust session frequency as the semester progresses, adding support around assessments when it is needed.

Course content includes fundamental probability concepts, random variables and probability distributions, functions of random variables, statistical data analysis and parameter estimation, multiple random variables with covariance and correlation, regression and response modeling, Monte Carlo simulation, uncertainty quantification, component and system reliability, reliability-based engineering design, and first- and second-order reliability methods.

Our Approach

At Thrive, tutoring at this level means more than reviewing solved problems. A student in graduate coursework needs a tutor who understands the mathematics well enough to explain why a method works, where its assumptions break down, and how it connects to what comes next in the sequence.

We match students with subject-matter experts, not generalists. For this placement that means someone genuinely fluent in probability and reliability analysis who can work at the pace of a motivated student who intends to get ahead and stay there.

Requirements

We're Looking for Someone Who...

  • Has completed graduate-level coursework in probability and mathematical statistics, or has taught it. An engineering degree that included an introductory statistics requirement is not sufficient preparation for this course.
  • Has worked directly with reliability analysis, including limit state functions, the reliability index, and first- and second-order reliability methods.
  • Can derive and work with distributions of functions of random variables, not only apply standard results.
  • Has built or run Monte Carlo simulations for uncertainty quantification, in coursework, research, or practice.
  • Is comfortable with parameter estimation, regression, and correlated random variables at the level of a graduate statistics sequence.
  • Can read an assigned problem set or textbook section and work through it without extensive preparation.
  • Has taught or tutored quantitative material at the graduate or advanced undergraduate level.
  • Explains both the how and the why clearly, and can find a second way in when the first explanation does not land.
  • Is available evenings Central time, can begin immediately, and can hold a consistent schedule through the end of the fall semester.

Is this the right fit?

CE 6300 sits closer to a graduate applied statistics and reliability sequence than to any undergraduate engineering course. We say that because we have put this material in front of practicing engineers and heard back that it was beyond their working knowledge — which says nothing about their engineering ability and everything about how specialized this content is.

If terms like limit state function, reliability index, and SORM are unfamiliar, this is not the right match, and we would rather say so now than spend your time on it.   • Opportunities for additional placements with Thrive based on availability and fit

  • Commitment: Through the end of the fall semester, including the cumulative final
  • Start Date: Immediate

Because the semester is already underway, the first few sessions carry more weight than usual. The priority is to establish where the student stands relative to the syllabus, get ahead of the next unit, and set a rhythm that holds through midterms and the final.

Support

It is virtual and evenings-based, which makes it workable alongside graduate study, research, or full-time engineering work. Roughly two sessions a week, scheduled around your availability, through the end of the fall semester.

For someone with a graduate background in probability, statistics, or reliability engineering, this is an opportunity to put specialized expertise to direct use and see it register quickly in a student's work.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in employment law, particularly in fast-paced, highly regulated environments, and a proven track record of effectively partnering with People, Legal, and executive teams to mitigate risk while enabling business objectives.

Responsibilities:

    Employment Law:

  • Serve as the primary legal advisor on all human resources and employment-related matters across the company’s business operations.

  • Counsel senior management and team leaders on a broad range of employment and labor law issues, including hiring practices, workplace conduct, accommodations, wage and hour compliance (Fair Labor Standards Act), benefits, separations, employee relations, and M&A-related employment issues, all while appropriately balancing business needs and risk mitigation.

  • Advise on the employment law implications of organizational changes, corporate structure, and business strategy.

  • Provide legal guidance on employee benefits and compensation structures.

    • Medical Staff Matters:

  • Legal Review: Serve as the final legal escalation point for complex credentialing files. Review "red flag" applications (e.g., prior malpractice history, licensure gaps) to advise on legal risk prior to onboarding.

  • Committee Advisement: Attend Clinical Review Committee meetings to provide real-time legal guidance regarding the granting, denial, or restriction of clinical privileges.

  • Fair Hearings: Manage the legal process for adverse privileging actions, including drafting notices of charges, managing fair hearing procedures, and ensuring compliance with the Health Care Quality Improvement Act (HCQIA) to maintain immunity.

  • Complaint Response: Act as lead counsel in responding to inquiries and complaints from state licensing boards (Medical Board, Nursing Board, Board of Psychology, Board of Behavioral Sciences, etc.).

  • Investigation Management: Conduct internal investigations to gather facts, interview providers, and review medical records to draft robust, exonerating responses to regulatory bodies.

  • Provider Preparation: Prepare clinicians for interviews or hearings before licensing boards.

  • Process Integrity: Oversee the legal aspects of the peer review process to ensure it remains privileged and confidential under relevant state laws.

  • Corrective Action: Draft and review Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) and Last Chance Agreements for providers under scrutiny.

  • Reporting: Advise on mandatory reporting requirements to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) and state enforcement agencies.

    • Litigation & Dispute Management

  • Manage all aspects of employment, medical malpractice and other commercial litigation, arbitration, and internal investigations, including overseeing strategy, discovery, and resolution.

  • Respond to and draft legal correspondence, including communications with federal and state agencies and correspondence from attorneys and other relevant parties.

  • Represent the company before government/administrative agencies in matters involving discrimination, wage disputes, and other employment claims, and in response to threatened claims.

  • Represent company employees in licensing boards and similar administrative matters.

  • Develop and implement litigation strategies in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external counsel.

    • Regulatory Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Monitor and analyze legislative, judicial, and regulatory developments affecting employment law.

  • Develop and implement company-wide policies, procedures, and training to ensure compliance and mitigate legal risk.

  • Facilitate responses to regulatory complaints and inquiries.

  • Assist in developing internal processes to ensure continued compliance with evolving employment regulations and standards.

    • Outside Counsel & Legal Team Management

  • Lead and supervise external employment counsel and other legal professionals to ensure high-quality and cost-effective legal support.

  • Manage outside counsel budgets, forecasts, and reporting related to employment matters.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for employment legal matters requiring external legal resources.

    • General Legal Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide support for non-employment litigation matters and assist with other general legal issues as needed.

  • Conduct review and administration related to employment agreements and policies.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Human Resources, Compliance, and other departments to ensure alignment between legal strategy and business objectives.

Required Qualifications:

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar; must be eligible to practice law in California (either directly or through in-house registration).

  • 8+ years of legal experience focused primarily on employment counseling and litigation, with a combination of law firm and in-house experience (experience in in-house high-growth and/or healthcare environments is strongly preferred).

  • Deep expertise in federal, state, and local employment laws, including multi-state compliance, employee relations, workplace investigations, wage and hour, and discrimination matters.

  • Strong litigation management skills, including hands-on experience with strategy, case evaluation, agency responses, and resolution of claims across varied forums.

  • Specific experience dealing with Medical Staff Credentialing and Professional Liability/Board Defense is required.

  • Familiarity with HCQIA, NPDB, and accreditation standards (The Joint Commission, NCQA, or URAC).

  • Proven ability to deliver clear, practical, and risk-balanced legal advice to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment; an ability to distill complex legal issues.

  • Demonstrated business acumen and strategic thinking, with a proactive approach to risk management and issue spotting aligned with business objectives.

  • Experience managing external counsel and legal staff, including budgeting, performance oversight, and matter coordination.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build strong relationships across legal, human resources, and business teams.

  • Highly organized with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities, balancing high-volume, high-risk and lower-value matters efficiently.

  • Must thrive in a fast paced environment and be able to successfully navigate ambiguity.

  • A low-ego, team-oriented mindset, with a commitment to integrity, continuous improvement, and the company’s mission and values.

Physical/Cognitive Requirements:

  • Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location.

  • Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate keyboard, computer and other office-related equipment.

jobs.title: Technischer Planer Rechenzentrumsbau (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über innovIT AG

Die innovIT AG denkt Rechenzentren neu: schneller geplant, modular aufgebaut und technisch präzise umgesetzt. Hinter unseren Lösungen steht ein Team mit mehr als 15 Jahren Erfahrung in Planung, Bau und Betrieb von Rechenzentren – alle Gewerke kommen aus dem eigenen Haus.

Unsere Rechenzentren entstehen in Modulen aus Stahl. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der aus unseren Grundrissen fertigungsreife Pläne macht – und der dabei mit KI arbeiten will statt gegen sie.

Aufgaben

  • Du setzt unsere Grundrisse für Rechenzentren in eine durchgängige Planung um.

  • Du konstruierst daraus die Containermodule für unsere Fertigung – Werkstatt- und Fertigungszeichnungen im Stahlbau auf Basis der vorliegenden Statik.

  • Du planst Kabeltrassen und Kanalwerke und stimmst sie mit dem Stahlbau ab.

  • Eine technische Zeichnerin arbeitet dir nach deinen Vorgaben zu.

  • Du erkennst Kollisionen, Lücken und Widersprüche selbst und sprichst sie an, bevor sie in der Fertigung landen.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI: Claude steuert bei uns AutoCAD – du gibst die Richtung vor, prüfst die Ergebnisse und entwickelst die Arbeitsweise mit.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung als Technischer Systemplaner (Stahl- und Metallbautechnik), Techniker Stahl- oder Metallbau oder Studium Bauingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Konstruktion

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Werk- und Fertigungsplanung im Stahl-, Modul- oder Containerbau

  • Sicher in Inventor, dazu AutoCAD

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise im Home-Office

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch

Ein Plus – und wenn nicht, lernst du es bei uns: Erfahrung mit TGA-Trassen, Rechenzentren, AutoLISP oder Skripten.

Das bieten wir

  • Hier planst du, was gerade die Welt bewegt: Rechenzentren für KI und Datenanalyse – modular, energieeffizient und jedes Projekt anders

  • Komplett remote: du arbeitest von zu Hause, Termine vor Ort nur bei Bedarf

  • Eine Zeichnerin, die dir zuarbeitet – du konzentrierst dich auf die Konstruktion

  • KI im CAD als gelebter Alltag, nicht als Zukunftsmusik

  • Ein erfahrenes Team aus Infrastruktur- und RZ-Spezialisten mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub

  • Moderne Ausstattung mit Laptop und Smartphone

  • Weiterbildung und langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Technologiefeld

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 %? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf trotzdem und erzähl uns, warum es passen könnte! Entscheidend sind Konstruktionserfahrung im Stahlbau und ein Blick für Details – darüber hinaus zählen für uns Eigeninitiative und Neugier mehr als ein perfekter Lebenslauf.

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn …

  • du Probleme lieber früh ansprichst als spät ausbadest,

  • du gern selbstständig arbeitest und trotzdem Teil eines Teams sein willst,

  • du neugierig auf neue Werkzeuge bist – auch auf KI,

  • und dir ein sauberer Plan mehr bedeutet als ein schneller.

Bitte bewirb dich über den Button auf dieser Seite.

Du hast Fragen? Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Jasmin Damann. Dann schreib uns einfach.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und plane mit uns die Rechenzentren von morgen.
