jobs.title: Account Manager (SMB) India APAC
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own a high-volume Launch portfolio — renewals, upsells, and day-to-day relationships across a large book of startup and early-stage SMB accounts, prioritising by risk and value rather than treating every account the same way.
  • Run the renewal pipeline end to end — track renewals well ahead of expiry, forecast accurately, and close on time; a slow renewal is the fastest way to lose a low-touch account.
  • Negotiate commercial terms with confidence — pricing, discounts, and contract length, knowing when to hold firm and when to flex, especially on multi-year commitments.
  • Spot and close expansion opportunities — accounts ready to add frameworks (SOC 2 to ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA) or upgrade plans, pitched naturally within renewal conversations.
  • Get ahead of payment and billing risk — step in early on failed payments or lapsed billing before it turns into churn, one of the biggest causes of loss in this segment.
  • Work the system, not just the relationship — use CRM workflows, templates, and playbooks to manage volume efficiently, keeping renewal stage, risk flags, and outcomes logged in real time.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and the audit team to unblock renewals, resolve billing disputes, and report regularly on portfolio health.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • 2–4 years in account management, customer success, renewals, or sales, ideally in SaaS — experience in security, compliance, or GRC software is a plus, not a requirement.
  • A confident, direct negotiator — comfortable discussing price and terms without getting defensive or over-discounting.
  • Strong organisational discipline — able to juggle a large number of accounts at different stages without letting things slip, working off dashboards and structured playbooks rather than ad hoc outreach.
  • A clear, concise communicator, written and verbal — this is fast, high-volume outreach, not long relationship-building calls.
  • Analytical enough to read account data — usage, payment status, renewal date — and decide what to prioritise each day.
  • Resilient and proactive — comfortable with pushback, price objections, and the occasional lost account, and flags risk before it shows up in a report.
  • Curious about compliance and security — or willing to get up to speed quickly on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 to be a credible main point of contact for lean teams without their own compliance staff.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven ABA Healthcare Recruiter to join our client's growing team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, with a strong focus on sourcing and recruiting qualified professionals within the Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) industry.

This role will focus on identifying, attracting, screening, and hiring Behaviour Technicians (BTs), Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs), and other ABA-related healthcare professionals across the United States.

The ideal candidate will have previous experience recruiting within the US healthcare or ABA industry, a strong understanding of clinical and behavioural health recruitment, and the ability to manage high-volume recruitment pipelines while maintaining a positive candidate experience.

This is a hands-on recruitment role requiring someone who is proactive, organised, target-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment.

Interested? Check out the steps below:




➡️ Click here to complete your video


Requirements


Key Responsibilities

1. Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for ABA and behavioural healthcare positions.

  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand staffing requirements, role expectations, and candidate profiles.

  • Source, attract, and recruit qualified candidates for BT, RBT, BCBA, and other ABA-related positions.

  • Review applications and CVs to assess candidate suitability.

  • Conduct initial screening interviews to evaluate experience, qualifications, communication skills, and overall fit.

  • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.

  • Manage candidate communication and provide regular recruitment updates.

  • Facilitate offers, follow-ups, and onboarding coordination.

2. Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Management

  • Proactively source candidates through platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, and other relevant recruitment channels.

  • Develop and maintain candidate pipelines for current and future hiring requirements.

  • Identify passive candidates and implement targeted sourcing strategies.

  • Build relationships with qualified ABA professionals.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activity within the ATS.

  • Monitor recruitment progress and ensure candidates move efficiently through the hiring process.

3. ABA Industry & Clinical Recruitment

  • Recruit across key ABA-related positions, including:

    • Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs).

    • Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs).

    • Behavior Technicians (BTs).

    • Clinical Supervisors.

    • ABA Case Managers.

    • Clinical Directors.

    • Other behavioural health professionals.

  • Understand the differences between ABA-related roles, qualifications, and certification requirements.

  • Identify candidates with the appropriate credentials, clinical experience, and relevant state-specific requirements.

  • Verify candidate qualifications and certifications where required.

4. Recruitment Performance & Reporting

  • Manage multiple open vacancies and recruitment priorities simultaneously.

  • Monitor sourcing activity, candidate conversion rates, and recruitment progress.

  • Work towards agreed recruitment targets and hiring deadlines.

  • Provide regular updates to hiring managers on candidate pipelines and recruitment challenges.

  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements to recruitment processes.

5. Candidate Experience & Relationship Management

  • Maintain professional and positive relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment process.

  • Ensure timely communication and consistent follow-ups.

  • Provide candidates with clear information about roles, expectations, and recruitment stages.

  • Deliver a professional and engaging candidate experience.

Minimum Requirements

  • Previous experience recruiting within the US healthcare, ABA, or behavioural health industry.

  • Experience recruiting for positions such as BCBAs, RBTs, BTs, or other clinical healthcare professionals.

  • Strong understanding of the ABA industry and relevant clinical roles.

  • Hands-on experience with candidate sourcing through Indeed, LinkedIn, or similar recruitment platforms.

  • Experience managing the full recruitment lifecycle.

  • Strong candidate screening and interviewing skills.

  • Experience managing multiple vacancies and recruitment pipelines.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

  • Strong follow-up, relationship-building, and candidate management abilities.

Preferred Personality Traits

  • Proactive and highly self-motivated.

  • Results-driven and comfortable working towards recruitment targets.

  • Confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills.

  • Persistent and resourceful when sourcing difficult-to-find candidates.

  • Highly organised and detail-oriented.

  • Adaptable and comfortable managing changing recruitment priorities.

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

  • Able to build relationships with candidates and hiring managers.

  • Resilient and able to work in a high-volume recruitment environment.

Software & Tools

Experience with the following platforms will be advantageous:

Indeed: Candidate sourcing, job postings, and sponsored advertisements.

LinkedIn Recruiter: Professional candidate sourcing and outreach.

Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS): Candidate pipeline and recruitment management.

Workable: Candidate tracking and recruitment workflows.

Monday.com: Recruitment tracking and reporting.

Google Workspace: Documentation, communication, and reporting.

Microsoft Office: Excel, Word, and general administrative tasks.

Headquarters: Remote US

Head of Content

Outmarket AI · Remote (US) · Full-time · Reports to the SVP of Marketing

About Outmarket

Insurance still runs on manual work. Most policies are sold through agents and brokers, and the people who know the work best are buried in the documents: checking policies line by line, comparing quotes, building proposals, on nights and weekends. We think that's backwards. The best people in insurance should spend their time advising clients.

Outmarket, the AI platform built for insurance, makes that possible. Account teams drop in their documents and get back finished work to review, with every finding linked to the page it came from. Outmarket connects to the systems they already use. The judgment stays with the person; the groundwork doesn't.

It's working. More than 10,000 people at over 300 agencies use Outmarket, including 30 of the top 100 U.S. insurance brokers. Most of those agencies found us through other customers. We raised a $34.5M Series B led by SignalFire four months after announcing our Series A because customers were pulling us forward faster than we planned.

Why this role

jobs.title: SOX AI Specialist (Contractor)
jobs.description:
About us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of advisory, audit, and tax practitioners at the world’s largest CPA firms. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re headquartered in San Francisco, California, and backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and others.

About the Engagement

We are seeking an experienced SOX and internal controls practitioner for a paid, short-term contract engagement. This is not a full-time role (at this time).

Over an initial engagement of 8–12 weeks, with the potential to extend, you will work directly with a small, cross-functional group of subject-matter experts, AI engineers, and product partners. You’ll help translate real-world SOX testing judgment into reliable, AI-assisted workflows. This is not a traditional client-delivery audit or attestation role. Your focus will be on prompting and refining AI agents to execute control testing and partnering closely with AI engineers to identify new engineering capabilities to enable better control testing.

Engagement type: Direct contractor

Initial term: 8–12 weeks, with potential to extend

Start date: Immediate

Time commitment: Approximately 40 hours per week

Target rate: $60–$80 per hour, based on experience, with flexibility for an exceptional fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with engineering, product, and design teams to translate real-world SOX testing processes into scalable product capabilities.

  • Co-develop AI agents with AI engineers to execute detailed SOX testing by translating SOX testing methodology into specific guidance, decision rules, and examples.

  • Work hands-on with AI agents: write and refine prompts, run controls and evidence through testing workflows, evaluate outputs, and document failure modes.

  • Analyze risk and control matrices and test plans to identify opportunities for improved agentic testing.

  • Develop stress-test scenarios, review and assess AI agent performance, and create detailed error analyses and evaluation criteria.

What We’re Looking For

  • At least four years of hands-on control testing experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or internal controls, with direct responsibility for control design and testing.

  • Broad experience across a range of control types, industries, and firms, with clear expertise in business process control testing.

  • The ability to consistently explain why a test step, exception, or conclusion passes or fails and to turn that reasoning into clear evaluation criteria.

  • Strong written reasoning: you can explain workflows and decisions step by step and turn professional judgment into clear rules, edge cases, and review criteria.

  • A high degree of comfort and hands-on experience using AI tools, writing prompts, and working with agentic harnesses.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, testing ideas quickly, and changing your approach when the evidence does not support it.

  • Availability for the expected time commitment during the initial engagement.

What We’d Love to See

  • Experience at the senior or manager level reviewing SOX workpapers or coaching testers.

  • A CPA, CIA, or similar relevant credential.

  • Experience across multiple companies, clients, industries, or control environments.

  • Familiarity with both business process controls and ITGCs.

  • Demonstrated interest or experience in creating AI workflows or tools of any kind.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Coder, you will own the infrastructure Coder's own engineers build on every day. Our internal environments run the same deployment path we publish for customers, so when something does not hold up at our scale, we find it before a customer does. We avoid building anything so specific to ourselves that a customer could not run the same thing.

Platform Engineering owns three areas. We run the internal environments our engineers develop in, the self-service environments our field teams use to demo Coder, and the release pipeline that publishes every Coder artifact. You will take ownership of components across these and stay accountable for how they behave in production after they ship. Our users are Coder’s engineers and field teams, and you’ll work with them to decide what to build and how we know it worked.

What you'll do here

  • Own one or more components of our Kubernetes platform end to end, from the Terraform and Flux configuration to how they run in production.

  • Improve the platform's observability, so that metrics, logs and alerts land in one stack with a runbook behind every alert.

  • Keep our Kubernetes clusters current, including version and add-on upgrades.

  • Apply cost and performance efficiency to our infrastructure.

  • Work on workspace isolation and container runtimes.

  • Contribute to the release and publishing pipeline for coder/coder, including its workflows, signing and publish targets.

  • Design for least privilege, with short-lived credentials and no shared static keys.

  • Write an RFC when a change warrants one, and a pull request a reviewer can follow without decoding it.

  • Mentor one or two engineers on the components you know best.

  • Run pilots with named users, gather feedback, and measure adoption and time to a useful result (e.g. from request to an environment someone can actually demo on)

  • Own docs, onboarding and support for what you ship.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering, with direct ownership of production systems other people depend on.

  • Strong technical depth across Linux, Kubernetes, containers and Infrastructure as Code, Terraform in particular.

  • Production experience with at least one major public cloud. Most of our infrastructure runs on AWS.

  • Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes clusters, including upgrades, add-ons, autoscaling and the failure modes that come with them.

  • Experience building and owning CI/CD pipelines, and treating them as production software.

  • A working understanding of IP networking and HTTP fundamentals.

  • Has changed or retired a platform feature based on how people used it, or can describe how they would decide to.

  • Good instincts for where cloud spend goes and what a change will cost.

  • Clear written communication. Most of this team's work is agreed in a document before it is built.

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • GitOps at scale with Flux or Argo CD.

  • Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry, including alerts you defined and owned.

  • Sandboxed container runtimes such as Kata, gVisor or sysbox.

  • Release engineering, artifact signing or supply chain security.

  • Prior work on developer tooling or internal developer platforms.

  • Public open source contributions.

  • You still carve out time to code, either at work or on passion projects.

Our tech stack

  • Backend: Go, Postgres, Kubernetes, gRPC

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Flux, Helm

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • General: GitHub, Slack, Discord, Notion

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

Our use of AI in hiring

We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:

  • Ashby and Brainerr help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.

  • Granola takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for Ashby.

If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact careers@coder.com.

 

Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Google Cloud & Gemini Enterprise Administrator to join our IT organization and manage Keeper’s Google Cloud, Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise environments. This role offers 100% remote work.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help securely scale the cloud and AI platforms used across Keeper’s global workforce.

 

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

The Google Cloud & Gemini Enterprise Administrator will report to the Director of IT and serve as a key technical resource for Keeper’s Google Cloud and enterprise AI environments. You will administer Google Cloud projects, identity and access controls, Gemini Enterprise licensing and configuration, enterprise data integrations and related Google Workspace services. You will work closely with IT, Information Security, Compliance and business stakeholders to ensure Google and Gemini services are secure, scalable and configured according to enterprise governance requirements. This role requires strong hands-on Google administration experience along with an understanding of identity, security, SaaS administration and emerging enterprise AI technologies.

 

Responsibilities

  • Administer Google Cloud projects, IAM roles, service access and related enterprise cloud configurations
  • Manage Google Workspace administrative settings, users, groups, permissions and security controls
  • Administer Gemini Enterprise licensing, user access, administrator roles and platform configuration
  • Configure and maintain identity and authentication integrations supporting Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise
  • Implement least-privilege access controls and role-based permissions across Google Cloud and Gemini Enterprise environments
  • Configure and manage Gemini Enterprise data connectors and enterprise data sources
  • Support integrations between Gemini Enterprise and platforms such as Google Drive, Jira, Slack, Salesforce, Microsoft SharePoint and other enterprise systems
  • Administer security and data-access controls governing how Gemini Enterprise interacts with organizational information
  • Configure AI security and governance controls, including appropriate protections for prompts, sensitive data and enterprise content
  • Monitor platform usage, access activity, logs and administrative events to identify issues or security concerns
  • Partner with Data Privacy, Information Security and Compliance teams to ensure Google and Gemini environments align with Keeper security and governance requirements
  • Troubleshoot complex access, licensing, identity, connectivity and configuration issues across Google Cloud, Workspace and Gemini Enterprise
  • Manage user lifecycle, licensing and access provisioning for Google and Gemini services
  • Maintain documentation for configurations, access policies, administrative procedures and support processes
  • Evaluate new Google Cloud, Workspace and Gemini Enterprise capabilities and recommend improvements to security, usability and operational efficiency
  • Support deployment and governance of custom Gemini agents and enterprise AI workflows
  • Assist business teams with adoption of approved Gemini Enterprise capabilities and enterprise AI best practices
  • Use scripting, APIs and automation where appropriate to streamline administrative and provisioning workflows
  • Use AI-enabled tools effectively to improve technical research, troubleshooting, documentation and workflow efficiency

 

Requirements 

  • 5+ years of experience administering enterprise cloud, SaaS, identity or IT systems
  • Strong hands-on experience administering Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace environments
  • Experience with Google Cloud IAM, roles, permissions, projects and organizational access controls
  • Experience managing Google Workspace users, groups, security settings and administrative controls
  • Strong understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization and least-privilege principles
  • Experience administering or supporting enterprise AI platforms, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini for Google Workspace or similar AI-enabled enterprise technologies
  • Experience managing SaaS licensing, user provisioning and enterprise application access
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data security, data access and governance principles
  • Experience troubleshooting complex cloud, identity and SaaS configuration issues
  • Familiarity with APIs, scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, Google Apps Script or similar technologies
  • Strong documentation and communication skills with the ability to work across IT, Security, Compliance and business teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to evaluate emerging AI capabilities and balance usability with enterprise security and governance requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Ability to work on-site up to 5 days per week when required for projects or operational needs

 

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Americas Remote

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're looking for a staff engineer to set technical direction for the systems that move billions of messages a day. This isn't a role about shipping more, faster. It's about deciding what gets built, where the architecture needs to go next, and raising the ceiling for the engineers around you.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership at company scale

You take on the problems nobody has claimed yet — the ones that span squads, have no obvious owner, and would quietly cost us a year if left alone. You either solve them or get leadership aligned to.

Engineers with product taste

You think like a user, not just an engineer. You connect architectural decisions to what customers actually experience, and you can explain that connection to people who don't write Go.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Your best quarter isn't measured by what you shipped. It's measured by what the department can now do that it couldn't before.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the technical direction of our distributed messaging systems in Go — making the high-level architectural calls on mission-critical services where scale, cost, and reliability are all in tension
  • Take on ambiguous, high-stakes problems that cross squad and function boundaries, and drive them to a decision when the right answer isn't obvious to anyone yet
  • Build consensus on contested technical questions across teams, and communicate the tradeoffs clearly enough that senior leadership can act on them
  • Raise the department's bar — set quality and design standards, mentor senior engineers, and turn what you know into frameworks and documentation other teams can use without you in the room
  • Drive engineering process and tooling improvements that span multiple squads, not just your own
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the reliability of the systems you build
  • Interview and calibrate against our career ladder, giving honest, evidence-based assessments of candidates
  • Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages), including several as the person others turned to on architecture
  • Depth across multiple systems or domains, not just one — you've been the recognized expert in more than one place
  • A track record of designing for production reality: you quantify tradeoffs in throughput, cost, and reliability rather than picking a reasonable path and defending it
  • Experience designing observability and recovery as first-class concerns — metrics, alerting, rollback, backpressure, checkpointing — not logging added afterward
  • Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP), with relational databases (we use MySQL) and a real understanding of performance tradeoffs
  • Evidence of making other engineers better: mentorship, technical writing, design review, standards that outlasted your involvement
  • A bias for action over perfection, and the judgment to know which decisions are worth slowing down for

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $240,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.
  4. Architecture Interview (60 mins) - A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges, tradeoffs, and failure modes.
  5. Take-Home Assignment - Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.
  6. Assignment Review Call (60 mins) - Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read and want to build software that makes communication better for everyone—apply now.

jobs.title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
jobs.description:
Headquarters: EMEA; Remote Roles - EMEA

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
 
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
 
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.
 
Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.
 
You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
  • Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
  • Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
  • Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
  • Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
  • Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
  • Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
  • Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.

What We Look For In You  

  • 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.
  • Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.
  • Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.
  • Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.
  • Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.
  • Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.
  • Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.
  • Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.
  • Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.
  • Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.
  • A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

jobs.title: Head of Tax Information Reporting
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote Roles - EMEA

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.
Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.
You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.
Location: remote available, with a strong preference for the US or EU. Some travel to OKX offices.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
  • Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
  • Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
  • Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
  • Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
  • Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
  • Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
  • Maintain the entity-by-entity readiness tracker covering domestic enactment, registration, self-certification coverage, and deadlines. Report weekly to the CCO and monthly to the CARF steering committee.
  • Hands-on leader. Build a small, senior team, scaled through the reporting vendor and outside advisers. Coordinate with and train local compliance and entity leads.
  • Support independent testing by Compliance Monitoring, Risk, and Internal Audit, and support tax authority examinations with complete, reproducible records.


What We Look For In You

  • 7+ years in tax information reporting, tax operations, or regulatory data reporting at a global exchange, broker, bank, fintech, or digital asset platform, including at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Hands-on experience in a global, distributed digital asset business: you have worked with exchange or wallet transaction data, multiple legal entities, and users spread across many jurisdictions. This is required.
  • Strong data skills. You can write SQL, define data specifications for engineers, reconcile large transaction datasets to a ledger, and find the gap when the numbers do not tie. You have built or run data quality controls on reporting output.
  • Working knowledge of CARF, DAC8, CRS, and FATCA, including due diligence rules, self-certification requirements, reportable transaction categories, and the XML schemas used for exchange. Direct CARF or DAC8 implementation experience is strongly preferred given live DAC8 obligations and upcoming CARF reporting.
  • Experience managing a tax reporting vendor or reporting platform, including scoping, testing, and holding the vendor to a delivery calendar. the tax platform vendor experience is a plus.
  • Experience building a function from a small base: writing the policy, designing the controls, hiring the team, and running the first cycle.
  • Ability to explain data and tax issues plainly to executives, engineers, and local compliance officers, and to run a steering committee.
  • Judgment on when to escalate, comfort working across US, EU, and Asia time zones, and a record of meeting hard filing deadlines.


Nice to Haves

  • Experience with US Form 1099-DA or 1099-B production, backup withholding, or Qualified Intermediary reporting.
  • Experience with the DAC8 60-day account restriction process or equivalent undocumented account remediation at scale.
  • Familiarity with GDPR requirements for sharing customer data with tax authorities, including data protection impact assessments.
  • Python or similar scripting for data validation, and experience with data warehouse tools such as Databricks.
  • Experience working inside a Three Lines Model, including supporting second-line monitoring and Internal Audit.
  • A CPA, chartered tax adviser, or equivalent; or a degree in data science, computer science, or accounting.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com

An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –  Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: 

  • TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)
  • Fortune Change the World (2024)
  • CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)
  • Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)
  • Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)

Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Senior Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our highest-value employer accounts. In this role, you will manage relationships with large employer clients introduced through Maven’s health plan channel partnerships, working in close coordination with the health plan team who co-owns the broader strategic relationship. 

The Senior Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for some of our larger accounts - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.  You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role — it’s a commercial leadership position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen.

As Senior Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:

  • Own the net revenue retention outcome for your portfolio of large employer clients with direct accountability for renewal rates, expansion pipeline, and risk mitigation Build and maintain strategic account plans, including expansion opportunities, competitive threats (e.g., vendor consolidation, competitor displacement), and renewal milestones
  • Forecast renewal health on a defined cadence, proactively monitor client risk on an ongoing basis and establish documented risk mitigation plans as needed, flagging risk  and develop Client Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) by surfacing expansion signals — new populations, benefit line additions, geographic growth — and building the internal business case before handing to Sales
  • Partner with Renewals and Sales as the account quarterback: own the quality and completeness of every commercial handoff, ensuring these teams inherit a fully developed narrative with quantified ROI, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to close
  • Own member enrollment and engagement campaigns that deliver measurable client business outcomes, developed in coordination with health plan partners and executed in adherence to channel-specific communication protocols and payer approval requirements.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews and data-driven business cases that translate Maven's clinical outcomes and member engagement into quantifiable ROI, tailoring messaging by stakeholder persona — cost containment and claims data for CFOs, utilization and engagement for Benefits leaders, retention and attraction narratives for CHROs
  • Proactively consult clients on program optimization and strategies to better support family building and their working parents, leveraging Maven’s industry expertise, benchmark data, and clinical outcomes to continuously demonstrate measurable business impact
  • Maintain high level of client engagement, satisfaction and loyalty, as measured by high client satisfaction scores and revenue retention
  • Partner with health plan Account Executives to align on strategy, enrollment goals, and renewal timing while maintaining Maven’s distinct presence and value proposition within the partnership.
  • Collaborate with client leadership, broker and consultant partners, and other internal and external stakeholders to unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional point of contact — leading initiatives with Product, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to deliver exceptional client outcomes, and managing escalations in partnership with Member Support, Operations, Analytics, and Sales — with ownership of project timelines and accountability for deliverables
  • Convert clients into Maven advocates, leveraging their successes for references, case studies, blogs, etc.
  • Provide strategic analysis of member engagement performance and program metrics
  • Own communications to meet mutually agreed upon goals including but not limited to quarterly business reviews, external client meetings/events and other project plans
  • Serve as the voice of the client internally by bringing insights to enhance product development and program marketing efforts
  • Identify and address root causes of challenges, recommending scalable improvements to processes and systems to enhance client outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted decision-maker, balancing multiple perspectives and ensuring alignment with company priorities to drive key decisions forward.

We’re looking for you to bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services role in digital health, healthcare company, benefits or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes (client retention, expansion, NRR), and a deep understanding of the employee benefits and healthcare landscape.
  • Demonstrate a proactive approach to adopting AI tools and technology, applying them to streamline workflows, generate insights, and elevate the client experience — with a mindset of continuous learning as the landscape evolves.
  • Experience working with large employer clients (10,000+ employees) is required
  • Experience working within or alongside channel partner or payer-distributed model is preferred. 
  • Proven track record of positioning and executing marketing strategies that drive enrollment to drive to measurable client business outcomes
  • Passion for healthcare and influencing organizational change
  • Serve as a strategic partner to internal stakeholders, collaborating to deliver a seamless experience for Maven clients and partners, translating insights into product, process, and market improvements.  Demonstrated history of contributing directly to net revenue retention through proactive renewal management, risk mitigation, and expansion pipeline development 
  • Proven ability to broaden and deepen multi-threaded executive relationships (VP, CHRO, CFO, Benefits leaders, consultants), within client relationship, specific experience managing the relationships across both the individual employer group and health plan/channel partner stakeholder simultaneously. 
  • Track record of partnering with Sales and/or Renewals teams to progress commercial opportunities, including developing CSQLs and building business cases for expansion
  • Strong interpersonal and verbal, written, and presentation skills, ability to communicate clearly and persuade, and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while holding yourself and others accountable for deadlines and deliverables
  • Possess analytical skills and strategic thinking- you’re strong on both IQ and EQ, with the ability to translate data, client performance into market insights and action planning in partnership with clients.
  • Experience in working with the full lifecycle of customer success post sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management)
  • Willingness to travel 25-30% of the time for key client meetings and participate occasionally in our NYC office for relationship building and key meetings (quarterly basis)
  • Comfort operating in high-growth environments with evolving processes — you build the plane while flying it and see ambiguity as opportunity, not friction

Helpful experiences and skills (if you don’t have them, you can learn them with us!):

  • Experience at a digital health company in the health, wellness, or family health space is preferred
  • Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients is a bonus
  • Salesforce, Looker and/or Microsoft suite experience

The base salary range for this role is $128,000 - 145,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.

New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and  Seattle, WA. This role is exclusively open to candidates in these locations. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week  (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.
Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days.

This role requires active work authorization in the US.

At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.

Benefits That Work For You

Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:

  • Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.
  • Whole-self care through wellness partnerships
  • Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 
  • 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)
  • Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens
  • 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting

These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. 

Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com. For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com.

#LI-NS1

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States - Remote, EMEA - Remote

Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.  Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About MetaMask & Trade

MetaMask is a self-custodial wallet used by tens of millions of people. In Trade, people swap, bridge, trade perps, predict and earn. Core UX is the part of MetaMask mobile that sit inside: Home, the navigation, balances, tokens and positions, and the path from the first screen into each of them.

People open the app and land on Home. If that screen is slow, crowded, or unclear about what to do next, Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn see fewer of the people who opened the app. The surface is live. You start from the app people already have, and you keep shipping on it.

The role is Staff Product Manager, Core UX. You write the vision for Home and the navigation, and you run the build with design and engineering. A design background is a requirement, because the work is the screen itself.

The Role

You are the product manager for Core UX on MetaMask mobile. You own the vision, the roadmap and the backlog for Home and the navigation, and you own whether that screen is working.

You will work closely with:

  • The Core UX engineering team
  • Design
  • Data and analytics
  • The product managers for Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn

Those products show up on Home. You own how a person reaches them from there, and how their balances and positions show up. Their roadmaps stay with their product managers. Yours is Home and the navigation.

The app is already live and people open it every day, so you start from what is there. You walk design leadership through the screen, and you are in the reviews where the layout gets decided.

What You'll Do

Set the Core UX vision

Write what Home is for, who has to succeed on it, and what it shows before anyone taps. Getting back to an open position has to be fast for people who already trade here. A first install still has to reach one real action in that same session.

Write down where a MetaMask person would already know what to tap, and where one of those apps does something we should study. Then write the roadmap, with the tradeoffs and the order, and what each step changes on Home.

Own Home, the navigation and the defaults

Own what a person sees when they open the app. That is balances, tokens and positions, and the way into Swap, Perps, Predict and Earn. A balance, a token, a position and an entry point are different, and Home has to show each one in a place the person can find.

Decide what Home shows before anyone taps. Anything past that waits until the person opens it. Put Swap, Perps and Predict close together for people who use more than one of them. A person using only one of those products still has to be able to finish their action.

Search and any assistance that sits on Home are part of this surface. You specify what stays on the screen, and what the person still confirms before money moves.

Get people to a first action, and get them to come back

You own the first session and the return after it. Count how many new wallets take a real action, and how many of those people open the app again. Define the path from the open to a confirmed action, and instrument it.

Review screens with design

You have a design background, and the role uses it. You review screens for hierarchy, type, spacing and what a tap does. You mark up a screen and say what should change, in writing, so design and engineering can build from the note.

You write the product point of view clearly enough that design and engineering can build it. You are in the design reviews. A crowded screen, or a tap that does the wrong thing, gets the specific change you want.

Work with the products that live on Home

Each MetaMask trade primitive already has their own product manager. You own the entry from Home and the way their positions and balances read there. When a change to Home helps one product and hurts another, you name the tradeoff in the spec.

You coordinate the sequencing when a Home change depends on one of those teams, or when one of their launches depends on Home. The spec says what Home will show on the day their change ships.

Run the work

You take a problem through spec, design, build, test and launch, and then you read what happened. You run planning and the backlog with the Core UX engineering team.

A feature is done when the edge cases are handled, the screen is fast enough to use, and we can see the result in the data. That includes an empty Home, a person who uses one product, and a person who uses several.

When something breaks, you write down what happened and what we will change in the screen or in the process, so the same break has a fix.

Who You Are

You have owned the main screen of a consumer product people open every day, and you stayed on it through launch. You can set a direction for that screen and stay with the tickets until it ships.

You:

  • Mark up a screen and say what the tap should do.
  • Know which KPI a given screen is supposed to impact, and tell a real move from noise.
  • Write a short spec that engineering and design can build, and use that same note when you walk a director through the decision.
  • Sit with someone who already uses the app and someone who just installed, and turn what they do into the next change on Home.
  • Work on a live product, where the screen is already open and the next change has to ship on top of it.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Software Engineer with a unique blend of accounting experience  who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

Sezzle Technical Stack:

  • Golang backend, React / React Native front-end
  • Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS
  • Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS
  • Gitlab CI/CD deployments
  • Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
  • Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Work as an integrated team member developing new features.
  • Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
  • Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
  • Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
  • Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

What We Look For:

  • Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
  • Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
  • Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with backend API development.
  • Experience with relational database storage and retrieval.
  • Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.
