jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
The Role

We are thrilled to be adding an Enterprise Sales Director to our team.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll source, develop, and land health systems clients throughout your US territory. You’ll quarterback your deals from start to finish, with the support of our VP of Sales, product and medical leadership, and our executive team.

In this role, you’re an evangelist and an expert in building out a territory to drive growth. Some of the major health systems you work with may have piloted several competitor solutions or some may have never tried AI within their health system. You’ll adapt your process to meet prospect where they’re at, engaging a wide range of champions, and build a solid foundational relationship for our Client Success team to launch from.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategically prospect into Chief Medical Officer, Chief Medical Information Officers and other leaders within health systems - from day one thinking strategically about how you can build out your territory

  • Establish and nurture relationships with key decision-makers in health systems and physician-led networks to implement pilot programs, measure their impact, and seamlessly transition successful pilots into long-term customer agreements.

  • Formulate and execute account plans, working closely with customers to create roadmaps for the full deployment of Nabla and plan for future expansion.

  • Meet and exceed sales targets, consistently driving revenue growth while collaborating with Client Success to ensure client expansion

  • Work cross functionally with product, support, legal, and marketing, to ensure the success of our customers and enable a cohesive customer experience.

  • Influence Nabla’s product roadmap based on customer needs and feedback, ensuring alignment with market demands.

  • Represent Nabla at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote our brand and generate leads.

  • Provide rigorous reporting on all sales activities, pipeline status, and forecasts to Nabla’s leadership within Hubspot. Strong cross departmental communication and collaboration

Qualifications:

We are seeking candidates with:

  • Minimum 5 + years of selling experience as a full cycle Account Executive navigating US healthcare sales in a startup environment

  • Minimum 3 + years in Enterprise sales, specifically to US health systems with a proven ability to develop strategies to convert competitive accounts

  • Self-starter with a strong sense of initiative and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions!

  • You are energized by a challenge and thrive finding ways to get creative in attacking deals

  • Deep understanding of the healthcare landscape, including familiarity with hospital operations, clinical workflows, and regulatory requirements.

  • Adept at navigating enterprise organizations with shifting priorities, connecting with multiple stakeholders at varying levels.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to establish rapport and credibility with C-suite executives and key stakeholders

  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in analyzing sales data and metrics.

  • Strong track record as an inspiring and effective leader and coach

Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must be able to maintain authorization to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship, now or in the future. For this role, the Company is not able to sponsor, transfer, or extend employment-based visas or other work authorization.

Benefits

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here are the benefits you get when joining Nabla:

  • Stock ownership offered to all employees.

  • Unlimited PTO, plus national holidays.

  • Unlimited sick days.

  • Remote-friendly — we know how to collaborate to drive results, regardless of location.

  • Culture of trust & accountability — your output matters more than your clock-in time.

  • Allocated budget so you can create a comfortable home office space tailored to your needs.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.

Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Principal Engineering Manager, AI Care
jobs.description:
About Pair Team

Pair Team is building a new kind of healthcare system across Medicaid, Medicare, and public assistance programs: one that recognizes that access to housing, nutritious food, and reliable transportation are just as critical to health as having the right medications or seeing a doctor.

As a public benefit corporation and AI-enabled medical group, we partner with shelters, food pantries, and community organizations to deliver “whole-person” care to the 115 million Americans who rely on the safety net. We are currently the largest complex care provider in California with over 500 employees and are expanding nationally. Our model replaces fragmented healthcare and social services systems with one trusted relationship for all medical, behavioral, and social needs. We improve access, build trust, and dramatically lower costs (52% fewer ER visits, 26% fewer hospitalizations). Our model is a rare combination of saving tax payer dollars ($150B annually at scale) while putting people on an upward life trajectory. At national scale, this approach would save taxpayers.

These outcomes are driven by the AI-first, whole-person infrastructure we are building — a platform that connects healthcare and social-service organizations into a unified network. Leveraging our vast data and years of operational experience, we are building the agentic infrastructure for the safety net to coordinate care, automate operations, and learn from every patient interaction to continuously improve outcomes.

Read more about the AI-First Medicaid System we are building here.

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most
  • TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team
  • Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity

As Principal Engineering Manager, AI Care, you’ll lead the team building agentic systems that participate directly in care delivery: coordinating care, engaging patients, and executing meaningful portions of care workflows. You’ll drive the strategy, roadmap and execution for autonomous care management – a new line of business and a strategic investment for the company. This highly collaborative position works closely with leadership, product, clinical, and operations to turn high-impact opportunities into shipped, working products rather than ideas built in a vacuum. You’ll also lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers, and communicate strategy, progress, and tradeoffs across the organization.

This is a fully remote position reporting up to the Senior Vice President, Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and evolution of agentic systems that participate directly in care delivery, helping coordinate care, engage patients, and execute meaningful portions of care workflows.
  • Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for agentic AI initiatives, partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership to identify high-impact opportunities and align technical investments with business goals.
  • Define and build architectural patterns for agent reasoning, tool use, memory, and human-in-the-loop collaboration.
  • Develop both reusable platform capabilities and product-facing implementations, balancing long-term architecture with rapid iteration.
  • Establish standards and best practices for agent evaluation, safety, and operational reliability as these systems evolve toward greater autonomy
  • Drive execution across complex, multi-disciplinary initiatives, establishing clear priorities, coordinating engineering efforts, and ensuring teams deliver high-quality outcomes effectively.
  • Serve as the technical and organizational leader for the team, communicating strategy, progress, and tradeoffs to leadership and cross-functional partners while driving alignment across the broader organization.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Who You'll Need

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the Staff or Principal level.
  • 2+ years leading or managing engineers, or record of mentoring engineers and building a culture of ownership, velocity and high standards.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, not just prototypes.

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mobile Engineer to own our mobile experience across iOS and Android using React Native. This will be the first time many users interact with Fin, so your work will define how our product feels in the real world. You will turn messy real world payment flows into simple, intuitive interfaces, and help hide the complexity of crypto, wallets, and cross border settlement behind a smooth mobile experience.

You will work closely with the founders and the rest of the engineering team, make foundational decisions about architecture and design, and ship features from idea to production. If you care about building delightful consumer products on top of serious infrastructure, this is for you.

We value your time: our process focuses on practical system design and architectural discussions, not LeetCode grinding or unpaid take-home assignments.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Fin mobile app across iOS and Android using React Native, from architecture to implementation and polish.

  • Design and implement flows that make sending, receiving, and managing money feel simple and trustworthy for everyday users.

  • Help design secure account and custody patterns that can scale to handle meaningful balances and real world usage.

  • Collaborate with design and product to prototype, refine, and ship new features quickly.

  • Maintain a high bar for code quality through thoughtful architecture, code review, and testing.

  • Work with backend and infra engineers to integrate APIs, payments, and identity or security features into the mobile app.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience building and shipping mobile apps in React Native. Deep familiarity with the Expo ecosystem and modern mobile build pipelines (EAS) is required.

  • Strong product sense and attention to detail in UI and UX, especially for consumer facing apps.

  • Solid understanding of mobile app architecture, performance, and offline or edge cases.

  • Ability to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects from idea to shipped.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating with design, product, and backend teams.

  • Interest in payments, fintech, or crypto. You do not need to be a chain maximalist, but curiosity about the space helps.

Bonus Points

  • You have shipped an app from concept to production in a small team or as the primary developer.

  • Experience in EITHER traditional consumer fintech apps (neobanks, peer-to-peer payments) OR mobile crypto wallets (Solana, non-custodial, etc).

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS.

  • Experience deploying smart contracts on Solana or integrating with blockchain based systems.

  • Background in security, threat modeling, or penetration testing, especially for consumer finance products.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You're an AI-native product leader and builder who thrives in high-ownership environments. You're energized by the full spectrum of the job — from iterating on live features to investing in greenfield 0→1 bets — and you have the judgment to know when to pursue each. You're comfortable in ambiguity, decisive under pressure, and relentless about customer and business impact.

You will succeed in this role if you are:

  • Focused on customer and business impact. You care about creating real value for educators and families, and about proving a business that's worth growing

  • A practitioner-builder. You don't lead from a distance. You use AI and modern tooling in your own work to build, prototype, and learn, and to show what great looks like

  • Motivated by ownership. You want a large surface area and the full portfolio that comes with it — from finding product-market fit and proving out a business model on a 0→1 bet, to removing pain points on existing, heavily used features

  • A generalist by instinct. You're drawn to whichever problem matters most right now, and you don't need the problem space to be familiar to make progress in it

What You’ll Do

Brightwheel sits at the center of early education, trusted by tens of thousands of schools and millions of families. We have more high-value opportunities than we have product managers, and you'll own one of them end to end.

The most likely starting point is enrollment — how schools fill their open seats and keep the families they already have. A center licensed for 50 children running at 42 is leaving real money on the table every month, and today the work of chasing inquiries, running tours, and confirming re-enrollment happens across inboxes and spreadsheets. Some of what schools need already exists in brightwheel. Some of it doesn't. You'll build both, and build the business around it.

This is an individual contributor role with significant scope — one of the broadest product mandates at brightwheel, with direct partnership with our CEO and executive team from day one.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the vision, strategy, and execution for a high-impact product area — from growing what already works to defining and launching what doesn't exist yet

  • Make the case for where we invest next, with evidence — including what to stop

  • Set appetite, scope accordingly, and hold your team to a high bar on speed, quality, and customer impact

  • Shape pricing and go-to-market for new capabilities you launch — from packaging to validating willingness to pay

  • Drive AI into the product in ways that genuinely improve outcomes for providers, staff, and families — not as a checkbox

  • Define success metrics, track performance, and communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly to leadership

  • Partner tightly with engineering and design to ship with urgency, unblock the team, and keep them focused on what matters

  • Contribute to brightwheel's product culture — raise the bar for product quality, velocity, and customer impact

What You've Done

We are open to a variety of backgrounds, but qualified candidates usually bring:

  • A record of building products customers love. You have the product taste and judgment to know what to build and what to leave out, and the customer empathy to find real needs before the data exists

  • Something taken from 0→1. You've built something new and gotten it to real customer pull, and you can point to the signal that proved it

  • Proven ownership of complex, cross-functional product initiatives with measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Strong product judgment and prioritization. You know what to work on, what to cut, and can drive alignment while balancing speed, quality, and learning

  • Communication and presence. You can set a vision, align an executive team, and inspire the builders who join you

  • Applied AI in your own work. You use AI and modern tooling to build and ship faster, and to go deeper across disciplines

  • Experience building and shipping AI-powered product features (bonus)

  • SaaS background, especially in products with complex operational workflows (bonus)

What Sets You Apart

The candidates who will thrive in this role go beyond strong product management:

  • You are a multidisciplinary builder. You move across product, design, engineering, and data, and you use AI to go deeper in each

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You make confident calls when there is no playbook and no data, and you follow the data the moment it exists

  • You think like an owner of the business, from the customer problem to the path to business impact, and you bring an executive team along with a clear, compelling vision

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Protecting Our Applicants: Please be aware of recruiting scams impersonating Brightwheel. All legitimate communications come from @mybrightwheel.com addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com. Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Australia
URL: https://www.goodbyegoodboy.com.au

At Goodbye Good Boy, we provide compassionate end of life services, supporting veterinary clinics and the families they care for during one of life’s most difficult moments.

Having experienced firsthand how overwhelming pet loss can be, we built a service focused on support, simplicity, and genuine care. Backed by more than 1,000 five-star reviews we are making a real difference and we want like minded people to join us on the journey.


So what is the role, exactly?

We’re looking for an empathetic, tech-savvy communicator with exceptional attention to detail to join our customer care team. You’ll guide and support families through one of their most vulnerable times. It’s no stretch to say this is one of the most important roles in the company.

This is a phone-based role, helping families arrange in-home euthanasia and pet cremation. You’ll take the time to listen, show them you care, and coordinate and communicate every step of the process.

That makes sense, but what would my day to day look like?

Families come to us looking for guidance, empathy and support as they arrange their pet’s end-of-life care. Each day, you’ll be:

  • Answering a high volume of inbound calls.

  • Offering thoughtful guidance as families consider the right time to say goodbye.

  • Being a trusted guide throughout the arrangement process.

  • Navigating multiple online systems with speed and accuracy.

  • Liaising with our veterinary team to find available appointment times.

  • Coordinating with our crematorium team and external partners to arrange services.

  • Supporting multiple families at once, following a structured workflow so every family receives the same outstanding care. The ability to multitask is a must!

You’ll report to our Customer Support Team Leader and work alongside a team of amazing, like-minded people.

OK, sounds great. Who are you looking for?

This is a hard but incredibly impactful role. Families come to us in all kinds of circumstances, trusting us to guide them through a difficult part of their lives.

You’ll need:

  • A genuine desire to offer empathy and support to pet parents from all walks of life.

  • Confidence guiding people who need thoughtful, non-judgemental support.

  • The ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfort using technology and following processes.

  • The ability to take the lead in a conversation and build trust.

Most importantly, we want someone who believes in our mission. Everyone at Goodbye Good Boy is driven by the impact of our work, and we want that to continue with every person who joins our team.

We operate seven days a week, supporting families from 7am–8:30pm Monday to Saturday and 8am–6pm Sunday (AEST).

You must be available for at least four eight-hour shifts per week, including Saturdays, plus a rotating Sunday shift at least one in every three weekends. Ideally available for 30 hours per week. 

What’s in it for me?

We’re a passionate team on a mission to bring positive change to the pet end-of-life industry. We’re incredibly proud of our work, celebrate our many milestones, and take immense pride in the difference we make for the families we have the privilege to serve.

We value our team’s contributions and offer:

  • $33.50 per hour on weekdays.

  • $45 per hour for all Saturday hours.

  • $50 per hour for all Sunday hours.

The main reason you’ll join, though, is because you believe in what we do and are excited to help transform an industry.

Sound like you? Apply now with your CV and a cover letter telling us why you want to be part of Goodbye Good Boy.



\n


\n

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer.

About the job

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.
  • Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.
  • Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.
  • Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.
  • Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).
  • Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.
  • Write well-designed, testable code.
  • Document and maintain software functionality.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 0-2 years of work experience building highly scalable products.
  • Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.
  • Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases.
  • Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.
  • Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.
  • Clear written and spoken communication skills.
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired:

  • Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation.
  • Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.
  • Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.
  • Experience optimizing and debugging SQL queries.
  • Experience working on customer-facing applications.
  • Good debugging skills on production systems.
  • Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.
  • Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.
.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will independently define and lead complex investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, prioritize work based on risk, develop new attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will combine practical AI security expertise with broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering teams, you will translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership through verified outcomes are essential to the role. You will help shape the Red Team’s technical direction while strengthening its tools, research methods, and testing practices. Alongside experienced researchers, you will bring your own areas of expertise, investigate emerging technologies, and advance Dropbox’s offensive security capabilities, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, publish research, and see your work directly influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.
  • Share research, mentor colleagues and improve the team’s methods through lessons from completed work.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 9+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Platform Database Engineer to join our team to drive improvements to our internal databases.

The focus of this role is around owning stability and deployment of our internal databases. Supabase’s internal databases are the backbone of our service offerings. You will play a critical role in architecture and optimizations of the databases in partnership with the platform service teams, both strategically and tactically.

In this role, your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Partnering closely with service teams to understand their workloads and growth, so our databases are sized, configured, and pooled to sustain current and future load.

  • Performance tuning AWS RDS instances running postgres

  • Automation and Improvement to operations, including infrastructure as code and scripting

  • Schema and query optimizations across multiple services

  • Timely PostgreSQL major, minor, and extension upgrades.

  • Engaging in proactive identification and resolution of production issues in customer deployments.

  • Spearheading the creation of best practices, tools, and tests to ensure enhanced stability and decreased deployment risks over time (minimal downtime, blue/green deployments, rollback plans).

  • Incident response, including driving RCA and followups.

What we need

This role demands the following pivotal qualities:

  1. AWS RDS + PostgreSQL Expert: A profound understanding of PostgreSQL running on RDS and its associated tools (AWS Aurora experience also great!) . Familiarity with extensions, performance optimization, and best practices is essential. Experience with connection management (RDS proxy, Pgbouncer, Supervisor) is a huge plus.

  2. Infrastructure Obsessed: Proven expertise in infrastructure management, tooling, and optimization.

  3. Optimization Wizard. Engages across the full stack to identify bottlenecks and drives deep changes (architectural, code, process) that will completely resolve the challenge.

  4. Self-directed & Bias Towards Action: At Supabase, we value independence and proactive problem-solving, driving clarity in complex situations. We anticipate you to be a dynamic self-starter, thriving in asynchronous collaboration across diverse teams. Your knack for spotting areas of improvement and commitment to realizing those enhancements will be key. You'd rather ship a safe, incremental fix today than wait for the perfect redesign next quarter.

What you’ll do

  • Improve the utility and efficiency of our PostgreSQL offerings.

  • Drive best practices across service teams; assisting with migrations and operations

  • Own tooling and solutions within the Supabase ecosystem.

Must haves

  • 3+ years experience with PostgreSQL in AWS setting (RDS or Aurora).

  • 3+ years experience with infrastructure as code technology (terraform, pulumi)

  • Computer Science Bachelors (or related field)

  • Located in EU region

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Content Designer II
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote UK

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

At Affirm, we’re reimagining how people access and experience financial products. Our commitment to clarity, honesty, and empathy fuels every design decision across all of our user experiences. We’re looking for a Content Designer II to help create clear, useful, trustworthy, and compelling product experiences that make it easier for people to understand and use Affirm.

 

About the team

In this role, you’ll work as an embedded partner on a product team, collaborating closely with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience. You’ll help design and improve product experiences from discovery through launch, experimentation, and optimization, with a focus on both thoughtful content strategy and precise UX writing.

You’ll bring strong writing skills, customer empathy, and product thinking to important product work. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, explain your rationale clearly, and advocate for simple, transparent experiences that help customers make informed decisions. You’ll use content strategy, systems thinking, and UX writing to help teams create experiences that are simple, transparent, and customer-centered.

You’ll also contribute to Affirm’s growing Content Design practice by sharing feedback, participating in team rituals, helping strengthen guidelines and patterns, and partnering with other content designers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, curious, and customer-oriented content designer who is ready to grow their craft while making meaningful contributions to product experiences.


What You’ll Do

  • Contribute content design to product work, shaping user flows, information architecture, content hierarchy, UX writing, and customer communications across web and native app experiences.

  • Work cross-functionally with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience from early ideas through launch and optimization.

  • Help teams understand customer problems, identify content and usability opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how product experiences should work and communicate.

  • Write clear, accurate, concise, and human product content across in-product flows, notifications, emails, text messages, prototypes, and other customer touchpoints.

  • Use research, experimentation, customer feedback, and data to improve content decisions, usability, and customer understanding.

  • Participate in design sprints, critique, content reviews, and product discussions as an advocate for clarity, accessibility, and content-first design.

  • Help strengthen Affirm’s content design practice by contributing to style guides, writing guidelines, reusable patterns, team artifacts, and shared ways of working.


What We Look For

  • 2+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, or a related field, with experience designing for web and native digital products.

  • A portfolio that shows strong UX writing craft, strategic thinking, and shipped product experiences across in-app, web, or other customer touchpoints.

  • Strong understanding of UX writing, information architecture, content hierarchy, usability, accessibility, research, experimentation, and product development.

  • Ability to work independently on defined projects, navigate ambiguity with support, connect content decisions to customer needs and business goals, and move work forward with care.

  • Experience collaborating with PMs, designers, researchers, engineers, legal, compliance, marketing, or brand partners to shape clear and effective product experiences.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain rationale, invite feedback, build alignment, and advocate for the customer.

  • Nice to have: experience in financial services, regulated industries, native app experiences, design systems, lifecycle communications, or AI-enabled content workflows.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Pay Grade: J

Equity Grade: UK 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness, and tech spending, and benefits including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental, and vision for you and your dependents. In addition, employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc.

GBR base pay range per year: £80,000 - 118,000

Location: Remote UK

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Creative Engineer, Stripe Creative Lab
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, US, Canada, Remote

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.


About the team

Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling. 

Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

About Stripe Creative Lab

Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

 

What you’ll do

You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

Responsibilities

  • Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools
  • Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better
  • Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it
  • Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work
  • Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects
  • Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them
  • Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner
  • Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

 

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience
  • Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies
  • A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology
  • Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences
  • Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it
  • Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence
  • Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with realtime graphics, WebGL, WebGPU, Three.js, shaders, animation, generative systems, or other forms of creative coding
  • Experience working with hardware, physical computing, embedded systems, sensors, displays, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, or interactive installations
  • Familiarity with backend development, APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, or other areas beyond frontend engineering
  • Experience collaborating with designers, artists, fabricators, creative studios, or other multidisciplinary partners
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, and directing outside technical specialists when a project extends beyond your own expertise
  • Deep curiosity about technology, design, craft, and the ways new technical capabilities can enable new forms of creative work

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-creative-engineer-stripe-creative-lab

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

Our Sales Development team play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will:

  • Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to handle a high volume of leads efficiently

jobs.title: Lead Growth Analyst
jobs.description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are.

In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. You will take ownership of analytical workstreams end to end, from framing the business question and exploring the data through to clear recommendations and supporting execution.

A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. You will bring together signals from channel performance, customer behaviour and experimentation to understand what is driving performance.

You will partner closely with Growth, Marketing and Product teams, acting as a trusted thought partner.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement.

  • Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over.

    Identify and size growth opportunities across channels, customer journeys and Product.

  • Support investment decisions by bringing together MMM, channel performance and customer behaviour.

  • Build clear growth narratives from complex analysis, translating data into concise, understandable insights with a strong “so what”, and clearly articulating the implications and actions for stakeholders.

  • Contribute to wider commercial questions such as forecasting, pricing and scenario analysis where they materially affect growth.

  • Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making.

  • Act as a trusted analytical partner, bringing a clear analytical point of view that shapes key growth decisions.

  • Own key stakeholder relationships and help ensure analytical recommendations are followed through into action and measurable impact.

  • Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team.

Experience and competencies

  • Significant experience in growth, marketing, or commercial analytics within a digital, marketplace, subscription or consumer technology business.
  • Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product.
  • Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys.
  • Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution.
  • Proven ability to independently structure and lead complex or ambiguous analytical work.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move from analysis to clear recommendations.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, influencing without authority and partnering closely with leadership teams.
    Flexible and open-minded, able to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
  • Clear, confident communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills.

Tools and technical skills

  • Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns
  • Familiarity with analytical tools and languages such as Python or R.
  • Experience working with marketing and experimentation data from major digital platforms and internal data warehouses (we use Databricks).
  • Practical understanding of advanced measurement methodologies and their limitations in real-world decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Products
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

When the world's largest organizations bet on Mural, Govern & Trust is the team that earns that trust at scale. We build the experiences that help enterprises roll out Mural with confidence, keep it secure, and see the impact it has on how their people work. Data sits at the center of it all. Admins are Mural's most demanding data consumers: they need to prove ROI to their leadership, guide adoption across thousands of people, and account for every action. If data products can meet their bar, they'll work for everyone.

Mural has a modern data platform, strong data engineering and analytics teams, and a wealth of data on how teams collaborate. The next step is treating that data as a product in its own right, with a dedicated owner for what it means and how it's used.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Product Manager you'll define the metrics that describe how Mural creates value, and make them the shared foundation for everything built on top. The same definitions will power internal product decisions, the Insights experience Admins use in the product, and the reporting API and MCP server that customers and AI agents query.

This role starts upstream. You'll work from raw product events to decide what each metric should measure, how it's calculated, and what the data needs to look like for customers and internal teams to rely on it. Then you'll turn those metrics into experiences that help organizations understand and grow their use of Mural.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • The evolution of data products. Shape how Mural's data products move from reporting on what happened to guiding what happens next. Work across the Govern & Trust portfolio to define how insights become part of how organizations run Mural.

  • The metric layer. Define Mural's shared, cross-product metrics, like activity, collaboration, and adoption. Set the standards that let product teams define and publish their own metrics consistently. Data Engineering builds and runs the layer; you shape what goes in it and how it evolves.

  • Internal product analytics. Be a thought partner to domain PMs as they set their north-star metrics, and make product data easy for them to explore on their own. Work with Business Analytics to keep product-facing and business-facing reporting working together.

  • Customer-facing data products. Own the strategy and roadmap for Insights: in-product reporting and dashboards, exports and APIs, audit logs, and the methodology behind every number customers see.

  • AI and agent access. Package and launch Mural's customer-facing reporting MCP server: which data it exposes, which plans get it, and what guardrails apply. Define how natural-language and agent-driven analysis extends Insights.

  • Instrumentation. R&D teams own emitting events. Your job is to raise the bar on what they emit. Set per-product requirements for granularity and retention, which differ for audit logs, activity data, and product analytics. Partner with Data Engineering on event standards so metrics start from good data.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping at least one analytics or reporting product used by paying business customers. You defined the metrics behind it, not just the UI.

  • A track record of making messy or conflicting data trustworthy: reconciling competing definitions, writing metric specs engineers could build from, and getting instrumentation changed upstream.

  • Experience building both platform products, where your customers are internal teams or developers, and end-user-facing data products like analytics, reporting, or insights. You understand how the two have to work together.

  • Working knowledge of modern data stacks: event pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses, dbt-style modeling, and semantic layers. You can write SQL and pull data yourself.

  • The ability to get agreement on definitions across teams you don't manage, including PMs, data engineering, analytics, finance, and go-to-market.

  • Experience with enterprise admin or governance products (IAM, security, compliance, audit)

  • Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, LookML)

  • Experience designing APIs, MCP servers, or connectors for analytics

Equal Opportunity
