jobs.title: Employee Experience Director
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Abu Dhabi, UAE; APAC - Remote; Dubai, UAE; Europe - Remote; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; UK - Remote

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with a distributed workforce operating across many countries and time zones around the clock. Our people work in a fast-moving, highly regulated industry where speed, trust, and clarity matter every day.
This is a new role. As Bybit scales, how people experience the company has to be designed on purpose, not left to chance. The Head of Employee Experience & Innovation will build that experience end to end: the offices we work in, how employees hear from leadership, how we come together, and how engaged and connected people feel.

Mission

Make Bybit a place where talented people across every location feel informed, connected, and able to do their best work, and use data and new ideas, including AI, to keep improving that experience as we grow.

Key responsibilities

Employee engagement

  • Design and run the employee listening strategy: engagement surveys, pulse checks, lifecycle surveys, and exit insights.
  • Turn results into action plans with leaders, and track progress so employees see their feedback lead to change.
  • Shape the employee journey from onboarding to exit, removing friction at key moments.
  • Lead recognition programs and culture initiatives that reinforce Bybit's values.
  • Build community and belonging programs, including employee networks and wellbeing initiatives.

Internal events

  • Own the internal events calendar: all-hands, town halls, leadership offsites, team celebrations, and company milestones.
  • Deliver events across locations and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) with clear goals, budgets, and measures of success.
  • Ensure events are inclusive and respectful of the cultural and religious diversity of our workforce.
  • Manage vendors, budgets, and logistics with strong cost discipline.

Internal communications

  • Build the internal communications strategy and editorial calendar.
  • Own and manage all internal communications channels: the intranet, company newsletter, all-company email, Slack or Lark channels, office digital screens, and leadership updates.
  • Own intranet content management end to end: content strategy, site structure, governance, publishing workflows, and keeping information accurate and current.
  • Set content standards and train content owners across functions so every team publishes clearly and consistently.
  • Partner with the CEO, executives, and the CPO on leadership messaging, change communications, and announcements.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Compliance so sensitive or regulated messages are accurate and consistent.
  • Measure reach and understanding, and keep improving how information flows across the company.

Innovation

  • Bring new tools and ideas to the employee experience, including AI-enabled self-service, chat assistants, and automation of routine People processes.
  • Run small pilots, measure results, and scale what works.
  • Work with HR Technology and IT to keep the People tech stack simple, connected, and easy to use.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team across the four areas above.
  • Own the function's budget and vendor relationships.
  • Serve as a member of the People Leadership Team and a trusted partner to senior business leaders.

Workplace operations

  • Lead the global Workplace Operations team that manages Bybit's offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Malaysia, and other offices across APAC and EMEA.
  • Own office strategy and space planning, including openings, moves, expansions, and fit-outs, in partnership with Finance.
  • Set consistent workplace standards across all sites: facilities, health and safety, front desk, amenities, and spaces that support diverse needs such as prayer and wellness rooms.
  • Manage facilities vendors, service contracts, and office budgets with strong cost discipline.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Legal on physical security, access, business continuity, and emergency response.
  • Use occupancy data and employee feedback to design offices people want to work in.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

Area
Outcome
Workplace operations
Consistent workplace standards across all four office locations; office space plan and budget agreed with Finance
Engagement
Company-wide listening program launched, with action plans owned by every executive
Internal events
Annual events calendar and budget set; flagship all-hands and leadership offsite delivered
Internal communications
Intranet organized with clear content owners and governance; channel strategy and editorial rhythm in place
Innovation
At least two People experience pilots (e.g., AI self-service) tested and measured
Team
Function fully staffed with clear roles and goals

What you bring

Requirements

  • 12+ years in People, employee experience, workplace, or internal communications, with 5+ years leading teams.
  • Proven ownership of at least two of: multi-country workplace or office operations, employee engagement, internal communications, or large-scale internal events.
  • Experience managing an intranet or other internal communications platforms, including content governance.
  • Experience in a high-growth, global company with employees in multiple countries.
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable turning survey, occupancy, and channel data into decisions.
  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment, including drafting for senior executives.
  • Track record of managing budgets and vendors.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience working in the Gulf region and across Asia and Europe.
  • Hands-on use of AI and automation to improve employee services.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, engagement, and communications platforms (e.g., Workday, Culture Amp, Lark, Slack).
  • Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

  • Builder. You create programs from a blank page and scale them as the company grows.
  • Data-driven. You measure what matters and use it to decide where to invest.
  • Executive presence. You earn the trust of the CEO and senior leaders and can push back with care.
  • Global mindset. You design for many cultures, languages, and time zones, not one headquarters.
  • Bias for action. You move fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn't work.
  • Integrity. You handle sensitive information and messages with discretion and judgment.
Why Join Us
 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-employee-experience-director

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core
 
 

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannotbe crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite
  • Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.
  • Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring orescalation.
  • Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.
  • Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.
  • Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals and subsequent changes.
  • Support post-launch monitoring, control testing and assurance in partnership with Audit, Product and other Compliance teams, and drive remediation of identified issues
  • Promote a compliance-by-design culture within the product lifecycle; communicate the Product Compliance framework and program requirements to relevant stakeholders and deliver targeted training or guidance to Product, Engineering and business teams as required.
  • Support special projects and priority product launches in a fast-paced and continually evolving environment.
 

What We Look For In You

  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in Compliance, Legal or Risk within financial services, fintech, payments or the cryptocurrency industry.
  • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, business, economics, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Significant hands-on experience in product compliance, regulatory advisory or product risk assessment, including advising on new products and material product changes
  • Strong understanding of the digital-asset industry and the products offered by crypto platforms, including trading, custody, payments, staking or earn products, lending, structured products, wallets or DeFi.
  • Strong working knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements, including licensing and regulatory-perimeter considerations, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions and trading or market-conduct requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze products or initiatives involving significant complexity and risk and translate regulatory requirements into practical product requirements and controls.
  • Experience in and demonstrated success in leveraging AI-enabled technology to maintain risk assessment standards, including ongoing tuning of agentic skills aligned with the Company’s risk appetite.
  • Excellent risk judgment and the ability to balance compliance rigor with a pragmatic, risk-based approach that supports responsible commercial outcomes.
  • Proven ability to develop and deliver repeatable product compliance solutions, controls and review processes aligned with broader group requirements.
  • Strong project-management and execution skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent reviews, maintain accurate documentation and meet product-launch deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clear recommendations and lead discussions with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, senior management and other Compliance stakeholders.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner/Senior Recruiter, Technical and Product
jobs.description:
D2L is a cloud company that is modernizing education and building the Future of Work. The old models of teaching and learning are in the midst of the largest transformation in history, and D2L is at the heart of that fundamental shift.

New models of teaching and learning enable a personalized, student-centric experience – and deliver improved retention, engagement, satisfaction, and results for learners of all ages – in schools, campuses, and companies.

D2L is disrupting the way the world learns, by providing the next generation learning environment and solutions to engage and inspire learners. And most importantly, by giving customers a platform that is easy, flexible, and smart. No other company provides a solution as robust and innovative as D2L.

D2L has had a singular mission for over 25 years and is dedicated to that same mission in the years ahead: to transform the way the world learns – and by doing so, we will help improve human potential globally.

D2L has a hybrid working model based on proximity to our working spaces. We hire both remotely, and hybrid out of our office locations.

While we use AI tools internally to streamline tasks like meeting notes, summaries, and administrative work, these tools never rank resumes, make hiring decisions, or influence candidate evaluations.

As the Talent Acquisition Partner focused on Technical and Product Recruitment, you will help build teams that create and improve D2L products. Reporting to the TA Operations Lead, you will own and prioritize full-cycle searches and advise hiring managers on how to attract and assess experienced technical and product talent.

You understand the requirements behind technical and product roles and can help teams build clear, job-related interview processes. You will bring market insight, thoughtful sourcing and strong candidate advocacy to every search. Our approach is high-tech and high touch: we pair effective recruiting practices with a responsive and inclusive candidate experience.

How Will I Make an Impact?:

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for assigned technical and product roles, from intake and search strategy through offer, close and transition to onboarding. Occasional recruitment for other functions as needed.
  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify business needs, role outcomes, level, essential qualifications and decision criteria; shape clear job descriptions and realistic hiring plans.
  • Recruit for experienced and senior roles across software engineering, architecture, product management, data, design, security, infrastructure and other business units depending on capacity and needs.
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies and talent pipelines using research, networks, referrals, social platforms and other appropriate channels, including outreach to passive candidates.
  • Build a working understanding of each role’s scope, technical context, level and core competencies so you can ask useful intake questions and advise on candidate profiles.
  • Help design interview plans with hiring teams: clarify what each stage should assess, who should participate and how interviewers will capture job-related evidence.
  • Prepare interviewers to use consistent questions and assessment criteria; support calibration and debriefs so teams can make timely, evidence-based decisions.
  • Keep candidates informed, set expectations, gather feedback and provide a responsive, respectful and inclusive experience throughout the process.
  • Advise on market conditions, talent availability, compensation considerations and search trade-offs; surface risks early and recommend practical options.
  • Maintain accurate requisition and candidate records in the ATS and related People systems. Use recruiting data to monitor pipeline health, service levels, bottlenecks and outcomes.
  • Partner with the TA Operations Lead and People & Culture colleagues to improve recruiting practices, share expertise and contribute to TA programs processes and strategy.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, complex environment, including searches for experienced or senior technical and/or product talent.
  • Experience partnering with technical or product leaders to define role requirements, calibrate profiles and build effective interview processes.
  • Strong consultative partnership skills, with the ability to influence, coach and communicate clearly with candidates, hiring managers and senior stakeholders.
  • Confidence with sourcing tools, an ATS and recruiting data; sound judgment, organization and follow-through across competing priorities.
  • A collaborative, accountable approach and commitment to inclusive hiring and a high-quality candidate experience.
  • Education or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business or a related field is an asset.

How success is measured

  • Hiring managers and candidates receive clear, timely communication and consistent, high-quality recruitment experience.
  • Evaluates progress against agreed priorities and service expectations, with risks surfaced early and decisions supported by relevant evidence.
  • Interviews and follow-up are coordinated effectively across regions and time zones.
  • Talent pipelines are appropriately targeted; ATS records and reporting are accurate and useful.

Location Requirements:

Kitchener, Toronto, or Remote in Ontario; our Kitchener and Toronto offices have hybrid in-office expectations.

This posting is for an existing vacancy

The expected base salary range for a new hire in this role is listed below. The annualized base salary offered is determined by each candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, education, training and experience. It is aligned to ensure both internal and external competitiveness using market data for the geographic location and industry. As part of the total compensation at D2L the role may be eligible for additional benefits including a Wellness Subsidy, Equity Grants, Variable Incentive, and more.

Base Salary Range

$80,000—$95,000 CAD

Don’t meet every single requirement? We strongly encourage you to still apply! At D2L, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. We encourage your application even if you don't believe you meet every single qualification outlined, because we love to help our people grow and develop!

Why we're awesome:

At D2L, we are dedicated to providing you with the tools to do the best work of your life. While some of our perks and benefits may vary depending on location or employment type, we are proud to provide employees with the following through #LifeAtD2L:

The role involves regular in-person work, driving and occasional international travel. Time-sensitive requests may require evening or weekend support within an agreed schedule.

  • Strong written and spoken English and French, and confidence in communicating with service providers and public offices.

  • A valid driving licence and confidence driving as part of the role.

  • Excellent organisation, discretion and sound judgment when handling changing priorities and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with calendars, spreadsheets and task trackers. Experience using ChatGPT or Claude for research and drafting, with the ability to verify outputs.

Nice to have

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

jobs.title: Sr. Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Your role in our mission

We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently.

This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors.

The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Partner with engineering and product teams to define and implement security requirements for applications, APIs, microservices, and AI systems (AI platform foundations, AI agents, MCP/tool integrations) during design and architecture reviews.

  • Conduct in-house penetration testing, secure code reviews, and threat modeling for high-impact features, including AI-specific threat models covering models, retrieval, tools, identity, and data flows.

  • Plan and execute AI red teaming: prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, data exfiltration through tools, excessive agency, and output abuse.

  • Design and implement AI defenses such as guardrails, input/output filtering, gateway controls, least-privilege tool scopes, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, logging, and kill switches.

  • Lead application vulnerability management, including triaging and driving the remediation of security findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, and penetration tests.

  • Consult and advise cross-functional teams (engineering, SRE, product) on secure coding practices, security architecture, and remediation strategies.

  • Establish and maintain application security and secure AI development standards, guidelines, and best practices, aligned with OWASP, NIST, ISO, and industry frameworks.

  • Stay up-to-date on emerging security threats, especially the fast-moving AI attack landscape, to continuously improve Prosper’s security posture.

Skills that will help you thrive

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, with 8+ years of relevant experience (or Master’s degree with 6+ years).

  • Strong hands-on experience in application security, secure coding, and penetration testing.

  • Development background with expertise in Java/Python, SQL, JavaScript, including scripting against model APIs to build test harnesses and automation

  • Experience working with modern web application frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, .NET, J2EE, Rails, REST, SOAP).

  • In-depth understanding of web and API security vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, CWE).

  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization protocols (e.g., OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).

  • Knowledge of application security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST) and methodologies.

  • Proven experience working with DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, integrating security tools and automation.

  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and regulatory frameworks (e.g., PCI DSS, GDPR, SOC 2).

Extra credit

  • Knowledge of cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Security experience in Agile, CI/CD, and fast-paced product development environments.

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, GWAPT, CEH, GPEN, CISSP.

  • Familiarity with mobile application security testing and API security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Postman, ZAP, Insomnia).

  • Knowledge of network security, infrastructure security, and microservices architecture.

  • Experience driving secure SDLC initiatives and developer security education.

Resources to help you prosper

  • A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.
  • Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.
  • Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.
  • Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

Interview process

  • Recruiter Call: A brief screening to discuss your experience and initial questions.
  • Department Interview: Deeper dive into technical skills and project alignment with the Hiring Manager or team member.
  • Technical Interview: Deeper dive into coding skills.
  • Team Interview: Meet team members for collaborative discussions, problem-solving, or technical exercises.

Compensation

Compensation details: The salary for this position is $190k - $220k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits. In determining your salary, we will consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

The Role

We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar.

We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool.

Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition.

Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's.

If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards baked in, we want to talk.

You'll report directly to our Chief Growth Officer (who spent his career building and leading marketing, growth, and product organizations at companies like Twilio, Plaid, and Salesforce). You'll work with our CEO, CTO, and a small, senior, fast-moving team across product, engineering, and growth.

What You'll Do

  • Extend and refine the Nash visual identity across motion, web, print, environmental, campaign, and product surfaces

  • Build the brand platform: prompt libraries, LLM-readable brand documentation, component systems, and template kits that let the whole team produce on-brand work with AI

  • Own the marketing site (fully Claude-coded): evolve it, ship new pages, raise the bar for craft and interaction

  • Create the work that wasn't possible before: generative illustrations, interactive explainers, AI-driven animations, brand content that would have taken a full studio and now takes you and a prompt

  • Produce the visual layer of the growth engine: decks, one-pagers, customer materials

  • Own booth and experiential design for trade shows (NRF, Manifest, Shoptalk) where Nash shows up with installations, not just a banner

  • Set the standard for craft and fix the system when something falls short, not just the artifact

Requirements

  • 6+ years in brand or visual design with a portfolio showing real range: identity, web, motion, campaign, systems

  • Has extended or evolved a brand at a high-growth technology company

  • AI-obsessed. Daily use of Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Cursor, or equivalent. Can show us the workflow, not just the outputs. If your portfolio is full of beautiful work but none of it involved AI, this is not the role

  • Systems thinker who can build a design kit, a prompt library, and a brand doc an LLM can reason against

  • Comfortable in Figma, After Effects, and Illustrator; bonus if you can ship a page with Claude Code

  • Treats taste as the skill that matters most, and AI as the tool that makes taste scale

How to Apply

We don't want your resume. We want to see your taste and how you apply it through tools.

Go to nash.ai. Look at our brand: read how we built it and explore the brand system. Then show us one example of how you would take something we already have and make it better. A tighter page. A motion concept. A campaign direction. An illustration style. A prompt template that generates on-brand output. Whatever catches your eye. Show us how you used AI to make it: the workflow, prompts, or system behind it, not just the output.

Send it however you want: a Figma file, a Replit prototype, a Loom, a PDF, a Claude artifact. No format requirements. Just the design idea.

Keep it small: an hour or two is plenty, and rough is fine. We're looking for your thinking and taste, not a finished deliverable. It stays yours.

A work sample is required to apply. Share it as a link or a file upload on the application form. Applications without one won't be reviewed.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.title: Virtual Assistant - AI, Marketing and Operations
jobs.description:
Virtual Assistant: Marketing and Operations

About Frontier:

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US based startups and high growth companies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a US-based commercial real estate brokerage team with marketing, research, listing management, and day-to-day administrative tasks.

This role is ideal for someone who goes beyond basic AI prompting and understands how to use tools like ChatGPT and other AI platforms to get things done more efficiently. You'll be expected to use AI to research information, organize data, create and refine content, simplify repetitive tasks, and identify opportunities to improve existing workflows.

You'll also support marketing activities, online property listings, document preparation, and general administrative tasks. While marketing experience is valuable, we're particularly interested in candidates who are comfortable experimenting with AI tools, figuring out how to solve unfamiliar problems, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing & Content Support

  • Create and update marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and promotional content using existing templates and digital tools.

  • Use AI tools to assist with drafting property descriptions, marketing copy, email campaigns, research summaries, and other content.

  • Review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and a professional tone before sharing or publishing.

  • Coordinate property images, maps, aerial imagery, and other visual assets for marketing materials.

  • Assist with email marketing campaigns, property announcements, and promotional activities.

  • Help coordinate the preparation and updating of property signage.

2. AI & Digital Tools

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT and other relevant platforms to streamline research, drafting, data organization, and repetitive administrative work.

  • Develop effective prompts and workflows to generate useful, accurate outputs for day-to-day tasks.

  • Verify AI-generated information against reliable sources rather than relying on unverified outputs.

  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and support team productivity.

  • Learn and adapt to new software, platforms, and workflows as business needs evolve.

3. Research & Data Management

  • Conduct online research to gather property details, market information, comparable listings, and other relevant data.

  • Maintain and update internal databases, spreadsheets, contact lists, and property records.

  • Collect, organize, and verify information from multiple sources.

  • Ensure data is accurate, complete, and consistently formatted.

  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, or errors and follow up as needed.

4. Listing & Administrative Support

  • Create and update online listings using approved information, templates, and workflows.

  • Maintain accurate property details, descriptions, pricing, images, and supporting documents across relevant platforms.

  • Prepare and organize documents using established templates.

  • Assist with sending documents through DocuSign and tracking signatures or outstanding paperwork.

  • Support the preparation of listing agreements and other brokerage documents using approved templates and instructions.

  • Keep marketing assets, property records, and administrative documents organized and easy to access.

  • Track pending tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and provide general support to the brokerage team.

Requirements

  • Experience in virtual assistance, administrative support, marketing coordination, research, data management, or a similar role.

  • Strong experience in AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, writing, content creation, and administrative workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to verify information before using or sharing it.

  • Good written English and the ability to produce clear, professional content.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, online databases, document management tools, and web-based platforms.

  • Resourceful and quick to learn new software and processes.

  • Able to work independently in a remote environment and communicate proactively with a US-based team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with commercial real estate, property management, or real estate marketing.

  • Familiarity with platforms such as Buildout, CoStar, LoopNet, or Crexi.

  • Experience with Canva or similar tools for creating marketing materials.

  • Familiarity with DocuSign, email marketing platforms, and CRM systems.

  • Experience using AI tools beyond basic prompting, including building repeatable workflows or using AI to improve productivity.

  • Experience coordinating property imagery, maps, aerial photos, or signage.

What We're Looking For

  • AI-savvy: Comfortable using AI to improve the speed and quality of everyday work, while checking outputs carefully.

  • Detail-oriented: Takes the time to verify facts, review documents, and catch inconsistencies.

  • Proactive: Spots what needs to be done and follows through without constant supervision.

  • Adaptable: Learns new platforms and workflows quickly, even without prior industry experience.

  • Organized: Keeps information, files, and tasks structured and easy to track.

  • Resourceful: Knows how to research unfamiliar topics, find reliable information, and solve problems independently.

The ideal candidate combines strong administrative and marketing skills with practical AI experience and a willingness to learn.

  • Build plugins, integrations, and automations that enable operational workflows
  • Prototype new capabilities quickly and iterate based on operator feedback
  • Debug complex systems operating in constrained environments
  • Help shape the evolution of the Mattermost platform based on mission needs

You will move between writing code, deploying infrastructure, and working directly with operators, often within the same week. Travel is typically approximately one week per month onsite with customers.

  • Strong engineering ability (Go, Python, TypeScript, or similar)
  • Comfort working across the full stack from infrastructure to applications
  • Ability to solve open-ended technical problems
  • Strong communication skills with both engineers and operators
  • Willingness to travel approximately one week per month

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with DoD, IC, or national security organizations
  • Experience deploying systems in secure or classified environments
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, distributed systems, and APIs
  • Experience building integrations or operational tooling

Mattermost Federal is aggressively adopting AI-enabled workflows across mission operations. FDEs will be among the first engineers deploying and operationalizing AI capabilities in secure environments, including:

  • Knowledge retrieval across operational history
  • AI tools that help operators understand fast-moving mission data

Why This Role Exists

The best software is built close to the problem. Forward Deployed Engineers at Mattermost Federal work directly with the people using the systems we build. You will see problems firsthand, build solutions quickly, and deploy them into environments where reliability, security, and speed matter.

Compensation

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Mattermost offers a remote-first work environment with medical, dental, and vision coverage. You’ll also receive unlimited PTO plus company holidays, a work from home stipend, an annual learning and development budget for conferences, certifications, and courses, paid parental leave for all parents, and a 401(k) plan.

Canada Eligibility & Compliance

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada without current or future sponsorship.

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a government security clearance or equivalent designation (such as Reliability Status or Secret clearance under Canada's Controlled Goods Program), depending on customer engagement. Candidates must meet eligibility requirements to be considered.

Given Mattermost's work with U.S. defense and government customers, some positions may also require compliance with U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR, which can apply to non-U.S. based employees working on covered technical data. For more information, visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

jobs.description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

jobs.title: GTM AI Lead
jobs.description:
About Us

Every physical product you touch starts with raw materials & chemicals that someone has to find, qualify, and buy. The soap you wash your hands with, the laptop you’re looking at right now, and even the concrete sidewalk under your feet. That’s a $6T industry. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and trade shows.

Valdera is the leading AI platform for chemicals and raw materials. Our agents help procurement teams find savings, reduce supply risk, and source from qualified suppliers. We also help suppliers find and win the right customers. We work with some of the largest manufacturers in the world, including market leaders in pharma, personal care, beauty, and industrials. Many of them spend $1B to $10B each on raw materials. They rely on Valdera as their source of truth and to run big workflows end to end.

Index Ventures led our $15M Series A, and we’re growing fast.

What's interesting?

You'll think like a product manager and own results like a revenue leader.

  • Drive real revenue - We're the fastest-growing company in our space, and we're investing heavily in technology to make step changes in how fast we sell. What you build shows up directly in our growth.
  • Build on a winning product - The largest manufacturers in the world rely on Valdera to run big purchasing and supply chain workflows end to end. Your work helps us win more of them, faster.
  • Have creative ownership - You'll help set the vision and have ownership of how we get there.
  • Work directly with the founders. You'll partner with them every week on how we sell, serve customers, and grow.
  • Build for top talent. Our people are technology-first and highly capable. You won't have to convince anyone to try what you build.
  • A fast engineering team. Our engineers are exceptional, and they'll speed you up instead of slowing you down.
  • You get the best tools. You'll have the budget to pick the best AI tools and data for the job.

Role Description

We're hiring our first GTM AI & Engineering Lead to keep accelerating Valdera's growth. You'll design the AI workflows our sales team runs on. Then you'll help build them.

Our AEs sell to some of the largest manufacturers in the world. Every deal takes deep account research, sharp meeting prep, tailored proposals, and steady follow-through. You'll build AI agents and workflows that handle that work, so our sellers spend their time with customers.

You'll start with sales and extend to customer success, forward deployed engineering, and marketing. You'll learn how each team works, where their time goes, and what would change their results. Then you'll prototype, prove ideas with data, and partner with our engineers to put it into production.

Role Responsibilities

  • Help set the AI vision for GTM. Decide which AI workflows, tools, and data will make the biggest step change in how fast we grow. Turn that into a plan the team believes in.
  • Learn how our sellers work. Sit with our AEs, CSMs, and FDEs. Map their workflows, find where their time goes, and pick the changes that will move results most.
  • Raise the bar for sales. Work with sales leaders as a peer. Challenge how we sell today, show them what's possible, and redesign the process around it.
  • Build AI agents for every stage of the deal. Automate account research, prospecting, meeting prep, call follow-ups, and proposals for Fortune 500 manufacturers. Every AE should have an AI team behind them.
  • Turn signals into pipeline. Use data from our platforms and from massive live global data sources to find the right accounts and the right moment to reach them, on both the buyer and supplier side.
  • Design how our systems fit together. Decide how Attio, our AI tools, and our data sources connect, from data models to integrations. Use AI to keep data clean, and make sure every tool earns its place.
  • Prototype fast. Build working versions with LLMs, coding agents, APIs, and automation tools. Test them with the team and keep what works.
  • Ship with engineering. Partner with our engineers to turn your best prototypes into production systems the whole team relies on.
  • Be data drive. Query and analyze pipeline, usage, and customer data. Judge every workflow by what it does to win rates, deal speed, and expansion.
  • Run AI the team can trust. Set guardrails, check output quality, and manage model costs as the agents scale.
  • Make change stick. Roll out each new workflow, train the team, and track adoption. A workflow only counts when people use it.

Experience & Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations, sales, growth, BizOps, or product, ideally at a fast-growing B2B startup.
  • You've built AI workflows that a sales team uses every day. You can show what they did for revenue, pipeline, win rates, or time saved.
  • You've enabled cross-functional GTM teams before. Sales, customer success, and marketing moved faster because of what you built.
  • You think like a product manager. You start with the user's workflow and the outcome, then decide what to build.
  • You think in systems. You understand APIs, data schemas, and integration patterns, and you know how tools like CRMs, Claude, and Jira connect.
  • You're data driven. You can write queries, analyze data, and let real evidence drive your decisions.
  • You know how B2B sales works. You understand prospecting, long enterprise sales cycles, and how pipeline, win rates, and expansion drive growth.
  • You build your own prototypes with LLMs, coding agents, APIs, and automation tools.
  • You've partnered with engineers to take a prototype to production.
  • You love open-ended problems. You take a high-level goal, shape the plan, and see it through.

Our Culture

The best want to work with the best. That's why we obsess over our culture and bring in exceptional people to lead every part of the business. Above all, we look for curiosity. Our people ask the right questions, get to innovative answers, and do whatever it takes to win. Building a winning startup takes hard work and a lot of time together, so being low-ego, genuine, and fun matters just as much.

Compensation

Additional Information

Salary Range:

  • Compensation of $170K to $300k.
  • Meaningful equity.
  • Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided a more detailed breakdown of your options prior to joining Valdera.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

Please note that Valdera uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The Enterprise Support Engineer (ESE) serves as a primary escalation point for customers experiencing advanced technical issues, in addition to acting as an initial point of entry for customers and partners that have elected Premium Support or are strategically valuable to Jamf. The ESE works closely with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager to ensure a successful deployment. The ESE is responsible for supporting and troubleshooting issues with the installation, performance, and integration of Jamf products and supporting technologies. The ESE serves as a point of contact for all technical inquiries and escalations.

We are only able to accept applications for those based in Australia and have unrestricted work rights in Australia. What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Strong technical troubleshooting skills, with knowledge of log analysis, debugging, and system diagnostics
  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with APIs, web technologies, networking and databases (e.g., SQL).
  • Working knowledge of the architecture and tools relevant to implementation of Jamf products.
  • Basic scripting or coding knowledge (e.g., Python, Bash) to assist in automation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a customer-first mentality.
  • Advanced technical knowledge and an aptitude for learning new software systems.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Ability to critical analyze issues and use sound judgement to make decisions

Security and Privacy Requirement:

  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

jobs.title: Cobalt Core Pentester
jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Cobalt Core is an exclusive community of security pentesters. We admit a select fraction of applicants, each earning their place through a rigorous vetting process that evaluates technical expertise, professionalism, and track record. Core members are recognized practitioners and researchers who set the standard for offensive security work.

Members actively track emerging vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques, and they regularly publish research, speak at major conferences, and lead open-source initiatives.

If you are an experienced security professional who wants high-impact client engagements alongside peers who share your commitment to the craft, we encourage you to apply.

Please note: this is a freelance, part-time position available only to pentesters residing outside in the USA.

(If you are currently residing in the USA, please apply via Cobalt's US pentester posting.)

Who You Are

  • Based outside of the US
  • Multiple years of hands-on offensive security experience, with demonstrated depth in at least one specialty (e.g., web/API, cloud, mobile, network, or AI/LLM security)
  • Proof of impact, such as CVEs, published research, conference talks, or open-source security tools
  • Recognized by clients and peers for finding high-value flaws and delivering clear, actionable reports
  • A track record of making the teams and engagements you're part of measurably stronger
  • Meticulous about your work, from methodology to the final report

What You'll Do

  • Perform manual penetration testing across the following engagement types: Web, API, Internal/External Network, Cloud Config Review, Desktop, LLM, MCP, Cloud, Mobile, SCR, and Digital Risk Assessments (DRA)
  • Work as part of a pentest team and engage directly with clients
  • Author comprehensive, well-documented assessment reports that serve as reliable reference standards
  • Rigorously find vulnerabilities through manual testing techniques rather than relying on automated scanners
  • Go beyond baseline frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 to uncover complex, chained, and logic-based flaws that automated tools miss
  • Support the broader Core community through mentoring, sharing methodology, or contributing insights from your own research or conference talks

Certifications (a plus, not required)

Why You Should Join Us

jobs.title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions.

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Lead a high-performing team focused on building a better future for artists, songwriters, and the music industry on Spotify.
  • Set and execute against a policy agenda for the team based on the biggest needs for artists, songwriters, music partners, listeners, and Spotify.
  • Own strategy and execution around Spotify’s music policy portfolio, including Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, Music Spam Filter, Preferred Provider Program, and more.
  • Develop and implement new policies that equitably impact the music ecosystem on topics like royalty administration, artificial streaming, new music technologies, music platform rules, and more.
  • Partner closely with technical and operational teams on content policy — including platform integrity issues, metadata strategy, and music supply chain dynamics.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to implement technical solutions for our policy agenda.
  • Craft clear, informative messaging about existing and new policies — and launch scaled educational initiatives to make sure artists, songwriters, distributors, and rights holders have accurate information about our platform.
  • Collaborate with Music Partnerships and Licensing to understand the needs of all the stakeholders on our music platform, to advocate for and explain new policies, and to listen to and incorporate feedback.
  • Partner with Data Science and Music Economics to deeply understand platform trends and the potential impact of various policy decisions.

Who You Are

  • You have 10+ years of relevant experience in the music industry, policy, legal, or technology platforms.
  • You have proven experience in the music industry, working with artists and creators, and with technology platforms. You have a deep understanding of the music supply chain.
  • You’re a dedicated people leader, caring deeply about the health and growth of the people on your team.
  • You have a deep passion for technology, love getting into the weeds of technical solutions, and have experience working closely with engineering
  • You have passion for creating a more rewarding, fairer experience for artists and songwriters around the world. You love music.
  • You’re comfortable diving deep into spreadsheets, talking to technical teams, mapping out complex incentive systems, and sweating the details.
  • You’re a strong communicator and a strong listener — understanding when to influence others and when to incorporate smart feedback.
  • You’re experienced at bringing cross-functional teams together in a shared vision.

Where You'll Be

  • We are a distributed workforce enabling our band members to find a work mode best for them!
  • Where in the world? For this role, it can be within the Americas region in which we have a work location
  • Prefer an office to work from home instead? Not a problem! We have plenty of options for your working preferences. Find more information about our Work From Anywhere options here
  • Working hours? We operate within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration, and you will be expected to work EST hours, no matter where you are located in the Americas region.

Compensation

Additional Information

The United States base range for this position is $181,000 – $259,000 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Senior Director, New Vertical Sales- Mortgage
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the role

We are seeking an entrepreneurial and highly accomplished Senior Director, New Vertical Sales to spearhead Flex’s expansion into the mortgage payment vertical. The mortgage vertical represents one of the largest and most consequential recurring expense categories in American life — and one that has been dramatically underserved by modern payment flexibility solutions.

Reporting to the VP Strategic Partnerships (New Verticals), you will own Flex’s go-to-market strategy and pipeline for the mortgage vertical — identifying the right partners across mortgage servicers and servicing platform providers, and adjacent proptech players, and building the relationships and deals that establish Flex as the flexible payment solution for mortgage consumers. This is a true zero-to-one charter: you’ll be defining the approach, building the pipeline, and closing the deals that put this vertical on the map for Flex.

You are the kind of person who brings energy into every room, pushes counterparts to think bigger, and finds a way to win even when the path isn’t clear. You know the mortgage ecosystem from the inside — who the buyers are, how they think, and what it actually takes to get a partnership from whiteboard to go-live. You’ll work hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Finance to shape our offering and ensure

What you’ll do

  • Build the Mortgage Vertical from the Ground Up: Identify, engage, and close enterprise partnerships across the mortgage ecosystem — including mortgage servicers, originators, and adjacent proptech and insurtech platforms — establishing Flex’s embedded split-pay offering as the standard for consumer payment flexibility in mortgage.
  • Develop and Manage a High-Value Pipeline: Build a disciplined, prioritized pipeline of strategic opportunities in the mortgage vertical, moving prospects through the sales cycle with urgency and converting them into live, revenue-generating partnerships.
  • Own Executive Relationships: Serve as a credible, trusted advisor to C-level leaders and senior decision-makers at target organizations — deeply understanding their strategic priorities and demonstrating exactly how Flex creates value for their customers and their business.
  • Lead Complex Deal Negotiations: Own term sheet and partnership agreement negotiations end-to-end, structuring deals that work economically and operationally for both parties while keeping momentum toward close.
  • Drive End-to-End Partnership Launch: Shepherd each partnership from signed agreement through technical deployment and go-live, working closely with Product and Engineering to ensure flawless execution and strong early performance metrics.
  • Influence GTM and Product Direction: Translate partner feedback and competitive dynamics in the mortgage market into actionable input for Product, Marketing, and Pricing — helping Flex continuously sharpen its positioning and offering for the vertical.
  • Build the Mortgage Playbook: Document learnings, establish scalable processes, and develop the repeatable partner acquisition motion that enables Flex to grow mortgage partnerships efficiently beyond initial market entry.

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, or strategic partnerships — with meaningful experience selling into or partnering with mortgage servicers, originators, LOS/servicing technology platforms, or adjacent fintech and proptech players.
  • A track record of closing complex, first-of-kind deals in new markets, ideally involving embedded financial products, consumer payments, or BNPL programs in high-ACV, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Deep knowledge of the mortgage ecosystem: You understand the dynamics between lenders and consumers — and you know how payment flexibility fits into the purchase and ownership lifecycle.
  • Executive presence and influence: You've operated confidently at the C-suite level, building trust with senior decision-makers and navigating complex organizations to drive deals to close.
  • Financial and legal acumen: You can build and defend deal models, structure partnership economics, and negotiate agreements — balancing commercial rigor with pragmatic deal-making.
  • High agency and comfort with ambiguity: You're energized by building in undefined spaces, don't wait for direction to take initiative, and bring clarity and momentum to evolving situations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You've successfully aligned Product, Engineering, and Marketing around partner priorities and used those relationships to accelerate deal outcomes.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and Flex's internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks. This is a commission earning role. The OTE (On Target Earnings) listed below:

$310,000—$390,000 USD

$278,000—$350,000 USD

$262,000—$330,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial
jobs.description:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

As a Solutions Consultant at Ramp, you will play a crucial role in establishing and nurturing partnerships with potential customers. Collaborating closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, and Account Management teams, you will prioritize and develop financial solutions for Ramp's key customers, ensuring that the product aligns with their evolving requirements. Acting as technical and financial experts, you will design integrated solutions, provide strategic advice to prospects, and facilitate communication between internal technical teams and prospects. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (North America)
jobs.description:

Every physical product you touch starts with raw materials & chemicals that someone has to find, qualify, and buy. The soap you wash your hands with, the laptop you’re looking at right now, and even the concrete sidewalk under your feet. That’s a $6T industry. Most of it still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and trade shows.

Valdera is the leading AI platform for chemicals and raw materials. Our agents help procurement teams find savings, reduce supply risk, and source from qualified suppliers. We also help suppliers find and win the right customers. We work with some of the largest manufacturers in the world, including market leaders in pharma, personal care, beauty, and industrials. Many of them spend $1B to $10B each on raw materials. They rely on Valdera as their source of truth and to run big workflows end to end.

jobs.title: Account Executive | HCLS | New Logo
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you’ll do at Jamf

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. As an Account Executive focused on new logo growth in Healthcare & Life Sciences, you’ll open doors at organizations that don’t run Jamf today, build relationships with decision makers across IT, clinical, and research teams, and establish Jamf as a trusted partner in your territory. Your efforts will drive sales of our Whole Product Experience (WPE), build qualified pipeline from the ground up, and bring in new customers. You’ll work closely with Sales Development Representatives and Sales Engineers to take new business from first conversation to signed contract. As a member of the Jamf family, you’ll bring our high-energy, collaborative, and fun spirit to every deal.

This role if offered as remote in the Western & Midwest Territory. You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the Western & Midwest Territories and have sponsorship to live and work in the United States.

What you can expect to do in this role

  • Own the full sales cycle for net-new healthcare and life sciences accounts, from prospecting through close, presenting to multiple levels of each organization to demonstrate the value of Jamf’s full suite.
  • Build a targeted prospect list in your territory and create qualified pipeline through outbound research, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Research each prospect’s environment, including Apple device fleets, compliance requirements, and clinical or research workflows, and partner with Sales Engineers to design solutions that fit.
  • Engage executives and key stakeholders early to position Jamf as a strategic option and turn first meetings into long-term customer relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships across the sales ecosystem, including Channel Partners and Apple, to open doors and co-sell into healthcare and life sciences organizations.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement monthly and quarterly, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our approach to the vertical.
  • Leverage industry leading sales tech stack including SalesForce.com, Clari, Groove, ZoomInfo , LinkedIn Navigator, and much more

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a sales role (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to carry a quota and consistently meet or exceed targets (Preferred)
  • Proven experience prospecting and closing new logos, building pipeline without relying on an existing book of business (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years health-tech, med-tech, biotech, or life sciences sales experience, including selling to health systems, hospitals, pharma, biotech, or research institutions (Preferred)
  • Minimum of 2 years software sales experience (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem or SaaS sales is a plus, but not required.
  • #LIRemote

Education and certifications

  • HS Diploma / GED (Required)
  • 4 Year / Bachelor’s Degree (Preferred)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered

How we help you reach your best potential

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class, sales-focused Bootcamp gives you the technical and product knowledge to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

For sales and commission-based roles, we post On-Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus estimated commission based on achieving 100% of performance targets. Commission is not guaranteed and varies based on individual performance results.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

$58,100—$133,200 USD

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf
