jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join us to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians


At Neo, we’re on a mission to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. Life at a rapidly scaling tech startup isn’t for everyone. It’s complex, fast-paced, high-pressure, but also incredibly fulfilling. Since its founding in 2019, Neo has gained incredible traction and is one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in Canada.

  • #1 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 for 2023, 2024, and 2025 — the first company ever to achieve a three-peat at the top!

  • #1 Fastest Growing Company in Canada for 2024 by Globe & Mail

  • Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards

  • Team of 500+ people

  • 1M+ customers

  • 10K+ retail partners

This is a remote-friendly position but candidates must be located within Canada.

The Role

At Neo, we operate at the intersection of modern finance, scalable distributed systems, and cutting-edge intelligence. We are seeking an exceptional Technical Product Manager who can work closely with AI-forward agile software engineering teams to scope and deliver high-value systems.

This role is only open to candidates with a deep background in the financial industry, possessing specialized domain expertise across core financial systems—including consumer and commercial lending, modern core banking architectures, scalable rewards/loyalty infrastructure, and complex payment processing systems.

This role is a great fit for people that have worked in an Engineering/technical environment, ideally from the financial industry. Success comes from strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with ability to to proactively engage stakeholders, organize requirements, and develop plans with awareness of underlying technical systems and technical requirements.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate ambiguous engineering and business asks into well-defined problems. You will work with subject matter experts, technical documentation, and software engineering teams to scope and clarify highly complex technical problems.

  • Plan technical solutions that don’t just work, but also scale. You’re able to articulate solution shapes to technical problems that consider non-functional requirements such as scale, security, operating cost, and complexity. You can ramp up on current systems and architecture to inform the fastest path forward.

  • Bring an AI-first mentality. You are the manager of agents rather than someone who dabbles with AI assistance. You extensively leverage agentic AI to do research, reverse-engineer competitor solutions, or develop prototypes, mockups or even an MVP.

  • Operationalize and platform-ize at every turn: Ensure we’re developing not just a working application or solution - but rather platforms that can be used to power future products or even be configured to run at other companies without code churn.

  • Be on the technical team. Technical product leadership is not separate from our software delivery team - you’ll be on the team working alongside software engineers and reporting to the Director of Software Engineering. Shepherd initiatives from whiteboard concepts to high-level system designs, technical workflow diagrams, data flow diagrams, and work breakdowns.

  • Mentor & Elevate: Cultivate engineering and product craft, fostering a culture of technical rigor, pragmatic experimentation, and customer empathy.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive Technical Product Experience: You bring substantial experience with technical product leadership - emphasis on technical. You have a background working with technical requirements and technical documentation in complex finance domains.

  • Product-Led Thinking: You excel at product discovery, shaping user experiences, and driving execution on strategic roadmaps while ensuring alignment across engineering and business goals.

  • Platform-Minded Technical Leadership: You collaborate seamlessly with architects and engineering leads on core systems, data models, and API strategies. You drive strategic architectural trade-offs from a product leadership perspective, translating complex platform infrastructure into scalable business capabilities without losing sight of overall product direction.

  • High Ownership: Experience owning complex, regulated, or operationally intensive products (fintech, payments, lending, infra platforms, or similar).

  • Building Through Ambiguity: A track record of scaling systems and teams through ambiguity, you've taken things from working to reliable to growing.

  • Low Ego, High Standards: You do the unglamorous work and hold others to the same.

  • AI-Driven Execution: You leverage AI as a daily tool to drive your work, accelerate problem-solving, and excel in product execution.

  • Must be a Canadian citizen, Permanent Resident or have a valid work permit.

🚀 Total Rewards

As Neo continues to grow, we’re committed to offering a competitive, market-leading rewards program that reflects the impact our team members make. In addition to salary, our program includes equity — empowering employees to share directly in our momentum today and in the meaningful value we create for years to come.

  • Salary: We provide a strong base salary aligned with market ranges, along with the flexibility to tailor your mix of cash and equity to match your longer term goals. Final compensation is based on your skills, experience, and scope. For exceptional talent, we’re prepared to go above and beyond.

  • Equity Ownership (Where Eligible): At Neo, you don’t just work here, you own a piece of what we’re building. As a full-time team member, you share directly in the upside of one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies. When we win, you win — with real ownership and meaningful long-term wealth-building potential tied to our success.

What does life as an Owner at Neo Include?

🇨🇦 You will redefine the financial landscape with top talent in Canada to help everyday Canadians win, and grow quickly while doing it

📈 For eligible roles, ownership structure that enables you to share in our path to victory

🏅Earn BIG with our short term incentive plans (STIP)

👥 Collaborating with the brightest minds to build something meaningful, united by a shared commitment to innovation, curiosity, and excellence

❤️‍🩹 Flexible health benefits & life insurance

🌴 21 Days PTO + stat holidays, and personal leave

💪 Health & personal spending accounts

🤑 A wide variety of discounts through our partner network

🏠 Access to early use of products and discounts on fixed-term Neo mortgages

👶 Parental top-up & equity vesting during long term leave

🎉 Neo night events

🧠 Company wide huddles, and education

So, Why Neo:

  • No compromises on tooling: Cursor, CodeRabbit, GitHub Enterprise, Wiz, Sentry, Snowflake, AWS. MacBook Pros.

  • Deployments are independent and automated. One button to ship when your work is ready, not when someone schedules a release window.

  • Competitive salaries that lead the Calgary market. Roles are eligible for STIP (cash bonuses tied to company milestones) and equity through stock options. At our trajectory, your 4-to-5-year total comp is designed to significantly outpace traditional tech tracks.

  • Relocation support available for candidates moving to Calgary.

Successful candidates will be required to complete a security screening including a criminal record check and credit check.

Working at Neo:

The people who thrive at Neo are resourceful, growth-oriented, and driven to win. We hold ourselves to high standards because we’re on a mission that matters: to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. As individuals and as a team, we constantly challenge ourselves and each other to raise the bar and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. Our commitment to customer success drives everything we do, from building world-class products to providing exceptional support at every step of their journey. If this resonates with you, keep reading.

We trust, respect, and support each other. This means honest conversations, constructive input, and empowering each other to move fast and think big. You’ll be surrounded by people who push you to be your best. We primarily collaborate in person across our Calgary, Winnipeg, and Toronto offices, where ideas move quickly and teams build momentum together. As we continue to scale and evolve, we’re looking for builders, innovators, and problem solvers who thrive on challenge–people who would rather blaze a trail through uncertainty than follow a well-paved path.

At Neo, ownership is part of how we think and operate. For select roles, equity participation reinforces that mindset by giving employees a direct stake in the company’s long-term success. Regardless of role, every team member is expected to think like an owner and make decisions that move the business forward.

Apply with us:

We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive climate where everyone can thrive. Customers trust us with their finances, so successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo a security screening, including a criminal records check and a credit check.

By continuing with your application, you agree to the Candidate Privacy Notice, which guides how we process your personal information for the purpose of your application.

Neo Financial leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to reinforce our candidate evaluation process, including the initial assessment of applications and screening of candidates. These tools support our recruitment team; however, all final hiring decisions are made by humans and are not based exclusively on automated processing. If you require further information regarding our data processing practices, please contact us.

We are hiring for an open, vacant position.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Growth (technical or ex-product engineer)
jobs.description:
Join an early-stage startup.
Accelerate economic opportunity.

Join us to grow Kovo's core product. Credit building is the business that got us here, and it's still growing fast. You'll have end-to-end responsibility: onboarding, lifecycle, conversion and retention. You set the roadmap and you build what you find.

This role is a good fit if:

  • You've shipped code to production and you've decided what to build.

  • You go deep on funnels, workflows and lifecycle systems, and find the opportunity others missed.

  • When you find a fix, you open a PR instead of writing a ticket.

  • You think in experiments and measured lift, not campaign sends.

  • You want to inform the direction for a product.

About us

  • Kovo is expanding access to financial tools for people historically excluded from the traditional credit system. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity for economic independence, and we're building products that help people establish financial identity and unlock opportunity.

  • Over the past three years, Kovo has grown revenue 20x while maintaining exceptional capital efficiency. We rank above the 99th percentile in revenue per employee benchmarks, reflecting the leverage of a small, high-performing team.

  • The team combines the ambition of a venture-scale company with the discipline of a profitable business. We reached positive free cash flow early in our lifecycle, allowing us to grow with less dilution and focus on building for the long term.

  • Kovo is backed by Inspired Capital and Homebrew, and built by alumni from Plaid, Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Innovis, Chime, Robinhood, Cash App, Honey, Possible, Monzo, Mercury, and more. We're looking for exceptional people to help us scale the company another 20x and beyond.

Why you might be excited about us

  • Direct impact on millions of people's ability to access credit

  • High ownership with minimal bureaucracy

  • Speed, learning, and impact are core values

Why you might not be excited about us

  • Roles and priorities evolve quickly

  • Some systems and processes are still being built

  • The pace of execution and career growth is intense (not optimized for work-life balance)

About the role

What you inherit

  • Two feature-complete credit builder products that report to all four major bureaus.

  • Onboarding, lifecycle messaging (email, push, in-app, SMS) and growth experiments across web and app.

  • A lifecycle stack migration to PostHog, alongside product analytics and experiments in PostHog.

  • Sandbox environments that let you prototype on the real product.

Where your time goes

  • Most of it: finding and shipping the highest-leverage improvements across the existing product.

  • Some of it: building a system that runs experiments with fewer humans in the loop every quarter.

  • A little of it: setting the roadmap and keeping the team informed.

What you'll do

Set the direction

  • Own the north star, input metrics, roadmap and quarterly plan for the core product, the same way each engineering team owns its own.

  • Rank bets by measured impact on conversion, retention and lifetime value. Keep the list short.

  • Write short updates about results, not activity.

Find the opportunity

  • Go deep on onboarding, payment and lifecycle workflows. Watch sessions, query the data, read support conversations.

  • Size each opportunity before you build it.

Build it

  • Prototype in sandbox environments, then ship production PRs yourself. Use agents heavily.

  • Instrument events cleanly, and fix event and property gaps yourself.

  • Run experiments end-to-end: hypothesis, sizing, launch and readout.

  • Own the lifecycle system: workflows, templates, triggers and monitoring.

  • Build agentic workflows that propose, launch and read out experiments with less of you every quarter.

What you won't do

  • Write tickets for someone else to build or do what you could build or do yourself.

  • Groom a backlog.

  • Write a PRD when a prototype or a PR would answer the question faster.

  • Hand off a spec and wait.

About you

Mindset

  • You want to own outcomes, and you measure yourself by what moved.

  • Energized by helping underserved people build credit and financial identity.

  • Comfortable in a high-intensity, remote role with full ownership and little scaffolding.

  • You hate AI slop. You use agents heavily and hold their output to a higher bar than your own.

How you work

  • PR first. You fix what you find.

  • Data first. You write your own SQL and read your own experiments.

  • Clear, short writer. People act on your message after one read.

Experience

  • 4+ years, or equivalent depth, in product engineering, growth engineering, or a product role where you shipped your own code.

  • You've shipped production code recently, in TypeScript, React or similar. AI-assisted counts.

  • A track record of measured wins in activation, conversion, retention or reactivation in a consumer product.

  • Comfortable with event-driven systems, product analytics, experiment design, and lifecycle platforms. Intermediate SQL or better.

  • Bonus: Consumer fintech experience.

You report to one of the founders, based in Austin, TX. We are fully remote. Austin is a plus, not a requirement.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description:
You: The voice behind PLF's daily presence on social media. Every day, government officials trample someone's rights, and every day PLF's freedom fighters push back in court. Your job is to make sure people see it. You'll take a dense case filing or a new legislative initiative and turn it into a post that stops the scroll. You know an exciting story when you hear one and you’re able to maximize its impact online. When you're nailing it, more Americans know PLF is a best-in-class public interest law firm, and donors, legislators, and journalists respond.

Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There's a lot of government overreach out there, and it's backed by seemingly endless resources. But fortunately, like all lumbering giants, abusive government is most vulnerable when countered by individuals who act strategically and nimbly, take calculated risks, have each other's backs, and are confident in and passionate about the cause—the very sort of swashbucklers we employ in spades here at PLF. And a giant's overreach only stays hidden if nobody tells the story.

Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation's first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the United States Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 21 litigated at the Court. We also have more than two hundred active cases across the nation.

We are a next-generation public interest law firm. That means we aren't interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game.

Here's what you get to do in this role

You'll report to our Social Media Manager who is responsible for increasing output while maintaining quality on PLF’s social media channels. You'll write, design, and schedule content every day. You'll turn case updates, legislative wins, and event news into posts, graphics, carousels, and short videos. The social media team works within our Case Publicity team to tell client stories, shape the narrative around our issues, and highlight the work of our attorneys. You’ll also collaborate with our Content Marketing, Media Relations, and Digital Marketing teams. That way, what we post lines up with what's happening in our cases.

Here's the twist: we know great social media people don't all have the same strengths. Some are wordsmiths who can make a property rights case sing in 280 characters. Others are storytellers behind a camera who can cut a 90-second video that people actually finish. We want you to bring your strongest skill and grow the others.

We’re building a best-in-class social media presence and want you to bring your unique set of skills to help us continually level up. Stick with it, and you'll learn the platforms, our audience, and our cases inside and out.

Here's where you'll spend your time:

  • Writing, designing, and publishing daily posts in Sprout Social and Canva, and scheduling them ahead for the Social Media Manager's approval
  • Boosting the volume and consistency of our case update and legislative posts, including carousel copy and graphics that promote our cases
  • Owning event promotion on social, with graphics and copy for LinkedIn
  • Filming and editing short-form video (potentially on location, with our clients and staff), and writing scripts for on-camera talent to deliver
  • Replying to comments, growing our followers, and handling routine upkeep on each platform
  • Building tracking links (UTMs) to measure how social drives traffic to our website, and sharing what's working with the team
  • Checking facts with our attorneys and massaging messaging so every post gets the story right

This role is ideal for someone with 2-4 years of experience professionally, in environments like a think tank, NGO, newsroom, agency, or political campaign. We're looking for:

  • A clear strength in either social copywriting or short-form video.
  • A strong sense of storytelling and the ability to put the most interesting facts at the front to grab audience attention.
  • A portfolio that showcases your strengths as a communicator. We want to see your work, so this one is required (see below).
  • Comfort reading case summaries and asking attorneys questions until you're sure the details are right. In our line of work, accuracy isn't optional.
  • The ability to run a daily publishing calendar without dropping deadlines, even when news breaks and plans change.
  • Working knowledge of Canva and a scheduling tool like Sprout Social. If you haven't used them, we'll teach you. Just be ready to learn fast.
  • A genuine passion for individual liberty, constitutional law, and helping real people fight back against government overreach.

The right person is relentless about getting the story right, confident enough to pitch a bold idea, and quick to elevate the teammates around them.

General Information

Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that will benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, we battle for freedom in the nation's courts and the court of public opinion.

As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California and Arlington, Virginia, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. You can work physically in any of our offices or work virtually.

Salary range and benefits

This is a full-time, permanent position with a starting salary range of $60,000–$70,000. Exceptions may be considered for candidates with exceptional experience, education, professional background, or proven results in previous roles. PLF is committed to recruiting and retaining the highest-quality talent nationwide and offers a total compensation package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a generous 403(b) company contribution, life and disability insurance, paid leave and wellness leave, and 3 weeks of paid time off. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

How to apply

If you think you might be a good fit, submit the following application materials:

  • Your resume, including your experience in the liberty movement and relevant professional experience
  • A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants. Tell us whether your strength leans toward writing or video.
  • A writing sample and/or a portfolio of your work. This can include social copy, graphics, video, or a mix. Links are great. Show us what you do best.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer — Data Engineering & AI
jobs.description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Data Engineering & AI) to help businesses transform their operations through data engineering, artificial intelligence, and intelligent automation.

This role combines strong data engineering expertise, practical AI knowledge, and a product-oriented mindset to identify business challenges and develop scalable, data-driven solutions.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with business stakeholders to understand operational processes, identify inefficiencies, and design solutions that connect enterprise data with AI-powered applications and workflows.

You will take ownership of initiatives from business discovery and technical design through data integration, implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement.

  • Develop reliable data transformation, validation, and processing solutions.
  • Prepare and structure enterprise data for use in AI-powered applications and intelligent workflows.
  • Design and implement solutions that connect business data with Large Language Models and AI services.
  • Build automated workflows that reduce manual operations and improve business efficiency.
  • Translate ambiguous business requirements into technical designs and actionable implementation plans.
  • Evaluate data availability, quality, reliability, security, and integration requirements.

  • Collaborate with software engineers and stakeholders to integrate data-driven solutions into business applications.

  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong programming skills, particularly with Python, SQL, or comparable data engineering technologies.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data transformation, and data processing.
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data architecture.
  • Practical experience developing or integrating AI-powered solutions.
  • Solid understanding of LLMs and their application to enterprise data.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and services.
  • Experience developing reliable and maintainable production data solutions.
  • Understanding of business processes and operational workflows.
  • Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating directly with business stakeholders or customers.
  • Ability to independently own technical initiatives from discovery through delivery.
  • Strong communication skills and a product-oriented mindset.

Must Have:

  • Strong hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong programming and SQL capabilities.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT and data transformation.
  • Experience integrating enterprise data from multiple systems and sources.
  • Practical experience developing or integrating AI-powered solutions, applications, or workflows.
  • Understanding of LLM capabilities, limitations, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience with cloud-based data environments.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, reliability, and production monitoring.
  • Ability to analyze business processes and identify opportunities for data-driven automation.
  • Experience translating business problems into technical requirements and solutions.
  • Strong technical ownership and independent problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify and recommend improvements without waiting for detailed instructions.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with AI agents and agentic workflows.
  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Experience with vector databases and embedding-based retrieval.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with structured and unstructured enterprise data.
  • Experience with data orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.
  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.
  • Experience with Spark, dbt, or comparable data processing technologies.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph.
  • Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with backend development and API design.
  • Experience with data governance, privacy, and security practices.
  • Experience developing internal business automation solutions.
  • Previous experience in consulting, professional services, or client-facing engineering roles.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, observability, and responsible AI development practices.

Compensation

Home office;

Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

International Projects;

Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational);

Games and Competitions;

jobs.title: Staff Software Developer
jobs.description:
Join us to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians


At Neo, we’re on a mission to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. Life at a rapidly scaling tech startup isn’t for everyone. It’s complex, fast-paced, high-pressure, but also incredibly fulfilling. Since its founding in 2019, Neo has gained incredible traction and is one of the fastest-growing fintech companies in Canada.

  • #1 on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 for 2023, 2024, and 2025 — the first company ever to achieve a three-peat at the top!

  • #1 Fastest Growing Company in Canada for 2024 by Globe & Mail

  • Top-ranked mobile apps and credit cards

  • Team of 500+ people

  • 1M+ customers

  • 10K+ retail partners

This is a remote-friendly position but candidates must be located within Canada.

The Role

Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over years but when it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative.

Neo has been Canada's fastest-growing company for three years running. The platform behind that growth is built entirely in-house: 150 services in production, hundreds of pull requests merged every week, tens of millions of transactions processed every month. Engineers own their services from architecture through production. There is no QA team to hand work off to and no DevOps team to manage your deployments.

Neo if looking for a Staff engineer who remains hands-on. You write code, not just docs. You shape architecture and raise the technical ceiling across teams in a program, not only inside one squad. You are a sparring partner for Engineering Managers and Directors on hard technical calls, and you drive multi-team work that would otherwise stall or fragment. Our stack is GraphQL, Mongo, Node.js, TypeScript, React, and React Native on AWS. If you have spent time at a company where good ideas died in committee and you know you could be going faster, this is the environment those engineers tend to thrive in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own and ship critical services and shared libraries end to end: design, implementation, production delivery, and long-term health.

  • Set the architectural bar across multiple teams in your program: review designs, catch cross-team dependency risk early, and drive the target state when current systems will not scale.

  • Lead scoping and planning for large, complex projects that span teams; keep product and engineering goals aligned without waiting for perfect requirements.

  • Build and evolve tools, templates, and patterns that many teams use, so the whole program moves faster.

  • Raise and own the technical debt that blocks reliability, security, or scale; get the work onto the roadmap and see it through.

  • Keep production honest: observability, alerting, incident response, and blameless follow-through with actionable fixes.

  • Mentor Senior engineers and coach teams through pairing, design reviews, and deliberate knowledge sharing.

  • Advise Engineering Directors and Managers on tech debt, delivery risk, and when to ship an MVP versus invest in a durable system.

  • Treat AI as a force multiplier for yourself and the teams you support: standards, guardrails, and review expectations, not one-off prompting.

Who We Are Looking For

  • You have roughly 10+ years building production systems, including serious time as a senior or lead IC, with impact that holds up at scale.

  • You have been the technical owner of systems that mattered: you shaped the architecture, not only implemented against someone else's plan.

  • You still write high-quality code and take pride in being a major contributor and code owner, not only a reviewer of others' work.

  • You think in systems: coupling, contracts, failure modes, cost, and second-order effects across services and teams.

  • You are opinionated about architecture, can defend a position, and change it when the argument is better.

  • You level up the people around you. Your reviews teach. Your mentoring sticks. Seniors and managers seek you out on hard problems.

  • You connect technical work to business outcomes and can sit in prioritization conversations with product and directors without losing the engineering bar.

  • You embrace agentic workflows as how you develop, not as a side experiment. You design and run multi-step agent loops for implementation, testing, and review, and you hold the quality bar when the agents get it wrong.

  • You shape how the program adopts this: skills, agents, playbooks, and guardrails that raise throughput across teams without creating review debt or unsafe shortcuts.

  • Must be a Canadian citizen, Permanent Resident or have a valid work permit.

This is not the right role if you want to leave coding behind, wait for fully scoped tickets, or optimize only for your own squad's backlog. Staff at Neo multiply the program while still shipping.

🚀 Total Rewards

As Neo continues to grow, we’re committed to offering a competitive, market-leading rewards program that reflects the impact our team members make. In addition to salary, our program includes equity — empowering employees to share directly in our momentum today and in the meaningful value we create for years to come.

  • Salary: We provide a strong base salary aligned with market ranges, along with the flexibility to tailor your mix of cash and equity to match your longer term goals. Final compensation is based on your skills, experience, and scope. For exceptional talent, we’re prepared to go above and beyond.

  • Equity Ownership (Where Eligible): At Neo, you don’t just work here, you own a piece of what we’re building. As a full-time team member, you share directly in the upside of one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies. When we win, you win — with real ownership and meaningful long-term wealth-building potential tied to our success.

What does life as an Owner at Neo Include?

🇨🇦 You will redefine the financial landscape with top talent in Canada to help everyday Canadians win, and grow quickly while doing it

📈 For eligible roles, ownership structure that enables you to share in our path to victory

🏅Earn BIG with our short term incentive plans (STIP)

👥 Collaborating with the brightest minds to build something meaningful, united by a shared commitment to innovation, curiosity, and excellence

❤️‍🩹 Flexible health benefits & life insurance

🌴 21 Days PTO + stat holidays, and personal leave

💪 Health & personal spending accounts

🤑 A wide variety of discounts through our partner network

🏠 Access to early use of products and discounts on fixed-term Neo mortgages

👶 Parental top-up & equity vesting during long term leave

🎉 Neo night events

🧠 Company wide huddles, and education

So, Why Neo:

  • No compromises on tooling: Cursor, CodeRabbit, GitHub Enterprise, Wiz, Sentry, Snowflake, AWS. MacBook Pros.

  • Deployments are independent and automated. One button to ship when your work is ready, not when someone schedules a release window.

  • Competitive salaries (up to CA$250,000) that lead the Calgary market. Roles are eligible for STIP (cash bonuses tied to company milestones) and equity through stock options. At our trajectory, your 4-to-5-year total comp is designed to significantly outpace traditional tech tracks.

  • Relocation support available for candidates moving to Calgary.

Successful candidates will be required to complete a security screening including a criminal record check and credit check.

Working at Neo:

The people who thrive at Neo are resourceful, growth-oriented, and driven to win. We hold ourselves to high standards because we’re on a mission that matters: to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. As individuals and as a team, we constantly challenge ourselves and each other to raise the bar and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. Our commitment to customer success drives everything we do, from building world-class products to providing exceptional support at every step of their journey. If this resonates with you, keep reading.

We trust, respect, and support each other. This means honest conversations, constructive input, and empowering each other to move fast and think big. You’ll be surrounded by people who push you to be your best. We primarily collaborate in person across our Calgary, Winnipeg, and Toronto offices, where ideas move quickly and teams build momentum together. As we continue to scale and evolve, we’re looking for builders, innovators, and problem solvers who thrive on challenge–people who would rather blaze a trail through uncertainty than follow a well-paved path.

At Neo, ownership is part of how we think and operate. For select roles, equity participation reinforces that mindset by giving employees a direct stake in the company’s long-term success. Regardless of role, every team member is expected to think like an owner and make decisions that move the business forward.

Apply with us:

We believe in equal opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive climate where everyone can thrive. Customers trust us with their finances, so successful candidates for this position will be required to undergo a security screening, including a criminal records check and a credit check.

By continuing with your application, you agree to the Candidate Privacy Notice, which guides how we process your personal information for the purpose of your application.

Neo Financial leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to reinforce our candidate evaluation process, including the initial assessment of applications and screening of candidates. These tools support our recruitment team; however, all final hiring decisions are made by humans and are not based exclusively on automated processing. If you require further information regarding our data processing practices, please contact us.

We are hiring for an open, vacant position.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - senior hire
jobs.description:
Join an early-stage startup.
Accelerate economic opportunity.

Join us as a Backend Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure that powers financial access for millions of underserved Americans. This role is for you if you want to own critical systems end-to-end and care deeply about performance, reliability, and scalability. You'll be expected to aggressively leverage AI-assisted development tools to dramatically accelerate your output and maximize impact, all while maintaining strong code quality and system reliability.

About us

  • Kovo is expanding access to financial tools for people historically excluded from the traditional credit system. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity for economic independence, and we’re building products that help people establish financial identity and unlock opportunity.

  • Over the past three years, Kovo has grown revenue 20x while maintaining exceptional capital efficiency. We rank above the 99th percentile in revenue-per-employee benchmarks, reflecting the leverage of a small, high-performing team.

  • The team combines the ambition of a venture-scale company with the discipline of a profitable business. We reached positive free cash flow early in our lifecycle, allowing us to grow with less dilution and focus on building for the long term.

  • Kovo is backed by Inspired Capital and Homebrew, and built by alumni from Plaid, Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Innovis, Chime, Cash App, Robinhood, Honey, Possible, Monzo, Mercury, and more. We're looking for exceptional people to help us scale the company another 20x and beyond.

Why you might be excited about us

  • Direct impact on millions of people’s ability to access credit

  • High ownership with minimal bureaucracy

  • Speed, learning, and impact are core values

Why you might not be excited about us

  • Roles and priorities evolve quickly

  • Some systems and processes are still being built

  • The pace of execution and career growth is intense (not optimized for work-life balance)

About the role

Engineering at Kovo is evolving quickly. You will own problems end-to-end, deliver a lot of high-quality code, dig into data, make product decisions, and iterate quickly in production.

Our core stack is Node (TypeScript) on AWS and React (NextJS) on Vercel.

What you'll do

  • Own backend systems and infrastructure end-to-end, from design through deployment and scaling

  • Build performant, reliable APIs and services that power our financial products

  • Design and implement scalable architectures on AWS using Node (TypeScript)

  • Make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, reliability, scalability, and maintainability

  • Ship production code frequently while maintaining high quality standards

  • Help establish technical patterns and best practices for the engineering team

  • Interface effectively with product engineers and other stakeholders

About you

Systems-oriented mindset

  • Care deeply about performance, reliability, and scalability

  • Motivated by ownership and accountability for system outcomes

  • Think critically about architectural decisions and their long-term implications

  • Thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable making technical decisions with incomplete information

  • Self-starter who can work independently and drive projects to completion

Focused on shipping high-quality systems fast - however it gets done

  • Comfortable in a high-intensity role and seeking an ambitious workload

  • Strong sense of ownership and willingness to deliver on tight deadlines. This takes many of our engineers more than 50 hours a week

  • Believe software engineering is evolving from writing code to orchestrating AI agents and are excited by this because it force-multiplies your output and impact

  • Embrace AI generation of code and workflow improvements while maintaining high quality

  • Hate AI slop and care about code quality and system reliability

Relevant experience

  • 5+ years or equivalent depth of experience in professional software engineering, with significant backend focus

  • Experience building and scaling production systems with Node and AWS

  • Proficient with TypeScript (bonus)

  • Track record of delivering reliable, performant systems at scale

jobs.title: Senior Test Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Focus

Focus is a digital services firm dedicated to delivering on projects with impact in the civic tech space. We partner with states and federal agencies—including the Department of State, IRS, and the Department of Education—transform outdated systems into modern, efficient solutions that deliver better outcomes for citizens.

At Focus, we believe in doing impactful work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We encourage our team to log off at the end of the day, take time off when needed, and bring their best selves to work. We are intentional about staying on the cutting edge of our tooling and practices—from modern cloud development environments to integrating AI into our daily workflows—so our engineers spend their time solving hard problems, not fighting dull tools.

We are a fully remote company, and all employees must be based in the continental U.S. Some projects may require occasional travel, approximately 1-2 times per year.

Role Overview

As a Senior Test Software Engineer, you will lead the quality engineering architecture and automation strategy for critical civic technology infrastructure. You will move far beyond traditional testing roles to serve as a software quality technical authority—architecting scalable automated test suites, building robust continuous integration workflows, and serving as a team representative in a complex environment with myriad vendors and dozen of stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and automated test scripts to validate system functionality, security, and performance.

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable end-to-end (E2E) automated UI and API test suites using Playwright and TypeScript across multiple product verticals.

  • Partner with product managers, developers, and regulatory teams early in the development lifecycle to evaluate requirements and assess risks.

  • Conduct functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing in compliance with project requirements.

  • Document and track defects, coordinate remediation with development teams, and retest fixes prior to release.

  • Work with development or integration teams to validate unit tests and/or assist in pair programming techniques to validate code flows.

  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert in the area of testing, able to provide feedback and best practice advice for test-related questions

  • Maintain test documentation and reports for submission to Government stakeholders.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience writing and maintaining testing frameworks for full-stack applications.

  • Experience testing complex systems that interact with multiple external services, databases, and third-party APIs.

  • Proven experience working on cross-functional agile teams, estimating complex tasks, and directly communicating technical updates to client stakeholders.

  • Strong diagnostic skills for troubleshooting complex, distributed multi-vendor application failures and microservices.

  • Prior experience working on federal government digital service projects or civic tech programs.

  • Experience implementing synthetic test data generators or complex mock data services for enterprise integrations.

Requirements

  • Legal authorization to work in the United States

  • Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

  • Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

  • May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

jobs.title: Private Sector Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
You: You're a natural relationship builder with an entrepreneurial spirit, a strategic mind, and a knack for turning conversations into opportunities. In this role, you'll be PLF's bridge to the business world: building relationships with companies, trade associations, and industry leaders, learning where government overreach is hurting them, and turning those insights into new cases, coalitions, and policy wins.

You’re equally comfortable with a corporate executive, a trade association leader, or a small business owner, and you’re energized by finding creative solutions to the challenges American businesses face. You’re more than a networker: you spot connections and opportunities others miss, build trust from scratch, and find common ground among people with different priorities. You know the best partnerships are mutually beneficial and long-term, so you make the first call, ask good questions, and follow through.

You want to develop strategies and own your projects, not execute someone else’s playbook. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you. You recognize where PLF can make a difference, develop strategies to engage the right people, and take ownership of turning ideas into results. You're comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and building something from the ground up. Above all, you’re motivated by impact, whether that’s identifying the next Supreme Court case, building industry support for a legal challenge, advancing state or federal policy reform, or introducing PLF to an entirely new audience.

Them: Government agencies, regulators, and lawmakers imposing barriers that keep Americans from building businesses, developing property, creating jobs, and pursuing opportunity. Burdensome permitting, property rights restrictions, occupational licensing, and unchecked administrative power affect businesses and industries across the country.

Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation is the nation's first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty, with 18 U.S. Supreme Court victories and more than 200 active cases nationwide. Our Private Sector Partnerships team connects PLF's mission and capabilities with the businesses, industries, and associations that have a stake in limiting government overreach.

Here's what you get to do in this role

Reporting to the Private Sector Partnerships Principal on the Outreach Team, you'll expand PLF's engagement with businesses, trade associations, and industry leaders, working closely with our attorneys, policy experts, researchers, and communications, events, and development teams. One day you might help an industry association identify clients for a constitutional challenge; the next, you might build a coalition around state legislation or connect PLF attorneys with businesses affected by government overreach. Success isn't measured in business cards collected. It's measured in relationships built, opportunities uncovered, and results delivered.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

  • Build partnerships with corporations, trade associations, business leaders, and industry stakeholders whose priorities align with PLF's mission.
  • Help identify PLF's next cases by working with attorneys and industry contacts to uncover litigation opportunities and prospective clients.
  • Mobilize private sector support for strategic litigation, amicus briefs, and state and federal legislative reforms.
  • Take initiatives from concept to execution, from targeted outreach campaigns to speaking engagements, webinars, events, research collaborations, and media placements.
  • Represent PLF at industry conferences, legislative gatherings, and association meetings, positioning PLF as a trusted resource.
  • Connect prospective corporate supporters and industry partners with PLF's Development team.
  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for partners, and track outreach and outcomes in Salesforce.

Where you might be coming from

People who thrive in this role have traditionally come from public affairs, government relations, external affairs, strategic partnerships, and corporate partnerships. You might be a Government Relations Manager at a trade association, a Public Affairs or External Affairs Manager at a company, a Strategic Partnerships Manager at a nonprofit or think tank, or an Account Manager running corporate partnerships. Whatever your title, the people who succeed here bring two things: the skills to build relationships that produce real results, and a genuine commitment to PLF's mission of protecting individual liberty, property rights, and constitutional limits on government power.

What we're looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in government affairs, external relations, public policy, trade associations, corporate affairs, business development, strategic partnerships, public affairs, or a related field.
  • A demonstrated ability to build strong relationships with business leaders, industry associations, policymakers, or other stakeholders.
  • An understanding of how regulation and public policy affect businesses and economic opportunity.
  • A strategic, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to plan and execute independently.
  • Strong communication skills, a collaborative approach, and the confidence to engage senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional follow-through and the ability to manage multiple projects and relationships at once.
  • Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and eagerness to learn new industries, policy issues, and legal concepts.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for PLF's mission of advancing individual liberty, protecting property rights, and restoring constitutional limits on government power.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% of the year.

Bonus points for:

  • Existing relationships with corporations, trade associations, or business advocacy groups.
  • Experience with state legislatures, federal policymakers, or regulatory agencies, or with conferences such as ALEC, NCSL, or major trade association gatherings.
  • Experience with property rights, energy, permitting, housing, healthcare, occupational licensing, or administrative regulation.
  • A track record of turning relationships into tangible outcomes, such as legislative support, litigation referrals, or strategic partnerships.
  • Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM.

You don't need a law degree or litigation background. We're looking for someone who asks good questions, learns quickly, and knows how to bring the right people together.

General Information

PLF has offices in Sacramento, CA, and Arlington, VA, with about half of our staff working remotely across the country. This position is open to both in-office and fully remote candidates, with no preference given based on location.

The salary range is $80,000–$100,000, depending on experience. This is a full-time, permanent position with medical and dental insurance, parental leave, employer-paid retirement savings, generous paid leave, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for professional development and advancement.

How to apply

If you think you might be a good fit, submit the following application materials:

  • Your resume, including your experience in the liberty movement and relevant professional experience
  • A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants.

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective.

You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You’ll turn messy go-to-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You’ll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and build LLM-powered agents and workflows for use cases like account research, lead and account prioritization, outbound personalization, call summarization, deal inspection, renewal risk detection, and customer health insights.
  • Focus on end user experience to optimize delivery of content, process adherence and tool utilization
  • Integrate AI systems with the GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Marketo, Slack, Zoom, data warehouse, and enrichment providers).
  • Build and maintain data pipelines that unify product usage, CRM, marketing, and support data into reliable inputs for models and agents.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps leaders to translate business problems into technical solutions, and prioritize by revenue impact and effort.
  • Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption.
  • Use LaunchDarkly’s own products, such as feature flags, AI Configs, and experimentation, to roll out, test, and iterate on GTM AI systems safely.
  • Prototype quickly, then productionize the winners with solid engineering practices (testing, observability, documentation, access controls).
  • Enable GTM teams through training, documentation, and playbooks so AI tools are adopted and trusted.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and recommend build vs. buy decisions.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or ML/AI engineering experience (or equivalent hands-on experience) 
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL
  • Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs (prompt design, tool use/function calling, RAG, agent frameworks, structured outputs)
  • Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs and SaaS platforms, ideally CRM and sales engagement tools
  • Familiarity with data warehouses and transformation tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar)
  • Ability to evaluate and monitor AI system quality using test sets, human review, and automated evals
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • A bias toward shipping, iterating, and measuring outcomes

**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

jobs.title: Director of User Experience (UX) Research
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote (U.S.)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is hiring a Director of User Experience Research to lead our research team, drive a user-centered understanding of Players (the people who use Discord), and turn that understanding into a better product. You'll own the research strategy for Discord, build and lead a team of researchers, and make sure a deep, evidence-based understanding of user needs shapes what we build before decisions are made.

You'll uncover and forecast the problems our users face and the opportunities that will add the most value to Discord. You'll deepen our understanding of every user cohort, from longtime gamers to new communities, creators, moderators, and teens. And you'll make sure what we ship results in user value for them. As Discord brings more AI-powered experiences to users, you'll ensure they're grounded in real needs and held to a clear, user-centered quality bar. You'll also modernize how research gets done, using AI to increase our speed and reach without losing rigor.

You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Safety. This person will report to the VP of Product Design and Insights.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the research vision and make research a strategic partner. Own the research roadmap across Discord, balancing foundational, generative, and evaluative work and prioritizing by user impact, business impact, and risk. Deliver clear, compelling readouts that shape prioritization and go/no-go calls, and measure research's impact on product outcomes.
  • Uncover opportunities and build a shared understanding of our users. Lead foundational and generative research that surfaces unmet needs, pain points, and emerging behaviors, and use segmentation, longitudinal, and international research to understand how different user cohorts use Discord and where their needs differ, so teams design for real people instead of assumptions.
  • Own usability and concept validation. Establish a consistent program for testing concepts, prototypes, and live experiences, so teams learn early whether ideas are desirable, usable, and valuable before investing heavily.
  • Bring a mixed-methods lens to every major decision. Partner with Data Science to combine qualitative insight with quantitative evidence (surveys, behavioral data, experimentation) that explains both what users do and why. Define and track experience-health measures such as satisfaction, ease, and trust over time.
  • Define user-centered quality for AI-powered experiences. Work with Product, Engineering, and ML partners to set quality dimensions, rubrics, and human evaluation programs that complement automated and model-based evaluation, so AI features solve real Player problems and earn user trust.

  • Experience understanding and segmenting diverse user populations, ideally in consumer social, community, communication, or multi-sided platforms

  • A history of earning buy-in from executives and cross-functional partners by telling the user story and making the "so what" impossible to ignore

Bonus Points

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Datacraft team
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Senior Data Engineer for Bloomreach!

Join our newly formed Datacraft team — the team building the next-generation data platform that powers internal Databricks, the Loomi Marketing Agent with Data Insights capability for Bloomreach Marketing platform. Your engineering work will directly impact how hundreds of enterprise customers access, understand, and activate their Bloomreach data internally and with data share in Databricks and BigQuery.

The base salary range for this position at the P3 / Senior Software Engineer level is CZK 1 300 000 - CZK 1 600 000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Working in one of our Central European offices (Bratislava, Brno or Prague) or from home on a full-time basis, you'll become a core part of the Engineering team.

What challenge awaits you?

You will join the Datacraft team as one of its founding engineers. Datacraft is a new team in the Engagement pillar, established to tackle three interconnected domains:

  • Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain) — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. The strategic goal for 27 is to use Databricks to exponentially accelerate data adoption — both for customers who want their data outside Bloomreach and for Bloomreach itself to build analytics faster.
  • Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%) — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick.

Datacraft is an AI-first team. We believe code is a commodity and expect every engineer to fluently use coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI) as a core part of their daily workflow. The ability to leverage AI tooling to accelerate development, prototyping, and problem-solving is not optional — it's foundational. We rely heavily on knowledge graphs and spec driven development.

As a P3 (Senior) engineer at Bloomreach you are an independent professional — expert in at least one component, able to decompose objectives into tasks, and lead small projects end-to-end with minimal day-to-day guidance.

Your job will be to:

  • a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. Own data models and ETL mutations for ID resolution and consent semantics. Maintain orchestration (Airflow / Cloud Composer) and monitoring.
  • b. Co-build dashboards & analytics stack — Design canonical metrics and models on Databricks, support semantic layers and BI tools (Cube, Looker Studio), ensure tight Marketing Agent (Insights skill) integration.

Our tech stack

Python, Go, Kafka, Databricks, Airflow, Flink (Java), GCP, Mongo, Redis, Airflow, DataProc, Spark, Apache Flink, Databricks, Kubernetes, Terraform, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, GitLab CI/CD, Claude Code

Your success story

30 Days: Understand the Datacraft domain, complete onboarding, set up your dev environment, and get oriented on Databricks architecture and Marketing Agent.

90 Days: Ship your first pipeline, data model, or orchestration improvement to production. Join architecture discussions and the on-call rotation.

180 Days: Own a component end-to-end. Make informed trade-off decisions independently. Contribute to measurable team goals.

You have the following experience and qualities:

Professional experience

  • Solid data engineering background with strong SQL and data modeling skills (star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning/clustering, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade data pipelines on Databricks and GCP, ideally involving Flink, Iceberg, Spark on DataProc.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow tools — specifically Airflow / Cloud Composer — and comfort working with DAG-based systems for scheduled and event-driven jobs.
  • Familiarity with open table formats (Iceberg preferred, Delta Lake / Hudi acceptable) and how they interact with query engines and DWH platforms.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); Scala/Java/Go also relevant.
  • Good understanding of data quality, lineage, and observability (monitoring SLAs/SLOs, detecting missing/late loads, backfilling strategies).
  • Ability to work across product and engineering teams, turning fuzzy problem statements into incremental, shippable slices.

Strongly preferred

  • Background in marketing analytics, CDPs, or BI/semantic layers (Looker, dbt, Cube).
  • Experience with Snowflake or Databricks or BigQuery.
  • Experience with spec driven development, knowledge graphs, agentic harnesses or AI-powered analytics

Personal qualities

Ownership & accountability · Sharp and Product thinking · Clear communication · Bias for reliability · Continuous improvement mindset · Comfortable remote-first in Central Europe.

#LI-KP1

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

  • We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

  • We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

  • We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

  • The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

  • We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

  • Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

  • Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

  • Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

  • The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

  • Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

  • We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

  • We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

Compensation:
