jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building an accounting & finance software that will be industry-defining, and we need someone to help Rillet transition to the next company phase. We’ve grown quickly over the past few months and are expanding our GTM team to accelerate this trajectory. You’ll work directly with the CEO, the GTM, and the Product teams to help prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. As an early member of Rillet's GTM team, you’ll be uniquely positioned to build strategies, test hypotheses, and lay the foundation for Rillet’s GTM motion for the future.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City, San Francisco or Chicago offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.

What You'll Do

  • Remove technical objections
    You’ll play a key role in the sales cycle by addressing all technical questions of potential customers. Specifically, you’ll understand their business requirements and existing technology stack, clearly articulate how Rillet will be integrated, and improve their processes. You’ll take part in sales conversations and will be able to answer the vast majority of technical questions immediately, without the need to circle back with the Product team.

  • Perform sales demonstrations
    You’ll set up the sandbox environment and tailor the data to showcase each customer's key specific use cases. You’ll deliver high-impact demonstrations, answering questions along the way and adapting based on the customer’s needs. You’ll be their consultant in the purchase process.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in close to real-time. You will experiment with different demo styles, help write thoughtful follow-ups to customers, and become a highly responsive advisor to our prospective customers. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company and will apply high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is delightful. You’re comfortable marketing to a user with high finance and accounting proficiency, and your knowledge about the domain will be furthered in the process.

Who We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience, involving various accounting areas including revenue recognition, month-end close, and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 2+ years of experience supporting the sales cycle with implementation and/or customer support for accounting/financial solutions.

  • Knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who can make complex concepts easy to understand and knows how to write and speak conversationally.

  • Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment while keeping a high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit, a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (North America)
jobs.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

🎯 The Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Revenue team and help us expand Filigran’s footprint across the North America region. Your mission is to identify, engage, and qualify new enterprise opportunities — fueling our growth by connecting security leaders with Filigran’s open-source and commercial solutions.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to turn market interest into meaningful conversations, driving the pipeline that powers Filigran’s mission to make cyber defense more proactive and connected.

💼 Your Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and engage potential enterprise customers across the NA region.

  • Proactively generate outbound opportunities through targeted outreach.

  • Build relationships with CISOs, security engineers, and threat intelligence professionals.

  • Qualify prospects through outreach (phone calls, emails, social media) and structured lead scoring to ensure strong fit and intent.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to book and hand off high-quality meetings that lead to new revenue.

  • Maintain accurate and organized activity tracking within HubSpot.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine messaging, campaigns, and regional strategies.

  • Represent Filigran at virtual and regional industry events to expand awareness and engagement.

🤝 Who You’ll Work With

  • Reports directly to Sam Weiss, Manager – BDR

  • Collaborates daily with Account Executives and Marketing teams

  • Works closely with the global Revenue organization to align on pipeline goals and regional strategies

  • Joins a team that values collaboration, curiosity, and continuous improvement

🧬 Profile We’re Looking For

  • 1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise software

  • Track record of success in outbound prospecting and lead qualification

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across multiple cultures and time zones

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and resilience in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar tools

  • Bonus: Experience engaging enterprise customers in the NA market or cybersecurity domain knowledge

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

🚀 Ready to Join Us?

Apply now and help us build the future of the cybersecurity ecosystem, together.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

Remote positions open to the US only.

The HR Business Partner (Global Functional Lead) is a strategic global lead responsible for defining the "what" of the talent agenda for their assigned business functions. Operating within a matrixed global model, this role owns the talent strategy, organizational design, and leadership coaching for their functional client groups worldwide.

The HRBP acts as the primary strategic architect, partnering with Regional HR Leaders (who own the "how" and local execution) to ensure a consistent, high-performance employee experience across all geographies.

Responsibilities:

Functional Talent Strategy & Org Design (The "What")

  • Global Strategic Lead: Identify root-cause business challenges for assigned functions and translate them into a multi-year global HR roadmap.
  • Organizational Architecture: Lead organizational design and restructuring initiatives for the function, ensuring global scalability and alignment with company goals.
  • Succession & Talent Reviews: Own the annual global talent review and succession planning process for the function, identifying high-potential talent and bridging leadership gaps.
  • Workforce Planning: Partner with Finance and Functional Heads to lead global headcount planning and talent acquisition prioritization.

Matrix Collaboration (Functional vs. Regional)

  • Regional Partnership: Collaborate with Regional HR Leaders (Americas, EMEA, APJ) to adapt global functional strategies to local legal and cultural requirements.
  • One Voice to Leadership: Serve as the primary point of contact for the function's senior-most global leaders, ensuring they receive coherent and coordinated HR support.
  • Global Consistency: Ensure HR programs (Performance, Compensation, DEI) are implemented with consistency across all regions for the specific function.
  • Operational Handoffs: Manage explicit handoffs to Regional HR for local Employee Relations, compliance, and office-specific culture initiatives.
  • Information Exchange: Ensure vital information is flowing between yourself, the function you’re supporting, and the regional HR leaders. Empowerment through coordination and collaboration is the way!

Leadership Coaching & Performance

  • Executive Advisory: Act as a trusted sounding board and coach for senior executives on people-related decisions, org health, and leadership behavior.
  • Proactive Performance: Partner with Employee Relations and Regional HR to inculcate a high-performance culture, guiding managers on talent assessment and complex performance management.
  • Compensation Strategy: Collaborate with the Total Rewards COE to broker scalable compensation and pay-equity strategies that align with functional benchmarks.

COE & Operational Integration

  • COE Liaison: Interface with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Total Rewards to deliver specialized solutions that address functional pain points.
  • Systems Optimization: Advocate for and help accelerate "Manager Self-Service" and automation in partnership with HR Operations to improve the functional user experience (UX).

Employee Relations Support

  • US Case Support: Partner with Employee Relations to help cover and support any overflow cases (US only). This includes direct work on disciplinary items, investigations, grievance resolution, and offboards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in HR, Business, or a related field (Master’s/MBA preferred).
  • 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a strategic HRBP capacity supporting global/matrixed organizations.
  • Matrix Navigation: Proven ability to influence across reporting lines—balancing global functional needs with regional operational realities.
  • Outside-In Thinking: Ability to develop HR solutions starting with the business client’s needs and moving toward process design.
  • Strategic Diplomacy: Exceptional communication skills; ability to manage "Functional vs. Regional" tensions and escalate issues via defined protocols.
  • Systems Fluency: Proficiency with Workday and a data-driven approach to HR analytics.
  • Discretion: Expert-level judgment in handling highly confidential executive-level matters.
  • Exceptional Collaboration: This role will need to collaborate with HRBPs, regional HR teams, and COE teams.

  • Preferred Location: Proximity to our Arlington, Clearwater, or New York offices is an added bonus.

The compensation for this position ranges from $100,000 - $120,000, which will vary depending on how well an applicant's skills and experience align with the job description listed above.

Application deadline: 12/11/2026. This is our good-faith estimate of the date the application window is anticipated to close. KnowBe4 reviews applications on a rolling basis and reserves the right to close the application window early if a qualified candidate for the position is identified.

Our Fantastic Benefits

We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits.

Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure.

Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation.

No recruitment agencies, please.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Trusted by 800,000 monthly active users, UpCodes (YC S17) is a comprehensive compliance and product research platform that accelerates design to construction in the AEC space. The construction industry suffers from unnecessary costs and complexity; every year billions of dollars are wasted on rework. We’re committed to delivering easy-to-use tools that help designers and builders spend less time finding the right compliance and product resources and more time doing what they love — designing and building. We make a real-world, tangible impact on the lives of our users and their work of constructing our homes, schools, hospitals, and offices.

ABOUT THE ROLE

UpCodes has grown organically across architecture firms, government agencies, and key players in the AEC industry. We have one Customer Success Manager today, and we’re hiring our first Manager of Customer Success to shape how the function works from here.

You’ll define how we measure customer health, set targets for the team, and create the processes that allow Customer Success to scale with our customer base. You’ll also stay hands-on with customers while the team grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Manager of Customer Success, you’ll have a direct and significant impact on how our customers succeed with UpCodes and how we grow with them. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and mentor our current CSM, and plan, hire, and train a high-performing team as we grow, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Support, and Product.

  • Hands-On Leadership: Until the team is in place, you’ll be on customer calls, running onboardings and trainings, and handling escalations. You’ll stay hands-on as the team grows.

  • Strategy and KPIs: Work backward from company priorities to set goals for the team. Evaluate our current metrics, such as retention, expansion, and adoption, set ambitious targets for improvement, and lead the team in achieving them.

  • Customer Health: Develop a customer health score based on product usage, engagement, and renewal signals, and monitor it regularly to flag at-risk revenue and expansion opportunities early.

  • Scalable Systems: Create the playbooks, workflows, and automations that enable the team to efficiently support a growing customer base.

  • Customer Knowledge Base: Build and maintain a knowledge base of guides and help articles so customers can find answers on their own.

  • Reporting and Dashboards: Build reports and dashboards that give the team and leadership clear visibility into customer health and trends.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

  • Experience in Customer Success: 7+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS or tech company, including at least two years managing CSMs.

    • Have hired, trained, and mentored team members

    • Have built a scalable Customer Success system, such as health scoring, playbooks, or lifecycle automation

    • Have owned KPIs and driven measurable improvements

    • Have hands-on experience building reports and dashboards

  • Data-driven: You use data to set the right targets and find the most effective solutions. Your decisions are backed by clear, defensible reasoning, but you also appreciate the role of intuition and conviction.

  • Open to feedback: You ask for feedback, take it well, and use it to get better. You're comfortable juggling several priorities at once and learning as you go.

  • You sweat the small stuff: You notice the details, like a missed follow-up or a messy handoff, and you set a high bar for quality on your team.

NICE TO HAVE

  • AI Fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and have used them to make your team more efficient, whether that’s analyzing account data, building reports, or automating parts of the CS workflow.

  • Startup Experience: You’ve worked at a fast-moving tech startup or an AI-native company, and you’re comfortable building without a playbook.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Tech Lead - NetBox Core
jobs.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead for NetBox Core, a team in our Applications group.

NetBox is a product that reaches people in a few ways: our open source community runs NetBox OSS; commercial customers use NetBox Cloud (SaaS) or NetBox Enterprise (self-managed). NetBox Core builds NetBox and its core plugins, the code that runs everywhere NetBox runs. We work closely with NetBox Delivery, the team that ships NetBox and runs it on Cloud and Enterprise.

As Tech Lead, you set the technical direction for NetBox Core and stay hands-on in the code. You bring deep Django and Python skills, experience running Django in production SaaS at scale, and a good understanding of Kubernetes and SRE practices.

In this role you will:

  • Design and build NetBox and its core plugins, across the data model, business logic, APIs, and integrations

  • Own the technical direction and architecture of NetBox and its core plugins, as the team's primary technical decision maker

  • Keep NetBox fast and reliable as data and usage grow, from query performance to background jobs

  • Drive NetBox releases, including versioning, release notes, and the release cadence

  • Lead and mentor the team's engineers through design and code review, and set the team's standards for testing and documentation

  • Take part in community contributions and public design discussions on GitHub

  • Work with NetBox Delivery and the Cloud, Enterprise, and Foundations teams to build observability into NetBox, define release contracts, and drive cross-team changes through RFCs

  • Act as a technical escalation point during incidents and make sure postmortem actions get done

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including technical ownership of a production system or platform area

  • Deep Python and Django expertise, including running a Django SaaS application in production at scale

  • A track record of finding and fixing Django performance problems, including ORM query optimization, Postgres indexing and query plans, schema design, and migration risk on large tables

  • Production experience with background job queues such as RQ or Celery, and message brokers such as Redis or RabbitMQ

  • Experience building observability into applications, including error reporting, distributed tracing, metrics, and structured logging, with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Sentry

  • A working understanding of how Python applications run on Kubernetes, and of SRE practices such as SLOs, incident response, and postmortems

  • Experience leading engineering work without formal manager authority, including mentoring other engineers

  • Hands-on experience building inside an AI-augmented development harness, including Claude Code and the workflows that make agentic tooling reliable

  • A track record of making technical decisions under ambiguity and driving work across team boundaries, from writing the RFC to getting a cross-team migration done

  • Comfort working in the open, including discussing designs in public issues, reviewing community contributions, and writing user-facing documentation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience building deep inside Django's internals, such as the app registry, model metadata, and the schema editor, for example to create models at runtime as our Custom Objects plugin does

  • Experience with the parts of the Django ecosystem NetBox uses, such as Django REST Framework, GraphQL with Strawberry, django-filter, and django-mptt

  • Experience with advanced Postgres features, such as schemas for multi-tenancy or branching, advisory locks, and connection pooling

  • Hands-on experience with several tools in our delivery stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Helm, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD, Terraform, and Prometheus and Grafana

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup or high-growth organization

  • Familiarity with the NetBox ecosystem or network automation

  • Contributions to or maintenance of an open source project

  • Experience with self-managed or on-premises delivery

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Marketing Programs Associate
jobs.description:
About Axiom

Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. Axiom serves over half the Fortune 100 with market leading NPS ratings from both its clients and employees.

About the role

We're looking for an energetic, detail-obsessed Marketing Specialist to support our Marketing Programs team. Each channel (email, events and social) already has an owner who sets its strategy. You'll partner with those owners and take on the hands-on, task-level work that brings their plans to life, side by side with marketers in the US, UK and APAC.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes a fast pace and a full plate. You'll turn approved plans into finished campaigns, keep projects moving on deadline, and make sure everything we put out sounds and looks like us.

It's also a role with room to grow. You'll see how a global B2B marketing engine works end to end, and you'll build skills across strategy, content, operations and events.

What you'll do

Each channel owner sets strategy and makes final decisions. Your focus is execution: building, coordinating, tracking and quality-checking the work so owners can spend more time on strategy.

Email marketing

  • Support the email owner by building, designing and QA-ing campaigns in HubSpot, from newsletters to event invitations to nurture sequences.
  • Draft and edit email copy, subject lines and calls to action that match our brand voice.
  • Manage lists and segments in partnership with marketing operations, using HubSpot and Salesforce data.
  • Run A/B tests and report on opens, clicks and conversions, and share findings with the email owner.

Events

  • Support event owners with planning and logistics for client events, webinars, conferences and sponsorships across regions.
  • Coordinate vendors, venues, timelines, shipping and onsite materials within approved budgets.
  • Run event promotion, registration and attendee communications before and after each event.
  • Track event leads and attendance in Salesforce and support post-event follow-up.

Social media

  • Draft and schedule LinkedIn and other company posts, following the social owner's content strategy.
  • Repurpose thought leadership, case studies and event moments into short, engaging posts.
  • Maintain the social content calendar and report on engagement and growth.

Program support and project management

  • Support integrated campaigns across all channels, from brief to launch to results.
  • Keep projects on track in our project management tool (Wrike, Asana or Monday.com), including timelines, tasks and approvals.
  • Help produce campaign reporting and dashboards for the Marketing Programs team.
  • Proofread and quality-check materials for accuracy, consistency and brand standards.

Cross-team and global collaboration

  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for every member of the marketing team.
  • Partner with our UK and APAC field marketing leaders to localize and execute campaigns and events in their regions.
  • Work with sales, practice leaders and subject matter experts to gather content and align on priorities.
  • Coordinate across time zones and keep stakeholders informed on status and next steps.

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of hands-on marketing experience, in-house or at an agency.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Working experience with HubSpot (email, lists, landing pages, reporting) and Salesforce (campaigns, leads, contacts).
  • Experience with a project management tool such as Wrike, Asana or Monday.com.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a portfolio or samples of email, social or campaign copy.
  • Exceptional attention to detail. You catch the typo, the broken link and the wrong date before anyone else does.
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment without dropping the ball.
  • Clear, proactive communication with colleagues at every level and across regions.
  • High energy, a positive attitude and a genuine willingness to roll up your sleeves.

Nice to have

  • Experience in professional services (consulting, legal, accounting, advisory) or another B2B environment.
  • HubSpot Marketing Hub or Email Marketing certification.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-region marketing teams.
  • Basic design skills in Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud or Figma.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, social scheduling tools or event platforms such as Cvent or ON24.
  • Comfort with marketing analytics and building simple reports in Excel or HubSpot.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you'll:

  • Learn our brand voice, audiences, systems, and campaign calendar.
  • Independently build and launch HubSpot email campaigns from approved briefs.
  • Own logistics for at least one event or webinar from planning through follow-up.
  • Take over day-to-day scheduling of company social content.

By the end of your first year, you'll:

  • Be the go-to person for campaign execution across email, events and social.
  • Support regional programs alongside our UK and APAC field marketing leaders.
  • Bring data-backed ideas to improve engagement and campaign results.
  • Help free up senior team members to focus on strategy and growth.

jobs.title: Deployment Lead - Accounting Solutions
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 700 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Deployment Lead to join our team and help lead the successful onboarding of new customers onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong accounting foundation who is excited to work directly with customers and help finance teams modernize how they operate. You may come from Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, finance transformation, or an operational accounting role at a high-growth technology company. You do not need to have formally led ERP implementations before, but you do need to be systems-minded, highly organized, customer-oriented, and eager to learn quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

We’re primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City, San Francisco or Chicago offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead key parts of customer onboarding and deployment, helping ensure a smooth and timely implementation experience

  • Partner with internal teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to execute implementation plans and solve customer problems quickly

  • Learn and analyze client accounting and finance workflows, then translate those needs into clear requirements and practical solutions

  • Guide customers through onboarding, training, change management, and adoption

  • Support data migration, reconciliations, systems setup, and integration coordination

  • Track milestones, drive follow-through, and keep internal and external stakeholders aligned throughout the onboarding process

  • Identify risks early, escalate issues quickly, and help keep customer launches on track

  • Build trust with customers by being responsive, thoughtful, and solutions-oriented

  • Maintain clear documentation and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders

Who We're Looking For

  • 4-8 years of experience in accounting, audit, advisory, or related customer-facing roles

  • Strong accounting foundation, with the ability to speak credibly about close, reconciliations, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and core finance workflows

  • Excellent communication skills and the presence to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders

  • Systems-minded and excited to learn implementation work, even if you have not formally held an implementation title before

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams at once

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

  • Experience in Big 4, SaaS or at a technology company is a plus

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

jobs.title: Account Director (Network Testing & Planning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director (Network Testing & Planning) based in the United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.

Accountabilities:

Take full ownership of territory revenue targets, sales pipeline development, and forecasting across the UK, Ireland, and assigned strategic European accounts. Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans aligned with business growth objectives and commercial priorities. Expand existing strategic customer relationships through account penetration, upselling, cross-selling, and the development of new business opportunities. Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers across the mobile network testing, planning, optimisation, and broader telecommunications ecosystem. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders within target accounts. Understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, and operational requirements, translating them into compelling commercial opportunities and tailored value propositions. Develop robust business cases demonstrating measurable customer benefits, supporting larger-scale engagements and long-term partnerships. Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting, qualification, and discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract closure. Identify competitive displacement opportunities and position alternative network testing and planning solutions to increase market share. Explore new market segments and addressable opportunities, including private networks, neutral hosts, infrastructure providers, engineering service companies, and adjacent telecommunications markets. Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and channel relationships to strengthen market coverage and create additional routes to market. Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams on technical qualification, product demonstrations, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance. Strengthen customer and partner relationships to generate repeat business, increase engagement value, and establish sustainable revenue streams.

Requirements:

Demonstrated success in B2B technology sales, with a proven track record of managing and achieving revenue targets and sales quotas. Significant experience selling to telecommunications operators, network equipment vendors, or organisations operating within the broader mobile network ecosystem. Strong understanding of mobile network technologies and the processes involved in planning, deploying, testing, optimising, and operating mobile networks. Proven ability to develop existing strategic accounts while successfully identifying and acquiring new customers. Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders. Excellent account planning, business development, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and closing capabilities. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to build compelling business cases, demonstrating measurable customer value beyond product features or pricing. Experience working closely with technical presales and solution engineering teams while maintaining ownership of commercial strategy and sales outcomes. Strong pipeline management, revenue forecasting, CRM discipline, and sales performance reporting skills. Ability to work autonomously across a geographically distributed territory while collaborating effectively within an international organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and build trusted customer relationships. Previous experience in network testing, drive testing, network planning, RF optimisation, network performance, or related telecommunications software and solutions would be a significant advantage. Experience gained within telecom software providers, network equipment manufacturers, test and measurement companies, engineering consultancies, service organisations, or technology suppliers serving mobile network operators is particularly relevant. Knowledge of the competitive landscape for network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions would be highly desirable. A proactive, results-oriented, and entrepreneurial mindset, with strong relationship-building skills and the ability to identify and pursue new commercial opportunities.

Benefits:

Competitive compensation package and benefits. Fully remote working arrangement within the UK. Flexible working hours and adaptable working locations. Inclusive and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Poland - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:  

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Backend Reliability (BRE) team is the backbone of our backend infrastructure and the guardian of our uptime. Our mission is to achieve and sustain 99.99% availability while building the tools, components, and safety nets that the entire engineering organization relies on. As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure.

Your Impact:  

  • Design, build, and maintain critical reliability components such as HTTP rate limiters, internal DB schema migration tools, circuit breakers, and distributed Redis-based caching.  
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize PostgreSQL usage, and ensure our distributed systems remain performant and stable under high load.  
  • Lead preliminary investigations during severe production incidents: identify likely root causes, assess impact, and propose mitigation options. The long-term fixes are then implemented by the owning team, based on your findings.  
  • Create scalable, reusable tools and frameworks that help other engineering teams build more resilient services.  
  • Leverage AI-powered tools and coding agents to accelerate development, analyze architectures, and automate repetitive or error-prone tasks.  
  • Influence reliability best practices across engineering by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs, and setting high technical standards.

Your Qualifications:  

  • Strong expertise with Java/JVM, building scalable, high-performance backend systems; open to leveraging other languages when appropriate.  
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including high availability, CAP theorem, and fault tolerance.  
  • Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and key–value / non-relational storages (Redis).  
  • Practical experience with containerization and cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes.  
  • Hands-on experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.  
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, using critical thinking to question assumptions and validate your own decisions.  
  • Strong written and spoken English skills suitable for collaborating in an international engineering environment.

Standout Qualities:  

  • Background in infrastructure engineering or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), including infrastructure-as-code practices.  
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, driving cross-team projects, and mentoring other engineers while remaining an individual contributor.  
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., Graylog, Zabbix, Grafana) and/or data analytics tools such as BigQuery.  
  • A strong interest in how complex systems fail and a track record of designing them to recover gracefully.

Team Dynamics:  

You will join the Backend Reliability (BRE) team, a small, highly specialized, senior group focused solely on Wrike’s reliability. The team operates as an internal “reliability task force,” partnering closely with product and platform engineering teams across the company. You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. The culture is ownership-driven: you are trusted to manage your time, make architectural decisions, and drive initiatives to completion.

Our Work Style:  

The BRE team works on core backend and infrastructure services that support millions of users. We operate in a collaborative environment that values clear communication, thoughtful design, and fast feedback loops.  

  • Tech focus areas include: Java/JVM-based services, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ/Kafka, and observability/monitoring tools.  
  • We encourage the use of modern AI-based tooling and coding agents as part of daily development and troubleshooting workflows.  
  • Work is organized with an emphasis on impact and reliability goals rather than ticket volume, giving you room for deep work and long-term improvements.  
  • Hybrid work mode (Prague, Czech Republic / Nicosia, Cyprus), with flexibility to balance focused individual work and collaborative sessions.

What’s next?

  • Interview with a Recruiter
  • Technical interview
  • System Design Interview
  • Cultural interview 

Your recruitment buddy will be Aleksandar Chernev, Senior Technical Recruiter.

#LI-AC1 

 

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wrike-staff-software-engineer-1

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) team, you will build a portfolio of clients by prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing new accounts. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, and management consulting. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a territory from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts from scratch - identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.

  • Working closely with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities while also expanding existing relationships.
  • You’ll operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment, working alongside pre-sales experts and delivery teams to craft compelling, tailored solutions for each client.
  • Your initial portfolio will scale toward an annualized gross sales target of $1M in your first year, with expectations to grow into a $5M book by years 2–3, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

We are seeking scrappy, bold, client-obsessed professionals who are energized by face-to-face interaction, inspired by client success, and motivated to close high-impact deals. This is not a “work from your home office” role. We’re looking for professionals who are ready to get in the field, build lasting relationships, and lead with purpose.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal, learning the core of our model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
  • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
  • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Work with your Portfolio Leader to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
  • Begin to meet with clients, articulate Toptal’s capabilities, and identify where we can help organizations in your territory plan.
  • Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
  • Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
  • Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
  • Meet with Sales Development Representatives and Client Partners and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
  • Collaborate with Pre-Sales Solutions and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Conduct research and outreach through multiple channels to uncover new business opportunities within your accounts and drive sales pursuits with cross-functional Toptal teams.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage Toptal’s engineering, design, and business specialists.
  • Provide consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
  • Provide advice and support for the planning of long term or short term business objectives or initiatives.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have an initial base of active clients, while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
  • Develop a network of client relationships and build a foundation of advocates and sponsors to expand Toptal’s partnership with existing accounts in alignment with your portfolio strategy.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our talent network to build world-class distributed teams and increase efficiency.
  • Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
  • Continue to expand your portfolio of accounts, accelerate growth in your region, and use the full suite of capabilities that Toptal has to offer.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Extensive experience in engaging and selling Consulting or Managed Services solutions, particularly within Financial Services or Professional Services organizations.
  • Proven track record in full-cycle sales of large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
  • A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
  • Ability to build and execute territory plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
  • Proven success in prospecting, running virtual sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location (25% or less).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager - Health Plans
jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.

The Commercial team at H1 plays a crucial role in shaping the future of our business. Our mission is to connect the world to the right doctors by partnering with health insurance & health plans companies to create a better patient experience. We aim to deeply understand our customers' needs and workflows to provide simple, innovative solutions that solve their problems.

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
As an Account Manager on our Health Plans Team, you will manage a strategic book of business within our existing health plan and insurance company clients. You will demonstrate the value of our platforms and partnerships to strengthen current relationships and expand our footprint within those accounts, supporting our market leadership in the industry.

You will:
- Manage and grow key client accounts by retaining existing revenue and expanding opportunities within assigned health plans companies.
- Engage with C-suite executives and key decision-makers to align H1’s solutions with their strategic priorities.
- Lead the expansion sales process within your accounts, including discovery calls, presentations, contract negotiations, and deal execution.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, and product teams to ensure seamless client experiences and successful implementations.
- Track and report sales performance, providing accurate forecasts and strategic insights to support company growth objectives.

ABOUT YOU

You’re an experienced account management professional with a background in enterprise B2B SaaS/PaaS/IaaS technology. You have a track record of building trusted relationships, retaining existing accounts, and identifying expansion opportunities. You know how to gather requirements, understand customer use cases, set proper expectations, demo platforms, and guide an enterprise sales cycle.
- You’re proactive, resourceful, and take ownership of outcomes, with a collaborative approach that fits a lean startup environment where everyone is encouraged to participate in and contribute across all teams
- Dedication to the creation of a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where teammates are celebrated for their unique perspectives and work together to simplify healthcare for all

REQUIREMENTS

- 6+ years of experience successfully selling enterprise B2B SaaS/ PaaS or IaaS technology, including managing renewals and expansion.
- Prior experience and success in closing complex sales-cycles in the $1.5M+ ARR range
- Strong communication and consultative sales skills
- Comfortable with traveling to customers 20% of the time

COMPENSATION

This role pays $180,000 to $205,000 per year, based on experience, plus variable commission, based on performance, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units.

Anticipated role close date: 12/14/2026

Compensation

Additional Information

H1 OFFERS

- Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off

- Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays

- Retirement options

- Health & charitable donation stipends

- Impactful Business Resource Groups

- The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

H1 is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter once you've begun the interview process. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, Consumer Products and Services
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Consumer Products & Services (CP&S) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients and secure new business bookings. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into organizations where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial deals. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into meaningful revenue.

You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing the first revenue booking. Working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders, you will develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. You will partner with Client Partners to ensure a seamless transition following the initial booking, allowing you to remain focused on what you do best: opening new doors and winning new clients.

We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep Consumer Products & Services industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing consumer products, retail, and services organizations, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.

Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rethinking how work gets done across brand and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S team already partners with some of the world’s largest consumer products organizations to help address these challenges. You will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help new clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.

Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement and field activity. Candidates based on within commutable distance of a major East Coast metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across Consumer Products & Services. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business.

Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Following the initial revenue booking, new clients transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams.

  • Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across consumer products, retail, and services organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business.
  • Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your CP&S industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline.
  • Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within organizations where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship.
  • Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the commercial, operational, and technology challenges shaping the consumer products and retail industries.
  • Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and securing the initial revenue booking.
  • Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate competitive enterprise buying processes.
  • Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Work with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, marketing, consulting, and managed services solutions addressing client challenges across digital commerce, supply chain, customer experience, commercial operations, and business transformation.
  • Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution.
  • Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing booked revenue.
  • Execute clean client transitions. Ensure commercial commitments, initial booking details, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition.
  • Build a strong market presence. Spend meaningful time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, CP&S industry events, referrals, and direct engagement.

We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and securing business that would not exist without your efforts.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities.
  • Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes.

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into financial institutions where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial engagements. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into signed deals.

You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing new business. Working in close partnership with our Client Partners, you will ensure a seamless transition from acquisition to account growth, maintaining strategic alignment throughout the handoff. This collaborative model allows you to focus on what you do best: building relationships, opening new doors, and winning new business, while Client Partners drive ongoing account management and expansion.

We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep BFSI industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing banks, financial services organizations, and insurers, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you.

Financial institutions are navigating significant change, from modernizing legacy technology and operating models to adopting AI, improving customer experiences, managing risk, and driving greater operational efficiency. At Toptal, you will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help clients address these challenges and accelerate their most important initiatives. You will have access to exceptional delivery expertise, industry leadership, and a global talent network, giving you the flexibility to shape solutions around what clients actually need.

Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts.

This is a remote position with an expectation of regular client-facing engagement and field activity. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
